1CH 2:28	Bana bamu a ba Onamu banali Shamai banali Nadabu na Abisha.
1CH 2:29	Zina ya mukazi wa Abisha yenzeli Abihail, ndipo anamubalila enve Abani na Molidi.
1CH 2:30	Bana bamuna Nadabu banali Seledi na Apayamu, koma Seledi anafa alibe bana.
1CH 2:31	Mwana mwamuna wa Apayamu anali Ishi. Mwana mwamuna wa Ishi enzeli Sheshani. Mwana mwamuna wa Sheshan enzeli Alayi.
1CH 2:32	Bana bamuna ba Jada, mulongo wa Shamai, benzeli Jeta na Jonathan. Jeta anafa alibe bana.
1CH 2:33	Bana bamuna ba Jonathan banali Peleti na Zaza. Aba banali bobadwa mumbuyo mwa Jeramil.
1CH 2:34	Manje Sheshamu analibe bana bamuna, anali chabe na bana bakazi. Sheshamu enzeli na wanchito, waku Iguputo, zina yake enzeli Jaha.
1CH 2:35	Sheshan anapasa mwana wake mukazi kuli Jaha wanchito wake kunkala mukazi wake. Anamubalila enve Attai.
1CH 2:36	Atayi anankala tate wa nathan, ndipo Nathan anankala tate wa Zabadi.
1CH 2:37	Zabadi anankala ate wa Efalli, na Efali tate wa Obadi.
1CH 2:38	Obedi anankala tate  wa Jehu, na Jehu anankala Jehu tate wa Azaria.
1CH 2:39	Azaria anankala tate wa Helezi, ndipo Helezi anankala ate wa Eleasa.
1CH 2:40	Eleasa ananakala tate wa Sisimai, ndipo Sisimai anankala ate wa Shallumu.
1CH 2:41	Shallumu anankala tate wa Jekamya, na Jekamya anankala Elishama.
1CH 2:42	Bana bamuna ba Calebu, Mulongo wa Jeramil, banali Mesha oyamba , wamene enzeli tate wa Ziph. Mwana mwamuna wa namba tu, Maresh, enzeli tate wa Hebroni.
1CH 2:43	Bana bamuna ba Hebroni benzeli Kora, Tapuwa, Rekemu, na Shema.
1CH 2:44	Shema anankala tate Rahamu, tate wa Jorkemu. Rekemu anankala tate wa Shamai.
1CH 2:45	Mwana mwamuna wa Shamayi enzeli Maoni, ndipo Moani  anali taet wa Beti Za.
1CH 2:46	Efa, Mainini wa Kalebu, anabala Haran, Moza, ndipo, na Gazez. harani anankala tate wa Gazezi.
1CH 2:47	Bana bamuna ba Jadai banali Regemu, Jotamu, Geshani, Peleti, Efa, na Shafu.
1CH 2:48	Maaka, mdzakazi wa Kalebe, anabala Seberi ndi Tiranahana.
1CH 2:49	Anaberekanso Shaafi bambo wa Madimana, Seva bambo wa Makibena ndi Gibeya. Mwana wamkazi wa Kalebe anali Akisa. Awa anali zidzukulu za Kalebe.
1CH 2:50	Aba ndiye banali bobadwa mumbuyo mwa Kalebu. Bana bamuna ba Ha oyamba wa Efrati: Shobali tate Kiriati Jearimu,
1CH 2:51	Salma tate wa Bethlehemu, na Harepu tate wa Beth Gader.
1CH 2:52	Shobali tate wa Kiriati Jearim anali na obadwa mumbuyo: Haroeh, pakati pama manahatites,
1CH 2:53	ndi ma banja ya Kiririati Jearimu: Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathies, na Mishraites. Obadwa mumbuyo mwa Zorathites na Eshtaolites banachokela uko.
1CH 2:54	Bobadwa mumbuyo mwa Salma benzeli Bethlehemu, Baku Netofatites, Atroti Beti Joabu, na pakati pa manahathites-mu Zorites,
1CH 2:55	nama banja yabolemba benzekunkala pa Jabezi: ma Tirathites, Shimeathites, na Sucathites. Aba ndiye banali ma Kenites bana chokela kuli Hamati, tate wa nyumba ya Rekabu.
1CH 3:0	Mutu 3
1CH 3:1	Manje aba ndiye banali bana bamuna ba Davide bamene banabadwa kwa iyi mu Heburoni: oyamba anali Amnoni, kuli Ahinoamu waku Jezril; wachi bili anali Daniel, ku chokela kuli Abigail waku Kamel;
1CH 3:2	wa chi tatu enzeli Absalomu, ba mai bake banali Maka, mwana mukazi wa Talmai mfumu yaku Gesha. Wa namabala fo anali Adonija mwana wa Haggiti;
1CH 3:3	wa namabala faivi anali Shefati kuli Abital; wa namabala sikisi anali Itreamu kuli mukazi wake Egla.
1CH 3:4	Aba sikisi bana badwa kuli Davide kuli Heburoni, kwamene analamulila zaka seveni na myezi sikisi. Ndipo analamulia  Jerusalema zaka sate fili.
1CH 3:5	Aba bana bamuna bali fo, ba Batisheba mwana mukazi wa Ammiel, baba badwa kuli enve mu Jerusalema: Shamwa, Shobabu, Nathan, na Solomoni.
1CH 3:6	Bana benangu ba Davidi bali naini benzeli: Ibhar, Elshuwa, Elifeleti,
1CH 3:7	Noga, Nefagi, Japfia,
1CH 3:8	Elishama, Eliada, na Elifaleti.
1CH 3:9	Aba benzeli bana bamuna ba Davidi, osakilako bana bana bamuna bakuli ma mainini. Tama ezeli mulongosi wao.
1CH 3:10	Mwana mamuna wa Solomoni enzeli Rehoboamu. Rehoboamu mwana mwamuna wake enzeli Abija. Abija mwana mwamuna wake enzeli Asa. Asa mwana mwanamuna wake enzeli Jehoshafati.
1CH 3:11	Jehoshafati mwana mwamuna wake enzeli Jeromu.
1CH 3:12	Jeromu mwana wake enzeli Ahazia. Ahazia mwana mwamuna wake enzeli Azaria. Azaria mwana mwamuna wake enzeli Jotamu.
1CH 3:13	Jotamu mwana wake mwanuna enzeli Ahazi. Ahaz mwana wake mwamuna enzeli Hezekah. Hezekaih mwana wake mwanuna Manasse.
1CH 3:14	Manasse mwana wake mwamuna enzeli Amoni. Amoni mwana wake mwamuna enzeli Josiya.
1CH 3:15	Josiya mwana wake oyamba enzeli Johanani, mwana wake wa chibili enzeli Jehoiakimu, mwana wake wa chi tatu enzeli Zedekeya, ndipo mwana wake mwamuna wa namabala fo enzeli Shallumu.
1CH 3:16	Jehoiakim mwana wake mwamuna enzeli Jehoyajin na Zedekeya.
1CH 3:17	Ana a Yehoyakini amene anatengedwa ukapolo anali Selatieli,
1CH 3:18	Malkiramu, Pedaya, Senazara, Yekamiya, Hoshama, ndi Nedabiya.
1CH 3:19	Pedaya bana bake bamuna banali Zerubabeli na Shimai. Zerubabeli bana bake bamuna benzeli Meshullamu na Hananaya; Shelomiti anali mulongosi wabo.
1CH 3:20	Bana bake bamuna bali faivi benzeli  Hashuba, Oheli, Berekiah, Hasadiya, na Jushab-Hesedi.
1CH 3:21	Hananaya bana bake bamuna benzeli Pelatya na Jeshaya. Mwana wake mwamuna enzeli Refiaya, na kupitiliza obadwa mumboyo benzeli Anani, Obadaya, na Shekanya.
1CH 3:22	Bodwa mumboyo ba Shekanya benzeli Shemaya na bana bake bamuna; Hatushi, Igali, Bariah, Nearia, na Shafati.
1CH 3:23	Nearia bana bake bamuna bali fili benzeli Elioenayi, na Azrikamu.
1CH 3:24	Elionenayi bana bake bamuna seveni benzeli Hodavya, Eliashibi, Pelaya, Akkubu, Johanani, Delaya, na Anani.
1CH 4:0	Mutu 4
1CH 4:1	Yuda obadwa mumbuyo mwake  benzeli Perezi, Hezroni, Karmi, Hur, na Shobali.
1CH 4:2	Shobali enzeli tate wa Reya. Reya enzeli tate wa Jahati. Jahati enzeli tate wa Ahumai na Lahadi. Aba ndiye benzeli ma banja ya Zaratites.
1CH 4:3	Aya ndiye benzeli makolo ya ma banja ya muzinda ya Etamu; Jezril, Ishma, na Idbashi. Zina ya mulongosi wabo yenzeli Hazzeleponi.
1CH 4:4	Penieli anali kolo ya ma banja ya muzinda ya Gedo. Ezeri ndiye anayambisa ma banja mu Hushah. Aba benzeli bobadwa mumbuyo mwa Hur, oymba wa Efrata na oyambisa waku Bethlehmu.
1CH 4:5	Asha tate wa Tekowa anali naba kazi baili, Hela na Nara.
1CH 4:6	Nara anamubalila Ahuzamu, Hafa, Temeni, na Hashatari. Aba ndiye banali bobdwa mumbuyo mwa Nara.
1CH 4:7	Hela bana bake bamuna benzeli Zereti, Zoha,
1CH 4:8	Etinani, na Kozi, wamene anankala tate wa Anubu na Hazobeba, na ma  anja obadwa mumbuyo kuli Ahahel mwana mwamuna wa Harumu.
1CH 4:9	Jabezi enzeli opasiwa ulemu maningi kudila balongo bake, Ba mai bake bana muitana Jabezi. Bana kamba, "Chifukwa namubala na chobaba."
1CH 4:10	Jabez anaitana kuli Mulungu wa Isilayeli ndi kuti, "Ngati imwe chabe mungani dalise ine, nakukulisa malo yanga, na kwanja yanu kankala ine. Muka chita ichi muzansiunga ine kunichosa ku choipa, kuti ninga nkale omasuka ku kubaba!' Chajuti Mulungu anayanka pempelo yake.
1CH 4:11	Kelubi mulongosi wa Shuha anankala tate wa Mehir, enzeli tate wa Eshtoni.
1CH 4:12	Eshtoni anankala tate wa Beti Rafa, Pasiya, na Tehina, tate wa Ir Nahashi. Aba ndiye bamuna banali kunkala mu Reka.
1CH 4:13	Kenazi bana bake bamuna benzeli Otineli na Seraya. Otineli bana bake bamuna benzeli Hatati na Meonotayi.
1CH 4:14	Meonotayi anankala tate wa Opfra, na Seraya anankala tate wa Jowabu, oyambisa wa originator waku Ge Harashimu, wamene bantu baali Misili.
1CH 4:15	Bana bamuna ba Kalebu mwana mwamuna wa Jefana benzeli bamuna Iru, Elah na Namu. Ela mwana mwamuna wa Kenazi.
1CH 4:16	Jehaleli bana bake bamuna benzeli Zifu, Zifa, Tiriya, na Asareli.
1CH 4:17	Bana bamuna ba Ezra benzeli Jeta, Meredi, Efa, na Jaloni. Meredi mukazi waku Iguputo anamubalila Miriyamu, Shamayi, na Ishba, wamene anabwela annkala tate wa Eshtomowa.
1CH 4:18	Aba ndiye benzeli bana bamuna ba Bitiya, mwana mukazi wa Farao, wamene Meredi anakwatila. Mukazi waku Yuda wa Meredi. anamubalila Jeredi, wamene anakala tate wa Gedp; Heber anankala tate wa Soko; na Jekutieli, wamene anankala tate wa Zanowa.
1CH 4:19	Pabana bamuna ba bili bamukazi wa Hodiya, mulongosi wa Nahamu, umozi anankala tate wa Keila mu Garmiti. Winangu oze Eshtemowa mu Makatite.
1CH 4:20	Bana bamuna ba Shimoni benzeli Amnoni, Rina, Ben-Hanani, na Tiloni. bobadwa mumbuyo ba Ishi benzeli Zoheti na Ben-Zoheti.
1CH 4:21	Bobadwa mumbuyo ba Shela mwana mwamuna wa Yuda, benzeli Er tate wa Leka, Lada tate wa Maresha na ma banja yabo sebenza munyula ku Beti Ashbi,
1CH 4:22	Jokimu, bamuna baku kozeba, na Jowashi na Sarafu, analmulila mu Mowabu na Jashubi Lehemu. (Iyi nkani ichoka muzosunga zakudala.)
1CH 4:23	Aba ndiye banali boumba benzonkala mu Netaimu na Gedera ndi kusebnzela mfumu.
1CH 4:24	Simiyoni bobadwa mumbuyo mwake benzeli Nemueli, Jamini, Jaribu, Zera, na Shauli.
1CH 4:25	Shallumu anali mwana mwamuna wa Shauli, Mibsamu anali mwana mwamuna wa Shallumu, na Mishma anali mwana mwamuna wa Mibsamu.
1CH 4:26	Mishma bobadwa mumbuyo mwake enzeli Hamuweli mwana mwamuna, Zaka muzukulu wake mwamuna, na Shimeyi muzukulu tengo wake.
1CH 4:27	Shimayi enzeli na bana sikisitini bamuna naba bakazi. Ba bale bake benzelibe bana, chakuti ma banja yabo siyana kule kwambili muma namba monga bantu baku Yuda banachitila.
1CH 4:28	Banankala ku Beersheba Molada, na Haza Shuali.
1CH 4:29	Banankala kuti ku Biha, Ezemu, Toladi,
1CH 4:30	Betiweli, Horma, Ziklag,
1CH 4:31	Beti Markaboti, Haza Susimu, Beti Biri, na Sharaimu. Aya ndiye yanali muzinda yabo mpaka kalamulila kwa Davide.
1CH 4:32	Mizi yabo ili faivi yenze Etani, Ain, Rimoni, Tokeni, na Ashani,
1CH 4:33	pamozi na mizi ine yakumbali kufikila ku Baalati. Aya ndiye mankalidwe yabo,nakusunga vonse vama banja.
1CH 4:34	Basogoleli ba bama banja benzeli Meshobabi, Jamileki, Josha mwana mwamuna wa Amazya,
1CH 4:35	Joel, Jehu mwana mwamuna wa Joshibya mwana mwamuna waku Seraya mwana mwamuna wa Asieli,
1CH 4:36	Elioenai, Jakoba, Jeshohaya, Asaya, Adieli, Jesimeli, Benaya
1CH 4:37	na Ziza mwana mwamuna wa Shifi mwana mwamuna wa Alloni mwamuna wa Jedaya mwamuna wa Shimri mwana mwamuna wa Shemaya.
1CH 4:38	Aba bamene bakambiwa mazina benzeli basogoleli muma banja yabo ndipo ma banja yabo yana kula kwambili.
1CH 4:39	Bana yenda pafupi na Gedo, kumawa ya chigwa, ku sakila vokudya va mfumu zabo.
1CH 4:40	Bana peza vambili vabwino ndipo vabwino. Malo aya yanali yakulu, yalibe chongo ndipo yamutendele. Ma Hamiti yana nkalapo kudala pamene paja.
1CH 4:41	Aba bamene bana lembewa mazina muma siku ya Hezekaya mfumu ya Yuda, ndipo bana vundumula pankala ba Hamite naba Meunites, bamene benzeli kuja nabenve. Bana onongelatu vonse ndipo banankala pamene paja chifukwa bana peza vokudya va nyama zabo.
1CH 4:42	Kuchokela kuli benve, kuchokela kubana bamuna ba Simiyoni bamuna bal faivi handiledi banayenda bamuna bali faivi handiledi banayenda kupili ya Seir na Pelatya, Neria, Refaya, na Uzzil, bana bamuna ba Ishi, ngati musogoleli wabo.
1CH 4:43	Bana menya bonse ma Amalekayite, ndipo banankala paja kufikila lelo.
1CH 5:0	Mutu 5
1CH 5:1	Bana bamuna ba Rubeni mwana oymaba wa Isilayeli-manje Rubeni anali mwana oyamba wa Isilayeli, koma udindio waku badwa kwake unapasiwa kubana bamuna ba Yosefe mwana mwamuna wa Isilwayeli chifukwa Rubeni anachita choipa ku chivaka chaba tate bake ndipo sicholembewa ktui anali mwana mwamuna mukulu.
1CH 5:2	Yuda ndiye anali wampabuyo pa balongo bae bonse, ndipo anakala musogoleli. koma udindo wakubadwa wenze na Yosefe-
1CH 5:3	bana bamuna ba Rubeni, mwana oyamba wa Isilayeli beze Hanoki, Palu, Hezroni, na Karmi.
1CH 5:4	Bobadwa mumbuyo ba Yoweli benzeli: Yoweli mwana mwamuna wake enzeli Shemaya.
1CH 5:5	Shemaya mwana mwamuna wake enzeli Gogi. Gogi mwana mwamuna wake enzeli Reya. Reya mwana wake mwamuna enzeli Baal.
1CH 5:6	Baal mwana wake mwamuna enzeli Beera, wamene Tiglati-Pileser mfumu ya Assyria anatenga ku ukapolo, Beera anali musogoleli wa mutundu wa Rubeni.
1CH 5:7	Beera bachi bululu kulinga nama banja yabo, ba nalembewa mokonka ma banja: Jeieil musogoleli, Zekariya, na
1CH 5:8	Bela mwana mwamuna wa Azazi mwana mwamuna wa Shema mwana mwamuna wa Joel. Banakala mu Aroer, kufikila ku Nebo na Baal Meoni,
1CH 5:9	ndi kumawa kufika koyambila chipululu chofuka ku musinje wa Yufrate, chifukwa zibeto zabo zinali zapaka kwambili mumalo ya Geleadi.
1CH 5:10	Mu masiku ya Saulo, mutundu wa Rubeni wa unaukila ma hagriti nakuba gonjesa. Banakala mu malo yonkalamo ma yonse yakumwa kwa Gileadi.
1CH 5:11	Ma membala ba mutundu wa Gadi banankala pafupi na benve, mumalo ya Bashani kufikila ku Saleka.
1CH 5:12	Joel enzeli musogoleli; Shafamu anali wa namba tu; na Janai ndi Shafati mu Bashan.
1CH 5:13	Babululu babo, kama banja yaba tate babo, benzeli Michale, Meshullamu, Sheba, Jorai, Jakani, Zia, na Eba-bonse pamozi seveni.
1CH 5:14	Aba banut bakambiwa pamwamba benzeli bobadwa mumbuyo mwa Abihail, na Abihail anali mwana mwamuna wa Yuri. Yuri anali mwana mwamuna wa Jaroah. Jaroah  anali mwana mwamuna wa Gileadi. Gileadi anali mwana mwamuna wa Michael. Michael anali mwana mwamuna wa Jeshishai. Jeshishai anali mwana mwamuna wa Jahdo. Jahdo anali mwana mwamuna wa Buzi.
1CH 5:15	Ahi mwana mwamuna wa Abdiel mwana mwamuna wa Guni, anali mukulu wama banja yaba tate babo.
1CH 5:16	Banankala mu Geleadi, mu bashani, mu muzinda yake ndi mumalo yonse yodyesela yaku Sharoni kufikila ku malile.
1CH 5:17	Vonse ivi vinzel volembewa mumitundu muma siku ya Jtamu mfummu ya Yuda na Jerobowamu mfumu ya Isilayeli.
1CH 5:18	Ma Rubeniti, ma Gadites, ndi pakati mutundu benzeli ya Manase 44,760 bopunzisiwa zankondo, banali kunyamula zishango na mikondo, na mibvii.
1CH 5:19	Bana ukila ma Hagritis, Jeta, Nafish, na Nodabu.
1CH 5:20	Bana landila tandizo yaumulungu kususana nabo. Mwa lehi, ma Hagriti na bonse bana gonjesewa chifukwa ba Isilayeli banalilila kuli Mulungu mu nkondo, ndipo anakulupilila chabo muli yenve.
1CH 5:21	Bana tenga nyama, kuikilapo fifite sauzande ngamela, 250,000 mbelele, tu sauzandi mabulu na 100, 000 bamuna.
1CH 5:22	Bambili banagwa cifukwa ndeo inali yachoka kuli Mulungu. Banankala mu malo mwao kufikila ukapolo.
1CH 5:23	Pakati mutundu wa Manasa banankala mu malo mwao kufikila ukapolo. Pakari mutundu wa Manase banankala mu malo ya Bashani Kufikila ku Ball Hermon na Seir (Iyo npili ya Hermoni).
1CH 5:24	Aba ndiye benzeli bakulu ba manyumba yaba tate bao; Efaa, Ishi, Eliel, Azreil, Yelemaya, Hodama, na Jadel. Bezenzeli bamuna bampavu, bamuna bazibika, bakulu bama nyumba ya baba tate babo.
1CH 5:25	Koma benxeli bosakulupilila kuli Mulungu wama kolo babo. Chifukwa benzeli kupempela tumilungu twabantu ba mumalo, bamene Mulungu anaononga kale.
1CH 5:26	Mulungu wa Isilayeli anaimisa Pul mfumu ya Assyria (ozibako futi Tiglati-Pileser, mfumu ya Assyria). Anatenga ukapolo ma Rubenites, Gadites, ndi pakakti pa mutundu wa Manase. Anabawelesa ku Halah, Habor, Hara, na kumusinje wa Gozani, kwamene bali kufikila siku yalelo.
1CH 6:0	Mutu 6
1CH 6:1	Bana bamuna ba Levi banali Geshoni, Kohati, na Merari.
1CH 6:2	Bana bamuna ba Kohati benzeli Amramu. Iza, Heberoni, na Uzziel.

1CH 6:5	Abishua anankla tate wa Buki, na Buki anankala tate wa Uzzi.
1CH 6:6	Uzzi anankala tate wa Zeraya, na Zeraya anankala tate wa Merioti.
1CH 6:7	Merioti anankala tate wa Amaria, na Amaria anankala tate wa Ahitubu.
1CH 6:8	Ahitubu anankala tate wa Zadoku, na Zadoku anankala tate wa Ahimazi.
1CH 6:9	Ahimazi anankala tate wa Azarria, na Azaria anankala tate wa Yohanani.
1CH 6:10	Yohanani anankala tate wa Azaria, wamene anali opelekela mu chalich yamene Solomoni anapanga mu Jerusalema.
1CH 6:11	Azariya anankala tate wa Amariyah ndipo Amariyah anankala tate wa Ahitubi.
1CH 6:12	Ahitubi anankala tate wa Zadoki, na Zadoki anankala tate wa Shalumu.
1CH 6:13	Shalumu anankala tate wa Hilikiya, ndipo Hilikiya anankala tate wa Azariya.
1CH 6:14	Azariya anankala tate wa Seraya, na Seraya anankala tate wa Jozidaki.
1CH 6:15	Jozidaki anangena mundende pamene Yehova anafaka mu undende Yuda na Jerusalema na kwanja ya Nebuchadineza.
1CH 6:16	Bana bamuna ba Levi benzeli Geshoni, Kohati, na Merari.
1CH 6:17	Bana bamuna ba Gershoni banali Libni na Shemayi.
1CH 6:18	Bana bamuna ba Kohati banali Amuramu, Izam=, Heberoni, na Uzziel.
1CH 6:19	Bana bamuna Merari banali Mahli na Mushi. Aya ndiye ma banja ya ba Levi molingana na batate babo.
1CH 6:20	Ba mubadwe wa Geshoni: Libini mwana wake mwamuna , Yahati mwana wake mwamuna, zina mwana wake mwamuna,
1CH 6:21	Yowa mwana wake mwamuna, Iddo mwana wake mwamuna na Yeteraiyi mwana wake mwamuna.
1CH 6:22	Ba mubadwe wa Kohati: Aminadabi mwana wake mwamuna, Kora mwana wake mwamuna, Asiri mwana wake mwamuna,
1CH 6:23	Elikana mwana wake mwamuna, Asiri mwana wake mwamuna,
1CH 6:24	Tahati mwana wake mwamuna, Uriyele mwana wake mwamuna, Uzzia mwana wake mwamuna, na Shaul mwana wake mwamuna.
1CH 6:25	Ba mubadwe wa Elikana banali Amasai, Ahimoti,
1CH 6:26	Elkana mwana wake mwamuna, Zofayi mwana wake mwamuna, Nahati mwana wake mwamuna,
1CH 6:27	Eliabu mwana wake mwamuna, Jerohamu mwana wake mwamuna, na Elkana mwana wake mwamuna.
1CH 6:0	***kumasula kwakudala kuma kwachi Geriki kuma pamudadada Samueli mwana wake.***
1CH 6:28	Bana bamuna ba Samueli banali oymaba kubadw Yoweli, na Abiya,Wachibili kubadwa.
1CH 6:29	Ba mubadwe wa Merari banali Mali, Libni mwana wake mwamuna, SHimeyi mwana wake mwamuna, Uza mwana wake mwamuna.
1CH 6:30	Shimya mwana mwamuna, Haggai mwana wake mwamuna, na Asaya mwana wake mwamuna.
1CH 6:31	Aya ndiye mazina ya bantu bamene Davide ana ika muku yanganila pali nyimbo mu nyumba ya Yehova, pamene bokosi ya chipangano inbwela mwamene mufa.

1CH 9:19	Salumu mwana mwamuna wa Kore mwana mwamuna wa Ebiyasafu, ***Ebiyasafu ndiye muntu umozi  na umozi analo kuitana Asafu mu mbiri 26:1 mwana mwamuna wa Kora, na bablul bake kuchokela ku nyumba ya batate bake, ma korati, banali ku yanganila pa nchito ya bolonda. bana londa komo yaku hema,mogna makolo babo bana londela musonkano wabo Yehoba, ndipo bana londoka na pongenela.
1CH 9:20	Finyasi mwanamwamuna wa Eleaza anali kuba langanila benve kumbuyo, ndipo Yheova anali na enve.
1CH 9:21	Zekariya mwana wa Meselemaya anali malonda wa pongenera ku hema ya musonkano.
1CH 9:22	Bonse banja bamene bana sankiwa umalonda wapa Geti po ngonera banali 212. Mazina yabo yana lembewa mu mabuku ya bantu bamu minzi zabo. Davide na Samuwele mulauli anabapasa udindo wabo wachichitetekelo.
1CH 9:23	Chifukwa chake benve na bamubadwo wabo, bana tumikila ki londa ma Geti yaku nuymba ya Yehova, yo itaniwa nyumba ya kachisi ya Mulungu.
1CH 9:24	Boyanganila ma geti banatuma kumbali vonse vili fo, na kuwela.
1CH 9:25	Ba bale babo, banali kunkala mu minzi zabo, bana bevelamo kuzungulukila masiku seveni, pa ntawi yabo.
1CH 9:26	Koma ba sogoleli bosunga mogeti, bamene banali ma Leviti, banaba tumikila ku londa vipinda na vipinda vosungila vintu mu nyumba ya Mulungu.
1CH 9:27	Banali kunkala usiku mu malo yabo mo zungulukila nyumba ya Mulungu, chifukwa banali udindo oyilonda. Banali kuyisegula kuseni.
1CH 9:28	Benangu banali kuyanganila zida zamu chalichi; Banali kupenda volemba pamene vinali kuletewa na pamene vinali kutengewa.
1CH 9:29	Benangu pali benve nabo banaba tumikila ku Samalira vintu voyela, Zida, na vo tandizila, kuikilapo flaulo yabwimo, vinyu, mafuta, lubani, vonunkila.
1CH 9:30	Benangu bana bamuna ba bansembe bana sankaniza vonunkil.
1CH 9:31	Mattitiya, umozi waba Levi, wamene anali mwana oyamba wa Salamu waku Korahiti, anali ku langnila vopanga mukate wa nsembe.
1CH 9:32	Benangu ba bale babo, bamubadwe waba Kohiti, banali kuyanganila mukate waku kalapo kuipanganila Sabata iliyonse.
1CH 9:33	Boyimba na bakuluk bama nyumba ya batate yaba Levi banali kunkala mu mapinda yapa malo yopatulika pamene banali bomasuka kunchito, chifukwa banali kufunikila kugwila nchito zabo muzuba na usiku.
1CH 9:34	Aba ndiye banali ba Sogoleli ba manyumba ya batate babo muli ma Leviti, monga mwamene yana lembewa mu volembewe va  mubadwo wabo, nduna zimuna. Banali kunkala mu Yelusalemu.
1CH 9:35	Batate ba Gibiyoni, Yewele, wamene mukazi wke anali Maaka, anali kunkala mu Gibiyoni.
1CH 9:36	Mwana wake wo yamba anali Abidoni, kukonka apo bana bake bamuna banali Zuri, Kisi, Baala, Nere, Ndababu,
1CH 9:37	Gedo, Ahiya, Zekariya, na Mikiloti.
1CH 9:38	Mikiloti anali tate wa Simeamu. Nabenve banli kunkala pafupo naba bale babo mu Yelusalemu.
1CH 9:39	Nere anali tate wa Kisi. KIsi anali tate wa Saulo. Saulo anali tate wa Yonatani, Maliki-Suwa, Abinadabu na Esi-Baala.
1CH 9:40	Mwana mwamuna wa Yonatani anali Meribu-Baala. Meribu-Baala anali tate wa Mika.
1CH 9:41	Bana bamuna ba Mika banali Pitoni, Meleki, Tahrea, na Ahazi.
1CH 9:42	Ahazi anali tate wa Yuda, Yuda anali tate wa Alemeti, Azimaveti, na Zimiri. Zimiri anali tate wa Moza.
1CH 9:43	Moza anali tate wa Binea. Binea anali tate wa Refaniya. Refaniya anali tate wa Eleasa. Eleasa anali tate wa Azele.
1CH 9:44	Bana bali sikisi ba Azele banali Azarikamu, Bokeru, Isimaele, Seariya, Obadiya, na Hanani. Aba banali bana ba Azele bamuna.
1CH 10:0	Mutu 10
1CH 10:1	Manje ma Filistine bana menyana nama Isilayeli. Mwamuna aliyense waku Isilayele anataba kuchokela pali ma Filisti na kugwa pansi okufa pa lupili ya Gilibowa.
1CH 10:2	Ba Filisti bana pilikisha maningi Saulo na mwana mwamuna,  Filisiti bana paya Yonatani, Abinadabu, na Maliki-Suwa, na bana bake bamuna.
1CH 10:3	Nkondo inamukulila Saulo, ndipo bopanga mivi banamu peza ndipo banamu panga vilonda.
1CH 10:4	Kuchokapo Saulo anakamaba kuli onyamula zida zake. "Chosa lupanga yako nakunilasa nayo. Ngati si ivo, aba bosa dulidwa baza bwela kuni vutisa." Koma onyamula zida zake sanacivhite, chifukwa anali na manta maningi. Mwaicho Saulo anatenga lupanga yake nake gwelapo.
1CH 10:5	Pamene onyamula zida zake anaona kuti Saulo anafa, anagwela pa lupanga yake nayenve na kufa.
1CH 10:6	Chakuti Saulo anafa, na bana bake bamuna batatu, chakuti na bonse bamunyumba mwake banafela pamozi.
1CH 10:7	Pamene bonse bamuna ba ku Isilayeli mu minda banaona kuti banataba na kuti Saulo na bana bake bamuna banafa bana siya mizinda zabo naku taba. kuchokela apo ba Filisti bana bwela natu nkalamo.
1CH 10:8	China bwela mozungulikila siku yokonkapo, pamene ma Filisti bana bweka kuvula bokufa, naku peza Saulo na bana bake bamuna banagwa pa lupili ya Gilibowa.
1CH 10:9	Bana muvula naku tenga mutu wake na zido zake. Bana tuma batumiki mu Filisiti yonse kupeleka nkani kuli tumilungu twao na kuli bantu.
1CH 10:10	Banaika zida zake mu chalichi ya milungu zabo, na kumangilila mutu wake kuli chalichi ya Diragoni.
1CH 10:11	Pamene ba Yabesi Gileyadi bonse bana nvela vonse vamene ma Filisti bana chit kuli Saulo.
1CH 10:12	Bonse bomenya nkondo bana yenda naku tenga tupi ya Saulo naya bana bake bamuna, naku yaleta kuli Yabesi. Bana shika ma bonzo yabo pansi pa mutengo mu Yabesi dipo sibanadye masiku seveni.
1CH 10:13	Chakuti Saulo anafa chifukwa enve anali osakululupilika kuli Yehova. Sanamvele malamulo ya Yehova, koma anafunsa malangizo kuchokela kuli muntu wamene anali kukamba na bokufa.
1CH 10:14	Sana pempe chisogozo kuchokela kuli Yehova, chakuti Yehova anamupaya naku pasa ufumu kuli Davide mwana ea Yesse.
1CH 11:0	Mutu 11
1CH 11:1	Kufika apo bonse  A'Isreali anabwele kuli Davidi ku Hebroni nakukamba kuti, '' onani, ife ndife thupi yanu na fupa yanu.
1CH 11:2	Mumbuyomu, pamene Saul enze mfumu yatu, ndimwe muna sogolela gulu ya nhkondo ya Isreali. Yehovah Mulungu wanu anakamba kuli imwe kuti, iwe uzasogolela bantu banga A'Isreali, ndipo uzanhkakala olamulila bantu banga ba Isreali. ''
1CH 11:3	Bonse bakulu ba Isreali bana bwela kuli mfumu ku Hebroni, na Davidi anapangana nawo chipangano pamenso ya Yehovah. Eve anamuzoza Davidi mfumu ya Isreali. Munjila mumeneyi , mau ya Yehovah yamene analengezewa na Samuel yanabwela yachitika.
1CH 11:4	Davidi na bonse A'Isreali anayenda ku Yerusalemu ( ndiye kuti, Jebusi). Manje A' Jebusi , bantu bonhkala muziko iyi, banali kwameneuko.
1CH 11:5	Bantu bonhkala muziko iyi A'Jebusi anakamba kuli Davidi, '' Simuzabwela muno.'' Koma Davidi anatenga mzaki ya Ziyoni, iyi, mzinda wa Davidi.
1CH 11:6	Davidi anakamba kuti, '' Aliyense amene azamenya nhkondo na A'Jebusi azanhkala musogoleli wa mukulu.'' Ndipo Joab mwana mwamuna wa Zeruiah anayambilila kumenya nhkondo, na eve anapangiwa musogoleli wa mukulu.
1CH 11:7	David anayamba nhkunhkala muzika. Beve banauyita ziko ya Davidi.
1CH 11:8	Eve anamanga muzinda kuzungulila konse kuchokela ku Millo mpaka nakufika ku  zungulila chipupa. Joab anabwelesa muzinda wonse.
1CH 11:9	Davidi anakulilakulila chifukwa Yehovah wamakamu anali na eve.
1CH 11:10	Aba ndiye asogoleli Davidi  analinawo, amene anamulimbikisa eve mu ufumu wake, pamozi na bonse ba Isreali, kumupanga iye mfumu, kumvelela mawu ya Yehovah zokhuza Isreali.
1CH 11:11	Iyi ni mundandanda wa amuna wamphamvu a Davidi: Jashobeami, mwana mwamuna wa Hachmoniti, anali wamkhulu wama bwana. Eve anapaya  amuna three hundredi na mkondo wake pa nthawi imozi.
1CH 11:12	Pakuchoka iye nali Eleazar mwana mwamuna wa Dodo,  mu Ahohiti, wamene anali umozi paba muna ba mphamvu batatu.
1CH 11:13	Eve anali na Davidi ku Pas Dammim, a Philistine anasonkana pamozi kukamenya khondo, kwamene kunali munda wa barley na gulu ya nkhondo inataba kucokela kuli a Philistines.
1CH 11:14	Beve banayimilila pakati pa munda. Ana tetezela nakudula a Philistine na Yehovah anabampulumusa na chigonzezo chachikulu.
1CH 11:15	Ndipo batatu pa basogoleli sate banayenda kumwala kunali Davide, ku kavu ya Adulamu. Ngulu ya nkhondo ya Philistine anamanga msasa mu chigwa cha Refaimu.
1CH 11:16	Pa nthawi ija Davide anali muzaki yake, mu kavu, pamene a Philistines ana khazikisa msasa wawo ku Bethlehemu.
1CH 11:17	Davide anafunisisa manzi naku kamba kuti, ngati wina anganipaseko manzi yokumwa yamene yachokela ku chisime chili ku Bethlehemu, chisime chilipamupata! ''
1CH 11:18	Aba baso bamuna ba mphamvu batatu bana ngonjeza gulu ya nkhondo ya
1CH 11:19	afilisi nakutapa manzi kucoka mu chisime cha Bethlehemu, chisime chiliku mupata. Bana tenga manzi nakupelekela Davide, koma eve anakana kuyamwa. mwayichi anatayila mwa Yehovah. Kuchoka apo eve anakamba kuti, '' zitheka kuti ine sinifunika sinifunika kuchita izi! Kodi nimwe magazi a amuna aba amene anayika moyo zawo?'' Chifukwa beve anayika pachiswe moyo zawo, Davide anayakana kuyamwa. Izi zinali zo chita za amuna atatu amphamvu.
1CH 11:20	Abishai mubale wa Yowabu anali musogoleli wa amuna atatu. Pa nthawi ina eve anasebenzesa lupanga moshushana na fili hundredi nakubapaya. Ana kambiwa na pamozi nabili batatu.
1CH 11:21	Pali batatu bamene bana pasiwa ulemelelo nakunkhala mukulu wawo, ngankhale sanali umozi wa beve.
1CH 11:22	Benaya mwana mwamuna wa Jehoiada anali wankhondo wolimba mutima kuchokala ku Kabzeel, anachita zodabwisa . Anapaya bana bamuna babili ba Ariel waku Moab. Eve anayenda pansi pamugodi nakupaya mukango pasiku yamene mame inali kugwa.

1CH 11:24	Benaya mwana mwamuna wa Jehioada anachita  izi, na eve anayitanidwa pambali ya amuna ba mphamvu batatu.
1CH 11:25	Anali wolemekezewa kupambana ba shilikali bali sate. Koma sanali olemekezewa kupambana bamuna batatu ba mphamvu, koma Davide anamufaka mukulu waba malonda bake.

1CH 12:0	Mutu 12
1CH 12:1	Aba ndiye amuna amene anabwela kuli Davide ku Ziklag, pa nthawi yamene eve anapishiwa kuckoka kumenso ya Saul mwana wa Kish. Beve banali pakati kaba asilikali,bomutandiza mukondo yake.
1CH 12:2	Banali bokonzeka nama wuta na kusenbenzesa manja yonse ya kulaiti na kulefuti kwa malegeni ya myala na kulasa mifwi kuchokela mu wuta. Banali ma Benjamites, bamuna ba mutundu wa Saul.
1CH 12:3	Musogoleli anali Ahiezer, ndiye Joash, bana bonse bamuna ba Shemaah mu Gibeathite. Aba benze Jeziel na Pelet, bana ba Azmaveth. Beve banali Berakah,Jehu mu Anathothite,
1CH 12:4	Ishmaiah mu Gibeonite, musilikali pakati pali makumi yatatu ( woyanganila pali makumi yatatu); Yeremiya, Jahaziel, Johanan, Jozabad mu Gederathite.
1CH 12:5	Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, Shephatiah mu Haruphite,
1CH 12:6	mu Korahites Elkanah, Isshiah, Azrel, Joezer, Jashobeam, na
1CH 12:7	Joelah na Zedadiah, bana ba Jeroham waku Gedor.
1CH 12:8	Ena a Gadites anajoyina Davide kumalo yachitetezo muchipululu. Beve banali bamuna ba mkondo, amuna ophunzisiwa kukhondo, amene wogwila chisango na mkondo; nkope zawo zinali zoyopesa ngati nkope za mikango. Beve banali othamanga ngati nsala pamapili.
1CH 12:9	Panali Ezer musogoleli, Obadiah wachibili, Eliab wa chitatu,
1CH 12:10	Mishmannah wa chinayi, Yeremiya wa chisanu,
1CH 12:11	Attai wa chisanu na chi modzi, Eliel wa chisanu na chibili,
1CH 12:12	Johanan wa chisanu na chitatu, Elzabad wa chisanu na chi modzi,
1CH 12:13	Yeremiya wa chisanu, Makbannai wa khumi na chimodzi.
1CH 12:14	Aba bana bamuna ba Gadi banali bakulu ba nkhondo. Wamung'ono anasogolela a hundredi, na wamukhulu anasogolela zana.
1CH 12:15	Beve bana woloka Jordan mu mwezi woyamba, pamene unasefukila ma banki, nakupisha bonse bamene banali nkhunkhala mumigodi, konse ku mawa naku mazulo.
1CH 12:16	Amuna ene baku Benjamini na Yuda anabwela ku chitetezo cha Davide.
1CH 12:17	Davide anayenda kukakumana nawo nakulankula na beve: '' Ngati imwe mwabwela mu mutendere kuti munitandizeko ine, imwe munganijoyine ine . Koma ngati mwabwela kunipeleka kuli adani banga, Mulungu wa makolo yathu akuwone na kumudzuzula imwe, pakuti kulibe choyipa chamene nachita ine.''
1CH 12:18	Pamene apo muzimu unabwela pali Amasai, amene anali musogoleli wa makumi  yatatu. Amasai anakamba kuti, ''Ndife bako, Davide. Tilipabali yako, mwana wa Jesse. Mutendere, Mutendere ukhale kuli bonse bamene bakutandiza. Mutendere kuli bokutandiza bako, pakuti Mulungu akutandiza iwe.'' Pamene apo Davide anabalandilila naku bayika khunkhala  asogoleli oyanganila banthu bake.
1CH 12:19	Benangu ochokela ku Mannasseh anatabila kuli Davide pamene eve anabwela na aFilisiti kumenyana na Saul kunkhondo. Koma sibana tandizile aFilisiti , cifukwa ambuye achiFilisitine  anakambilana wina na muzake na kutumiza Davide apite. Beve bana kamba, '' Eve azathawila kuli mbuye wake Saul pachiswe cha umoyo wathu,''
1CH 12:20	Pamene anayenda ku Ziklag, amuna a Manasse amene anagwilizana na eve anali Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, na Zillethai, asogoleli a zikwi za Mannasseh.
1CH 12:21	Beve bana thandiza Davide kumenya magulu oyenda, pakuti beve banali bamuna ba nkhondo. pambuyo pake bana nkhala oyanganila gulu ya nkhondo.
1CH 12:22	Siku na siku, banthu banabwela kuli Davide kumuthandiza eve, mpaka panali gulu yayikhulu ya khondo, monga gulu ya nkhondo ya Mulungu.
1CH 12:23	Iyi ndiye mbiri ya asilikali omenyela nkhondo, amene anabwela kuli Davide ku Hebroni, kutembenukila ufumu wa Saul kuli eve, yamene anakwanisika mau ya Yehova.
1CH 12:24	Kuchokela ku Yuda amene anayamula zishango na mukondo banali 6,800, okonzekela nkhondo.
1CH 12:25	Kuchokela ku Simeonites kunali 7,100 amuna a nkhondo.
1CH 12:26	Kuchokela ku aLevites, kunali 4,600 amuna ba nkhondo.
1CH 12:27	Yehoyada anali musogoleli wa mubadwe wa Aaroni, ndipo na eve banali 3,700.
1CH 12:28	Na Zadok, munyamata, wamphamvu, na wolimba, anali makumi abili kuchoka ku banja yaba tate bake.
1CH 12:29	Kuchokela Benjamini,  mutundu wa Saul, banali zikwi zitatu. Bambili benze okulupilika kuli Saul paka pa nthawi iyi.
1CH 12:30	Kuchokela kuli a Ephraimites bali 20,800 bamuna ba nkhondo, bamuna bamene benze bozibika muma nyumba yaba tate bawo.
1CH 12:31	Hafu ya mutundu ya Manasseh banali zikwi khumi na zisanu na zitatu amuna ozibika amene anabwela  kufaka Davide nkhunkhala mfumu.
1CH 12:32	Kuchokela Issachar, kunali asogoleli mazana abili bamene banali ozindikila za nthawi na kuziba chamene Israel amayenela kuchita. Abale bonse bawo anali kubayanganila.
1CH 12:33	Kuchokela Zebuloni kunali amuna ankhondo fifty thousand, okonzekela nkondo, na zida zonse zankhondo, na wokonzeka kupeleka kukhulupilika kosagabanika.
1CH 12:34	Kuchokela Nafitali, panali asogoleli one thousand, na pamozi nawo amuna zikwi makumi yatatu mphamvu zisanu na ziwili na zishango na mikondo.
1CH 12:35	Kuchokela ku Dani banali 28,600  bamuna bokonzekela nkhondo.
1CH 12:36	Kuchokela Asher, kunali forty thousand bamuna bokonzekela nkhondo.
1CH 12:37	Kuchokela kusidya ina ya Jordani, kuchokela ku Rubeni, Gadi, naku hafu mutundu wa Manasseh, panali amuna 120,000 onyamula zida zosiyanasiyana zankhondo.
1CH 12:38	Asilikali bonse, okonzekela nkhondo, anabwela ku Hebroni na zolinga zolimba kuti apange Davide khunkhala mfumu ya Israeli. Aisrali bena bonse banali pa ugwilizano kuti Davide ankhale mfumu.
1CH 12:39	Beve banali na Davide masiku yatatu, kudya na kumwa, popeza abale awo anabatuma na katundu.
1CH 12:40	kuwonjezela apo, awo amene banali pafupi nawo, kufikila Issachar, na Zebuloni na Nafitali, anabwelesa mukate pa abulu, ngamila, nyulu na pa ng'ombe, na mikate ya nkhuyu, masanga ya zoumba, vinyu, mafuta, ng'ombe na nhkosa, pakuti munali chimwemwe mu Israel.
1CH 13:0	Mutu 13
1CH 13:1	Davide anafunsana na akulu azikwi na a mazana, na asogoleli bonse.
1CH 13:2	Davide anakamba ku musonkano onse wa Israeli, '' Ngati chioneka bwino kuli imwe, ndipo ngati ici chichokela kuli Yehova Mulungu watu, tiyeni titumize atumiki kulikonse kuli abale bathu amene asala mumadela onse ya Israeli, nakuli ansembe na a Levi onkhala mumizi yawo. Bauzeni kuti bati joyine ife.
1CH 13:3	Tiyeni tibwelese likasa ya Mulungu wathu kuli ife, pakuti ife sitinafunile chifunilo chake mu masiku ya ulamulilo ya Saul.''
1CH 13:4	Banthu bonse baku musonkano bana vomela kuchita ivivinthu, chifukwa zinakomela banthu bonse.
1CH 13:5	Davide anasonkanisa pamozi bonse ba Israel, kuchokela ku musinje wa Shihor ku Egypto mpaka Lebo Hamath, kubwelesa likasa ya Mulungu kuchokela ku Kiriati Jearimu.
1CH 13:6	Davide na bonse ba Israel banayenda ku Baalah, ndiye kuti, Kiriati Jearimu, za Yuda, kubwelesa likasa ya Mulungu  kuchokela kuja, yamene imayitaniwa zina ya Yehova, Yehova, onkhala pa a Kerubi.
1CH 13:7	Beve banakwelesa likasa ya Mulungu pa chi ngolo cha newanu. Beve bana yichosa mu nyumba ya Abinadab. Uzzah na Ahio banali kusogolela ngolo.
1CH 13:8	Davide na bonse ba Israeli  banali kusangalala pamanso pa Mulungu na mphamvu zawo zonse. Banali kuyimba na azeze na malupanga, maseche, zinganga, na malipenga.
1CH 13:9	Pamene banafika pamalo opunthila mbewu mu Kidroni, Uzzah anathambulula kwanja kwake kuti agwile likasa, chifukwa ng'ombe zina ziphuntula.
1CH 13:10	Pamene apo ukali wa Yehova unayakila Uzzah, ndipo Yehova anamupaya eve chifukwa Uzzah enze anathambulula kwanja kwake ku likasa. Eve anamwalila pamanso ya Mulungu.
1CH 13:11	Davide anakwiya chifukwa Yehova anaukila Uzzah. Muja mumalo muyitanidwa Perez Uzzah mpaka lelo.
1CH 13:12	Davide anayopa Mulungu pasiku ija. Eve anakamba kuti, '' Nigabwelese bwanji likasa ya Mulungu kwathu ine? ''
1CH 13:13	Davide sanapeleke likasa kupita nayo ku muzinda wa Davide, koma anayifaka pabali mu nyumba ya Obedi Edomu mu Gittite.
1CH 13:14	Likasa ya Mulungu inakhala mu nyumba ya Obedi Edomu  mu nyumba mwake miyezi itatu. Yehova anadalisa nyumba yake na zonse zamene anali navo.
1CH 14:0	Mutu 14
1CH 14:1	Pamene apo Hiram mfumu ya Tyra, anatumiza atumiki kuli Davide, na mitengo ya mukungudza, akalipentala, na omanga miyala. Beve bana manga nyumba yake.
1CH 14:2	Davide enzoziba kuti Yehova ana mukazika kunkhala mfumu ya Israeli, ndipo kuti ufumu wake unakwezeka pamwamba chifukwa cha Israel banthu bake.
1CH 14:3	Mu Yerusalemu, Davide anakwatila bakazi bena bambili. Ndipo nankhukala tate wa bana bamuna na bakazi bambili.
1CH 14:4	Aya ndiye mazina ya bana bamene banabadwa kuli eve mu Yerusalemu: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomoni,
1CH 14:5	Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
1CH 14:6	Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
1CH 14:7	Elishama, Beeliada, na Eliphelet.
1CH 14:8	Pamene aFilisti anamvela kuti Davide anazozedwa khunkhala mfumu ya  monse mu Israel, Beve bonse banayenda kumusakila eve. Koma Davide anamvela zimene izi, anayenda kukasusana nawo.
1CH 14:9	Pamene apo aFilisti anabwela  kupanga nkhondo mu mugodi wa Rephaimu.
1CH 14:10	Kuchoka apo Davide anampempa thandizo kuchokela kwa Mulungu. Eve anakamba kuti, '' Kodi nimenyane na aFilisiti? Kodi muzatipasa chigonjezo pali beve?'' Yehova anakamba na eve kuti, uukira, ndithu namipasani beve kuli iwe.
1CH 14:11	Ndipo beve banabwela ku Baal Perazim, ndipo pamene apo eve anabagonjeza beve. Eve anayankha, '' Mulungu wapyola adani banga na kwanja yanga ngati manzi osefukila.'' Zina ya pamene apo inakhala Baal Perazimu.
1CH 14:12	Afilisiti anasiya milungu zawo kuja, ndipo Davide anapasa lamulo kuti beve bavishoke.
1CH 14:13	Afilisiti anagonjeza mu mugodi nafuti.
1CH 14:14	Davide anampempa thandizo nafuti kuchokela kuli Mulungu. Mulungu anakamba kuli eve kuti, '' Simuyenela kuwukila kusogolo, koma mumalo mwake muzizunguluke kumbuyo kwawo nakubwela pali beve kupitila mu nkhalango ya basamu.
1CH 14:15	Pamene iwe wamvela phokoso yaku guba mphepo ikuwomba mu mitengo ya basamu, uukira na mphamvu. Chita ici chifukwa Mulungu azakhala kuyenda pasogolo panu kuti akaukile gulu ya nkhondo ya chifilisiti.''
1CH 14:16	Davide anachita monga Mulungu anamulamulila eve. Anagonjeza gulu ya Nkhondo ya Afilisiti kuchokela ku Gibeoni mpaka ku Gezer.
1CH 14:17	Pamene apo kuzibika kwa Davide kunayenda ku  malo konse, ndipo Yehova anachitisa mitundu yonse kumuyopa.
1CH 15:0	Mutu 15
1CH 15:1	Davide anamanga manyumba yake muzinda ya Davide. Eve anakonzekela malo ya likasa ya Mulungu na kuyipangila  hema.
1CH 15:2	Pamene apo Davide anakamba kuti, aLeviti chabe ndiye bazatenga likasa ya Mulungu, chifukwa beve bana sankiwa kuli Mulungu kuti batenge likasa ya Yehova, nakumusebenzela eve muyayaya.
1CH 15:3	Davide ana sokanisa bonse aIsrael ku Yerusalemu, kubwelesa likasa ya Yehova ku malo yamene anayikonzekela.
1CH 15:4	Davide anasokaniza  pamozi mubado wa Aaroni na wa ALevi.
1CH 15:5	Kuchokela mubado wa Kohath, kunali Uriel musogoleli na banja yake, amuna 120.
1CH 15:6	Kuchokela mubado wa Merari, kunali Asaiah musogoleli na banja yake,amuna 220.
1CH 15:7	Kuchokela mubado wa Gershom, kunali Joel musogoleli na banja yake, amuna 130.
1CH 15:8	Kuchokela mubado wa Elizaphan, kunali Shemaiah musogoleli na banja yake, amuna 200.
1CH 15:9	Kuchokela mubado wa Hebroni, kunali Eliel musogoleli  na banja yake, amuna eyite.
1CH 15:10	Kuchokela  mubado wa Uzziel, kunali Amminadab musogoleli na banja yake, amuna 112.
1CH 15:11	Davide anayitana Zadok na Abiathar ansembe, na aLevi Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, na Amminadab.
1CH 15:12	Eve anakamba kuli beve kuti, '' Imwe ndimwe asogoleli yama banja ALeviti. Muzipatule imwe, imwe nababale bako, pakuti imwe mungabwelese liksa ya Yehova, Mulungu wa Israel, kumalo yamene ninayigonzekela.
1CH 15:13	Simuna nyamule pa nthawi yoyamba. Nichifukwa chake Yehova Mulungu wathu watisusa ife, popeza kuti  sitinamufunefune kapena kumvela lamulo yake. ''
1CH 15:14	Ansembe na ALevi anazipatula kuti atenge likasa ya Yehova, Mulungu wa Israel.
1CH 15:15	Chifukwa chake ALevi ananyamula likasa ya Mulungu pa mapeya yawo na mizati, monga analamulila Mose - kukonka malamulo yamene yanapasiwa na mawu ya Yehova.
1CH 15:16	Davide analankhula na asogoleli ALevi kuti asanke abale awo ngati oyimba amene azayimba mokwezeka na zida zoyimbila, azeze na zeze na zinganga, kuti akwezeke zikumveka zachimwemwe.
1CH 15:17	Ndipo ALevi anasanka Hemani mwana mwamuna wa Joel na umozi mubale wake, Asafu mwana mwamuna wa Beereya. Beve bana sanka futi achibale ochokela ku mbado wa Mereri na Ethan mwana wa Kushaiah.
1CH 15:18	Abale awo achibili anali nawo: Zekariya, Yezieli, Shemiramoti, Yehieli, Unni, Eliabu, Benaya, Maaseya, Mattithiya, Eliphelehu, Mikneya, Obedi Edomu, na Jeieli, akamilonda a pazipata.
1CH 15:19	Oyimba nyimbo monga Heman, Asafu, na Ethani anasankiwa kuti azimenya kwambili zinganga zamkuwa.
1CH 15:20	Zekariya, Azieli, Shemiramoti, Yehieli, Unni, Eliabu, Maaseya na Benaya ezoliza azeze, konza ku Alamoth.
1CH 15:21	Mattithiya, Eliphelehu, Mikneya, Obedi Edomu, Jeieli, na Azaziah anasogolela njila na azeze okonzekela ku Sheminith.
1CH 15:22	Kenaniya, musogoleli wa ALevi, ndiye anali woyanganila kuyimba chifukwa eve anali muphunzisi wanyimbo.
1CH 15:23	Beereya na Elikana banali baka mlonda wa likasa.
1CH 15:24	Sebaniya, Yosafati, Netaneli, Amasai, Zekariya, Benaya, na Eliezere, ansembe, enzofunika kuliza malipenga pasogolo pa likasa ya Mulungu. Obedi Edomu na Jehiya anali malonda ya likasa.
1CH 15:25	Davide, akulu Aisrael, na asogoleli a masausande anayenda kutenga likasa ya chipangano ya Yehova kuchokela munyumba ya Obedi Edomu na chisangalalo.
1CH 15:26	Pamene Mulungu anathandiza ALevi amene anatenga likasa ya chipangano cha Yehova, beve banapeleka nsembe ng'ombe zisanu na ziwili na nkhosa zamphongo zisanu na ziwili.
1CH 15:27	Davide anavala mukanjo ya nula yabwino kwambili, monga ALevi amene anatenga likasa, oyimba nyimbo, na Kenaniya, musogoleli wa nyimbo pamozi na woyimba. Davide anavala nula ya efodi.
1CH 15:28	Onse Aisraeli anabwelesa likasa ya chipangano cha Yehova kufuula mokondwela, na kuwomba kwa nyanga na malipenga, na zinganga, na azeze na zeze.
1CH 15:29	Koma pamene likasa ya chipangano cha Yehova inabwela ku muzinda wa Davide, Michal mwana wa Saul, anayangana panja pa zenela. Eve anaona mfumu Davide  avina nakusangalala. Pamene apo anamunyoza eve mumutima mwake.
1CH 16:0	Mutu 16
1CH 16:1	Iwo anabweretsa likasa la Mulungu woona ndi kuliika pakati pa tenti imene Davide anakhazikitsiramo. Kenako anapereka nsembe zopsereza ndi nsembe zachiyanjano pamaso pa Mulungu.
1CH 16:2	Davide atatsiriza kupereka nsembe yopsereza ndi nsembe zachiyanjano, anadalitsa anthuwo m namedzina la Yehova.
1CH 16:3	Anagawira amuna onse a Israyeli, kwa amuna ndi akazi, mtanda wa mkate, ndi nthuli ya nyama, ndi keke ya mphesa zouma.
1CH 16:4	Ndipo Davide anasankha Alevi ena azimtumikira patsogolo pa likasa la Yehova, ndi kusekerera, kuyamika, ndi kutamanda Yehova Mulungu wa Israyeli.
1CH 16:5	Alevi anali mtsogoleri wawo, ndipo wachiwiri wake anali Zekariya, Yaazieli, Semiramoti, Yehieli, Matitiya, Eliyabu, Benaya, Obedi-edomu ndi Yeyeli. Awa anali oyimba ndi azeze ndi azeze. Asafu anali kuwomba zinganga, ndipo anali kuwomba mokweza kwambiri.
1CH 16:6	Ansembe Benaya ndi Yahazieli anali kuimba malipenga pafupipafupi, patsogolo pa Bokosi la Chipangano la Mulungu.
1CH 16:7	Tsiku lomwelo Davide anasankha Asafu ndi abale ake kuyimba nyimbo iyi yakuyamika Yehova.
1CH 16:8	Yamikani Yehova, itanani pa dzina lake; Dziwitsani mitundu ya anthu zochita zake.
1CH 16:9	Muimbireni, muimbireni zomlemekeza; Nenani zodabwiza zake zonse.
1CH 16:10	Dzitamandeni ndi dzina lake loyera; mtima wa iwo akufunafuna Yehova ukondwere.
1CH 16:11	Funani Yehova ndi mphamvu yake; funani nkhope yake kosalekeza.
1CH 16:12	Kumbukirani zodabwiza zake adazichita, Ndi zozizwa zake ndi maweruzo ochokera mkamwa mwake,
1CH 16:13	Inu ana a Israyeli mtumiki wake, Inu anthu a Yakobo, osankhidwa ake.
1CH 16:14	Iye ndiye Yehova, Mulungu wathu. Malamulo ake ali padziko lonse lapansi.
1CH 16:15	Kumbukirani chipangano chake kwamuyaya, mawu amene analamulira mibadwo chikwi.
1CH 16:16	Akukumbukira pangano lomwe adapangana ndi Abrahamu, ndi lumbiro lake kwa Isaki.
1CH 16:17	Izi n'zimene anatsimikizira Yakobo monga lamulo, ndi kwa Israyeli ngati pangano losatha.
1CH 16:18	Ndipo anati, Ndidzakupatsa iwe dziko la Kanani likhale colowa cako.
1CH 16:19	Pamene anali owerengeka ochepa, ochepa kwambiri, ndipo anali alendo mdzikolo,
1CH 16:20	ankayendayenda kuchokera ku mtundu wina kupita ku mtundu wina, kuchokera ku ufumu wina kupita ku wina.
1CH 16:21	Sanalole aliyense kuwapondereza; adalanga mafumu chifukwa cha iwo.
1CH 16:22	Iye adati, "Musakhudze odzozedwa anga, kapena kuvulaza aneneri anga."
1CH 16:23	Imbirani Yehova, dziko lonse lapansi; lengezani chipulumutso chake tsiku ndi tsiku.
1CH 16:24	Fotokozerani ulemerero wake mwa amitundu, ndi zozizwitsa zake mwa amitundu onse.
1CH 16:25	Pakuti Yehova ndiye wamkulu, nayenera kulemekezedwa kwakukulu;
1CH 16:26	Pakuti milungu yonse ya amitundu ndi mafano, koma Yehova ndiye adalenga zakumwamba.
1CH 16:27	Ulemerero ndi ulemu zili pamaso pake. Mphamvu ndi chimwemwe zili m'malo mwake.
1CH 16:28	Vomerezani kwa Yehova, inu mafuko a mitundu ya anthu, M'patseni Yehova ulemerero ndi mphamvu.
1CH 16:29	M'patseni Yehova ulemerero woyenera dzina lake. Bweretsani chopereka mubwere pamaso pake. Gwadirani Yehova mu ulemerero woyera.
1CH 16:30	Njenjemera pamaso pake, dziko lonse lapansi. Dziko lapansi nalonso lakhazikika; sungagwedezeke.
1CH 16:31	Kumwamba kukondwere, ndipo dziko lapansi lisangalale. anene mwa amitundu, "Yehova alamulira."
1CH 16:32	Nyanja ibangule, ndi zonse zili mmenemo zifuule mokondwera. Minda isangalale, ndi zonse zili momwemo.
1CH 16:33	Pamenepo mitengo ya m'nkhalango ifuule ndi chisangalalo pamaso pa Yehova, pakuti akubwera kudzaweruza dziko lapansi.
1CH 16:34	Yamikani Yehova, chifukwa iye ndi wabwino, pakuti pangano lake ndi lokhalitsa.
1CH 16:35	Pamenepo nenani, "Tipulumutseni, Mulungu wa chipulumutso chathu. Tisonkhanitseni pamodzi ndi kutipulumutsa kuchokera ku mitundu ina, kuti tithokoze dzina lanu loyera ndi kudzitamanda m yourmitamando yanu."
1CH 16:36	Adalitsike Yehova, Mulungu wa Israele, kuyambira nthawi yosayamba kufikira nthawi yosatha. Anthu onse anati, Ameni; natamanda Yehova.
1CH 16:37	Kotero Davide anasiya Asafu ndi abale ake kumeneko patsogolo pa Bokosi la Chipangano la Yehova, kuti azitumikira mosalekeza patsogolo pa Likasa, monga mwa ntchito za tsiku ndi tsiku.
1CH 16:38	Obedi Edomu ndi abale awo makumi asanu ndi limodzi mphambu asanu ndi atatu anaphatikizidwa. Obedi Edomu mwana wa Yedutuni, pamodzi ndi Hosa anali odikira.
1CH 16:39	Wansembe Zadoki ndi ansembe anzake anatumikira patsogolo pa chihema cha Yehova ku malo okwezeka a ku Gibeoni.
1CH 16:40	Anali kupereka nsembe zopsereza kwa Yehova paguwa lansembe zopsereza mosalekeza m'mawa ndi madzulo, mogwirizana ndi zonse zolembedwa m lawchilamulo cha Yehova, chimene analamula Israeli.
1CH 16:41	Hemani ndi Yedutuni anali nawo, pamodzi ndi enawo amene anasankhidwa ndi mayina, kuti ayamike Yehova; chifukwa chake pangano lake ndi la chikhalire.
1CH 16:42	Hemani ndi Yedutuni anali oyang'anira oyimba malipenga, zinganga ndi zida zina zoyimbira Mulungu. Ana a Yedutuni anali olondera pachipata.
1CH 16:43	Pamenepo anthu onse anabwerera kunyumba zawo, ndipo Davide anabwerera kudalitsa banja lake.
1CH 17:0	Mutu 17
1CH 17:1	Ndipo panali atakhala mfumu m'nyumba mwace, anati kwa Natani mneneriyo, Tawonani, ine ndikhala m'nyumba ya mkungudza, koma likasa la cipangano la Yehova likhalabe pansi pa hema.
1CH 17:2	Natani anati kwa Davide, "Pita, kachita zomwe zili mumtima mwako, chifukwa Mulungu ali ndi iwe."
1CH 17:3	Koma usiku womwewo mau a Mulungu anadza kwa Natani, kuti,
1CH 17:4	Pita, ukauze mnyamata wanga Davide, Atero Yehova, Simudzandimangira nyumba yokhalamo;
1CH 17:5	Pakuti sindinakhale m'nyumba ya Yehova tsiku lomwe ndinatulutsa Israeli kufikira lero. M'malo mwake, ndakhala mchihema, mchihema, m'malo osiyanasiyana.
1CH 17:6	M'malo monse momwe ndasamukira mu Israeli yense, kodi ndidanenapo chilichonse kwa atsogoleri onse a Israeli omwe ndidawasankha kuweta anthu anga, ndikuti, Chifukwa chiyani simunandimangira nyumba ya mkungudza?
1CH 17:7	“Tsopano uzani mtumiki wanga Davide kuti, 'Yehova Wamphamvuzonse akuti: Ine ndinakutenga kuchokera kumalo odyetserako ziweto kuti uzisamalira nkhosa kuti ukhale mtsogoleri wa anthu anga Aisraeli.
1CH 17:8	Ndakhala ndi iwe kulikonse komwe umapita komanso ndachotsa adani ako onse pamaso pako; ndipo ndidzakupangira iwe dzina, lolingana ndi maina a akulu omwe ali padziko lapansi.
1CH 17:9	Ndidzasankhira anthu anga Aisraeli malo ndipo ndidzawaoka kumeneko, kuti adzakhale m theirmalo mwawo ndipo sadzakhalanso ndi nkhawa. Anthu oipa sadzawaponderezanso monga anachitira kale,
1CH 17:10	monga anachitira kuyambira masiku amene ndinalamula oweruza kuti aziweruza anthu anga Aisraeli. Pamenepo ndidzagonjetsa adani ako onse. Komanso ndikukuuza kuti ine Yehova ndidzakumangira nyumba.
1CH 17:11	Ndipo padzakhala kuti, masiku ako atakwanira kuti upite kwa makolo ako, ndidzakuwukitsa mbeu yako yobwera pambuyo pako, ndipo ndidzakhazikitsa ufumu wake mwa mmodzi wa mbewu zako;
1CH 17:12	Iyeyu adzandimangira nyumba, ndipo ndidzakhazikitsa mpando wake wachifumu kosatha.
1CH 17:13	Ine ndidzakhala atate wake, ndipo iye adzakhala mwana wanga. Sindidzachotsa pangano langa pa iye, monga ndinachotsera Sauli, amene analamulira iwe usanabadwe.
1CH 17:14	Ndidzamuika kuti aziyang'anira nyumba yanga ndi ufumu wanga kwamuyaya, ndipo mpando wake wachifumu udzakhazikika mpaka kalekale. '”
1CH 17:15	Natani analankhula ndi Davide ndipo anamuwuza mawu onsewa, ndipo anamuwuza za masomphenya onsewo.
1CH 17:16	Pamenepo mfumu Davide analowa nakhala pansi pamaso pa Yehova; nati, Ndine yani, Yehova Mulungu, ndi banja langa nchiani, kuti mundifikitse ine pano?
1CH 17:17	Pakuti ichi chinali chaching'ono pamaso panu, Mulungu. Bwera udzandiwonetse mibadwo ya mtsogolo, Inu Yehova Mulungu.
1CH 17:18	Kodi Davide ndinena chiyani kwa inu, kuti mwalemekeza mtumiki wanu? Mwapatsa kapolo wanu ulemu waukulu.
1CH 17:19	Yehova, chifukwa cha mtumiki wanu, ndikukwaniritsa cholinga chanu, mwachita chinthu chachikulu ichi kuti muulule ntchito zanu zonse zazikulu.
1CH 17:20	Yehova, palibenso wina wonga inu, ndipo palibenso Mulungu wina koma Inu nokha;
1CH 17:21	Pakuti ndi mtundu uti wa dziko lapansi wofanana ndi anthu anu Israyeli, amene inu Mulungu, mudawombola ku Aigupto, mukhale anthu anu, kudzipangira dzina ndi ntchito zazikulu ndi zoopsa? Munapitikitsa amitundu pamaso pa anthu anu, amene munawawombola ku Aigupto.
1CH 17:22	Inu munapanga Israyeli kukhala anthu anu nthawi zonse, ndipo inu Yehova munakhala Mulungu wao.
1CH 17:23	Cifukwa cace tsono, Yehova, lonjezano lanu lokhudza mtumiki wanu ndi banja lace likhazikike kosatha. Chitani monga mwanenera.
1CH 17:24	Dzina lanu likhazikike kwamuyaya ndi kukhala wamkulu, kotero anthu adzati, 'Yehova wa makamu ndiye Mulungu wa Israeli,' pamene nyumba yanga, Davide mtumiki wanu yakhazikika pamaso panu.
1CH 17:25	Pakuti inu Mulungu wanga mwaulula kwa ine mtumiki wanu kuti mudzamumangira nyumba. N whychifukwa chake ine mtumiki wanu ndapeza kulimbika kwa kupemphera kwa inu.
1CH 17:26	Tsopano, Yehova, Inu ndinu Mulungu, ndipo mwapangana ndi lonjezo labwino ili kwa ine mtumiki wanu:
1CH 17:27	Tsopano chikukondweretsani inu kudalitsa nyumba ya kapolo wanu, kuti ikhale chikhalire pamaso panu. Inu, Yehova, mudalitsadi, ndipo idzadalitsidwa kosatha. "
1CH 18:0	Mutu 18
1CH 18:1	Pambuyo pake, Davide anapha Afilisiti ndi kuwagonjetsa. Iye analanda Gati ndi midzi yake yonse mmanja mwa Afilisiti. Kenako anapha Amowabu,
1CH 18:2	ndipo Amowabuwo anakhala akapolo a Davide ndipo anali kukhoma msonkho kwa iye.
1CH 18:3	Ndipo Davide anagonjetsa Hadadezeri, mfumu ya Zoba ku Hamati, pamene Hadadezeri anali paulendo wopita kukakhazikitsa ulamuliro wake m thembali mwa Mtsinje.
1CH 18:4	Davide analanda magaleta 1,000, okwera pamahatchi 7,000, ndi anthu oyenda pansi okwana 20,000. Davide anapundula mahatchi onse a magaleta, koma anasiya mahatchi 100 okwanira.
1CH 18:5	Aaramu a ku Damasiko atabwera kudzathandiza Hadadezeri mfumu ya Zoba, Davide anapha Aaramu 22,000.
1CH 18:6	Ndipo Davide anaika magulu a nkhondo ku Aramu wa ku Damasiko, ndipo Aaramu anakhala akapolo ace, nabwera nayo msonkho. Ndipo Yehova anapulumutsa Davide kuli konse amukako.
1CH 18:7	Davide anatenga zishango zagolide zomwe zinali ndi antchito a Hadadezeri ndipo anabwera nazo ku Yerusalemu.
1CH 18:8	Kuchokera ku Teba ndi Kun, mizinda ya Hadadezeri, Davide anatenga mkuwa wambiri. Ndi mkuwa uwu pomwe Solomo pambuyo pake adapanga beseni lamkuwa lotchedwa "Nyanja," nsanamira, ndi zida zamkuwa.
1CH 18:9	Tou, mfumu ya Hamati, atamva kuti Davide wagonjetsa gulu lankhondo lonse la Hadadezeri mfumu ya Zoba,
1CH 18:10	ndipo Tou anatumiza mwana wake Hadoramu kwa Mfumu Davide kuti akamupatse moni ndi kumudalitsa. Anachita izi chifukwa Davide anali atamenyana ndi Hadadezeri ndipo anamugonjetsa, komanso chifukwa chakuti Tou anali kumenyana nthawi zambiri ndi Hadadezeri. Inunso munamutumiziranso Davide zinthu zosiyanasiyana zagolide, zasiliva ndi zamkuwa.
1CH 18:11	Mfumu Davide anapatula zinthu izi kwa Yehova, pamodzi ndi siliva ndi golide amene anatenga kuchokera ku mitundu yonse: Edomu, Moabu, Aamoni, Afilisti, ndi Amaleki.
1CH 18:12	Abisai mwana wa Zeruya anapha Aedomu okwana 18,000 m Valley Chigwa cha Mchere.
1CH 18:13	Ndipo anaika maboma m'Edomu, ndipo Aedomu onse anakhala akapolo a Davide. Ndipo Yehova anapulumutsa Davide kuli konse amukako.
1CH 18:14	Davide analamulira Aisraeli onse, ndipo ankachita chilungamo ndi chilungamo kwa anthu ake onse.
1CH 18:15	Yowabu mwana wa Zeruya anali mtsogoleri wa ankhondo, ndipo Yehosafati mwana wa Ahiludi anali wolemba mbiri.
1CH 18:16	Zadoki mwana wa Ahitubu ndi Ahimeleki mwana wa Abiyatara anali ansembe, ndipo Shavsha anali mlembi.

1CH 19:0	Mutu 19

1CH 19:6	Ana a Amoni ataona kuti anyansidwa ndi Davide, Hanuni ndi Aamoni anatumiza matalente siliva chikwi kuti akalonge magaleta ndi apakavalo ku Aramu kuchokera ku Naharaimu, Maaka ndi Zoba.
1CH 19:7	Adalemba ganyu zikwi makumi atatu mphambu ziwiri ndi mfumu ya Maaka ndi gulu lake lankhondo, amene adadza namanga msasa patsogolo pa Medeba. Pamenepo Aamoni anasonkhana pamodzi kuchokera m'mizinda yawo ndi kutuluka kunkhondo.
1CH 19:8	Davide atamva zimenezi, anatumiza Yowabu ndi gulu lake lonse lankhondo kuti akumane nawo.
1CH 19:9	Ana a Amoni anali kutuluka ndi kufola mwa dongosolo lomenyera nkhondo kuchipata cha mzinda, koma mafumu amene anabwerawo anali okhaokha kutchire.
1CH 19:10	Yowabu ataona kuti magulu ankhondo akuyang'ana kutsogolo ndi kumbuyo, anasankha ena mwa odziwa bwino nkhondo mu Israeli ndipo anawayika kuti amenyane ndi Aaramu.
1CH 19:11	Anthu ena otsala, anawapereka kwa Abisai m'bale wake, ndipo anawayika kuti akamenyane ndi gulu la Amoni.
1CH 19:12	Ndipo Yoabu anati, Ngati Aaramu andiposa mphamvu, iwe Abisai undipulumutse; koma ngati khamu la Aamoni likukulira iwe, pamenepo ndidzadza ndikupulumutsa.
1CH 19:13	kukhala wamphamvu mwa anthu athu, ndi chifukwa cha mizinda ya Mulungu wathu, chifukwa Yehova adzachita zokoma pamaso pake. "
1CH 19:14	Kotero Yowabu ndi gulu lake lankhondo anapita kunkhondo kukamenyana ndi Aaramu, amene anathawa pamaso pa ankhondo a Israeli.
1CH 19:15	Aamoni atawona kuti Aaramu athawa, iwonso anathawa Abisai m brotherbale wake ndi kubwerera kumzinda. Pamenepo Yowabu anabwerera kuchokera kwa ana a Amoni ndi kubwerera ku Yerusalemu.
1CH 19:16	Aaramu ataona kuti agonjetsedwa ndi Aisraeli, anatumiza amithenga ochokera kutsidya lina la Mtsinje, pamodzi ndi Sofaki mtsogoleri wa gulu lankhondo la Hadadezeri.
1CH 19:17	Davide atauzidwa zimenezi, anasonkhanitsa Aisraeli onse ndi kuwoloka Yorodani ndi kupita kukakumana nawo. Iye anasankha gulu lankhondo kuti limenyane ndi Aaramu, ndipo iwo anamenyana naye.
1CH 19:18	Aaramu anathawa mu Israeli, ndipo Davide anapha Aaramu okwanira 7,000 okwanira magaleta ndi asilikali 40,000 oyenda pansi. Komanso anapha Sofaki, mtsogoleri wa gulu lankhondo.
1CH 19:19	Mafumu onse amene anali atumiki a Hadadezeri ataona kuti agonjetsedwa ndi Aisraeli, anachita mtendere ndi Davide ndipo anawatumikira. Kotero Aaramu sanathenso kuthandiza Aamoni.

Iye anati kwa mngelo wowononga, "Zokwanira! Tsopano bweza dzanja lako." Pa nthawi imeneyo mngelo wa Yehova anali ataimirira pamalo opunthira mbewu a Orinani Myebusi.
1CH 21:16	Davide atakweza maso anaona mngelo wa Yehova atayimirira pakati pa dziko lapansi ndi thambo. Kenako Davide ndi akulu aja, atavala ziguduli, anali kugona chafufumimba.
1CH 21:17	Ndipo Davide anati kwa Mulungu, Si ndine kodi amene ndinalamulira kuti anthu awerengeke? Ndinachita choyipa ichi; mliriwo utsalira anthu anu. Koma nkhosa izi, zachita chiyani? Yehova Mulungu wanga! Dzanja lanu likanthe ine ndi banja langa, koma mliriwo usakhale pa anthu anu. ""

1CH 21:22	Ndipo Davide anati kwa Orinani, Ukagulitse ine dwale ili, kuti ndimangire Yehova guwa la nsembe; ndidzalipira mtengo wake wonse, kuti mliri uchotsedwe mwa anthu.

1CH 21:24	Mfumu Davide inauza Ornani, "Ayi, ndikulimbikira kuti ndigule pa mtengo wathunthu. Sindingatenge zanu zanu ndikupereka ngati nsembe yopsereza kwa Yehova ngati sizindilipira chilichonse."
1CH 21:25	Ndipo Davide analipira golidi mazana asanu ndi limodzi a malowo.
1CH 21:26	Davide anamangira Yehova guwa la nsembe kumeneko; naperekapo nsembe zopsereza, ndi nsembe zoyamika. Anaitana kwa Yehova, amene anamyankha ndi moto wochokera kumwamba pa guwa la nsembe yopsereza.
1CH 21:27	Kenako Yehova analamula mngeloyo, ndipo mngeloyo anabwezera lupanga lake m'chimake.

1CH 23:20	Ana aamuna a Uziyeli anali Mika woyamba, ndi Isiya wachiwiri.
1CH 23:21	Ana a Merari anali Mali ndi Musi. Ana a Mali anali Eleazara ndi Kisi.
1CH 23:22	Eleazara anamwalira wopanda mwana wamwamuna. Anali ndi ana akazi okha. Ana a Kisi anakwatira.
1CH 23:23	Ana atatu a Musi anali Mali, Ederi, ndi Yerimoti.

1CH 23:25	Pakuti Davide anati, Yehova Mulungu wa Israyeli wapumulitsa anthu ake; akhala m'nyumba yake ku Yerusalemu kosatha.

1CH 23:27	Pakuti ndi mawu otsiriza a Davide anawerenga Alevi, kuyambira a zaka makumi awiri ndi mphambu.

1CH 26:10	Hosa, mbadwa ya Merari, anali ndi ana. Ana onse a Hosa ndi abale ake analipo khumi ndi atatu. Shimri mtsogoleri (ngakhale sanali woyamba kubadwa, abambo ake anamusankha kukhala mtsogoleri),

1CH 26:15	Obedi Edomu anamupatsa chipata chakumwera, ndipo ana ake anapatsidwa nkhokwe.
1CH 26:16	Chipinda cha Supimu ndi Hosa chinayang'aniridwa ndi chipata cha kumadzulo pamodzi ndi chipata cha Saleketi. Mawotchi amapangidwira banja lililonse.

1CH 26:25	Abale ake ochokera ku banja la Eliezere anali awa: Rehabiya mwana wake, Yesaiya, Yoramu mwana wa Yoramu, Zikiri mwana wa Yoramu, ndi Selomiti mwana wa Zikiri.

1CH 26:31	Kuchokera ku zidzukulu za Hebroni, Yeriya anali mtsogoleri wa zidzukulu zake, owerengedwa mwa mndandanda wa mabanja awo. M'chaka cha 40 cha ulamuliro wa Davide, iwo anafufuza m'mabuku a mbiri yawo ndipo anapeza ena mwa amuna odziwa bwino ntchito yawo ku Yazeri wa ku Giliyadi.
1CH 26:32	Yeriya anali ndi achibale 2,700, omwe anali atsogoleri othandiza mabanja. Davide anawayika akhale oyang'anira a fuko la Rubeni, Gadi, ndi theka la fuko la Manase, pa ntchito zonse za Mulungu ndi ntchito za mfumu.

1CH 28:0	Mutu 28
1CH 28:1	Davide anasonkhanitsa akalonga onse a Israeli ku Yerusalemu: atsogoleri a mafuko, oyang ofanira magulu amene anali kutumikira mfumu pa ntchito yawo, atsogoleri a magulu a anthu 1,000 ndi a anthu 100, oyang overanira katundu ndi katundu wa mfumu. mwa ana ake aamuna, ndi akapitawo, ndi amuna ankhondo, kuphatikizapo aluso koposa mwa iwo.
1CH 28:2	Pamenepo mfumu Davide inaimirira nati, Mverani ine, abale anga ndi anthu anga. Ndinali ndi cholinga chomanga nyumba ya likasa la chipangano cha Yehova; chopondapo mapazi cha Mulungu wathu, ndipo ndakonzekera
1CH 28:3	koma Mulungu anati kwa ine, 'Simudzamangira dzina langa nyumba, chifukwa uli munthu wankhondo ndipo wakhetsa mwazi.'
1CH 28:4	Komabe Yehova, Mulungu wa Israeli, anandisankha m familybanja lonse la abambo anga kuti ndikhale mfumu ya Israeli kwamuyaya. Iye anasankha Yuda kukhala mtsogoleri, ndipo kuchokera m ofnyumba ya Yuda anasankha nyumba ya abambo anga,
1CH 28:5	ndipo pakati pa ana onse aamuna a abambo anga anakondwera kundipanga ine kukhala mfumu ya Israeli yense.
1CH 28:6	Anandiuza kuti, 'Solomoni mwana wako ndi amene adzamange nyumba yanga ndi mabwalo anga, chifukwa ndamusankha kuti akhale mwana wanga, ndipo ine ndidzakhala abambo ake.
1CH 28:7	Ndidzakhazikitsa ufumu wake kwamuyaya, ngati apitirizabe kumvera malamulo anga, monga lero lino. '
1CH 28:8	Tsopano, pamaso pa Aisraeli onse, msonkhano uwu wa Yehova, ndi pamaso pa Mulungu wathu, nonse muyenera kusunga ndi kuyesetsa kuchita malamulo onse a Yehova Mulungu wanu. Chitani izi kuti mukhale m landdziko lokoma ili ndi kulisiya m astchire kwa zidzukulu zanu pambuyo panu kwamuyaya.
1CH 28:9	Koma iwe Solomo mwana wanga, mvera Mulungu wa atate wako, umtumikire ndi mtima wako wonse, ndi mzimu wofunitsitsa. Chitani ichi chifukwa Yahweh amasanthula mitima yonse ndikumvetsetsa zomwe zimalimbikitsa malingaliro a aliyense. Mukamfunafuna, adzapezeka nanu, koma mukamusiya, adzakukanani mpaka kalekale.
1CH 28:10	Dziwani kuti Yahweh wakusankhani kuti mumange kachisiyu ngati kachisi wake. Khala wamphamvu, nuchite.
1CH 28:11	Kenako Davide anapatsa mwana wake Solomo mapulani a khonde la kachisi, nyumba za pakachisi, zipinda zosungira, zipinda zam'mwamba, zipinda zamkati, ndi chipinda chokhala ndi chivindikiro chotetezera.
1CH 28:12	Anamupatsa mapulani amene anakokera mabwalo a nyumba ya Yehova, zipinda zonse zozungulira, zipinda zosungiramo nyumba ya Mulungu, ndi chuma cha zinthu za Yehova.
1CH 28:13	Anamupatsanso malangizo okhudza magulu a ansembe ndi Alevi, okhudza ntchito za m ofNyumba ya Yehova ndi za ntchito zonse za mnyumba ya Yehova.
1CH 28:14	Iye anayeza kulemera kwa ziwiya zonse zagolide pa ntchito iliyonse, kulemera kwa ziwiya zasiliva zogwirira ntchito iliyonse, kulemera kwa golide wa ziwiya zonse zagolide, zoyikapo nyale ndi nyale zagolide,
1CH 28:15	kulemera kwake kwa golide pa choyikapo nyale chilichonse, kulemera kwake wa siliva wa choikapo nyali chilichonse cha siliva, monga mwa kuikapo nyali iliyonse pakutumikira.
1CH 28:16	Anaperekanso kulemera kwa golide kwa matebulo a mkate wopatulika, tebulo lililonse, ndi kulemera kwake kwa siliva pa matebulo asiliva.
1CH 28:17	Anapereka kulemera kwa golide woyenga bwino wa mafoloko a nyama, mabeseni, ndi makapu. Iye anayeza kulemera kwake kwa mbale zonse zagolide, ndi kulemera kwake kwa mbale zonse zasiliva.
1CH 28:18	Anapereka kulemera kwa golide woyengedwa bwino wa guwa lansembe zofukiza, ndi golide wopangira akerubi otambasula mapiko awo ndikuphimba likasa la chipangano la Yehova.

1CH 28:21	Onani magulu a ansembe ndi Alevi otumikira m'Nyumba ya Mulungu onse. gwirani ntchitoyi. Atsogoleri ndi anthu onse ali okonzeka kutsatira malamulo anu. "
1CH 29:0	Mutu 29
1CH 29:1	Mfumu Davide inauza khamu lonselo kuti, "Mwana wanga Solomoni, amene Mulungu wamusankha yekha, akadali wachichepere komanso wosadziwa zambiri, ndipo ntchitoyi ndi yayikulu. Pakuti kachisi si wa anthu koma wa Yehova Mulungu.
1CH 29:2	Chifukwa chake ndachita zonse pereka kachisi wa Mulungu wanga. Ndikupereka golidi wa zinthu zopangidwa ndi golidi, siliva wopangira zinthu zasiliva, mkuwa wopangira zinthu zamkuwa, chitsulo chopangira chitsulo Ndikupatsanso miyala ya onekisi, miyala yoikidwapo, miyala yokhotakhota ya mitundu yosiyana-siyana — miyala yamtengo wapatali yamitundumitundu — ndi miyala ya mabo.
1CH 29:3	Tsopano, chifukwa cha kukondwera kwanga m'nyumba ya Mulungu wanga, ndapereka chuma changa chagolidi ndi siliva chifukwa cha icho. Ndikuchita izi kuwonjezera pa zonse zomwe ndakonzera kachisi wopatulika uyu:
1CH 29:4	matalente zikwi zitatu agolide ochokera ku Ofiri, ndi matalente zikwi zisanu ndi ziwiri za siliva woyengeka, kuti ndikute pa makoma a nyumbazi.
1CH 29:5	Ndikupereka golide pazinthu zopangidwa ndi golide, ndi siliva kuti zinthuzo zizipangidwa ndi siliva, komanso zinthu zogwirira ntchito zamitundumitundu. Ndani winanso amene akufuna kupereka chopereka kwa Yehova lero ndi kudzipereka yekha kwa iye? "
1CH 29:6	Napereka zopereka zaufulu ndi akuru a mabanja a makolo ao, ndi akuru a mafuko a Israyeli, ndi olamulira a zikwi ndi a mazana, ndi iwo akuyang'anira ntchito ya mfumu.
1CH 29:7	Anapereka kwa iwo ntchito ya pa nyumba ya Mulungu matalente zikwi zisanu ndi golidi wa golidi zikwi khumi, matalente a siliva zikwi khumi, matalente zikwi khumi ndi zisanu ndi zitatu, ndi matalente 100,000.
1CH 29:8	Amene anali ndi miyala yamtengo wapatali anawapereka mosungiramo chuma cha m'nyumba ya Yehova moyang'aniridwa ndi Yehieli, mbadwa ya Gerisoni.
1CH 29:9	Anthu anasangalala chifukwa cha nsembe zaufulu izi, chifukwa anapereka kwa Yehova ndi mtima wonse. Mfumu Davide nayenso anasangalala kwambiri.
1CH 29:10	Ndipo Davide anatamanda Yehova pamaso pa msonkhano wonse. Anati, Matamando, Yehova, Mulungu wa Israyeli kholo lathu, kunthawi za nthawi.
1CH 29:11	Ukulu, ndi mphamvu, ndi ulemerero, ndi chipambano, ndi ukulu, zanuzanu. Kwa zonse zakumwamba ndi padziko lapansi ndi lanu, ufumu ndi wanu, Yehova; ndipo wakwezedwa monga wolamulira pa zonse.
1CH 29:12	Chuma ndi ulemu zachokera kwa inu, ndipo mumalamulira anthu onse. M'dzanja lanu muli mphamvu ndi nyonga. Muli ndi nyonga ndi kulimba kuti mukulitse anthu ndi kupatsa mphamvu aliyense.
1CH 29:13	Tsopano, Mulungu wathu, tikukuyamikani ndi kulemekeza dzina lanu laulemerero.
1CH 29:14	Koma ine ndine yani, ndi anthu anga ndani, kuti ife tikhoza kupereka mwaufulu zinthu izi? Zoonadi, zonse zimachokera Kwa inu, ndipo takupatsani zomwe zili Zanu.
1CH 29:15	Popeza ndife alendo ndi oyendayenda pamaso panu, monga analili makolo athu onse. Masiku athu padziko lapansi ali ngati mthunzi, ndipo palibe chiyembekezo chotsalira padziko lapansi.
1CH 29:16	Yehova Mulungu wathu, chuma chonse chimene tasonkhanitsa kuti timange nyumba yolemekeza dzina lanu loyera — chimachokera kwa inu ndipo ndi chanu.
1CH 29:17	Ndikudziwanso, Mulungu wanga, kuti mumasanthula mtima ndikusangalala ndi kuwongoka. Koma ine, ndi mtima wowongoka ndapereka zinthu zonsezi mwaufulu, ndipo tsopano ndikuyang'ana mwachimwemwe pamene anthu anu amene muli pano akupereka mofunitsitsa kwa inu.
1CH 29:18	Yehova, Mulungu wa Abrahamu, Isake, ndi Israeli, makolo athu, sungani ichi kosatha m'malingaliro a anthu anu. Yendetsani mitima yawo kwa inu.
1CH 29:19	Umupatse mwana wanga Solomo ndi mtima wonse kuti asunge malamulo anu, malemba anu a chipangano, ndi malemba anu, kuti akwaniritse zolinganiza izi zonse zomangira nyumba yachifumu yomwe ndakonzera.
1CH 29:20	Ndipo Davide anati kwa khamu lonse, Tsopano lemekezani Yehova Mulungu wanu. Ndipo khamu lonse linatamanda Yehova, Mulungu wa makolo ao; ndipo anawerama ndi kulemekeza Yehova, ndi mfumu.
1CH 29:21	Tsiku lotsatira, anapereka nsembe kwa Yehova ndi kupereka nsembe zopsereza kwa iye. Anapereka ng'ombe zamphongo 1,000, nkhosa zamphongo chikwi chimodzi, ndi ana ankhosa 1,000, ndi nsembe zawo zachakumwa ndi nsembe zambiri kwa Aisraeli onse.
1CH 29:22	Pa tsikuli, iwo ankadya ndi kumwa pamaso pa Yehova ndi chikondwerero chachikulu. Bāmwek Solomonle Solomone, wandi mwana wa Davida, bu mulopwe, ne kumusanswa na bukomo bwa Yehova bwa kutonga. Anadzozanso Zadoki kuti akhale wansembe.
1CH 29:23	Kenako Solomo anakhala pampando wachifumu wa Yehova + monga mfumu m'malo mwa Davide bambo ake. Anachita bwino, ndipo Aisraeli onse anamumvera.
1CH 29:24	Atsogoleri onse, asilikali, ndi ana aamuna a Mfumu Davide anagonjera Mfumu Solomo. Ndipo
1CH 29:25	Yehova analemekeza Solomo pamaso pa Aisraeli onse, nam'patsa mphamvu zoposa zonse anapatsidwa ndi mfumu iliyonse m'Israyeli.
1CH 29:26	Davide mwana wa Yese analamulira Aisraeli onse.
1CH 29:27	Davide anali atakhala mfumu ya Israeli kwa zaka makumi anayi. Analamulira ku Hebroni zaka zisanu ndi ziwiri ndi zaka 33 ku Yerusalemu.
1CH 29:28	Anamwalira ali wokalamba, atakhala ndi moyo wautali, chuma ndi ulemu. Solomo mwana wake analowa ufumu m himmalo mwake.
1CH 29:29	Zochita za Mfumu Davide zinalembedwa m historymbiri ya mneneri Samueli, m history mbiri ya mneneri Natani, ndi m history mbiri ya mneneri Gadi.
1CH 29:30	Zolembedwa pali zochitika zaulamuliro wake, zomwe adachita komanso zomwe zidamukhudza iye, Israeli, ndi maufumu onse a m'maiko ena.

2CH 2:1	Manje solomoni analamulila kuti bamange nyumba ya zina ya Yehova na kumananga nyumba ya ufumu mu ufumu wake.
2CH 2:2	Solomo anaika bamuna 70,000 bonyamula katundu, na bamuna 80,000 kuti bankale bojuba  myala kumalupili, na bamuna 3,600 kuti bazibayanganila.
2CH 2:3	Pamene apo Solomo anatumiza mau kuli Hiramu mfumu ya ku Turo, kukamba kuti, “Monga mwamene munachitila na tate wanga Davide, pakumutumizila mitengo ya mkunguza kuti amange nyumba yonkalamo, imwe muchite so chabe na kuli ine.
2CH 2:4	Ona nasala pan'gono kumangila nyumba zina ya Yehova Mulungu wanga, kuti niyipatule,  na kuputiza  vonunkila pamenso pake, kupeleka mukate wopatulika, na nsembe zopseleza kuseni na kumazulo, pa Masabata na pa myezi yanyowani, na pa mapwando yo yikiwa ya Yehova Mulungu watu. ivi niva ntau zonse, kuli  Israeli.
2CH 2:5	Nyumba yamene nizamanga izankala ikulu maningi, chifukwa mulungu watu ni mukulu kuchila milungu zinango zonse.
2CH 2:6	Koma nindani angakwanise kumangila Mulungu nyumba, pakuti cholengewa chonse ngankale kumwamba sikungankale na eve? Ndine ndani kuti nimumangile nyumba, koma kuperekela nsembe zopsereza pamenso pake?
2CH 2:7	ndiye Chifukwa chake nitumizileni muntu waluso pa nchito ya golide, siliva, mkuwa, chisulo, na nyula ya chibakuwa, yofiila, na tonje yamanzi; azankala na bamuna baluso bamene bali na ine ku Yuda na ku Yerusalemu, bamene Davide tate banga anapasa.
2CH 2:8	Nitumizileni futi mitengo ya mkunguza, mkunguza, na mialigamu yochokela ku Lebanoni, chifukwa niziba kuti batumiki banu bamaziba kujuba mitengo ku Lebanoni. onani, banyamata banga bazankala na bakapolo banu,
2CH 2:9	kuti banikonzele mitengo yambili;
2CH 2:10	onani, nizapasa bakapolo banu, bamene bazadula mitengo, zikwi makumi yabili ya tiligu, makilogilamu zikwi makumi yabili ya balele, malita makumi yabili ya vinyo, na misuko ya mafuta zikwi makumi yabili.
2CH 2:11	Pamene apo Hiramu, mfumu ya ku Turo, anayanka na kulemba, nakutumiza kuli Solomo,'' nakukamba, pakuti Yehova akonda bantu bake, anakuyika iwe mfumu yao.
2CH 2:12	Kuwonjezerapo, Hiramu anakamba, "Adalisike Yehova, Mulungu wa Israeli, wamene analenga kumwamba na ziko yapansi, wamene anapasa mfumu Davide mwana wanzelu, wanzelu na woziba, bamene bazamangila Yehova nyumba na nyumba ya ufumu yake mwine.
2CH 2:13	Manje natumiza muntu waluso, Huram-Abi, wamene anapasiwa mpaso yo mvesesa.
2CH 2:14	Na mwana mwamuna wa mukazi wa bana bakazi ba Dani. Batate bake banali ba ku turo. eve  ni waluso pa nchito yagolide, siliva, yamkuwa, yachisulo, yamyala, yamitengo, na yofiirira, yamtambo, na yofiira, na bafuta yotelela. Futi niwaluso mukupanga vili vonse vo beza futi na kapangidwe ka vili vonse vosiyanasiyana. Mumupase malo pakati pa ba nchito banu baluso, na kuli ba Ambuye wanga Davide tate wanu.
2CH 2:15	Manje tiligu, balele, mafuta na vinyo, vamene mbuye wanga mwanena, atumize ivi kuli bakapolo bake. Tijuba mitengo kuchokela ku Lebanoni, mitengo yambili yamene  munga fune.
2CH 2:16	Tizayenda na imwe monga matanga yoyenda panyanja kuyenda ku Yopa, ndipo imwe muyende nabo ku Yerusalemu. "
2CH 2:17	Ndipo Solomo anabelenga balendo bonse bonkala muziko ya Israyeli, monga machitidwe Anababelenga Davide, atate bake. Beve banapezeka kuti benze 153,600.
2CH 2:18	Anabapasa bantu 70,000 kuti banyamule katundu, benango 80,000 kuti bankale Bojuba myala mumapili, ndipo 3,600 bankale boyang'anila bantu bogwila nchito.
2CH 7:1	Manje pamene Solomoni anasiliza kupempela, mulilo unabwela pansi kuchoka kumwmba na kushoka nsembe zoshoka na nsembe zopasa, ndipo ulemelelo wa Yehova unazula mu nyumba.
2CH 7:2	Bansembe sibanakwanise kungena mu nyumba ya Yehova, chifukwa ulemelelo wake unazula munyumba yake.
2CH 7:3	Pamene bana ba Israyeli banaona mulilo ubwela pansi na ulemelelo wa Yehova pamwamba pa nyumba, banagwada pansi nankope zawo pansi  pa mwala woikika na kulambila na kuyamika Yehova. Banati, "Pakuti ni wabwino, chifukwa chipangano chake nichamuyayaya."
2CH 7:4	Ndipo mfumu na bantu bonse banapeleka nsembe kwa Yehova.
2CH 7:5	Mfumu Solomoni inapeleka nsembe ya ng'ombe 22,000 na nkosa na mbuzi 120,000. Ndipo mfumu na bantu bonse banaipeleka nyumba ya Mulungu.
2CH 7:6	Bansembe banaimilila, aliyense kuimilila kwamene asebenzela; ma Levi nawo navilimba vawo vanyimbo kwa Yehova, vamene  Davide mfumu anapanga zoyamikila Yehova munyimbo, "Chifukwa chipangano chake chili chamuyayaya." Bonse bansembe banaliza malupenga pasogolo pawo, ndipo Israeli yonse inaimilila.
2CH 7:7	Solomoni anapatula pakati pa bwalo pasogolo pa nyumba ya Yehova. Kwamene uko anapeleka nsembe zoshoka na mafuta ya nsembe za kuyanjana, chifukwa guwa yansembe yamukuwa yamene banamanga siinakwanise kugwila nsembe zoshoka, nsembe zambeu na  zamafuta.
2CH 7:8	Ndipo Solomoni anachita chikondwelelo masiku yali 7, na bonse ba Israeli, musonkano waukulu kwambili, kuchokela ku Lebo Hamati mpaka ku mumana wa ku Igupto.
2CH 7:9	Pa siku lachisanu na chitatu anachita musonkano waukulu, chifukwa anapatulila guwa ya bansembe masiku yasanu na yabili, na madyelelo masiku yasanu na yabili.
2CH 7:10	Pa siku ya 23 ya mwezi wachisanu na chibili, Solomoni anatuma bantu kuti bayende ku matenti yawo na chimwemwe na mitima yokondwela chifukwa cha zabwino zamene Yehova anachitila Davide, Solomoni, na Israeli, bantu bake.
2CH 7:11	Momwemo Solomoni anasiliza kumanga nyumba ya Yehova na nyumba yake. Chilichonse chamene chinabwela mumutima wa Solomoni kupanga mu nyumba ya Yehova na munyumba yake, anachikwanilisa bwino.
2CH 7:12	Yehova anaonekela kuli Solomoni usiku nakumuuza kuti, "Nanvela pempelo yako, ndipo nazisankila yano malo monga nyumba yopelekelamo nsembe.
2CH 7:13	Nanga ngati navala kumwamba kuti kulibe nvula, kapena nalamulila zombekuononga ziko, kapena nikatuma matenda pakati pa bantu banga,
2CH 7:14	ndipo ngati bantu banga, bamene baitaniwa pazina yanga, bazazichepesa, kupempela, nakufuna nkope yanga, na kuchoka kunjila zawo zoipa, nianvela kuchoka kumwamba, kubakululukila machimo yawo, na kupolesa ziko yawo.
2CH 7:15	Manje nizasegula menso yanga na makutu yanga kunvela ku mapempelo yamene yachitikila pamalo yano.
2CH 7:16	Chifukwa nasanka na kupatula ino nyumba kuti zina yanga izankalapo muyayaya. Menso yanga na mutima wanga yazankala kwamene uko masiku yonse.
2CH 7:17	Koma iwe, ukayenda pamenso  panga monga Davide batate bako banayendela, kumvelela vonse vamene nakulamulila, na kusunga malamulo yanga, malemba anga,
2CH 7:18	nizankazikisa mupando wako wachifumu, monga ninakambila muchipangano na Davide batate bako , pamene ninakamba kuti, 'Mwana wako sazakangiwa kunkala olamulila Isiraeli.'
2CH 7:19	Koma ngati wachokako, na kukana malemba na malamulo yanga yamene naika pasogolo pako, ndipo ukayenda kupembeza milungu inangu na kuigwadila,
2CH 7:20	nizabachosa kuchoka mu ntaka yamene nabapasa. Iyi nyumba yamene naipatula chifukwa cha zina yanga, nizayitaya kuchoka pamenso panga, ndipo nizaipanga mwambo na chosekewa mukati mwa bantu.
2CH 7:21	Ngakhale  iyi tempele niyokwela kwambili, aliyense wamene azapita pafupi azadabwa eka. Bazafunsa kuti, 'Nichifukwa chani Yehova achita izi ziko lino na nyumba iyi?'
2CH 7:22	Benangu bazayanka, 'Chifukwa banakana Yehova, Mulungu wawo, wamene anabwelesa makolo yawo kuchoka mu ziko ya Aiguputo, ndipo banagwililila milungu inangu ndi kuigwadira na kuigwadia na kuipembeza. Ndiye chifukwa chake Yehova abwelesa chionongeko ichi chonse."
2CH 8:1	Chinachitika kuti pa kusila kwa zaka 20, pamene Solomoni anamanga nyumba ya Yehova na nyumba yake,

Anasanka futi olonda muvigawo pa komo iliyonse, ya Davide, muntu wa Mulungu, anavikambapo ivi.
