PRO 3:13	Wopeza nzeru ndi wodala; amapezanso luntha.
PRO 3:14	Zomwe upindula ndi nzeru ziposa siliva wobwezera, ndi phindu lake liposa golidi.
PRO 3:15	Nzeru n’zamtengo wapatali kuposa miyala yamtengo wapatali, ndipo palibe chimene mungachifune sichingafanane nazo.
PRO 3:16	Iye ali ndi masiku ambiri m’dzanja lake lamanja; m’dzanja lake lamanzere muli chuma ndi ulemu.
PRO 3:17	Njira zake ndi zokondweretsa, ndi njira zake zonse ndi mtendere.
PRO 3:18	Iye ndiye mtengo wamoyo kwa iwo akuugwira; amene akuugwiritsa amasangalala.
PRO 3:19	Yehova anakhazikitsa dziko lapansi ndi nzeru; ndi luntha anakhazikitsa zakumwamba.
PRO 3:20	Ndi nzeru zake zozama zinatseguka, ndipo mitambo inagwetsa mame.
PRO 3:21	Mwana wanga, izi zisachoke pamaso pako: sunga nzeru yeniyeni ndi kuzindikira.
PRO 3:22	Zidzakhala moyo wa moyo wako, Ndi chokongoletsera chachisomo chovala pakhosi pako.
PRO 3:23	Pamenepo udzayenda m'njira yako mosatekeseka, osapunthwa phazi lako;
PRO 3:24	Pogona iwe sudzaopa; pogona tulo tako tidzakhala tokoma.
PRO 3:25	Usaope zoopsa zodzidzimutsa, kapena chiwonongeko cha oipa chikafika,
PRO 3:26	pakuti Yehova adzakhala kumbali yako, ndipo adzateteza phazi lako kuti lisagwidwe mumsampha.
PRO 3:27	Musamana zabwino kwa amene akuyenera, pamene muli m'manja mwanu kuchita.
PRO 3:28	Usanene kwa mnzako kuti, “Pita ukabwerenso, ndipo mawa ndidzakupatsa,” pamene uli ndi ndalamazo.
PRO 3:29	Usapange chiwembu chochitira mnzako choipa, amene amakhala nawe mwamtendere.
PRO 3:30	Osatsutsana ndi munthu popanda chifukwa, pamene sanakuchitire choipa.
PRO 3:31	Usachitire nsanje munthu wachiwawa, kapena kusankha njira yake iliyonse.
PRO 3:32	Pakuti munthu wacinyengo anyansa Yehova, koma ampatsa woongoka mtima m’chikhulupiriro chake.
PRO 3:33	Themberero la Yehova lili pa nyumba ya woipa, koma amadalitsa nyumba ya anthu olungama.
PRO 3:34	Iye amanyoza onyoza, koma amakomera mtima anthu odzichepetsa.
PRO 3:35	Anzeru adzalandira ulemu; Koma opusa adzakwezeka m'manyazi ao.
PRO 4:0	Mutu 4
PRO 4:1	Ana inu, imvani mwambo wa atate, ndipo tcherani khutu, kuti mudziwe cidziwitso.
PRO 4:2	Ndikupatsani malangizo abwino; musasiye chiphunzitso changa.
PRO 4:3	Pamene ndinali mwana wa atate wanga, mwana mmodzi yekha wa amayi wanga,
PRO 4:4	anandiphunzitsa, nati kwa ine, Mtima wako ugwire mawu anga; sunga malamulo anga, nukhale ndi moyo.
PRO 4:5	Tenga nzeru ndi luntha; musaiwale, musakane mau a pakamwa panga;
PRO 4:6	usasiye nzeru, ndipo idzayang’anira iwe; mkondeni ndipo adzakusungani.
PRO 4:7	Nzeru ndiyo chinthu chofunika kwambiri; choncho tenga nzeru, nugwiritse ntchito zonse uli nazo, kuti upeze luntha.
PRO 4:8	Samalitsa nzeru, ndipo idzakukweza; adzakulemekezani pomfungatira.
PRO 4:9	Iye adzakuveka nkhata waulemu pamutu pako; adzakupatsa korona wokongola.
PRO 4:10	Tamvera mwana wanga, nulandire mawu anga, ndipo udzakhala ndi moyo zaka zambiri.
PRO 4:11	Ndikuphunzitsa m'njira yanzeru; Ndikukutsogolerani m’njira zowongoka.
PRO 4:12	Ukayenda palibe amene adzaima panjira yako, ndipo ukathamanga sudzapunthwa.
PRO 4:13	Gwira mwambo, usauleke; sungani, pakuti ndiwo moyo wanu.
PRO 4:14	Usatengere njira ya oipa, Usayende m'njira ya anthu ochita zoipa.
PRO 4:15	Pewani, musapitirirepo; upatuke ndi kupita njira ina.
PRO 4:16	For they cannot sleep until they do evil and they are robbed of sleep until they cause someone to stumble.
PRO 4:17	For they devour the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
PRO 4:18	Koma mayendedwe a olungama ali ngati kuunika koyamba kumera; imawala mochulukira mpaka kudzaza kwa tsiku kudzafika.
PRO 4:19	Mayendedwe a oipa ali ngati mdima, sadziwa cimene apunthwa.
PRO 4:20	Mwana wanga, mvera mau anga; tchera makutu ku zonena zanga.
PRO 4:21	Zisachoke pamaso pako; uwasunge mumtima mwako.
PRO 4:22	Pakuti mau anga ali moyo kwa iwo amene awapeza, ndi thanzi la thupi lawo lonse.
PRO 4:23	Sunga mtima wako, nuusunge ndi kusamala konse; pakuti m'menemo mutuluka akasupe a moyo.
PRO 4:24	Chotsani mawu okhotakhota kutali ndi inu; Maso ako ayang'ane kutsogolo, ndi kuyang'ana patsogolo pako.
PRO 4:25	Maso ako ayang'ane patsogolo, ndi kuyang'ana patsogolo pako.
PRO 4:26	Lunga phazi lako njira yolunjika; pamenepo njira zako zonse zidzakhazikika.
PRO 4:27	Usapatukire kulamanja kapena kulamanzere; tembenuza phazi lako ku zoipa.
PRO 5:0	Mutu 5
PRO 5:1	Mwana wanga, mvera nzeru zanga; tchera makutu ako ku luntha langa,
PRO 5:2	kuti uphunzire kuchenjera, ndi milomo yako itchinjirize chidziwitso.
PRO 5:3	Pakuti milomo ya mkazi wacigololo ikukha uci, ndipo m'kamwa mwace mukusalala koposa mafuta,
PRO 5:4	koma potsirizira pake ndi owawa ngati chivumulo, akudula ngati lupanga lakuthwa.
PRO 5:5	Mapazi ake atsikira kuimfa; Mapazi ake apita kumanda. Saganizira njira ya moyo.
PRO 5:6	Mapazi ake amayendayenda; sadziwa kumene amuka.
PRO 5:7	Tsopano, ana anga, ndimvereni; usapatuke kumvera mawu a pakamwa panga.
PRO 5:8	Njira yako ikhale kutali ndi iye, ndipo usayandikire pakhomo la nyumba yake.
PRO 5:9	Potero simudzapereka ulemu wanu kwa ena kapena zaka za moyo wanu kwa munthu wankhanza;
PRO 5:10	alendo sadzakondwera ndi mphamvu zako; ntchito zako sizidzalowa m’nyumba ya alendo.
PRO 5:11	Kumapeto kwa moyo wako udzabuula, pamene thupi lako ndi thupi lako ziwonda.
PRO 5:12	Udzati, “Ndinadana kwambiri ndi malangizo, ndipo mtima wanga unanyoza chidzudzulo!
PRO 5:13	Sindinamvera mau a aphunzitsi anga, kapena kutchera khutu kwa aphunzitsi anga.
PRO 5:14	Ndinatsala pang’ono kuonongeka pakati pa msonkhano, pakati pa kusonkhana kwa anthu.”
PRO 5:15	Imwa madzi a m’chitsime chako, ndi kumwa madzi oyenda a m’chitsime chako.
PRO 5:16	Kodi akasupe ako azimwazikana paliponse, ndi mitsinje yako yamadzi idzayende m'makwalala?
PRO 5:17	Zikhale zako wekha, osati za alendo okhala nawe.
PRO 5:18	Adalitsike kasupe wako, ndipo usangalale ndi mkazi wokula naye;
PRO 5:19	pakuti ndiye nswala wokonda ndi mbawala yachisomo. Mabere ake akukhutiritse nthawi zonse; uledzera nthawi zonse ndi chikondi chake.
PRO 5:20	Chifukwa chiyani iwe, mwana wanga, ugwidwa ndi mkazi wachigololo? Ukumbatiranji chifuwa cha mkazi wadama?
PRO 5:21	Yahova ambawona bzense bzomwe munthu ambacita, ndipo ambawona bzense bzomwe ambacita.
PRO 5:22	Woipa adzagwidwa ndi mphulupulu zace; zingwe za uchimo wake zidzamgwira.
PRO 5:23	Iye adzafa chifukwa chosowa mwambo; wasokeretsedwa ndi kupusa kwake kwakukulu.
PRO 6:0	Mutu 6
PRO 6:1	Mwana wanga, ngati wapeleka ndalama cha ngongole ya munzako wako wapafupi, ngati unamukongolesa munthu wamene suziba ,
PRO 6:2	wazitchela msampha na lonjezano yako, ndipo wagwiliwa na mau ya pakamwa pako.
PRO 6:3	Ukagwiliwa na mau yako, mwana wanga, chita ici uzipulumuse weka, popeza wagwa mukwanja ya munzako wako wapafupi; yenda ukazichepese, mukambisane milandu yako na munzako wako wapafupi.
PRO 6:4	Usagone tulo na manso yako na zikope zako sizakusile.
PRO 6:5	Zipulumuse weka ngati mbalame mukwanja ya mlenje, monga nyoni mukwanja ya msodzi.
PRO 6:6	Yangana nyelele, waulesi iwe, punzila njila zake, unkhale wanzelu.
PRO 6:7	Ilibe musogoleli, mukulu, kapena wolamulila,
PRO 6:8	koma ikonza zakudya zake mumalimwe  nakusunga zamene izadya  mu nthawi yokolola.
PRO 6:9	Ugona mpaka liti,waulesi iwe? Muzauka liti mutulo yanu?
PRO 6:10	''Kugona pangono, kukusila pangono, kupeteka manja pangono kuti mupumule” -
PRO 6:11	ndipo umphawi wanu uzabwela monga wachifwamba na zosowa zanu ngati musilikali wonkhala na zida.
PRO 6:12	Munthu wachabechabe -  munthu woyipa - ankhala na mau okhotakhota,
PRO 6:13	akuzidinizila na manso yake, akuloza na jala zake.
PRO 6:14	Amakonza zoyipa na chinyengo mumtima mwake; nthawi zonse amayambisa mikangano.
PRO 6:15	Chifukwa cake soka yake izamugwela mukanthawi kochepa; mukamphindi azasweka kosachilisiwa.
PRO 6:16	Pali vinthu visanu na imodzi  vamene Yehova amazonda , zisanu na ziwili zonyansa kwa eve:
PRO 6:17	Manso ya munthu wozitukumula, lilime yonama, manja okhesa mwazi ya banthu ya wosacimwa,
PRO 6:18	mutima wokonza ziwembu zoyipa, mendo yothamangila kucita zoyipa,
PRO 6:19	mboni yolankhula maboza na woshanga mikangano pakati pa abale.
PRO 6:20	Mwana wanga, mvela lamulo ya batate bako osasiya chiphunziso cha amai bako.
PRO 6:21	Yamange pamutima nthawi zonse; uyamange pamukosi pako.
PRO 6:22	Pamene muyenda, vizakusogolelani; pamene  mwagona pansi , azakuyanganila; ndipo mukauuka, yeve yazakuphunzisani.
PRO 6:23	Pakuti malamulo ni nyali, na chiphunziso ichi ni nyali; chilangizo camene chimabwela ni njila ya umoyo.
PRO 6:24	Ima kuchingiliza ku mukazi wachiwelewele, Kumau yotelela  ya mukazi wachiwelewele.
PRO 6:25	Usasilile kukongola kwake mumtima mwako ndipo asakukole na nsili zake.
PRO 6:26	Kugona na hule kungawononge mutengo wa buledi, koma mukazi wa wina angawononge umoyo wako.
PRO 6:27	Kodi munthu anganyamule moto pachifuba pake kosashoka zovala zake?
PRO 6:28	Kodi munthu angayende pa makala yamoto osapya mu mendo mwake ?
PRO 6:29	Ndiye mwamene munthu woloba kwa mukazi wa muzake wake wa pafupi ; wamene akukhuza sazaleka kulangiwa.
PRO 6:30	Banthu musanyoza wakuba ngati aba kuti apeze chakudya ali na njala.
PRO 6:31	Koma akagwiliwa, azibwezela kasanu na kawili zamene anaba; ayenela kusiya chilichonse chamutengo wapatali chili munyumba mwake.
PRO 6:32	Wochita chigololo alibe nzelu; wochita zamene izi aziwononga eka.
PRO 6:33	Vilonda na manyazi nizomuyenela ndipo manyazi yake sazafufutiwa.
PRO 6:34	Pakuti nsanje ikwiyisa munthu; sazachitila chifundo pobwezela chilango.
PRO 6:35	Sazalandila malipilo ndipo sangaguliwe, ngankhale mumupase mphaso zambili.
PRO 7:0	Mutu 7
PRO 7:1	Mwana wanga, sunga mau yanga na kusunga malamulo yanga mukati mwako.
PRO 7:2	Sunga malamulo yanga unkhale na umoyo, ndipo usunge malangizo yanga monga apulosi mu linso yako.
PRO 7:3	Uvimange pa vimbombo vako ; zilembe pa cholembapo cha mutima wako.
PRO 7:4	Nena kwa nzelu, ''Iwe ndiwe mulongo wanga,'' itani kuvesesa mbale wako,
PRO 7:5	kuti uziteteze kwa mukazi wachigololo, kuchokela kuli mukazi wachiwelewele amene amapanga mau yotelela yake.
PRO 7:6	Pa zenela ya nyumba yanga ninayangana  pa latisi.
PRO 7:7	Ninayangana banthu wosachangamuka , ndipo ninaona kuti pakati pa ba anyamata panali wachinyamata wopanda nzelu.
PRO 7:8	Munyamata uyu anapita mumusewu pafupi na mphambano ya mayiyo, nikupita kunyumba kwa mukazi uyu.
PRO 7:9	Kunali mumazulo, mazulo ya usana, nthawi ya usiku na mudima.
PRO 7:10	Kwamene mukazi wina anakumana na eve, anavala ngati hule, na mutima waboza.
PRO 7:11	Banali waphokoso na wosokela; mendo yake sanankhale kunyumba.
PRO 7:12	Manje mumisewu, na mumisika, na pobisalila pa ngodya zonse.
PRO 7:13	Ndipo anamugwila na mphamvu, naku mupsompsona, nkhope yake yamphamvu anamuuza eve kuti,
PRO 7:14	Napeleka lelo nsembe yamutendele, nachita zowinda zanga,
PRO 7:15	manje nabwela  kukumana na iwe, kufunafuna nkhope yako, ndipo ine nakupeza.
PRO 7:16	Nayanzika zofunda pa bedi panga, nsalu zamitundumitundu za ku Igupto.
PRO 7:17	Ndawaza pabedi yanga mure, aloe, na sinamoni.
PRO 7:18	Tiyeni, tikhute na chikondi kufikila mumawa; tiyeni tisangalale na nchito zachikondi.
PRO 7:19	Pakuti mwamuna wanga palibe kunyumba kwake; ayenda ulendo wautali.
PRO 7:20	Anatenga thumba ya ndalama pamozi naye ; azabwela pa siku ya mwezi wathunthu.''
PRO 7:21	Na kulankhula zambili  anamutembenuza; na milomo yake yosalala anamsokeresa.
PRO 7:22	Mwazizizi anayenda kuli eve monga ng’ombe yopita kukapayiwa, ndipo ngati chipuba chalangiwa na maunyolo
PRO 7:23	mpaka muvi ulasa pachiwindi chake. Anali monga nyoni yothamangila mumsampha. Sanazibe kuti zikanamutayisa moyo.
PRO 7:24	Manje, bana banga, mvelani kuli ine; tcherani khutu ku mawu a pakamwa panga.
PRO 7:25	Mutima wako usapatukile kumayendedwe yake; musasocheresewe mumayendedwe yake.
PRO 7:26	Wagwesa banthu bambili olasiwa; bamene eve anapaya  ni bambili.
PRO 7:27	Nyumba yake ili munjila za kumanda; amasikira ku zipinda zamumudima za infa.
PRO 8:0	Mutu 8
PRO 8:1	Kodi Nzeru siziitana? Kodi Kumvetsetsa sikukweza mawu ake?
PRO 8:2	Pa nsonga za mapiri m’mbali mwa msewu, m’mphambano za misewu, Nzeru yaima.
PRO 8:3	Pamaso pa zipata zolowera m'mudzi, polowera m'mzinda, afuula.
PRO 8:4	Ndikuitana inu, anthu inu, mau anga alankhula kwa ana a anthu;
PRO 8:5	inu opusa, phunzirani nzeru, ndi opusa inu mutenge mtima wozindikira.
PRO 8:6	Mvetserani, chifukwa ndilankhula zinthu zolemekezeka, ndipo potsegula milomo yanga ndidzanena zoongoka.
PRO 8:7	Pakuti pakamwa panga palankhula zokhulupirika, ndi zoipa zinyansa milomo yanga.
PRO 8:8	Mawu onse a m’kamwa mwanga ndi olungama; m’menemo mulibe chopotoka, kapena chokhota.
PRO 8:9	Zonsezo ndi zowongoka kwa munthu wozindikira; mawu anga ali olunjika kwa amene apeza chidziwitso.
PRO 8:10	Gulani mwambo wanga koposa siliva; phunzirani kudziwa koposa golidi wosankhika.
PRO 8:11	Pakuti nzeru iposa ngale; palibe chokoma chingafanane naye.
PRO 8:12	Ine Nzeru ndimakhala ndi nzeru, ndipo ndili ndi nzeru ndi kuzindikira.
PRO 8:13	Kuopa Yehova ndiko kuda zoipa. Ndidana ndi kudzikuza ndi kudzikuza, njira yoipa, ndi kalankhulidwe kopotoka; Ndimadana nawo.
PRO 8:14	Ndili ndi uphungu wabwino ndi nzeru zomveka; Ndine wozindikira; mphamvu ndi yanga.
PRO 8:15	Mwa ine mafumu acita ufumu, ndi olamulira akhazikitsa malamulo olungama.
PRO 8:16	Mwa ine akalonga amalamulira, olemekezeka, ndi onse oweruza mwachilungamo.
PRO 8:17	Ndikonda iwo amene amandikonda, ndipo iwo amene andifunafuna mwakhama adzandipeza.
PRO 8:18	Za ine chuma ndi ulemu, chuma chosatha ndi chilungamo.
PRO 8:19	Zipatso zanga ziposa golidi, ngakhale golidi woyengeka; zokolola zanga ziposa siliva woyengeka.
PRO 8:20	Ndimayenda m’njira yachilungamo, M’kati mwa mayendedwe achilungamo.
PRO 8:21	Chotero, amene amandikonda ndilandira chuma; Ndimadzaza chuma chawo.
PRO 8:22	Yehova anandilenga ine paciyambi, woyamba wa nchito zace zakale.
PRO 8:23	Ndinakhazikitsidwa kalekale, kuyambira pachiyambi, kuyambira chiyambi cha dziko lapansi.
PRO 8:24	Ndisanakhale nyanja, ndinabadwa, pasanakhale akasupe odzaza madzi.
PRO 8:25	Mapiri asanakhazikike, ndi zitunda zisanakhazikike, ine ndinabadwa.
PRO 8:26	Ine ndinabadwa Yehova asanalenge dziko lapansi, kapena minda, ngakhale fumbi loyamba pa dziko lapansi.
PRO 8:27	Ndinali komweko muja anakhazikitsa kumwamba, pozungulira iye pamwamba pa nyanja.
PRO 8:28	Ndinalipo pamene anakhazikitsa mitambo kumwamba, ndi pamene akasupe akuzama anakhazikika.
PRO 8:29	Ndinali komweko, poika malire ace panyanja, kuti madzi asapitirire analamulira, ndi poikira malire a maziko a nthaka youma.
PRO 8:30	Ndinali pambali pake ngati mmisiri waluso; Ndinali wokondwera naye tsiku ndi tsiku, wokondwera pamaso pake nthawi zonse.
PRO 8:31	Ndinakondwera m’dziko lake lonse, Ndi kukondwera kwanga mwa ana a anthu.
PRO 8:32	Tsopano ana anga, ndimvereni, pakuti iwo amene amasunga njira zanga adzadalitsidwa.
PRO 8:33	Mverani malangizo anga ndipo mukhale anzeru; musanyalanyaze izo.
PRO 8:34	Iye amene amvera Ine adzakhala wodala. Adzakhala akuyang’anira tsiku ndi tsiku pakhomo panga, nadikira m’mbali mwa mphuthu za zitseko zanga.
PRO 8:35	Pakuti aliyense wondipeza, wapeza moyo, ndipo Yehova adzam’komera mtima.
PRO 8:36	Koma iye amene alephera adzipweteka yekha; onse amene amadana nane amakonda imfa.
PRO 9:0	Mutu 9
PRO 9:1	Nzeru imamanga nyumba yakeyake; wasema mizati isanu ndi iwiri ya miyala.
PRO 9:2	Wapha nyama zake, wasanganiza vinyo wake, wakonzera tebulo lake.
PRO 9:3	Watumiza adzakazi ake; ipfuula pa nsonga za mzindawo, Ndani ali wopusa?
PRO 9:4	Alankhula kwa wopanda nzeru, Apatukire kuno!” Akulankhula kwa wosaganiza bwino.
PRO 9:5	Idzani, idyani chakudya changa, ndi kumwa vinyo amene ndasakaniza,
PRO 9:6	siyani zopusa zanu, nimukhale ndi moyo; yendani m'njira ya luntha.
PRO 9:7	Wodzudzula wonyoza adzalandira chipongwe;
PRO 9:8	Usadzudzule wonyoza, kuti angakudani; dzudzula wanzeru, ndipo adzakukonda.
PRO 9:9	Upatse wanzeru, ndipo iye adzakulitsa nzeru; phunzitsa wolungama, ndipo adzawonjezera pa maphunziro ake.
PRO 9:10	Kuopa Yehova ndiko chiyambi cha nzeru, ndi kudziwa Woyerayo ndiko luntha.
PRO 9:11	Pakuti mwa ine masiku ako adzacuruka, Ndipo zaka za moyo zidzaonjezedwa kwa iwe.
PRO 9:12	Ngati ndiwe wanzeru, udzichitira wekha wanzeru, ndipo ngati ukunyoza, udzanyamula wekha.”
PRO 9:13	Mkazi wopusa sadziwa; ndi wosaphunzitsidwa ndipo sadziwa kanthu.
PRO 9:14	Akhala pakhomo pa nyumba yace, Pampando wa pa misanje ya mudzi.
PRO 9:15	Afuulira iwo odutsa m’makwalala, kwa anthu oyenda molunjika m’njira zawo.
PRO 9:16	“Aliyense wopusa apatukire kuno,” akutero kwa anthu opanda nzeru.
PRO 9:17	“Madzi akuba ndi okoma, ndipo mkate wa mseri ndi wokoma.”
PRO 9:18	Koma sadziwa kuti akufa ali komweko, Kuti oitanidwa ace ali kunsi kwa manda.
PRO 10:0	Mutu 10
PRO 10:1	Miyambi ya Solomo. Mwana wanzeru akondweretsa atate wake; koma mwana wopusa atengera amake chisoni.
PRO 10:2	Chuma chounjidwa m'choipa sichipindula; koma kuchita zabwino kupulumutsa kuimfa.
PRO 10:3	Yehova salola moyo wa wolungama kukhala ndi njala; Koma zokhumba za oipa afooketsa.
PRO 10:4	Dzanja laulesi lisauka; Koma dzanja la wakhama lilemera. Mwana wanzeru amatuta m'malimwe.
PRO 10:5	koma kugona nthawi yokolola kuchititsa manyazi.
PRO 10:6	Madalitso a Mulungu ali pamutu pa wolungama; Koma m'kamwa mwa oipa mubisa ciwawa.
PRO 10:7	Wolungama akondweretsa omkumbukira; Koma dzina la oipa lidzabvunda.
PRO 10:8	Wa mtima wanzeru alandira malamulo,
PRO 10:9	Woyenda moongoka ayenda mosatekeseka; Koma wokhotakhota adzadziwika.
PRO 10:10	Wotsinzinira acititsa cisoni; Koma wolankhula citsinzi adzaonongeka.
PRO 10:11	M'kamwa mwa wolungama muli kasupe wa madzi a moyo; Koma m'kamwa mwa oipa mubisa ciwawa.
PRO 10:12	Udani uyambitsa mikangano; Koma cikondi cikwirira zolakwa zonse.
PRO 10:13	Nzeru ipezeka m'milomo ya wozindikira; Koma wopusa ndi ndodo.
PRO 10:14	Anzeru akundika kudziwa; Koma m'kamwa mwa citsiru payandikira chiwonongeko.
PRO 10:15	Chuma cha wolemera ndicho mudzi wace wa linga; umphawi wa aumphawi ndi chiwonongeko chawo.
PRO 10:16	Mphotho ya wolungama ndi moyo; phindu la oipa limawafikitsa ku uchimo.
PRO 10:17	Alipo njira ya kumoyo kwa wotsata mwambo; Koma wokana mwambo asokera.
PRO 10:18	Wobisa udani ali ndi milomo yonama, Ndipo amene amasinjirira ndi chitsiru.
PRO 10:19	Pakachuluka mawu zolakwa sizisoweka; koma wosamala polankhula ali wanzeru, koma wosamala m’mawuwo ali wanzeru.
PRO 10:20	Lilime la wolungama ndi siliva woyenga; m'mtima wa oipa mulibe phindu.
PRO 10:21	Milomo ya wolungama idyetsa ambiri; Koma opusa amafa chifukwa cha kupanda nzeru.
PRO 10:22	Madalitso a Yehova amabweretsa chuma, ndipo sawonjezerapo ululu.
PRO 10:23	Kuipa ndi masewera a chitsiru; Koma wozindikira akondweretsa nzeru.
PRO 10:24	Kuopa woipa kudzamgwira; Koma zokhumba za olungama zidzaperekedwa.
PRO 10:25	Oipa ali ngati namondwe wopita, ndipo palibepo, koma wolungama ndiye maziko amuyaya.
PRO 10:26	Monga vinyo wosasa m'mano, ndi utsi m'maso, momwemo waulesi kwa iwo akumtuma.
PRO 10:27	Kuopa Yehova kumatalikitsa moyo; Koma zaka za oipa zidzachepa.
PRO 10:28	Chiyembekezo cha olungama ndicho chimwemwe chawo; koma chiyembekezo cha oipa chidzatayika.
PRO 10:29	Njira ya Yehova ndi linga la angwiro, koma ochita zoipa ndi chionongeko.
PRO 10:30	Wolungama sadzaonongeka konse; koma oipa sadzakhala m'dziko.
PRO 10:31	M’kamwa mwa wolungama mutuluka nzeru, koma lilime lokhota lidzadulidwa.
PRO 10:32	Milomo ya munthu wolungama imadziwa chokomera mtima; koma m'kamwa mwa oipa mudziwa zokhota.
PRO 11:0	Mutu 11
PRO 11:1	Miyeso yonyenga inyansa Yehova, amakondwera ndi anthu amene amayeza miyeso yolondola.
PRO 11:2	Pakudza kudzikuza padzanso manyazi; koma kudzichepetsa kuli nzeru.
PRO 11:3	Umphumphu wa oongoka mtima umawatsogolera; Koma njira zokhotakhota za achiwembu ziwaononga.
PRO 11:4	Chuma n’chachabechabe pa tsiku la mkwiyo, koma kuchita zabwino kumapulumutsa ku imfa.
PRO 11:5	Mayendedwe a munthu wangwiro amawongola njira yake; Koma oipa adzagwa chifukwa cha kuipa kwawo.
PRO 11:6	Mayendedwe abwino a oongoka mtima amawasunga; Koma aciwembu akodwa ndi zilakolako zao.
PRO 11:7	Munthu woipa akamwalira, chiyembekezo chake chimatha, ndipo chiyembekezo chimene anali nacho m’mphamvu yake chimatheratu.
PRO 11:8	Wolungama amapulumutsidwa ku masautso ndipo amagwera oipa m'malo mwake.
PRO 11:9	Wosapembedza aononga mnzace ndi m'kamwa mwace; Koma olungama atetezedwa ndi nzeru.
PRO 11:10	Pamene olungama apindula, mudzi ukondwera; pamene oipa atayika, pali kupfuula kokondwa.
PRO 11:11	Ndi mdalitso wa oongoka mtima mudzi ukukwezeka; pakamwa pa oipa mudzi wapasulidwa.
PRO 11:12	Wonyoza mnzake alibe nzeru; Koma wozindikira amakhala chete.
PRO 11:13	Woyenda miseche amavumbulutsa zinsinsi; Koma wokhulupirira mtima abisa nkhani.
PRO 11:14	Popanda uphungu mtundu umagwa; Koma aphungu ambiri amapambana.
PRO 11:15	Wopereka chikole kwa mlendo ndithu adzapwetekedwa, koma amene amadana ndi kulonjezana lonjezano ali wotetezeka.
PRO 11:16	Mkazi wachifundo alemekezedwa; Koma aciwawa apeza chuma.
PRO 11:17	Munthu wachifundo amapindula yekha, koma wankhanza amadzivulaza yekha.
PRO 11:18	Woipa amanama kuti alandire mphotho yake; koma wofesa chilungamo amatuta mphotho ya choonadi.
PRO 11:19	Wolungama muntu adzakhala ndi moyo, koma wotsata zoipa adzafa.
PRO 11:20	Anthu amene mitima yawo ili yokhotakhota anyansa Yehova, koma akondwera nao angwiro njira zao.
PRO 11:21	Dziwani kuti woipa sangalangidwe, koma mbadwa za olungama zidzapulumutsidwa.
PRO 11:22	Monga mphete yagolidi m'mphuno ya nkhumba, Momwemo mkazi wokongola wopanda nzeru;
PRO 11:23	Zokhumba za olungama zipeza zabwino; Koma woipa ayembekezera mkwiyo.
PRO 11:24	Pali wina wobalalitsa—adzaunjikana zambiri; wina akaniza cilungamo, nasauka.
PRO 11:25	Munthu wopatsa adzapeza bwino, ndipo wopatsa ena madzi adzapeza madzi ake.
PRO 11:26	Anthu amatemberera munthu amene akana kugulitsa tirigu, koma mphatso zabwino zimaveka mutu wa wogulitsa.
PRO 11:27	Wofunafuna zabwino afunanso kukondedwa; koma wofunafuna choipa adzachipeza.
PRO 11:28	Wokhulupirira chuma chake adzagwa; koma olungama adzaphuka ngati tsamba.
PRO 11:29	Wogwetsa banja lake mavuto adzalandira mphepo, ndipo wopusa adzakhala kapolo wa munthu wanzeru.
PRO 11:30	Zipatso za wolungama ndi mtengo wamoyo; koma chiwawa chimachotsa moyo.
PRO 11:31	Taonani! Wolungama amalipidwa padziko lapansi; kuli bwanji woipa ndi wochimwa!
PRO 12:0	Mutu 12
PRO 12:1	Wokonda mwambo akonda kudziŵa; koma wakuda kudzudzulidwa ndi wopusa.
PRO 12:2	Yehova amakomera mtima munthu wabwino, koma munthu wochita ziwembu amadzudzula.
PRO 12:3	Munthu sakhazikika ndi zoipa; koma olungama sangazulidwe.
PRO 12:4	Mkazi wangwiro ndiye korona wa mwamuna wake; koma wochititsa manyazi akunga nthenda yovunditsa mafupa ace.
PRO 12:5	Zolingalira za olungama ndi zolungama; Koma uphungu wa oipa ndi wonyenga.
PRO 12:6	Mawu a oipa ali olalira kukhetsa mwazi; Koma mau a oongoka mtima amawasunga.
PRO 12:7	Anthu oipa agwetsedwa, ndipo palibe; koma nyumba ya wolungama idzakhazikikapo.
PRO 12:8	Munthu amatamandidwa chifukwa cha milomo yochenjera; Koma wopotoka mtima anyozedwa.
PRO 12:9	Wonyozeka amene ali ndi kapolo aposa iye amene amadzilemekeza koma alibe chakudya.
PRO 12:10	Wolungama asamalira zosoŵa za chiweto chake; Koma chifundo cha oipa ndi nkhanza.
PRO 12:11	Wolima munda wake adzakhala ndi chakudya chochuluka; koma wothamangitsa zinthu zopanda pake alibe nzeru.
PRO 12:12	Woipa akhumba zofunkha za oipa; Koma muzu wolungama ukhalitsa.
PRO 12:13	Woipa agwidwa ndi kulakwa kwa milomo yace; Koma wolungama apulumuka m'mavuto.
PRO 12:14	Ndi zipatso za mawu ake munthu amadzazidwa ndi zinthu zabwino, monga mmene ntchito ya manja ake imam’bwezera.
PRO 12:15	Njira ya citsiru ilungama pamaso pace; Koma wanzeru amamvera uphungu.
PRO 12:16	Chitsiru chivumbulutsa mkwiyo wace nthawi yomweyo; Koma wonyalanyaza chipongwe ali wanzeru.
PRO 12:17	Wolankhula coonadi anena zoona; koma mboni yonama icita cinyengo.
PRO 12:18	Mawu a munthu wolankhula mosalingalira bwino ali ngati kupyoza kwa lupanga; koma lilime la anzeru lilamitsa.
PRO 12:19	Milomo yoona ndi yosatha; Koma lilime lonama likhala kamphindi.
PRO 12:20	Muli chinyengo m’mitima ya iwo amene alingalira zoipa;
PRO 12:21	Zoipa sizidzagwera olungama; Koma oipa amazunzika.
PRO 12:22	Milomo yonama inyansa Yehova, Koma okhala mokhulupirika akondwera naye.
PRO 12:23	Wochenjera amabisa cidziwitso cace; Koma mtima wa zitsiru uturutsa utsiru.
PRO 12:24	Dzanja la akhama lidzalamulira, koma aulesi adzagwiritsidwa ntchito yokakamiza.
PRO 12:25	Nkhawa mumtima mwa munthu imulemetsa; Koma mau abwino amamkondweretsa.
PRO 12:26	Wolungama atsogolera mnzace; Koma njira ya oipa imasokeretsa.
PRO 12:27	Waulesi saotcha nyama yake; Koma wakhama adzapeza chuma cha mtengo wake.
PRO 12:28	Woyenda m'njira yoongoka apeza moyo, Ndipo m'njira yake mulibe imfa.
PRO 13:0	Mutu 13
PRO 13:1	Mwana wanzeru amamvera mwambo wa atate wake; Koma wonyoza samvera chidzudzulo.
PRO 13:2	Munthu adya zabwino ndi zipatso za m'kamwa mwake; Koma aciwembu adya ciwawa.
PRO 13:3	Wosunga pakamwa pake asunga moyo wace; Koma woyasamula milomo yace adziononga.
PRO 13:4	Mtima wa waulesi ukhumba, koma osapeza kanthu; koma wakhama adzakhuta;
PRO 13:5	Wolungama amadana ndi mawu onyenga; Koma woipa anyansidwa naye, nachita zochititsa manyazi.
PRO 13:6	Cilungamo cimateteza angwiro m'mayendedwe ao; Koma coipa ciononga ocimwa.
PRO 13:7	Pali wina amene amadzilemeretsa, koma alibe kalikonse, ndipo pali wina amene ataya zonse, koma ali ndi chuma chambiri.
PRO 13:8	Dipo la moyo wa wolemera ndi chuma chake; Koma waumphawi samva kuopseza.
PRO 13:9	Kuunika kwa olungama kukondwera; koma nyale ya oipa idzazimitsidwa.
PRO 13:10	Kunyada kumangoyambitsa mikangano, koma kwa amene amamvera uphungu wabwino ali ndi nzeru.
PRO 13:11	Chuma chikachuluka ngati chachabechabe chichepa, koma wopeza ndalama pogwira ntchito ndi dzanja lake amachulukitsa ndalama zake.
PRO 13:12	Chiyembekezo chikachedwa, chithyola mtima; Koma chokhumba chimene chidzakwaniritsidwa ndicho mtengo wamoyo.
PRO 13:13	Wonyoza mwambo adziwononga yekha; koma womvera lamulo adzalandira mphotho.
PRO 13:14	Chilangizo cha wanzeru ndicho kasupe wa moyo, wakucotsa ku misampha ya imfa.
PRO 13:15	Kuzindikira bwino kumabweretsa chisomo, koma njira ya achiwembu ndi tsoka.
PRO 13:16	Wochenjera amachita mwanzeru m'maweruzo onse; Koma wopusa aonetsa utsiru wace.
PRO 13:17	Mthenga woipa agwa m'mabvuto; Koma mthenga wokhulupirika alamitsa.
PRO 13:18	Wonyalanyaza mwambo adzakhala ndi umphawi ndi manyazi; koma wophunzira kudzudzulidwa adzapatsidwa ulemu.
PRO 13:19	Chilakolako chimene chakwaniritsidwa chikoma m'chilakolako; Koma kupatuka pa zoipa kunyansa opusa.
PRO 13:20	Yenda ndi anthu anzeru ndipo udzakhala wanzeru, koma wogwirizana ndi zitsiru adzapwetekedwa.
PRO 13:21	Tsoka lithamangira ochimwa; Koma olungama adzalandira zabwino.
PRO 13:22	Wabwino asiyira zidzukulu zace cholowa, Koma wochimwa amaunjikira wolungama chuma chake.
PRO 13:23	Munda wosalimidwa wa aumphawi ukhoza kutulutsa chakudya chambiri, koma upululuka ndi chisalungamo.
PRO 13:24	Wosagwiritsa ntchito ndodo adana ndi mwana wake; koma wokonda mwana wake asamalira kumulangiza.
PRO 13:25	Wolungama amadya kufikira kukhuta; koma m'mimba mwa oipa muli ndi njala nthawi zonse.
PRO 14:0	Mutu 14
PRO 14:1	Mkazi wanzeru amanga nyumba yake; koma wopusa alipasula ndi manja ake.
PRO 14:2	Woyenda moongoka amaopa Yehova, koma wokhotakhota m’njira zake amnyoza.
PRO 14:3	M'kamwa mwa citsiru mutuluka ndodo pa msana wace; Koma milomo ya anzeru idzawasunga.
PRO 14:4	Popanda ng'ombe, modyeramo modyeramo ndi woyera; koma zokolola zochuluka ndi mphamvu ya ng'ombe.
PRO 14:5	Mboni yokhulupirika sinama, koma mboni yonama imalankhula zonama.
PRO 14:6	Wonyoza afunafuna nzeru, koma palibe; Koma wozindikira adzapeza nzeru.
PRO 14:7	Ucoke pa citsiru, pakuti sudzapeza pa milomo yace nzeru.
PRO 14:8	Nzeru ya wocenjera ndiyo kuzindikira njira ya iye yekha; Koma utsiru wa zitsiru ndiwo chinyengo.
PRO 14:9	Opusa aseka nsembe yoparamula; Koma oongoka mtima agawanika.
PRO 14:10	Mtima umadziwa kuwawa kwawo ndipo palibe mlendo amene amagawana nawo chimwemwe chake.
PRO 14:11	Nyumba ya oipa idzapasuka; koma chihema cha oongoka mtima chidzaphuka.
PRO 14:12	Pali njira yooneka kwa munthu ngati yoongoka, koma mapeto ake ndi imfa.
PRO 14:13	Mtima ukhoza kuseka, koma uwawa, ndi cisoni cacikuru.
PRO 14:14	Wosakhulupirika mtima adzalandira zoyenera njira zake; Koma wolungama adzalandira zake.
PRO 14:15	Wopusa akhulupirira zonse; koma wochenjera asamalira mayendedwe ake.
PRO 14:16	Wanzeru amaopa, napeŵa zoipa; Koma wopusa anyalanyaza chenjezo.
PRO 14:17	Wofulumira kupsa mtima achita zopusa, ndipo munthu wochita ziwembu amadedwa.
PRO 14:18	Opusa alandira utsiru; Koma anzeru abvala nzeru.
PRO 14:19	Anthu oipa adzagwadira abwino, ndipo oipa adzagwada pa zipata za olungama.
PRO 14:20	Waumphawi amadedwa ngakhale ndi mabwenzi ake, koma olemera ali ndi mabwenzi ambiri.
PRO 14:21	Wonyoza mnzake achimwa; Koma wochitira osauka chifundo adala. Kodi sasokera ochita chiwembu?
PRO 14:22	Koma amene amalinganiza kuchita zabwino adzalandira chikondi chokhazikika ndi kukhulupirika.
PRO 14:23	Kugwira ntchito molimbika kumabweretsa phindu; koma kulankhula kokha kumabweretsa umphawi.
PRO 14:24	Korona wa anzeru ndi cuma cao; Koma kupusa kwa zitsiru kumawaonjezera utsiru.
PRO 14:25	Mboni yoona imapulumutsa miyoyo; Koma wolankhula zonama acita ciwembu.
PRO 14:26	Mkuopa Yehova muli chikhulupiriro cholimba; lidzakhala pothaŵirapo ana ake.
PRO 14:27	Kuopa Yehova ndi kasupe wa moyo, kuti munthu acoke ku misampha ya imfa.
PRO 14:28	Ulemerero wa mfumu umapezeka mwa unyinji wa anthu ake, koma popanda anthu kalonga amawonongeka.
PRO 14:29	Woleza mtima ali ndi luntha lalikulu, koma wachangu akweza utsiru.
PRO 14:30	Mtima wodekha ndi moyo wa thupi; koma nsanje ivunditsa mafupa.
PRO 14:31	Wotsendereza waumphawi anyoza Mlengi wake; Koma wochitira wosauka chifundo amlemekeza.
PRO 14:32	Woipa agwetsedwa ndi zoipa zace; Koma wolungama ali ndi pothawirapo ngakhale imfa.
PRO 14:33	Nzeru iri m'mtima wa wozindikira; Koma ingakhale mwa zitsiru izindikirika.
PRO 14:34	Kuchita chilungamo kumakwezera mtundu, koma uchimo ndi manyazi kwa anthu onse.
PRO 14:35	Mfumu ikondwera ndi kapolo wocita mwanzeru, koma mkwiyo wake uli pa wocita manyazi.
PRO 15:0	Mutu 15
PRO 15:1	Munthu wodziwa ali ndi mawu ochepa; ndipo wofatsa mtima ali ndi luntha.
PRO 15:2	Ngakhale wopusa ayesedwa wanzeru akatonthola; akatseka pakamwa pake amatengedwa kuti ndi wanzeru.
PRO 15:3	Mayankhidwe ofatsa abweza mkwiyo; Koma mau owawitsa aputa mkwiyo.
PRO 15:4	Lilime la anzeru liyamikila cidziwitso; Koma m'kamwa mwa opusa mutsanulira utsiru.
PRO 15:5	Chitsiru chipeputsa mwambo wa atate wace; Koma wophunzira kudzudzulidwa ali wanzeru.
PRO 15:6	M’nyumba ya wolungama muli chuma chambiri, koma zopindula za woipa zimbvuta.
PRO 15:7	Milomo ya anzeru iwanditsa nzeru; Koma mtima wa zitsiru sizitero.
PRO 15:8	Nsembe ya oipa inyansa Yehova, Koma pemphero la oongoka mtima limkondweretsa.
PRO 15:9	Mayendedwe a oipa anyansa Yehova; Koma akonda wotsata cilungamo.
PRO 15:10	Chilango chopweteka chimuyembekezera aliyense wosiya njirayo, ndipo wodana ndi kudzudzulidwa adzafa.
PRO 15:11	Manda ndi chiwonongeko zatseguka pamaso pa Yehova; koposa kotani nanga mitima ya ana a anthu?
PRO 15:12	Wonyoza sakonda womudzudzula; sadzapita kwa anzeru.
PRO 15:13	Mtima wokondwa usekeretsa nkhope; Koma ndi mtima wosweka mzimu ukusweka.
PRO 15:14	Mtima wa wozindikira ufuna kudziwa; Koma m'kamwa mwa opusa mudya utsiru.
PRO 15:15	Masiku onse a wosauka ali oipa; Koma wokondwera mtima ali ndi phwando losatha.
PRO 15:16	Zochepa uli ndi kuopa Yehova zipambana ndi chuma chambiri pamodzi ndi phokoso.
PRO 15:17	Kudya masamba pali cikondi, kuli bwino, Kuposa mwana wa ng'ombe wonenepa ndi udani.
PRO 15:18	Wokwiya aputa makani, Koma wosakwiya msanga atonthoza makangano.
PRO 15:19	Njira ya munthu waulesi ili ngati malo okhala ndi minga, koma njira ya oongoka mtima ili ngati khwalala lomangidwa.
PRO 15:20	Mwana wanzeru akondweretsa atate wace; Koma wopusa apeputsa amake.
PRO 15:21	Utsiru ukondweretsa munthu wopanda nzeru; Koma wozindikira amayenda m'njira yolunjika.
PRO 15:22	olingalira sizili bwino popanda uphungu; Koma ndi aphungu ambiri zipambana.
PRO 15:23	Munthu amasangalala akayankha moyenerera; ndi mawu a pa nthawi yake abwino bwanji!
PRO 15:24	Njira ya moyo ikwera m’mwamba kwa wochenjera, kuti apatuke kunsi kunsi.
PRO 15:25	Yehova akugwetsa nyumba ya wonyada, koma atetezera chuma cha mkazi wamasiye.
PRO 15:26	Malingaliro a oipa anyansa Yehova; Koma mau okoma ndi oyera.
PRO 15:27	Wopindula ndi phindu losalungama abvuta banja lace; koma wodana ndi ciphuphu adzakhala ndi moyo.
PRO 15:28	Mtima wa wolungama uganizira asanayankhe; Koma m'kamwa mwa oipa mutsanulira zoipa zonse.
PRO 15:29	Yehova ali kutali ndi oipa; Koma amamva pemphero la olungama.
PRO 15:30	Kuwala kwa maso kukondweretsa mtima, ndi uthenga wabwino uchiritsa thupi.
PRO 15:31	Khutu lomvera chidzudzulo chopatsa moyo lidzakhala pakati pa anthu anzeru.
PRO 15:32	Wokana mwambo adzipeputsa yekha; Koma womvera chidzudzulo apeza luntha.
PRO 15:33	Kuopa Yehova kulangiza nzeru, ndipo kudzichepetsa kutsogolera ulemu.
PRO 16:0	Mutu 16
PRO 16:1	Zolingalira za mtima ndi za munthu; koma mayankhidwe a lilime lake achokera kwa Yehova.
PRO 16:2	Njira zonse za munthu ziyera pamaso pace; Koma Yehova ayesa mizimu.
PRO 16:3	Pereka ntchito zako kwa Yehova ndipo zolingalira zako zidzakwaniritsidwa.
PRO 16:4	Yehova anacipangira ciliconse colinga cace, ngakhale oipa tsiku la tsoka.
PRO 16:5	Mtima wonse wokwezeka ndi wonyansa kwa Yehova, koma dziwani kuti sadzalephera kulangidwa.
PRO 16:6	Ndi kukoma mtima kosatha ndi kukhulupirika mphulupulu zimakhululukidwa ndipo chifukwa cha kuopa Yehova anthu asiya zoipa.
PRO 16:7	Njira za munthu zikakhala zokomera Yehova, amachititsa kuti ngakhale adani a munthuyo akhale naye pa mtendere.
PRO 16:8	Zapang'ono pamodzi ndi zolungama zipambana, kusiyana ndi kukhala ndi phindu lalikulu pamodzi ndi kusalungama.
PRO 16:9	Mumtima mwake munthu amalingalira njira yake; Koma Yehova ayendetsa mayendedwe ake.
PRO 16:10	Maweruzo anzeru ali pamilomo ya mfumu; pakamwa pake pasamachite chilungamo.
PRO 16:11	Miyeso yoona imachokera kwa Yehova; Miyeso yonse ya m’thumba ndiyo ntchito yake.
PRO 16:12	Kucita zoipa kunyansa mafumu; pakuti mpando wacifumu ukhazikika ndi kucita cilungamo.
PRO 16:13	Milomo yolungama ikondweretsa mfumu; ikonda wonena zoongoka.
PRO 16:14	Mkwiyo wa mfumu ndi mthenga wa imfa; Koma wanzeru adzadetsa mkwiyo wace.
PRO 16:15	M'kuwala kwa nkhope ya mfumu muli moyo, ndi cikondi cace cinga mtambo wa mvula wa masika.
PRO 16:16	Kulandira nzeru ndiko kwabwino kuposa golidi! Kupeza luntha kusankhidwa koposa siliva.
PRO 16:17	Msewu waukulu wa oongoka mtima upatuka ku zoipa; wosunga njira yake asunga moyo wake.
PRO 16:18	Kunyada kutsogolera chionongeko, ndi mzimu wodzikuza usanagwe.
PRO 16:19	Kudzichepetsa mtima pakati pa aumphawi kuli bwino, Koposa kugawa zofunkha ndi onyada.
PRO 16:20	Aliyense amene amasinkhasinkha zimene akuphunzitsidwa adzapeza zabwino, ndipo amene amakhulupirira Yehova adzadalitsidwa.
PRO 16:21	Munthu wanzeru mu mtima amatchedwa wozindikira, ndipo mawu okoma akulitsa luso la kuphunzitsa.

ECC 5:1	Samalira mayendedwe ako ukamapita ku nyumba ya Mulungu. Yandikirani kuti mumvere m'malo mongopereka nsembe kwa opusa, omwe sazindikira kuti akuchita zoyipa.
ECC 5:2	Musafulumire kulankhula ndi pakamwa panu, ndipo musalole mtima wanu kufulumira kufotokozera Mulungu chilichonse. Mulungu ali kumwamba, koma inu muli padziko lapansi, kotero mawu anu akhale ochepa.
ECC 5:3	Ngati muli ndi zambiri zochita komanso kuda nkhawa, mwina mudzakhala ndi maloto oyipa. Mukamalankhula kwambiri, mudzanenanso zopusa kwambiri.
ECC 5:4	Ukalonjeza kwa Mulungu, usachedwe kuzikwaniritsa, chifukwa Mulungu sasangalala ndi anthu opusa. Chitani zomwe mumalonjeza kuti mudzachita.
ECC 5:5	Ndibwino kuti usalumbire kusiyana ndi kupanga zomwe sunakwaniritse.
ECC 5:6	Musalole pakamwa panu kuchititse thupi lanu kuti lichimwe. Osati kwa wamthenga wa wansembe, "Lumbirolo linali lolakwika." Chifukwa chiyani mukukwiyitsa Mulungu polumbira monama, kuputa Mulungu kuti awononge ntchito ya manja anu?
ECC 5:7	Pakuti pamene pali maloto ambiri ndi mawu ambiri, amakhala opanda tanthauzo. Koma opani Mulungu;
ECC 5:8	Mukawona osauka akuponderezedwa ndikubedwa chilungamo ndi chilungamo m'chigawo chanu, musadabwe ngati kuti palibe amene akudziwa, chifukwa pali olamulira omwe amawayang'anira omwe ali pansi pawo, ndipo palinso ena apamwamba kuposa iwo.
ECC 5:9	Kuphatikiza apo, zokolola za minda ndi za aliyense, ndipo mfumu imatenga zomwezo kuchokera kumunda.
ECC 5:10	Aliyense wokonda siliva sakhutira ndi siliva, ndipo amene amakonda chuma amangofuna zambiri. Izinso, zilibe tanthauzo.
ECC 5:11	Chuma chikamakula, momwemonso anthu omwe amawononga. Kodi chuma chimapindulanji kwa mwini chuma kupatula kuti aziyang'ana ndi maso?
ECC 5:12	Tulo ta munthu wogwira ntchito n'tabwino, ngakhale adya pang'ono kapena zambiri, koma chuma cha munthu wolemera sichimamulola kuti agone bwino.
ECC 5:13	Pali choyipa chomwe ndidachiwona pansi pano: Chuma chomwe mwiniwake adasunga, zomwe zimadzetsa mavuto ake.
ECC 5:14	Wolemerayo atataya chuma chake mwangozi, mwana wake wamwamuna, amene wamuberekayo, amasiyidwa wopanda kanthu m'manja.
ECC 5:15	Monga munthu amachokera m'mimba mwa amake, momwemonso adzasiya wamaliseche. Sangatenge chilichonse cha zipatso za ntchito yake m'manja mwake.
ECC 5:16	Choipa china ndikuti monga munthu amabwera, amapitanso. Ndiye pali phindu lanji kwa iye amene amagwirira ntchito mphepo?
ECC 5:17	M'masiku ake amadya mumdima ndipo amasautsika kwambiri ndi matenda ndi mkwiyo.
ECC 5:18	Taonani, chimene ndaona kuti ndichabwino ndi choyenera kudya, ndi kumwa, ndi kusangalala ndi phindu la ntchito zathu zonse, monga tikugwira ntchito pansi pano kunja kwa masiku a moyo uwu umene Mulungu watipatsa. Pakuti uwu ndi udindo wa munthu.
ECC 5:19	Munthu aliyense amene Mulungu wapatsa chuma ndi chuma ndi kuthekera kolandira cholowa chake ndi kusangalala ndi ntchito yake — iyi ndi mphatso yochokera kwa Mulungu.
ECC 5:20	Pakuti sakumbukira nthawi zambiri masiku a moyo wake, chifukwa Mulungu amampangitsa kukhala wotanganidwa ndi zinthu zomwe amakonda kuchita.
ECC 6:0	Mutu 6
ECC 6:1	Pali choipa china chimene ndidachiwona pansi pano, ndipo chimalemera anthu.
ECC 6:2	Mulungu atha kupereka chuma, chuma, ndi ulemu kwa munthu kotero kuti asasowe kalikonse kamene amakhumba kwa iye yekha, koma kenako Mulungu samamupatsa kuthekera kokasangalala nako. M'malo mwake, wina amagwiritsa ntchito zinthu zake. Izi ndizopanda tanthauzo komanso vuto lowopsa.
ECC 6:3	Ngati munthu abala ana zana ndikukhala zaka zambiri, kuti masiku a zaka zake achuluke, koma ngati mtima wake sukhutitsidwa ndi zabwino ndipo sanaikidwe m'manda, ndiye ndinena kuti mwana wobadwa wakufa ali bwino kuposa momwe iye alili.
ECC 6:4	Mwana woteroyo amabadwa wopanda tanthauzo ndipo amapita mumdima, ndipo dzina lake limakutidwa ndi mdima.
ECC 6:5	Ngakhale mwana uyu sawona dzuwa kapena kudziwa chilichonse, ali ndi mpumulo ngakhale mwamunayo sanawone.
ECC 6:6	Ngakhale munthu atakhala ndi moyo zaka zikwi ziwiri koma osaphunzira kusangalala ndi zinthu zabwino, amapita kumalo omwe aja ena onse.
ECC 6:7	Ntchito za munthu zonse ndi za pakamwa pake, koma moyo wake sakhuta.
ECC 6:8	Kodi munthu wanzeru aposa bwanji citsiru? Kodi munthu wosauka ali ndi mwayi wanji ngakhale atadziwa momwe angachitire pamaso pa anthu ena?
ECC 6:9	Zomwe diso limawona ndizabwino kuposa zomwe mzimu umasochera pambuyo pake. Izinso ndi zopanda pake, monga kuthamangitsa mphepo.
ECC 6:10	Chilichonse chomwe chidalipo chapatsidwa kale dzina lake, ndipo mtundu wa anthu womwe udali kale wadziwika kale. Kotero zakhala zopanda ntchito kutsutsana ndi amene ali woweruza wamphamvu kuposa onse.
ECC 6:11	Mawu akachuluka, amakhala opanda tanthauzo. Ndi mwayi wanji kwa munthu?
ECC 6:12	Pakuti ndani adziwa zabwino kwa munthu m'moyo wake, m'masiku ochepa ndi opanda pake apyola ngati mthunzi? Ndani angauze munthu zimene zidzachitike pansi pano iye atachoka?
ECC 7:0	Mutu 7
ECC 7:1	Mbiri yabwino iposa zonunkhira zamtengo wapatali, ndipo tsiku lakumwalira liposa tsiku lakubadwa.
ECC 7:2	Kuli bwino kupita kunyumba yachisoni kusiyana ndi kupita kunyumba yamadyerero, chifukwa maliro amabwera kwa anthu onse kumapeto kwa moyo, kotero anthu amoyo ayenera kukumbukira izi.
ECC 7:3	Chisoni chiposa kuseka, chifukwa pambuyo pake nkhope ya munthu ikhala yachisoni, kukondwera mtima.
ECC 7:4	Mtima wa anzeru uli m'nyumba ya maliro, koma mtima wa opusa uli m'nyumba ya madyerero.
ECC 7:5	Kuli bwino kumvera chidzudzulo cha anzeru kuposa kumvera nyimbo ya opusa.
ECC 7:6	Pakuti monga kuseka kwaminga pansi pa mphika, momwemonso kuseka kwa opusa. Izinso ndi zopanda pake.
ECC 7:7	Kuba mwachinyengo kumapangitsa munthu wanzeru kukhala wopusa, ndipo ziphuphu zimawononga mtima.
ECC 7:8	Mapeto a chinthu aposa chiyambi; ndipo opirira mu mzimu aposa odzikuza.
ECC 7:9	Musafulumire kukwiya mumtima mwanu, chifukwa mkwiyo umakhala mumtima mwa opusa.
ECC 7:10	Usanene, Chifukwa chiyani masiku akale adapambana masiku ano? Chifukwa simufunsa funso ili chifukwa cha nzeru.
ECC 7:11	Nzeru, monga cholowa, ndiyabwino. Amapindulitsa iwo amene amawona dzuwa.
ECC 7:12	Pakuti nzeru imapereka chitetezo monga ndalama zingatetezere, koma phindu la chidziwitso ndilakuti nzeru zimapulumutsa moyo kwa iye amene ali nayo.
ECC 7:13	Taonani ntchito za Mulungu. Ndani angawongole chilichonse chimene wapotoza?
ECC 7:15	M'moyo wanga wopanda tanthauzo ndaona zonse. Pali munthu wolungama amene amawonongeka ngakhale ali olungama, ndipo pali munthu wina woipa amene amakhala ndi moyo wautali ngakhale kuti amachita zoipa.
ECC 7:16	Osamadziyesa olungama, anzeru m'maso mwanu. Bwanji uziwononga wekha?
ECC 7:17	Osakhala oyipa kwambiri kapena opusa. Uferanji isanakwane nthawi yako?
ECC 7:18	Ndibwino kuti mugwiritse nzeru izi, ndikuti musasiye chilungamo. Kwa munthu amene amaopa Mulungu amakwaniritsa zofunikira zake zonse.
ECC 7:19	Nzeru ndi yamphamvu mwa wanzeru, koposa olamulira khumi m'mudzi.
ECC 7:20	Palibe munthu wolungama pansi pano amene achita zabwino osachimwa.
ECC 7:21	Musamvere mawu aliwonse amene ananenedwa, chifukwa mungamve kapolo wanu akukutembererani.
ECC 7:22	Momwemonso, mukudziwa kuti mumtima mwako nthawi zambiri watemberera ena.
ECC 7:23	Zonsezi ndazitsimikizira mwanzeru. Ndidati, "Ndikhala wanzeru," koma zidaposa zomwe ndikanatha.
ECC 7:24	Nzeru zili kutali, ndipo ndizozama kwambiri. Ndani angazipeze?
ECC 7:25	Ndidatembenuza mtima wanga kuti ndiphunzire ndikusanthula ndi kufunafuna nzeru ndi mafotokozedwe a zenizeni, ndikumvetsetsa kuti choyipa ndichopusa ndipo kuti kupusa ndi misala.
ECC 7:26	Ndidapeza kuti owawa kuposa imfa ndi mzimayi aliyense amene mtima wake uli wodzaza ndi misampha ndi maukonde, ndipo manja ake ndi maunyolo. Aliyense amene amasangalatsa Mulungu adzapulumuka kwa iye, koma wochimwa adzagwidwa.
ECC 7:27	"Ganizirani zomwe ndapeza," akutero Mphunzitsi. "Ndakhala ndikuwonjezerapo chinthu china kuti ndipeze tanthauzo lenileni.
ECC 7:28	Izi ndizomwe ndimafunabe, koma sindinazipeze. Ndapeza munthu m'modzi wolungama pakati pa chikwi, koma mkazi mwa onsewo Sindinapeze.
ECC 7:29	Ndazindikira ichi chokha: Mulungu adalenga anthu owongoka, koma adapita kukafunafuna zovuta zambiri. "
ECC 8:0	Mutu 8
ECC 8:1	Munthu wanzeru ndi ndani? Ndani akudziwa tanthauzo la zochitika m'moyo? Nzeru mwa munthu imawalitsa nkhope yake, ndipo kuuma kwa nkhope yake kumasintha.
ECC 8:2	Ndikukulangizani kuti muzimvera lamulo la mfumu chifukwa cha lumbiro la Mulungu lomuteteza.
ECC 8:3	Usatuluke msanga pamaso pake, ndipo usayimire choipa chifukwa mfumu ichita chili chonse chikufuna.
ECC 8:4	Mawu a mfumu amalamulira, ndiye ndani angamuuze kuti, "Mukuchita chiyani?"
ECC 8:5	Aliyense wosunga malamulo a mfumu amapewa mavuto. Mtima wa munthu wanzeru umazindikira njira yoyenera ndi nthawi yochitapo kanthu.
ECC 8:6	Pazinthu zilizonse pali yankho lolondola komanso nthawi yoyankha, chifukwa mavuto amunthu ndi akulu.
ECC 8:7	Palibe amene akudziwa zomwe zikubwera mtsogolo. Ndani angamuuze zomwe zikubwera?
ECC 8:8	Palibe amene ali ndi mphamvu youletsa mphepo, ndipo palibe amene ali ndi mphamvu patsiku lakufa kwake. Palibe amene amasulidwa kunkhondo pankhondo, ndipo zoyipa sizingapulumutse iwo omwe ali akapolo ake.
ECC 8:9	Ndazindikira zonsezi; Ndayesetsa ndi mtima wanga ntchito zonse zochitidwa pansi pano. Pali nthawi yomwe munthu amapondereza mnzake kuti amupweteke.
ECC 8:10	Chifukwa chake ndidawona oyipa akwiriridwa m'manda. Adatengedwa kuchokera kumalo oyera ndipo adayikidwa m'manda ndipo adayamikiridwa ndi anthu mumzinda momwe adachitiramo zoyipa zawo. Izinso zilibe tanthauzo.
ECC 8:11	Chilango chokhudza mlandu woipa chikapanda kuchitidwa mwachangu, chimakopa mitima ya anthu kuti ichite zoyipa.
ECC 8:12	Ngakhale wochimwa amachita zoyipa nthawi zana ndipo amakhala ndi moyo nthawi yayitali, komabe ndikudziwa kuti zidzakhala zabwino kwa iwo amene amalemekeza Mulungu, kwa iwo amene amaima pamaso pake ndikumupatsa ulemu.
ECC 8:13	Koma munthu woyipa sadzamuyendera bwino; moyo wake sudzatalikitsidwa. Masiku ake ali ngati mthunzi wakanthawi chifukwa salemekeza Mulungu.
ECC 8:14	Palinso chinthu china chopanda tanthauzo chomwe chimachitika padziko lapansi: pali olungama omwe amalandira zomwe oyipa amayenera, ndipo pali anthu oyipa omwe amalandira zomwe oyenera amayenera. Ndidanenanso kuti izi ndi zopanda tanthauzo.
ECC 8:15	Chifukwa chake ndimalimbikitsa chimwemwe, chifukwa munthu alibe kanthu kabwino pansi pano kunja kwa kudya ndi kumwa, ndi kukondwa. Ndicho chisangalalo chimene chidzatsagana naye m'ntchito zake masiku onse a moyo wake amene Mulungu wamupatsa pansi pano.
ECC 8:16	Nditaika mtima wanga kuti ndidziwe nzeru ndi kumvetsetsa ntchito yomwe imagwiridwa pa dziko lapansi, ntchito yomwe imagwiridwa nthawi zambiri osagona kwa maso usiku kapena masana,
ECC 8:17	ndimaganizira ntchito zonse za Mulungu, ndikuti munthu sangathe kumvetsetsa ntchitoyi zomwe zachitidwa pansi pano. Ngakhale munthu agwire ntchito mwakhama kuti apeze mayankho, iye sawapeza. Ngakhale munthu wanzeru atha kukhulupirira kuti akudziwa, sadziwa.
ECC 9:0	Mutu 9
ECC 9:1	Chifukwa chake zonsezi ndinaziika mumtima mwanga, kuti ndizimveke bwino, ndipo ndidatsimikiza kuti olungama ndi anzeru, ndi zonse zomwe amachita, zili m'manja mwa Mulungu, koma palibe amene akudziwa ngati akuyembekezera chikondi kapena chidani.
ECC 9:2	Aliyense ali ndi tsoka lomwelo. Zofananazo zikuyembekezera olungama ndi oipa, abwino, oyera ndi osayera, ndi amene amapereka nsembe ndi amene samapereka. Monga anthu abwino amafa, momwemonso wochimwa. Monga wolumbira adzafa, momwemonso munthu amene akuopa kulumbira.
ECC 9:3	Chilango choipa chili chonse chomwe chimachitika pansi pano, zomwezi zimawachitikira onsewo. Mitima ya anthu yadzala ndi zoipa, ndipo misala ili m'mitima mwawo pamene ali ndi moyo. Kotero pambuyo pake amapita kwa akufa.
ECC 9:4	Woyanjana ndi amoyo ali ndi chiyembekezo, ngakhale galu wamoyo aposa mkango wakufa.
ECC 9:5	Pakuti amoyo adziwa kuti adzafa, koma akufa sadziwa kanthu bi. Alibenso mphotho chifukwa kukumbukira kwawo kwaiwalika.
ECC 9:6	Chikondi, chidani, ndi kaduka zawo zatha kalekale. Sadzakhalanso ndi malo pachilichonse chachitidwa pansi pano.
ECC 9:7	Pita ukadye chakudya chako mosangalala, ndi kumwa vinyo wako ndi mtima wosangalala, chifukwa Mulungu amavomereza kukondwerera ntchito zabwino.
ECC 9:8	Zovala zanu zizikhala zoyera nthawi zonse komanso mutu wanu udzoze mafuta.
ECC 9:9	Sangalala ndi moyo ndi mkazi wako amene umamukonda masiku onse a moyo wopanda pake uwu umene Mulungu wakupatsa pansi pano, masiku ako onse opanda pake. Pakuti iyi ndi mphoto yako m'moyo chifukwa cha ntchito yako yovuta imene unagwira ntchito pansi pano.
ECC 9:10	Chilichonse dzanja lako lichipeza kuchichita, gwira ntchito ndi mphamvu yako, chifukwa mulibe ntchito, kapena kulongosola, kapena kudziwa, kapena nzeru, kumanda ulikupitako.
ECC 9:11	Ndawonapo zinthu zosangalatsa pansi pano: Mpikisano suli wa anthu othamanga. Nkhondoyo si ya anthu amphamvu. Mkate si wa anthu anzeru. Chuma sichiri cha anthu ozindikira. Kukondera sikuli kwa anthu odziwa. M'malo mwake, nthawi ndi mwayi zimawakhudza onse.
ECC 9:12	Zowonadi, palibe amene amadziwa nthawi yake idzafika. Monga nsomba zikodwa mumsampha wakupha, kapena mbalame zikodwa mumsampha, ana a anthu amatcheredwa msampha ndi nthawi zoyipa zomwe zimawagwera modzidzimutsa.
ECC 9:13	Ndinaonanso nzeru pansi pano monga mwa nzeru zanga.
ECC 9:14	Panali mzinda wawung'ono wokhala ndi amuna ochepa okha, ndipo mfumu yayikulu idabwera kudzamenyana nawo, adauzungulira ndikumanga misewu yayikulu yomuzungulira.
ECC 9:15	Tsopano mu mzinda munapezeka munthu wosauka, wanzeru, amene mwa nzeru zake anapulumutsa mzindawo. Pambuyo pake, palibe amene adakumbukira munthu wosauka yemweyo.
ECC 9:16	Chifukwa chake ndidamaliza kuti, "Nzeru ipambana mphamvu, koma nzeru ya wosauka imanyozedwa, ndipo mawu ake samvedwa."
ECC 9:17	Mawu a anthu anzeru amene amalankhulidwa mwakachetechete amamveka bwino kuposa kufuula kwa mtsogoleri aliyense wa zitsiru.
ECC 9:18	Nzeru iposa zida za nkhondo, koma wochimwa m'modzi akhoza kuwononga zabwino zambiri.
ECC 10:0	Mutu 10
ECC 10:1	Monga ntchentche zakufa zimanunkhiritsa mafuta onunkhira, kupusa pang'ono kumatha kugonjetsa nzeru ndi ulemu.
ECC 10:2	Mtima wa munthu wanzeru umakhotera kumanja, koma mtima wa munthu wopusa umapendekera kumanzere kwake.
ECC 10:3	Munthu wopusa akamayenda panjira, kuganiza kwake kumakhala koperewera, kutsimikizira kwa aliyense kuti ndi wopusa.
ECC 10:4	Mtsogoleri akakukhumudwitsani, musasiye ntchito yanu. Kudekha kumatha kukhazika mtima pansi mkwiyo waukulu.
ECC 10:5	Pali choyipa chomwe ndidachiwona pansi pano, cholakwika china chochokera kwa wolamulira:
ECC 10:6	Opusa amapatsidwa utsogoleri, pomwe amuna opambana amapatsidwa maudindo ochepa.
ECC 10:7	Ndaonapo akapolo akukwera pamahatchi, ndipo amuna opambana akuyenda ngati akapolo pansi.
ECC 10:8	Wokumba dzenje adzagweramo, ndipo amene adzaboola khoma adzalumidwa ndi njoka. Wodula miyala akhoza kupwetekedwa ndi iye,
ECC 10:9	Wodula miyala akhoza kupwetekedwa ndi iye, ndipo amene amadula nkhuni ali pangozi.
ECC 10:10	Ngati chitsulo chimakhala chosalala, ndipo munthu osachilola, ayenera kugwiritsa ntchito mphamvu zowonjezereka, koma nzeru imapereka mwayi wopambana.
ECC 10:11	Njoka ikaluma isanalodzeredwe, ndiye kuti wosatsirayo alibe mwayi.
ECC 10:12	Mawu a m'kamwa mwa munthu wanzeru ali osangalatsa, koma milomo ya wopusa imamuwononga.
ECC 10:13	Mawu akuyamba kutuluka m'kamwa mwa chitsiru, utsiru umatuluka, ndipo pamapeto pake pakamwa pake pamatuluka misala yoyipa.
ECC 10:14	Wopusa amachulukitsa mawu, koma palibe amene akudziwa zomwe zikubwera. Ndani akudziwa zomwe zikubwera pambuyo pake?
ECC 10:15	Khama la opusa limawatopetsa, kotero kuti sadziwa ngakhale njira yopita kutauni.
ECC 10:16	Tsoka kwa iwe, nthaka, ngati mfumu yako ndi mwana, ndipo atsogoleri ako akayamba kudya m'mawa!
ECC 10:17	Koma ndinu odala inu, dziko, ngati mfumu yanu ndi mwana wa anthu olemekezeka, ndipo ngati atsogoleri anu amadya nthawi yoyenera, kuti akhale olimba, osati chifukwa cha uchidakwa!
ECC 10:18	Chifukwa cha ulesi denga limalowa, komanso chifukwa cha manja aulesi nyumba ikudontha.
ECC 10:19	Anthu amakonza chakudya kuti aseke, vinyo amasangalatsa moyo, ndipo ndalama zimakwaniritsa chilichonse.
ECC 10:20	Usatukwane mfumu, ngakhale mumtima mwako, ndipo usatemberere anthu olemera m'chipinda chako chogona. Pakuti mbalame ya mlengalenga imatha kunyamula mawu anu; chilichonse chokhala ndi mapiko chitha kufalitsa nkhaniyi.
ECC 11:0	Mutu 11
ECC 11:1	Ponya mkate wako pamadzi; pakuti udzapezanso pakapita masiku ambiri.
ECC 11:2	Gawani izi ndi anthu asanu ndi awiri, ngakhale asanu ndi atatu, chifukwa simudziwa masoka ati akubwera padziko lapansi.
ECC 11:3	Mitambo ikadzaza ndi mvula, imatsanulira pansi, ndipo mtengo ukagwa kumwera kapena kumpoto, kulikonse komwe mtengo ungagwere, ukhalabe komweko.
ECC 11:4	Woyang'anira mphepo sangabzale, ndipo woyang'anira mitambo sangakolole.
ECC 11:5	Monga simudziwa njira ya mphepo, kapena mafupa a mwana amakula m'mimba ya mimba, momwemonso simungamvetsetse ntchito ya Mulungu, amene adalenga zonse.
ECC 11:6	M'mawa mubzale mbewu zanu; mpaka madzulo, gwirani ntchito ndi manja anu momwe mukufunira, chifukwa simukudziwa chomwe chiti chichitike, kaya m'mawa kapena madzulo, kapena izi kapena izo, kapena ngati zonse zidzakhale bwino.
ECC 11:7	Zowonadi kuunika ndi kokoma, ndipo ndichokoma kuti maso awone dzuwa.
ECC 11:8	Ngati wina akhala zaka zambiri, asangalale ndi zaka zonsezi, koma aganizire za masiku akudza a mdima, chifukwa adzakhala ochuluka. Zonse zilinkudza zilibe tanthauzo.
ECC 11:9	Kondwera, ndiwe mnyamata, pa unyamata wako, ndi mtima wako usangalale masiku a unyamata wako. Tsatirani zokhumba zabwino za mtima wanu, ndi chilichonse chomwe mukuwona. Komabe, dziwani kuti Mulungu adzakuweruzani chifukwa cha izi.
ECC 11:10	Chotsa mkwiyo mumtima mwako, nunyalanyaze zowawa zilizonse m'thupi lako; chifukwa unyamata ndi mphamvu yake zilibe kanthu.
ECC 12:0	Mutu 12

ISA 1:0	Mutu 1
ISA 1:1	Masomphenya a Yesaya mwana wa Amozi, amene anaona za Yuda ndi Yerusalemu, m'masiku a Uziya, Yotamu, Ahazi, ndi Hezekiya, mafumu a Yuda.
ISA 1:2	Imvani, miyamba, mvuwe, dziko lapansi; pakuti Yehova wanena, Ndinalera bwino ndi kulera ana, koma iwo andipandukira.
ISA 1:3	Ng'ombeyo idadziwa mwini wake, ndi bulu amadziwa mbiya yake, koma Israyeli samadziwa, Israyeli samazindikira.
ISA 1:4	Tsoka! Mtundu, ocimwa, anthu olemedwa ndi mphulupulu, mbeu ya ocita zoipa, ana acinyengo; Anasiya Yehova, anyoza Woyera wa Israyeli, apatukana naye.
ISA 1:6	Bwanji mukumenyedwabe? Cifukwa ninji mupanduka kopitirira? Mutu wonse wadwala, mtima wonse wafooka. Kuyambira pansi pa phazi kufikira kumutu palibe gawo losavulazidwa; mabala okha, ndi mikwingwirima, ndi zilonda zatsopano zotseguka; sanatsekedwe, sanatsukidwe, sanamangidwa mabandeji, ndipo sanathiridwe mafuta.
ISA 1:8	Dziko lako lawonongeka; mizinda yanu yatenthedwa; minda yanu, pamaso panu, alendo akuwawononga; Mwana wamkazi wa Ziyoni wasiyidwa ngati kanyumba ka m'munda wamphesa, ngati malo okhetsedwa m'munda wa nkhaka, ngati mtengo wozingidwa
ISA 1:9	Ngati Yehova wa makamu sanatisiyire otsalira ochepa, tikadakhala ngati Sodomu, tikadakhala ngati Gomora.
ISA 1:11	Imvani mawu a Yehova, olamulira a Sodomu inu; mverani chilamulo cha Mulungu wathu, inu anthu a Gomora. ati Yehova. Ndakhuta nazo nsembe zopsereza za nkhosa zamphongo, ndi mafuta a nyama zonenepa; ndipo sindikondwera ndi mwazi wa ng'ombe zamphongo, ana ankhosa, kapena mbuzi.
ISA 1:13	Mukabwera kudzaonekera pamaso panga, ndani wakufunsani izi kuti muponde mabwalo anga? Musabweretse nsembe zachabechabe; zofukiza ndizonyansa kwa ine; mwezi wanu watsopano ndi masabata anu — sindingathe kulekerera misonkhanoyi.
ISA 1:14	Ndimadana ndi mwezi wanu watsopano ndi maphwando anu; zandilemetsa; Ndatopa kuwapirira.
ISA 1:15	Kotero pamene mutambasula manja anu ndikupemphera, Ine ndimakubisirani maso anga; ngakhale mupereke mapemphero ambiri, sindidzamvera; manja anu adzaza magazi.
ISA 1:16	Sambani, dziyeretseni; chotsani choipa cha machitidwe anu pamaso panga; lekani kukhala woyipa; phunzirani kuchita zabwino;
ISA 1:17	funani chilungamo, onetsani kuponderezana, weruzirani ana amasiye, thandizani amasiye. "
ISA 1:18	Bwerani tsopano, tiyeni tikambirane, ”akutero Yehova. "Ngakhale machimo anu atakhala ofiira, adzayera ngati matalala; ngakhale atakhala ofiira ngati kapezi, adzakhala ngati ubweya wa nkhosa.
ISA 1:19	Mukakhala omvera ndi omvera mudzadya zabwino za m'dziko,
ISA 1:20	koma mukakana, nkupanduka, lupanga lidzakudya, pakuti m'kamwa mwa Yehova mwatero.
ISA 1:21	Mzinda wokhulupirika wasanduka hule bwanji! Iye amene anali wodzala ndi chiweruzo — iye anali wodzala ndi chilungamo, koma tsopano iye wadzaza ndi ambanda.
ISA 1:22	Siliva wako waipitsidwa, vinyo wako wosanganizidwa ndi madzi.
ISA 1:23	Akalonga ako ndi opanduka, ndi anzawo a mbala; aliyense amakonda ziphuphu ndipo amathamangira kulandira zabwino. Iwo sateteza ana amasiye, ngakhalenso mlandu wa akazi amasiye suwadzudzula.
ISA 1:24	Cifukwa cace atero Ambuye Yehova wa makamu, Wamphamvu wa Israyeli, Tsoka kwa iwo! Ndidzabwezera cilango adani anga,
ISA 1:25	ndi kubwezera chilango adani anga; monga ndi lye, ndipo chotsa zinyansi zako zonse.
ISA 1:26	Ndibwezera oweruza ako monga poyamba, ndi aphungu ako monga poyamba paja; pamenepo udzatchedwa mudzi wolungama, mudzi wokhulupirika.
ISA 1:27	Ziyoni adzawomboledwa ndi chiweruzo, ndi olapa ake ndi chilungamo.
ISA 1:28	Opanduka ndi ochimwa adzaphwanyidwa pamodzi, ndipo iwo amene asiya Yehova adzachotsedwa.
ISA 1:29	"Chifukwa mudzachita manyazi ndi mitengo yopatulika yomwe mwayilakalaka, ndipo mudzachita manyazi ndi minda yomwe mwasankha.
ISA 1:30	Chifukwa mudzakhala ngati mtengo waukulu womwe masamba ake amafota, ndiponso ngati munda wopanda madzi.
ISA 1:31	Mwamuna wamphamvu adzanga mphonje, ndi ntchito yake ngati nsakali; zidzayaka zonse pamodzi, ndipo palibe wakuzimitsa. "
ISA 2:0	Mutu 2
ISA 2:1	Zinthu zimene Yesaya mwana wa Amozi anaziona m'masomphenya, zokhudza Yuda ndi Yerusalemu.
ISA 2:2	Kudzakhala m'masiku otsiriza kuti phiri la nyumba ya Yehova lidzakhazikika monga phiri lalitali kwambiri, ndipo lidzakwezedwa pamwamba pa zitunda, ndipo mafuko onse adzakhamukira kumeneko.
ISA 2:3	Anthu ambiri adzabwera nati, Tiyeni tikwere kunka kuphiri la Yehova, ku nyumba ya Mulungu wa Yakobo, kuti atiphunzitse zina mwa njira zake, ndipo tidzayenda m'mayendedwe ake. Pakuti m'Ziyoni mudzatuluka chilamulo, ndi mawu a Yehova kuchokera ku Yerusalemu.
ISA 2:4	Iye adzaweruza pakati pa akunja, nadzaweruza mitundu yambiri ya anthu; iwo adzasula malupanga awo akhale zolimira, ndi nthungo zawo zikhale anangwape; mtundu sudzanyamula lupanga kumenyana ndi mtundu wina, ndipo sadzaphunziranso nkhondo.
ISA 2:5	A nyumba ya Yakobo, tiyeni, tiyende m'kuwala kwa Yehova.
ISA 2:6	Pakuti mwataya anthu anu, nyumba ya Yakobo, popeza adzala ndi miyambo ya kum'mawa, ndipo aombeza ula monga Afilisti, ndipo agwirana chanza ndi ana a mlendo.
ISA 2:7	Dziko lawo ladzala ndi siliva ndi golidi, ndipo alibe malire; dziko lao ladzala ndi akavalo, ngakhale magareta ao alibe malire.
ISA 2:8	Dziko lawo ladzalanso mafano; amapembedza manja a manja awo, zinthu zopangidwa ndi zala zawo;
ISA 2:9	Anthuwo adzawerama, ndipo aliyense adzagwa pansi; choncho Usawaukitse.
ISA 2:10	Pitani kumiyala ndi kubisala munthaka chifukwa cha kuopa Yehova ndi ku ulemerero wa ukulu wake.
ISA 2:11	Maso apamwamba a munthu adzatsitsidwa, ndi kunyada kwa anthu kudzatsitsidwa, ndipo Yehova yekha adzakwezedwa tsiku lomwelo.
ISA 2:12	Pakuti padzakhala tsiku la Yehova wa makamu lotsutsana ndi yense wodzikuza ndi wodzikuza,
ISA 2:13	ndi kwa yense wodzikuza —ndipo adzatsitsidwa; mitengo ikuluikulu ya ku Basana
ISA 2:14	Tsiku la Yehova wa makamu lidzaukira mapiri onse ataliatali, ndi zitunda zonse zazitali,
ISA 2:15	ndi nsanja zonse zazitali, ndi makoma onse osagwedezeka,
ISA 2:16	ndi zombo zonse za Tarisi, ndi zombo zonse zokongola .
ISA 2:17	Kunyada kwa munthu kudzatsitsidwa, ndi kudzikuza kwa anthu kudzagwa; Yehova yekha adzakwezedwa tsiku lomwelo.
ISA 2:18	Mafano adzatha kwathunthu.
ISA 2:19	Amuna adzalowa m'mapanga a m'matanthwe ndi m'mapanga a nthaka chifukwa cha kuopsa kwa Yehova ndi ulemerero wa ukulu wake, pamene adzauka kuti aopsyeze dziko lapansi.
ISA 2:20	Tsiku lomwelo anthu adzataya mafano awo a siliva ndi golidi omwe adadzipangira okha kuti azipembedza, ndipo adzawaponyera ku zipolowe ndi mileme.
ISA 2:21	Anthu adzalowa m'ming'alu ya m'matanthwe ndi m'ming'alu ya miyala yowopsya, chifukwa cha kuwopsa kwa Yehova ndi ulemerero wa ukulu wake, pamene adzauka kuti aopseze dziko lapansi.
ISA 2:22	Lekani kudalira munthu, yemwe mpweya wake wamoyo uli m'mphuno mwake, chifukwa amandiyendera chiyani?
ISA 3:0	Mutu 3
ISA 3:1	Taonani, Ambuye Yehova wa makamu atsala pang'ono kuchotsa ku Yerusalemu ndi ku Yuda thandizo ndi ndodo; chakudya chonse, ndi madzi onse,
ISA 3:2	munthu wamphamvu, wankhondo, woweruza, ndi mneneri, wakuchita kuwombeza ndi wamkulu,
ISA 3:3	mtsogoleri wa makumi asanu ndi nzika yolemekezeka, phungu, amisiri aluso, ndi wanyanga.
ISA 3:4	"Ndidzaika achinyamata ngati atsogoleri awo, ndipo achinyamata adzawalamulira.
ISA 3:5	Anthu adzaponderezedwa wina ndi mnzake, ndipo aliyense ndi mnansi wake; mwanayo adzanyoza okalamba, ndipo onyozeka adzatsutsana ndi olemekezeka .
ISA 3:6	Mwamuna adzagwira m'bale wake m'nyumba ya bambo ake ndi kunena, 'Uli ndi malaya akunja; khala wolamulira wathu, ndipo kuwonongedwaku kukhale m'manja mwako. '
ISA 3:7	Patsikulo adzafuula kuti, 'Sindikhala mchiritsi; Ndilibe mkate kapena chovala. Simundiyesa wolamulira anthu. '"
ISA 3:8	Pakuti Yerusalemu wapunthwa, ndi Yuda wagwa; pakuti zolankhula zao ndi macitidwe ao atsutsana ndi Yehova, Ndi zonyoza maso a ulemerero wace.
ISA 3:9	Nkhope zawo zikuchitira umboni motsutsana nawo; ndipo amafotokoza tchimo lawo monga Sodomu; samazibisa. Tsoka kwa iwo! Pakuti adzichita okha tsoka
ISA 3:10	Uzani wolungama kuti zikhala bwino, chifukwa adzadya zipatso za ntchito zawo.
ISA 3:11	Tsoka kwa anthu oyipa! Zinthu zidzamuyendera bwino, chifukwa mphoto imene manja ake anamuchitira.
ISA 3:12	Anthu anga, ana ndiwo akuwapondereza, ndipo akazi amawalamulira. Anthu anga, iwo amene akutsogolerani akusokeretsani, nkusokoneza mayendedwe anu.
ISA 3:13	Yave wumvanganga mawu; wayimirira kuti anene anthu.
ISA 3:14	Yehova adzabwera ndi chiweruzo kwa akulu a anthu ake ndi atsogoleri awo: "Mwawononga munda wamphesa; zofunkha zaumphawi zili mnyumba zanu.
ISA 3:15	Chifukwa chiyani mukuthyola anthu anga ndikupera nkhope za anthu osauka?" Atero Ambuye Yehova wa makamu.
ISA 3:16	Yahweh akunena kuti chifukwa ana aakazi a Ziyoni ndi onyada, amayenda atakweza makosi awo, ndi maso achikondi, akuyenda ndi timayendedwe tating'ono pamene akupita, akumveka kulira kwa zibangili m'miyendo mwawo.
ISA 3:17	Chifukwa chake Ambuye adzapanga mphonje pamitu ya ana aakazi a Ziyoni, ndipo Yehova adzawadula.
ISA 3:18	Tsiku lomwelo Ambuye adzachotsa zokongoletsa zawo za akakolo, zingwe za kumutu, zokongoletsera za kachigawo,
ISA 3:19	ndolo, zibangili, ndi zophimba;
ISA 3:20	zovala zapamutu, maunyolo a akakolo, ma sasheni, ndi mabokosi onunkhiritsa, ndi zithumwa zamwayi.
ISA 3:21	Adzachotsa mphete ndi mphuno;
ISA 3:22	miinjiro yausangalale, ndi miinjiro yamkati, ndi zophimba,
ISA 3:23	ndi zikwama zam'manja; magalasi amanja, nsalu zabwino kwambiri, zidutswa zam'mutu, ndi zomangira.
ISA 3:24	M'malo mwa mafuta onunkhira padzakhala kununkha; ndi mmalo mwa lamba, chingwe; m'malo mwa tsitsi lokonzedwa bwino, dazi; ndi m'malo mwinjiro, chophimba chiguduli; ndi kutentha m'malo mokongola.
ISA 3:25	Amuna anu adzaphedwa ndi lupanga, ndipo amuna anu amphamvu adzaphedwa pankhondo.
ISA 3:26	Zipata za Yerusalemu zidzalira ndi kubuma; ndipo adzakhala yekha ndi kukhala pansi.
ISA 4:0	Mutu 4
ISA 4:1	Pa siku ija ba zimai bali seveni bazagwila mwamuna umozi nakukamba kuti, ''chakudya chili chatu tizachidya, vovala vili vatu tizavala. Koma titenga zina yako kuti tichose nsoni.''
ISA 4:2	Pa siku ija ntambi ya yehova izankala yo oneka bwino naya ulemelelo, na vipaso vamu malo vizankala vonzuna naku kondwelesa kuli abo bamene baapulumusiwa mu israeli.
ISA 4:3	Chiza chitika kuti wamene azasala mu ziyoni nawamene azasala mu yelusalemu azaitaniwa oyela, aliyense olembewe ngati wamoyo onkala mu yelusalemu.
ISA 4:4	Ichi chizachitika pamene ambuye aza suka vonyansa vabana bakazi ba ziyoni naku suka magazi yotimbilila kuchoka pakati pa yelusalemu,kusebenzesa muzimu woweluza namu zimu wamulilo woyaka
ISA 4:5	Ndipo pamwamba pamalo yonse yapa pili ya ziyoni napa mwamba pa malo yokumnila, yehova azapanga makumbi na chusi pama siku, naku wala kwa mulilo woyaka usiku; chizankala chonyamulilamo pa ulemelelo onse.
ISA 4:6	Chizankala chonkalamo chakamfwile muzuba kuchingiliza kupya, nako tabila na chovinikila kuchoka ku chimpepo chikulu na nvila.
ISA 5:0	Mutu 5
ISA 5:1	Ndimuimbire wokondedwa wanga, nyimbo ya wokondedwa wanga za munda wake wamphesa. Wokondedwa wanga anali ndi munda wamphesa paphiri lachonde kwambiri.
ISA 5:2	Anayipitsa, anachotsa miyala, ndipo anaibzala ndi mpesa wabwino kwambiri. Anamanga nsanja pakati pake, komanso anapangira moponderamo mphesa. Anayembekezera kuti ipange mphesa, koma amangobereka mphesa zamtchire.
ISA 5:3	Cifukwa cace tsono, wokhala ku Yerusalemu, ndi munthu wa Yuda, weruza pakati pa ine ndi munda wanga wamphesa.
ISA 5:4	Ndikanachitanso chiyani ndi munda wanga wamphesa, zomwe sindinachite? Pamene ndimayang'ana kuti ipange mphesa, bwanji wabala mphesa zakutchire?
ISA 5:5	Tsopano ndikuwuzani zomwe ndichite ndi munda wanga wamphesawo: Ndidzachotsa linga, ndidzalisandutsa msipu, ndidzagumula linga lake, ndipo lidzaponderezedwa.
ISA 5:6	Ndidzauwononga, ndipo sudzaudulira kapena kuuika. M'malo mwake, minga ndi minga zidzamera. Ndilamuliranso mitambo kuti isavumbire pa iyo.
ISA 5:7	Pakuti munda wamphesa wa Yehova wa makamu ndiwo nyumba ya Israyeli, ndi munthu wa Yuda chodzala chosangalatsa; adadikirira chilungamo, koma m'malo mwake, panali kupha; kuyembekezera chilungamo, koma m'malo mwake, fuulirani thandizo.
ISA 5:8	Tsoka kwa iwo amene alumikizana nyumba ndi nyumba, amene alumikizana ndi munda kumunda, kufikira sipadzasowanso malo, ndipo inu nokha mudzakhalabe m'dzikolo!
ISA 5:9	Yehova wa makamu anandiuza kuti, nyumba zambiri zidzakhala zopanda anthu, zazikulu ndi zokongola zosakhalamo aliyense.
ISA 5:10	Pakuti munda wamphesa wamphesa wokwanira magalamu khumi udzaperekanso mkasa umodzi wokha, ndipo homeri imodzi yokha idzapereka efa imodzi yokha
ISA 5:11	Tsoka kwa iwo amene amadzuka m'mawa kuti apeze chakumwa choledzeretsa, iwo amene amagona mpaka pakati pa usiku mpaka vinyo awotche.
ISA 5:12	Iwo ali ndi zeze, ndi lingaka, ndi maseche, ndi chitoliro, ndi vinyo pamaphwando awo, koma salemekeza zomwe Yehova wachita kapena samalemekeza ntchito ya manja ake.
ISA 5:13	Cifukwa cace anthu anga atengedwa ndende cifukwa ca kusazindikira; Atsogoleri awo olemera ali ndi njala, Ndi anthu wamba alibe chakumwa.
ISA 5:14	Chifukwa chake manda adakulitsa chilakolako chawo, natsegula pakamwa pake; osankhika, anthu, atsogoleri awo, ndi mapwando osangalatsa ndi iwo amene ali okondwa pakati pawo, atsikira ku Manda.
ISA 5:15	Munthu adzakakamizidwa kugwada, ndipo anthu adzatsitsidwa; diso lodzikweza lidzagwa pansi.
ISA 5:16	Yehova wa makamu adzakwezedwa ndi chiweruzo chake, ndipo Mulungu Woyera adzakhala woyera chifukwa cha chilungamo chake.
ISA 5:17	Kenako nkhosazo zidzadya ngati busa lawo, ndipo m'mabwinja, ana ankhosa adzadya monga alendo.
ISA 5:18	Tsoka kwa iwo amene amakoka mphulupulu ndi zingwe zopanda ntchito ndi amene amakoka tchimo ngati kuti ali ndi chingwe cha ngolo.
ISA 5:19	Tsoka kwa iwo amene ati, "Lolani Mulungu achite changu, achite mwachangu, kuti tiwone chikuchitika; ndipo zolinganiza za Woyera wa Israyeli zibwere, kuti tizidziwe."
ISA 5:20	Tsoka kwa iwo amene atcha zoipa zabwino zabwino, ndi zabwino zoipa zoipa; amene amayimira mdima ngati kuunika, ndi kuwunika ngati mdima; omwe amaimira owawa ngati okoma, ndi okoma ngati owawa!
ISA 5:21	Tsoka kwa iwo amene adziyesa anzeru ndi ochenjera m'kuzindikira kwawo!
ISA 5:22	Tsoka kwa iwo amene alimba pakumwa vinyo, ndi ambuye akusanganiza zakumwa zoledzeretsa;
ISA 5:23	amene amamasula woipa polipira, nam'chotsera wosalakwa ufulu wake!
ISA 5:24	Cifukwa cace monga lilime lamoto liwononga ziputu, ndi monga udzu wouma udzatentha ndi moto, momwemo muzu wao udzaola, ndi duwa lake lidzafuula ngati fumbi. Izi zidzachitika chifukwa chakana chilamulo cha Yehova wa makamu, ndi chifukwa chanyoza mawu a Woyera wa Israeli.
ISA 5:25	Chifukwa chake mkwiyo wa Yehova wayakira anthu ake. Watambasula dzanja lake pa iwo ndipo wawalanga. Mapiri agwedezeka, ndipo mitembo yawo ili ngati zinyalala m'makwalala. Mu zinthu zonsezi, mkwiyo wake sutha; m'malo mwake, dzanja lake lidakali lotambasulidwa.
ISA 5:26	Adzakweza mbendera yopita kumayiko akutali ndipo adzaimbira mluzu amene ali kumapeto kwa dziko lapansi. Taonani, abwera mofulumira ndipo mwachangu.
ISA 5:27	Palibe amene watopa kapena kukhumudwa pakati pawo; Palibe amene amagona kapena kugona. Ngakhale malamba awo samasulidwa, kapena nsapato za nsapato zawo zaduka.
ISA 5:28	Mivi yawo ndi yakuthwa ndipo mauta awo onse ndi okhota. ziboda za akavalo ao zili ngati mwala wolimba, ndi mawilo a magareta ao ngati mphepo yamkuntho.
ISA 5:29	Kubangula kwawo kudzakhala ngati mkango; adzabangula ngati mikango yamphamvu. Adzalira ndipo adzagwira nyama ija ndi kupita nayo kwina, popanda wowapulumutsa.
ISA 5:30	Tsiku lomwelo iwo adzabangula pa nyama ngati nyama za m'nyanja. Ngati wina ayang'ana padziko, adzawona mdima ndi kuzunzika; ngakhale kuwala kudetsedwa ndi mitambo.
ISA 6:0	Mutu 6
ISA 6:1	Mu chaka chamene mfumu Uziya anafa,ninaona ambuye alinkale pamupando wau mfumu; anali pamwamba naku kwezekewa, na nyula yake inazula mutempele.
ISA 6:2	Pawamba pake panali selafimi; aliyense anali nama papiko; yabili anambisa kumeso kwake, nayabili yanambisa kumendo kwake, nayabili yombulululikilako.
ISA 6:3	Aliyense anaitana wena nakukamba kuti, ''oyela, oyela, oyela, ni Yehova wamakamu! ziko yonse yapansi niyo zula na ulemelelo wake.''
ISA 6:4	Maziko yapopepetela yananyang'anya na mau ya abo bamene banali kulila, na nyumba inazula na chusi.
ISA 6:5	Mwaicho  nina kamba, ''soka kuli ine! pakuti naonongeka chifukwa ndine muntu wa milomo yosayela, ndipo ninkala pakati pa bantu bamilomo yosayela, chifukwa menso yanga yaona mfumu, Yehova wamakamu!''
ISA 6:6	Mwaicho umozi wa selafimi ana mbululukila kuli ine; anali nayo lilasha yenze kuyaka mumnja mwake, yamene ana chosa na mbaniro kuchoka ku guwa.
ISA 6:7	Anagwila nacho kamwa yanga nakukamba, ''Ona , ichi chagwila milomo yako; kulakwa kwako kwachosewa, na chimo yako yaombolewa.''
ISA 6:8	Ninanvela mau ya ambuye yakamba, ''ni ndani wamene  nizatuma; ni ndani wamene aztiyendela ise?'' Mwaicho ninakamba, ''ndine pano, nitumeni.''
ISA 6:9	Anakamba, ''yenda naku bauza aba bantu, 'nvelani, koma musa nvesesa; onani koma musa ganizila.?
ISA 6:10	Pangani mitima ya aba bantu kusanvesesa, na matu yabo nakusanvela, muvale meso yabo kusaona chifukwa bangaone na menso yabo, na kunvela na matu yabo, na kunvesesa na mitima zabo, naku pindamuka na kupola.''
ISA 6:0	Mwaicho nina kamba, '' ambuye, kufika liti?'' eve anayanka,
ISA 6:12	paka Yehova ana tuma bantu kutali, na malo onse kusoba bonkalamo.
ISA 6:13	Ngankale bantu bokwanila 10 basalamo,izaonogeka futi;monga kacere kapena mutengo wojubiwa na mutengo wamene wasala,mbeu yoyela ili muvikamba vake."
ISA 7:0	Mutu 7
ISA 7:1	Mu ma siku ya Ahaz mwana wa Jotani mwana wa Uziya,  mfumu wa Yuda, Rezini mfumu wa Aramu, na Peka mwana wa Remaliya, mfumu ya israeli, banayenda ku Yerusalemu mukumenyana nkondo nabo, koma sibanakwanise.
ISA 7:2	Chinakambiwa kunyumba ya Davida kuti Aramu anagwilizana na Efulemu. Mutima wake unatuntuma, ndipo namitima ya bantu bake, monga mitengo yamunsanga imanyang'anya na mpepo.
ISA 7:3	Ndipo Yehova anakamga kuti kuli Esaya, ''yenda panja namwana wako Shiya-Jashubu mukukumanya Ahazi pamwamba posilizila pamanzi, munjila yo yenda kumunda yaosuka manyula.
ISA 7:4	Mu uze, 'oyanganila bwino, nkala otekenya, osayopa olo kuyofewa na aba babili balibe nchito, mu ukali wa Rezini na Aramu, na wa Peka mwana Remaliya.
ISA 7:5	Aramu, Efulemu, na mwana wa Remaliya apanga zoipa kwa iwe; bakamba kuti,
ISA 7:6	''Tiyeni tikamumenye Yuda naku yofya, naku mungenela naku yika mfumu watu paja, mwana wa Tabe.''

ISA 7:8	chifukwa mutu wa Aramu ni damasikasi, ndipo mutu wa Damasikasi ni Rezin. Muzaka zokwanila 65, Efulemu azapwanyiwa ndipo sazankala bantu.
ISA 7:9	Mutu wa Efulemu ni samaria, ndipo mutu wa samaria ni mwana wa Remalia. Ngati simugwililila  kuchi kulupililo, zoona simuzasala bochingiliziwa.'''''

ISA 7:14	Mwaicho mulungu pali eka azamipasani imwe bantu chilangizo: Onani, mwana mukazi azankala namimba, nakubala mwana, ndipo muzaitana zina yake Emanuwele.
ISA 7:15	Azakadya mukaka na uchi pamene azaziba kukana voipa nakusanka cha bwino.
ISA 7:16	Pakuti pamene mwana akalibe kuziba kukana voipa nakusanka vabwino, malo yali na mfumu zibili zamene muyopa yazakawonongeka.
ISA 7:17	Yehova azaleta pali imwe, pa bantu banu, na pama nyumba yaba tate banu masiku yamene siyali monga iliyense kuchokela pamene Efulemu anatenga kuli Yuda- azaleta pali imwe mfumu yaba Asiriya.''

ISA 7:20	Pa ntawi ija mulungu azakagela na kaleza kanatenga kupitilila mumana wa Yufuletis- mfumu wa Asiriya- mutu na sis zaku mendo; azaka pyanga nandevu.
ISA 7:21	Pasiku ija, mwamuna azakasunga kamwana ka ng'ombe na nkosa zibili,
ISA 7:22	ndipo chifukwa chakupaka kwa mukaka wamene bazakapasa, azakadya mafuta yamukaka, pakuti aliyense anasala mumalo azakadya mafuta yamukaka na uchi.
ISA 7:23	Pa ntawi ija, kwamene kunali ma sauzandi ya mpesa inali kuguliwa na shekeli ya siliva yali sauzande, sikuzankala chilichonse kuchoselako chipupu na minga.

ISA 7:25	Bazakachoka mumalupili yamene yenze yanalimiwa nakambwili, chifukwa choyopa chipupu na minga; koma yazakankala malo yamene ng'ombe na nkosa vizakadyela.

ISA 8:8	Mumana uzapyanga kuyendelela mu Yuda, kuwononga naku pitilila mpaka ifike mumikosi mwanu. Mapapiko yake yotambasuka yazazula mufupi mwa malo yanu, manuweli."

ISA 8:14	Enve azankala ndiye malo opatulika; koma azankala mwala wotemelako, na mwala wochingiliza-pa yonse manyumba ya Isilayeli, Azankala chogililako na choteya kubantu bamu Yelusalemu.
ISA 8:15	Bambili bazabuntuliwa nawo nakugwa naku pwanika, bazagwiliwa naku tengewa.
ISA 8:16	Manga umboni wanga, vala lamulo yazo-ona, nakupasa bopunzila banga.

ISA 8:19	Bazakamba kuli iwe, "funsa kuli abo bamene bakamba na bakufa na mizimu, "bamene bama kambilila na kuombeza. Koma bantu sibafunika kufnsila Mulungu wabo? Nanga bafunika kufunsa bakufa pa bamoyo?
ISA 8:20	Pa lamulo na pa umboni! ngati sibanakambe vintu vaso, Nichifukwa balibe kusanikila kwakuseni  seni.
ISA 8:21	Bazapita mumalo bofokelatu na njala. Bakanvela njala, baza kalipa. Nakutembelela mfumu yabo na Mulungu wabo, pamene balangana nkope zabo kumwamba.
ISA 8:22	Bazayangana pa chalo nauona mavuto, kufipa, na kutitikiziwa koipa. Bazapelekewa muziko yamudima
ISA 9:0	Mutu 9
ISA 9:1	Mdimawo udzachotsedwa mwa iye amene anali kumva zowawa. M'mbuyomu ananyozetsa dziko la Zebuloni ndi dziko la Nafitali, koma m latermasiku otsiriza adzakongoletsa njira ya kunyanja, kutsidya la Yorodani, Galileya wa amitundu.
ISA 9:2	Anthu amene anayenda mumdima awona kuwala kwakukulu; iwo amene akhala m'dziko la mthunzi wa imfa, kuunikaku kwawawalira.
ISA 9:3	Mwachulukitsa mtundu; mwawonjezera chimwemwe chawo. Amakondwera pamaso panu monga chimwemwe m'nthawi yokolola, monga anthu akondwera akugawana zofunkha.
ISA 9:4	Pakuti goli la katundu wake, mtanda wa pamapewa ake, ndodo ya womzunza, mwaswa monga tsiku la Midyani.

ISA 9:6	Pakuti kwa ife mwana wakhanda wabadwa, kwa ife mwana wamwamuna wapatsidwa; ndipo ulamuliro udzakhala paphewa pake; ndipo adzamutcha dzina lake Wodabwitsa Wauphungu, Mulungu Wamphamvu, Atate Wosatha, Kalonga Wamtendere.
ISA 9:7	Za kukula kwa boma lake ndi za mtendere sizidzatha, popeza akulamulira pa mpando wachifumu wa Davide, ndi pa ufumu wake, kuukhazikitsa ndi kuuchirikiza ndi chiweruzo ndi chilungamo kuyambira tsopano kufikira nthawi zonse. Changu cha Yehova wa makamu chidzachita izi.
ISA 9:8	Yehova anatumiza mawu motsutsana ndi Yakobo, ndipo anagwera Israyeli.
ISA 9:9	Anthu onse adzadziwa, ngakhale Efraimu ndi okhala m'Samariya, akunena monyada ndi mtima wonyada kuti,
ISA 9:10	"Njerwa zagwa, koma timanganso ndi miyala yosema; mikuyu yagwetsedwa; m'malo mwawo. "
ISA 9:11	Chifukwa chake Yehova adzaukitsa Rezini, mdani wake, ndipo adzautsa adani ake,
ISA 9:12	Aaramu kum'mawa, ndi Afilisti kumadzulo. Adzameza ndi pakamwa potsegula. Mu zinthu zonsezi, mkwiyo wake sutha; m'malo mwake, dzanja lake lidakali lotambasulidwa.
ISA 9:13	Koma anthu sadzatembenukira kwa Iye amene anawamenya, kapena kufunafuna Yehova wa makamu.
ISA 9:14	Chifukwa chake Yehova adzadula pakati pa Israyeli mutu ndi mchira, nthambi ya kanjedza ndi bango, tsiku limodzi.
ISA 9:15	Mtsogoleri ndi munthu wolemekezeka ndiye mutu; ndipo mneneri wophunzitsa mabodza ndiye mchira.
ISA 9:16	Iwo amene atsogolera anthuwa akuwasokeretsa, ndipo omwe akuwatsogolera awameza.
ISA 9:17	Chifukwa chake Yehova sadzakondwera ndi anyamata awo, ndipo sadzachitira chifundo amasiye awo ndi akazi amasiye; Mu zinthu zonsezi, mkwiyo wake sutha; m'malo mwake, dzanja lake lidakali lotambasulidwa.
ISA 9:18	Kuipa kuyaka ngati moto; umadya minga ndi minga; imaotcha ngakhale nkhalango, zomwe zimatuluka utsi.
ISA 9:19	Ndi ukali wa Yehova wa makamu dziko latenthedwa, ndipo anthu akunga nkhuni. Palibe munthu akumvera chisoni mbale wake.
ISA 9:20	Adzagwira dzanja lamanja, nadzamva njala; adzadya chakudya kumanzere koma osakhuta. Aliyense adzadya nyama ya mkono wake.
ISA 9:21	Manase adzadya Efraimu, ndi Efraimu adzadya Manase; Iwo onse pamodzi adzaukira Yuda. Mu zinthu zonsezi, mkwiyo wake sutha; m'malo mwake, dzanja lake lidakali lotambasulidwa.
ISA 10:0	Mutu 10
ISA 10:1	Soka kuli aba bamene baika malamulo yosalunama naku kamba zosalungama na zilemba.
ISA 10:2	Anapoka chilungamo kuli losauka, kubela ovutika banty ufulu wabo kutengela akazi ofedwa bamuna, kutenga balibe makolo babo kunkala monga vinyama.
ISA 10:3	Uzachita chani pasiku ya chiweluzo pamene chionongeka chizabwela kuchokela kutali? nikuli ndani kwamene uzatabila kufuna tandizo, ndipo muzasiyila ndani chuma?
ISA 10:4	Palibe chizasala, ndipo uzankala pakati pabo mangiwa na kupezeka pabo paiwa, muli ivi vonse, ukali wake suseluka, mwakuti kwanja kwake nikotambuluka.
ISA 10:5	soka kwa Asilkya, nkolo yawukali wanga, ndodo yamene nizawonesera ukali wanga!
