MRK 3:20	Ndipo anayenda kunyumba, na banthu bambili banabwela pamozi futi, kuti bakane kudya buledi.
MRK 3:21	Pamene babanja bake bananvaa ivi, banayenda kuti bakamugwile, cifukwa anati, "aleka kuganiza bwino."
MRK 3:22	Balembi bamane banabwela kucokela ku Yelusalemu anati, "ali na vibanda vya Beluzabebu," ndipo, "mwa ulamulilo wa vibanda ochosa vibanda,"
MRK 3:23	Yesu anabaitana na kubauza mu myambi, "Zingachitike bwanji kuti Satana achose Satana?
MRK 3:24	Ngati ufumu niwogabanikana suungaimilile.
MRK 3:25	Ngati nyumba niyogabanikana, ija nyumba siingaimilile.
MRK 3:26	Ngati Satana aziukila eka na kugabanikana, sangaimilile, koma kwabwela kusila.
MRK 3:27	Koma palibe amene angangene munyumba ya wampamvu nakuba vonse vauja munthu bakalibe kumumangilila, ndiye pamene bangaononge nyumba yake.
MRK 3:28	Zoona nikuuzani , uchimo uliwonse wa mwana wa munthu uzakakhululukidwa, na minyozo yonse yokambiwa,
MRK 3:29	koma aliwonse wonyoza Muzimu Woyela sazakakhululukiwa, koma azankhala wochimwa ndi uchimo wa nthawi zonse."
MRK 3:30	Yesu anakamba izi chifukwa banali kukamba kuti, " Ali na mizimu yonyansa."
MRK 3:31	Ndipo bamai bake na babale bake banabwela nakuimilila panja. Banatuma banthu, nakumuitana.
MRK 3:32	Ndipo banthu bambili banalipo nankhala momuzungulila iye na kuti,"Bamai bako na babale bako bali panja, dnipo bakufuna,"
MRK 3:33	Anabayankha nakuti,"Nibandani bamai banga na babale banga?"
MRK 3:34	Anabalangana baja bamene banali nkhale banamuzunguluka nakuti,  "Onani, aba ndiye bamai banga na babale banga!
MRK 3:35	Chifukwa aliwonse wamene achita chifunilo cha Mulungu, uja munthu ndiye mubale wanga, na mulongo ndi mai wanga."
MRK 4:0	Mutu 4
MRK 4:1	Nafuti anayamba kuphunzitsa mumbali ya chimana. Ndipo anthu ambiri anaza kwa iye, ndipo anasika mu boti inali pachimana, nakhala pansi. Anthu wonse anali kumbali kwa chimana.
MRK 4:2	Anabaphunzisa zinthu zambiri mumafanizo, ndipo anati kwawo muciphunzinso,
MRK 4:3	Mvelani, mlimi anayenda kukafesa mbeu zake.
MRK 4:4	Pamene analikubyala, mbeu zina zinagwela munjila, mbalame zinabwela nakudya mbeu.
MRK 4:5	Mbeu zina zinagwela pamwala, panalibe doti yambili. Nthawi yamene zinangomela, cifukwa mizyu siinayende kwambili pansi pa doti.
MRK 4:6	Koma pamene zuwa inacoka, zinapya, cifukwa zinalibe mizyu zinayuma.
MRK 4:7	Mbeu zina zinagwela mitengo ya minga. Mitengo ya minga inakula ndipo mbeu inalasidwa, ndipo siinabale mbeu iliyonse.
MRK 4:8	Mbeu zina zinagwela panthaka yabwino ndipo zinabala zipaso pamene zinali kukula ndikuculuka, zina zinabala makumi yatatu (30), zina makumi asanu ndi imodzi (60), ndi zina makumi kumi (100)."
MRK 4:9	Ndipo anati, "uyo ali ndimakutu omvela, amve!"
MRK 4:12	Pamene Yesu anali yeka, iwo amene anali naye pafupi ndi iye ndi aja twelufu anamufunsa iye za fanizo.  Ndipo anati kwawo, "kuli imwezapasidwa zisinsi za ufumu wa Mlungu. Koma kwa iwo ali kunja zonse zili mumafanizilo, kuti pamene apenya, inde azapenya, koma sazaona, ndipo pamene azamva, inde zamva, koma sazamvesa, kuti angabwelele kuli Mlungu ndikubakhululukila macimo yawo."
MRK 4:13	Ndipo anati kwa iwo, "Simvesesa fanizo iyi? Muzamvesesa bwanji mafanizo yena?
MRK 4:14	Mlimi amaene anafesa mbeu yake ndiye amane afesa mau.
MRK 4:15	Zina zimene zinagwela mbali mwa njila, mwamene mau anagwela. Ndi pamene amvela mau, Satana panthawi yamene iyo amabwela ndikutenga mau amene anafesedwa mwa iwo.
MRK 4:16	Ndi zina zimene zinafesedwa pa mwala, ndi iwo amene amamva mau, nthawi yamene amalalikidwa mau amalandila ndi chimwemwe.
MRK 4:17	Ndipo alibe mizu mwa iwo, koma amalimbikila kwa kathawi kocepa. Pamene akumana ndi mabvuto kapena abanzunza cifukwa ca mau nthawi yamene ija amagwa.
MRK 4:19	Ndipo zina zamene zinagwela pa minga. Amamva mau,
MRK 4:19	koma nkhawa ya zamudziko, chinyengo ca vya cuma, cilakolako ca vinthu vina cimabangena, cimaononga mau, ndipo amankhala opanda cipatso.
MRK 4:20	Ndipo zina zinja zamene zinafesedwa pa nthaka yabwino.  Iwo amamva mau ndikulandila ndikubala zipatso; zina makumi yatatu(30) ndi zina makumi asanu ndi imozi(60) ndi zina makumi kumi (100)
MRK 4:21	Yesu anati kwa iwo, "Kodi mungabwelese nyali mukati mu nyumba naku iika pansi pa basiketi kapena pansi pa bedi? Muzaileta mukati naku iika poika nyali.
MRK 4:22	Chifukwa kulibe chamene nichobisika chamene sichizazibika, ndiponso kulibe chamene chili chosazibika chamene sichizabwela po-onekela.
MRK 4:23	Ngati wina ali onse ali na matu yomvelela, lekani amvele!"
MRK 4:24	Anati kwa iwo, "Ikankhoni nzeru pa zimene mumvela, cifukwa ndimpimo wamene mupimilamo, azasebenzesya mupimo wamene uyo uzapasidwa kwanu.
MRK 4:25	Cifukwa aliwonse amene alinavo, kuli yeve zizapasidwa zambiri, ndi kuli uyo alibe , zizapokedwa cukanga zimene alinazo."
MRK 4:26	Ndipo anati, "Ufumu Pamene wa Mlungu uli ngati munthu amene anafesa mbeu yake pansi.
MRK 4:27	Pamene anagona usiku pamene anauka mmawa, mbeu inayamba kumela ndikukula, cukanga iye sanazibe zimene zinacitika.
MRK 4:28	Nthaka inayamba kubeleka zipatso: poyamba mpunga, pavuli pake mbeu.
MRK 4:29	Pamene inapya mumela nthawi yamene iyo anatuma bavikwakwa, cifukwa nthawi yokolola inafika."
MRK 4:30	Ndipo anati, "Tizayelekeza ndiciyani ufumu wa Mlungu, kapena ndifanizo yabwanji yamene tizasebezesha kukamba?
MRK 4:31	uli ngati kambeu kampiru, kapene kanafesedwa, ndikang'ono kwambiri pambeu zonse pa dziko lapansi.
MRK 4:32	Koma pamene kafesedwa, ndikukula kamakala kakulu kupambana cimutemgo cilicose ca mdimba, ndipo kamankhala ndi misambo zikulu, ndipo mbalame zamumulenga-lenga zimabwela ndikumanga visa mucifule cake."
MRK 4:33	Ndi mafanizo yambili yotelo anakamba mau kwa iwo, monga mwamene anamvesesa,
MRK 4:34	ndipo sanakambepo ciliconse kosasebenzesha fanizo, koma pamene anali yeka, anafotokoza zonse kwa wophunzila ake.
MRK 4:35	Pa siku ija, pamene kunali mumazulo, anati kwa iwo, "Tiyeni kusidya ina,"
MRK 4:36	Ndipo anasiya anthu ambiri, anayenda pamodzi ndi Yesu, cifukwa anali kale muboti. Ndipo maboti yena anali naye.
MRK 4:37	Ndipo cimphepo cikulu cinanyamuka mu boti, ndipo boti inazula kwambiri cifukwa ca mawevu.
MRK 4:38	Koma Yesu iye anali pansi pa boti atagona pa kushoni. Ndipo anamuuusha nati, "Mphunzisi, kodi simusamalila kuti tili kufa?"
MRK 4:39	Ndipo,  anauka, ndikuzuzula cimphepo cija nati kucimana, "Mtendele, nkala cete." Ndipo mphepo ija inaleka, ndipo kunali cete.
MRK 4:40	Ndipo  anabafunsa iwo, "Kodi ndiciyani munacita mantha? Kufikila tsopano mulibe cikhulupirilo?"
MRK 4:41	Anali ndi mantha yakulu ndipo anati kwa wina ndi mzace, " Nidani uyu, cukanga cimphepo na cimana cimumvelela iye?"
MRK 5:0	Mutu 5
MRK 5:1	anabwela ku sidya ina ya chimana, kumuzinda wa Gelasene.
MRK 5:2	Ndipo panthawipamene Yesu analikucoka mu Boti, munthu wa vimizimu vyonyansa anabwela kucokela ku manda.
MRK 5:3	Munthu uja anali kunkhala ku manda. Kunalibe munthu aliyense amene anakwanisa kumulesa, cukanga macheni sanakwanise.
MRK 5:4	Nthhawi  yabili anali kunkhala wovaliliwa ndi womangiwa ndi maceni. Anali kujuba ma cheni. panalibe amene anali ndi mpamvu zomugwila.
MRK 5:5	Usiku ndi mzuba anali kukala ku manda ndi kumaphiri, analikulila ndi kuzicekha yeka ndi miyala yakutwa.
MRK 5:6	Pamene anaona Yesu kucokela patali, anatamangila kwa iye ndi kugwada ppkwa iye.
MRK 5:7	Analira kwambiri nati, "kodi takucimwirani ciyani, Yesu, mwana wa Mlungu wamwamba? Nikupempani mwa Mlungu kuti musaniceneke."
MRK 5:8	Cifukwa anali kunena kwa iye,"Tuluka mwa munthu uyu, iwe mizimu yonyansa."
MRK 5:9	Ndipo anamufunsa iye, "Zinalako ndiwe ndani? Ndipo anamuyankha nati, "Zina langa ndine Cigulu, cifukwa ndise ambiri."
MRK 5:10	Anamupempa iye mobwezela-bwezela kuti asavicose mumuzinda.
MRK 5:11	Manje nkhumba zambiri zinali kudya  pakaluphiri,
MRK 5:12	ndipo vinamupempha iye, kuti, "Titumene ku nkhumba; kuti tilowemo."
MRK 5:13	Ndipo anavilola; Mizimu yonyansa inacokandikungena mu nkhumba,ndipo zinautukila kuluphiri yopolika kucimana, ndipo nkhumba zokwanila tuwu sauzande zinambila mucimana.
MRK 5:14	Ndipo aja wodyesa nkhumba zinja zinathaba anayenda ndi kuuza zamene zinacitika kumuzinda ndi malo wozungulila. Ndipo anthu ambiri anayenda kukaonelela zamene zinacitika.
MRK 5:15	Pamene anafika kwamene kunali Yesu anaona uja mwamuna uja amene anali ndi ziwanda- cikamu ca viwanda - alikhale pansi, atavala, ndipo ali ndi kuganiza bwino, ndipo anacita mantha.
MRK 5:16	Aja amene anaona zamene zinacitika kuli uja mwamuna amene anali ndi ziwanda anawauza zamene zinacitika kuli iye ndi vyamene vinacitika ku nkhumba.
MRK 5:17	Ndipo anamupempha kuti acoke kumalo aja.
MRK 5:18	Ndipo pamene anangena mu boti, uja mwamuna amene ziwanda zinacoka mwa iyeanapempha kuti ayende naye.
MRK 5:19	Koma iye anamukanila, koma iye anati, "Pita kunyumba yako ndi kuanthu ako kawauze zamene Ambuye akucitila iwe, ndicifundo camene akucitila iwe."
MRK 5:20	Iye anapita ndikuyamba kulankhula zinthu zikulu-zikulu zamene Yesu anamucitila iye ku Dekapolisi, ndipo wonse anadabwa.
MRK 5:21	Ndipo pamene Yesu anathauka kusidya ina, muboti, anthu ambiri anafika pamene anali iye, pamene anali mumbali mwa cimana.
MRK 5:22	Umodzi wa atsogoleli wa kacisi, woyitiwa Jailosi, anaza kwa iye pamene anamuona, anagwela pamendo pake.
MRK 5:23	Anamupemphatso ndi mobwezela, nati, "Mwana wanga mkazi alipafupi kufa. Ndikupemphani, kuti mubwele, kuti muzemumusanjike manja anu, kuti apole kuti ankhale ndi moyo."
MRK 5:24	Anayenda naye, ndipo anthu ambiri anamusatila iye ndikumukuza kwambiri.
MRK 5:25	Apo panali mzimai amene anali wocoka magazi kwa zaka twelufu (12).
MRK 5:26	Anavutika kwambiri popita kuvipatala vyosiyana-siyana ndi anasewenzesa ndalama zake zonse, koma sanapole koma matenda anayendelela patsogolo.
MRK 5:27	Pamene anava zimene anthu analikulankula  za Yesu, Iye anabwela ku mbuyo kwake pamene anali kuyenda, anagwila nsoga ya covala cake.
MRK 5:28	Cifukwa anati, "Ngati ndingagwileko cabe covala cake, ndizacilisika."
MRK 5:29	Pamene anamugwila iye, magazi analeka kucoka, ndipo anamvela mutupi mwake kuti acilisika kumatenda aja.
MRK 5:30	Panthawi yamene ijaYesu anazindikila kuti mpamvu zacoka muli iye. Ndipo anayangana kumbuyo kwamene kunali anthu ambiri nafunsa nati, "Ndani wanikuza covala canga?"
MRK 5:31	Wophunzila ake anati, "Muona anthu awa ambiri alikukugundani, ndipo inu mulikunena kuti, 'ndani wakugwilani?"'
MRK 5:32	Koma Yesu anayangana kuti amuone wamene anacita izi.
MRK 5:33	Pamene mzimai, anaona zimene zinamucitikila, anacita mantha ndikuthutuma. Anabwela ndikugwa pansi pafupi ndi iye ndikumuuza coonadi conse pazimene zinacitika.
MRK 5:34	Anati kwa iye, "Mwana wanga mkazi, cikhulupiliro cako cakucilitsa. Pita mumtendele ndipo cilisika ku matenda yako."
MRK 5:35	Pamene anali kulankhula naye, anthu ena anabwela kucokela kunyumba ya uja mtsogoleli wa sunagogi, nati, "mwana wanu mkazi wamwalila. Cifukwa ncani mupitiliza kumuvutisha mphunzitsi?"
MRK 5:36	Koma pamene Yesu anamvako zimene analikulankhula, iye anati kumtsogoleli wa sunagogi, "Usacite mantha. Kuluphilira cabe."
MRK 5:37	Sanavomeze kuti wina ayende naye, koma Petulo, Yakobo ndi Yohana, ndimbale wa Yakobo.
MRK 5:38	Anafika kunyumba kwa uja mtsogoleli ndi anaona anthu ambiri alikumpanga congo; analikulira ndikupunda kwambiri.
MRK 5:39	Pamene anangena munyumba, anati kwa iye, "Cifukwa nicani muli wosweka mitima ndipo muli kulira? uyu mwana sanafe wagona cabe."
MRK 5:40	Ndipo iwo anamuseka iye. Koma anawacosa panja ndipo anathenga atate ndi amake amwana ndi aja amene anabwela nawo, ndikupita mwamene munali mwana.
MRK 5:41	Anathenga zanja la mwana ndipo anati, "Talitha Kumi,"kutanthauza kuti, "Mwana wacicepele, ndinena nawe, Uka."
MRK 5:42	Panthawi yamene ija mwana uja anauka ndikuyamba kuyenda (cifukwa anali twelufu (12) zaka) ndipo wonse anadabwa.
MRK 5:43	Ndipo anawauza mosimikiza kuti munthu aliyense asaziwe izi. ndipo anawauza kuti amupase mwana uja mkazi kuti ampase zakudya adye.
MRK 6:0	Mutu 6
MRK 6:1	Ndipo ancokako kuja ndi kupita kumuzida wake, ndipo wophunzira anamusata iye.
MRK 6:2	Pamene sabata inafika anali kuphunzitsa musunagoge. Anthu ambiri anamva ndipo anadabwisika. Anati, "Anacotsa kuti ziphunziso zotele?" "Kodi nzelu izi zamene zinapasidwa kwa iye nizabwanji?"  "Nanga izi zodabwitsa zamene iye ali kucita?"
MRK 6:3	"Kodi uyu siuja mpala mathabwa mwana wa Maliya and mkwawo wa Yakobo na Joses na Yudas na Simoni? Nipo alongo ake sali naife pano?" Ndipo anakumudwisiwa ndi Yesu.
MRK 6:4	Ndipo Yesu anati kwa iwo, "Mneneli samakhala opanda ulemo, kucosako cabe kumudzi kwake ndipakati ka enekwawo ndi banja yake."
MRK 6:5	Analepelakucita zambiri zodabwitsa, kucoselako cabe kusanjika manja yake paodwala ang'ono cabe ndikuwacilisa.
MRK 6:6	Kusakhulupirira kwawo kunamudabwisa iye. Ndipo anapita kumidzi yozungulira ndikuphunzitsa.
MRK 6:7	Ndipo anaitana aja twelufu (12) ndikuwatuma kuti apite  awili - awili, ndipo anawapasa ulamuliro pamizimu yonyansa,
MRK 6:8	anawalamulira kuti asanyamule ciliconse paulendo, koma cabe ndodo: asanyamule buledi, kapena thumba, kapena ndalama mucikwama,
MRK 6:9	koma avale nkwabilo asavwale minjilo iwili.
MRK 6:10	Ndipo anawauza kuti, " Pamene mungena munyumba, munkhale mwamene muja kufikila pamene muzacoka malo yaja.
MRK 6:11	Ndipo ngati mumzinda muja sanakulandileni kapena kukumvela inu, pamene mucoka malo aja mukunkhumule doti yakumendo kwanu ngati umboni kwa iwo."
MRK 6:12	Anapita kukalalikira kuti anthu atembenuke kucoka kuviipa vawo.
MRK 6:13	Anacosa ziwanda, ndi kuzoza  ndi mafuta odwala ambiri ndipo anawacilitsa.
MRK 6:14	Mfumu Herode anavela izi, cifukwa zina la Yesu ianamveka pali ponse. Ena anati, "Yohane Mbatizi auka kwa kufa ndipo cifukwa ca ici, zodabwitsa za mpamvu zili kusewenza mwa iye."
MRK 6:15	Ndipo ena anati, " ndi Eliya." ena anatitso, "Ndi mneneli, ngati uja wa kale."
MRK 6:16	Koma pamene Herode anamva izi anati, "Yohana wamene ndinadula mutu wauka."
MRK 6:17	Cifukwa Herode anatuma nthumi kuti Yohana amangiwe ndipo anamangiwa cifukwa ca Herodiya ( Mkazi wa mbale wakeFilipo) cifukwa anamkwatila iye.
MRK 6:18	Cifukwa Yohana anamuuza Herode, " Sicinthuncovomelekeza kulti iwe umukwatile mkazi wa mbale wako."
MRK 6:19	Koma Herodiya iye anakwiya ndikufuna kumupa Yohana, koma analephela,
MRK 6:20	cifukwa Herode anaopa Yohana; anazindikila kuti anali wolunga ndipo woyela, ndipo anazimusunga bwino, kumvwelela iye kunamupanga iye kumvwela kuipa kwambiri, koma anamvwela mokondwela.
MRK 6:21	Koma mpata unapezeka pamene Herode anali ndi pwando kusekelela siku yamene anabadwilamo ndipo anapanga cakudya camazulo ca anyanchito wake, ndi akulu asilikali ndi atsogoleli a Galileya.
MRK 6:22	Mwana mkazi wa Herodiya anaza kuzawabvinila, ndipo anakondwelesa Herode ndi alendo woitanidwa. Mfumu inati kukamsikana, "Nipemphe ciliconse camene ufuna nizakupasa."
MRK 6:23	Analapa kwa iye nati, " Ciliconse camene uzapempha kwa ine, nizakupasa, cukanga pakati ka ufumu wanga,"
MRK 6:24	anabwelela kukafunsa amai ake, "Kodi ndikapemphe ciyani?" Anati, " Mutu wa Yohane mbatizi,"
MRK 6:25	Ndipo anangena mwacangu panthawi yamene ija kwa mfumu, nati, " Ndifuna inu mundipase mwamsanga, pa mbale, mutu wa Yohana mbatizi."
MRK 6:26	Ngakale kuti ici  cinakumudwisa mfumu, sanakane kucitha cifukwa analonjeza kudala ndicikwa ca alendo aja amene anaitana.
MRK 6:27	Telo mfumu inatuma asilikali womuyanganila ndi akulu asilikakali kuti akamuletele mutu wa Yohana. Ndipo womuyanganila anayenda mundende ndikukajuwa mutu.
MRK 6:28	Anaubwelesa mutu pa mbale ndikuzapasa msikana ndi msikana anapasa amai ake.
MRK 6:29	Ndi wophunzila ake, pamene anamva izi, anabwela ndi kutenga mtembo ndikukaika ku m'manda.
MRK 6:30	Apositolo, anakumana pamodzi ndi Yesu, ndikumuuza iye zamane anacita ndi zamene anaphunzisa.
MRK 6:31	Ndipo iye anati kwa iwo,"Bwelani inu noka mupite kumalo kulibe anthu mukaphumuleko kwa kanthawi." Cifukwa ambiri anali kubwela ndikupita, analibe nthawi cukanga yakudya.
MRK 6:32	Ndipo anapita muboti kumalo yopanda anthu.
MRK 6:33	Koma anawaonandipo ambiri anawazindikila iwo, ndipo anathawa ndi mendo m'muzinda wonse, ndipo anafika koyamba asanafike iwo.
MRK 6:34	Pamene anafika kumbali kwa cimana, anaona cigulu ca anthu ndipo anawacitila cifundo cifukwa anali ngati nkhosa yopanda mbusa. Anayamba kuwaphunzisa zinthu zambiri.
MRK 6:35	Pamene nthawi inasila, wophunzila ake anaza kwaiye nati, "Aya malo niyopanda anthu ndipo nthawi yatha.
MRK 6:36	Muwalole awa anthu apite pafupi m'muzinda ndi m'minzi kuti akaguleko zakudya zawo."
MRK 6:37	Koma iye anawayankha nati kwa iwo, "Imwe muwapase zakudya," Anati kuli iye, "Kodi tingayende kukagula ndi tuu hunderedi denari ya buledi ndi kuwapasa kuti adye?"
MRK 6:38	Iye anati kwa iwo,"Muli ndi buledi ingati? pitani mukaone." Pamene anaona anati, "Buledi mitanda isanu ndi nsomba ziwili."
MRK 6:39	Anawalamulila kuti ankhale mphasi mumagulupu pa uzu wa msipu.
MRK 6:40	Ndipo anankhala mumagulupu; magulupu ya mahundredi (100) ndi mafifte (50).
MRK 6:41	Anathenga mitanda isanu ya buledi ndi nsomba ziwili, ndipo anayangana kumwamba ndikuyidalitsa ndi kusuna ndikupasa wophunzila ake kuti apase anthu. Ndipo anagawana nsomba zija ziwili kwa wonse.
MRK 6:44	Ndipo wonse anadya ndi kukutha. Anathenga zosala za buledi, mabasiketi fulu yokwana twelufu, ndi ziduswa za nsomba. Ndipo anali anthu wokwana faivi sauzande amuna amene anadya buledi.
MRK 6:45	Panthawi yamene iyo anauza wophunzila ake kuti angene mu boti ndi kupita patsogolo pawo kusidya ina ya cimana, ku Besaida, pamene anauza anthu kuti abwelelemo kumanyumba yawo.
MRK 6:46	Pamene anapita, anakwela kuluphiri kukapemphela.
MRK 6:47	Pamene kunali m'mazulo, boti inafika pakati kacimana, ndipo analiyeka kusidya.

MRK 10:16	Ndipo anathenga ana m'manja ake ndikutudalisa pamene anatusanjika manja ake pa tiana.
MRK 10:17	Pamene anayamba ulendo wake, mwamuna wina anamtamangila ndikumgwadila iye, ndikumpempha, "Mphunzisi wabwino, kodi ndicite ciani kuti ningene moyo wosatha?"

MRK 10:22	koma cifukwa ca mau aya anawoneka wosakonda nawo ndipo anacokapo wokumudwisiwa, cifukwa anali ndi cuma cambiri.

MRK 10:25	Ciliko capafupi ngamila kungena pamulomo wa nyeleti, kupambana munthu wolemela kungena ufumu wa Mulungu,"
MRK 10:26	Anadabwa kwambiri ndikukambirana wina ndi mzace, "Manje nindani azaphulumuka?"

MRK 10:29	Yesu anati, " Zoonadi ndikuuzani inu, palibe amene anasiya nyumba, kapena abale kapena alongo ake, kapena amai ake, kapena atate ake, kapena ana ake kapena malo, cifukwa ca ine m'malo mwa uthenga wa bwino,
MRK 10:30	wamene sazalandila mpaso zopitilila pa hunderedi pano paziko lapansi ; ndi  mbale ake, ndi mlongo wake, ndi amake, ndi ana, ndi malo ake, ndikunzunzika, ndiziko likuza, moyo wosatha.
MRK 10:31	koma ambiri amene aliwoyamba azakhala wosiliza, ndi wosiliza azankhala woyamba."
MRK 10:34	Anali pa njira, yopita ku Yelusalemu, ndipo Yesu anali patsogolo pawo. Wophunzira ake anadabwa, ndipo aja amene analikukonkha anacita mantha. Ndipo Yesu anaitanatso pambali aja twelufu wophunzila ake ndikuwauza zamene zizacitika posacedwa kwa iye. Onani, tilikuyenda kuYelusalemu, Mwana wa Munthu azapelekedwa kwa akulu ansembe ndi alembi. Azaweluzidwa kuti ifa ndikupelekedwa kwa
MRK 10:35	Yakobo ndi Yohane ana a Zebediya anabwela kwa iye anati, ''Mphuzisi, tifuna inu kuti m'tichitire virivotse vamene tizakupemphani."

MRK 10:43	Koma sicizakhala telo pakati kanu.  Amene afuna kukhala mkulu pakati kanu afunika kukhala kapolo wa wonse,

MRK 11:0	Mutu 11

MRK 11:24	Ndiye cifukwa cake  ndilankhula nanu: Ciliconse camene mzapemphelelapo ndi kupempha , khulupirirani kuti mwacilandila, ndipo cizankhala canu.
MRK 11:25	Nthawi zonse pamene muimirira ndi kupemphera, mufunika kukululukira aliyense amene anakucimwilani, kuti Atatet alikumwamba akukululukireni inutso macimo yanu."

MRK 12:0	Mutu 12
MRK 12:1	Ndipo Yesu anayamba kuphunzitsa mumafanizo. Iye anati, "Mdala wina anabyala munda wake wa mpesa, ndipo anaika linga kuzengulusa munda wonse, ndikukumba kuwelengela mpesa. Anamanga nsanja ya olonda ndikuukongoletsa munda kuli aja wolima mpesa. Ndipo anayenda pa ulendo.
MRK 12:2	Panthawi yake, anatuma wanchito kuwolima munda kuti akampaseko zipatso zina zamunda.

MRK 12:20	Kunali abale ake seveni; woyamba anakwatira ndikufa, sanasiyemo ana.

MRK 13:0	Mutu 13
MRK 13:1	Pamene Yesu anayenda kuchoka mutempele, umodzi wa wophunzila bake anati kwa iye, "Mphunzisi, wonani myala zabwino na zomanga zabwino!"
MRK 13:2	Anamuuza kuti, " Waziona izi zomangidwa bwino? Palibe mwala uliwonse wamene uzasala pamwamba pa unzake wamene siuzachosewapo."
MRK 13:3	Pamene anankhala paluphiri lwa Oliva kumbali kwa tempele, Petulo, Yakobo, Yohane na Anduleya anamufunsa kumbali,
MRK 13:4	"Tiuzyeni,  nanga ivi vizachitika liti? Nichani choonesela kuti ivi vinthu vili pafupi nakuchitika?"
MRK 13:5	Yesu anayamba kubauza kuti, "Nkhalani chelu kuti wina asakusobeseni.
MRK 13:6	Bambili bazabwela muzina yanga nakuti, 'Ndine wamene, 'ndipo azasobesa bambili.
MRK 13:7	Koma mukamvela va nkhondo na nkhani za nkhondo, musakavutike mutima, ivi vinthu vifunika kuchitika, koma kusila kwa dziko kukalimbe kucitika.
MRK 13:8	Chifukwa ziko izaukila mosusana na ziko, na ufumu uzaukilana mosusana na ufumu. Kuzankhala chogwendeza ziko mumadela yambili, na njala. Ivi ndivo voyamba va kubaba pobala.
MRK 13:9	Nkalani bachelu. Bazakupelekani  kuli bakulu bansaka, ndipo muzakamenyewa mumasunagogi. Muzakaimilila kuli bakulu ba  boma na mafumu cifukwa cha ine, ngati umboni kuli beve.
MRK 13:10	Koma uthenga wabwino ufunika kuti ulalikiliwe ku maiko yonse.
MRK 13:11	Pamene bazakakugwilani nakukupelekani, musakachite nkhawa kuti tizakakamba chani. Chifukwa pantawi ija, vamene muzakakamba vizakapasiwa kuli imwe; simuzankala imwe wokamba, koma Muzimu Woyela.
MRK 13:12	Mubale azakapeleka mubale munzake ku infa, ndipo tate azakapeleka mwana wake. Na bana bang'ono bazaukila makolo yawo nakufuna kuti bapaiwe.
MRK 13:13	Bazakuzondani banthu bambili chifukwa cha zina langa. koma wamene azalimbikila kufikila kuchimalizilo, uja munthu azaphulumusiwa.
MRK 13:14	Ndipo mukaona zamalodza zosavomelezewa ziimilila pamene sizifunika kuimiliila," (lekani bamene baziba kubelenga banvesese) "lekani awo bali ku Yudeya batamangile ku maluphili,
MRK 13:15	lekani uyo ali pamwamba pamutenge wa nyumba asaseluke kungena munyumba kapena kuti akatenge chili chonse kuchosa munyumba,
MRK 13:16	ndipo lekani uyo ali  mu munda asabwelele kuti athenge chovala chake.
MRK 13:17	Koma  soka kuli baja bamene bali na bana mumala na bamene onyosha bana mumasiku yaja!
MRK 13:18	Pemphelani kuti visakachitike muthawi ya mphepo.
MRK 13:19	Chifukwa kuzankhala mazunzo yakulu, yamene yakalibe kuchitikapo kuchoka pachiyambi, pamene Mulungu analenga ziko lapansi, kufikila manje, kulibe, kapena sikuzankhalanso.
MRK 13:20	Kapena Ambuye akachepeseko masiku, kulibe aliyense wamene azaphulumusidwa. Koma chifukwa cha awo wolungama, bamene awo banasankha, azachosako masiku.

MRK 16:0	Mutu 16
MRK 16:1	Pamene siku ya Sabata inatha, Maliya Magadalene ndi Maliya amake a Yakobo, ndi Salome anagula mafuta yonukira kuti akazoze thupi ya Yesu.

MRK 16:7	Manje pitani, mukauze wophunzira ake ndi Petulo kuti alikuyenda patsogolo panu ku Galileya. Kunja mzamuona  iye, Nganimwane anakuuzilani."
MRK 16:8	Anayenda ndikuthamanga kucokela ku manda; Anacitha mantha ndi kuthuthuma. Sanakhambe ciliconse kuli aliyense cifukwa anali ndi mantha.

MRK 16:10	Anayenda ndikukhauza iwo amene anali naye, pamene anali kulira ndi kucita maliro.
MRK 16:11	Anamva kuti ali moyo, ndipo waonekela kwa iye, koma sanakhuluphirire.

LUK 3:12	Baja otenga misonko ndi iwo anabwela kubadizika, ndiponso ananena kwa iye, ''Mupunzisi, nichani chamene tingachite?''

LUK 3:14	Basilikali ndiiwo anamufunsa, ndikunena, ''Nanga ise? Tizachita bwanji?'' Ananena kwaiwo, Musatenge ndalama kumunthu aliyense mokankamizila, ndiponso musakankamize kunamiza wina mopatikiza.Munkale okutila ndizamene mufola.''
LUK 3:15	Koma pamene banthu banali ndi chilakolako kuembekeza kubwela kwa kristhu, aliyense anali kuzifufuza mumitima mwao paza Yoani ngati angankale kristhu.
LUK 3:16	Yoani anabayankha bonse, '' koma ine, nikubadizani ndi manzi, koma alikubwela winawake wamene alina mphamvu kupambana ine, ndiponso siniyenela ndi kumasula ntambo zansapato zake.Azakubadizani ndi muzimu oyela ndiponso ndi mulilo.
LUK 3:17	Ndi chokololelako alinacho mumanja kuti awamise bwino gome yake ndiponso kukolola witi kufaka munyumba yosungilamo.koma azashoka zinyalala ndi mulilo wamene siusila.''
LUK 3:18	Ndi bambiri enanso ozinyamula, Yoani analalikila utenga wabwino kubanthu.
LUK 3:19	Pamene Herodi ndi tetrachi bana vomekezedwa kukwatila mukazi wamubale wao, Helodias, ndi zinthu zonse zonyansa zamene anachita ndi Helod,
LUK 3:20	anafakilako pamilandu zonse zamene anachita: anakomela Yoani mujele.
LUK 3:21	Manje chinabwela chachitika kuti, pamene bonse banthu anabadizika, Ndi Yesu anabadizika. Ndiponso pamene akali kupempela, kumwamba kunaseguka,
LUK 3:22	ndi Muzimo Oyela anabwela pansi muchifanikizo chatupi monga nkunda, ndiponso liu linabwela kuchoka kumwamba, '' Ndikuti iwe ndiwe mwana wanga mwamuna, wamene nikonda. Ndine okondwela ndi iwe.''
LUK 3:23	Pamene Yesu anayamba utumiki wake, Anali ndi zaka makumi yatatu.Anali mwana mwamuna(wamene benzoganila) kuti ni wa Yosefe, mwana wa Heli, mwana
LUK 3:24	mwamuna wa matthat, mwana mwamuna wa Levi, mwana mwamuna wa Melchi, mwana mwamuna wa Janani, mwana mwamuna wa Yosefe.
LUK 3:25	Yosefe anali mwana mwamuna wa Mattatiyas,mwana mwamuna wa Amos, mwana mwamuna wa Naham, mwana mwamuna wa Esili, mwana mwamuna wa Naagi, mwana mwamuna wa
LUK 3:26	Maati, mwana mwamuna wa Mattatiyas, mwana mwamuna wa Simeni, mwana mwamuna wa Yoseki, mwana mwamuna wa Yoda.
LUK 3:27	Yoda anali mwana mwamuna wa Yoanani, mwana mwamuna wa Resa,mwana mwamuna wa Zelubabel, mwana mwamuna wa Salathieo, mwana mwamuna wa Neri ,
LUK 3:28	mwana mwamuna wa Melchi, mwana mwamuna wa Addi, mwana mwamuna wa Kosamu, mwana mwamuna wa Elimadam, mwana mwamuna wa Er,
LUK 3:29	mwana mwamuna wa Yoshua, mwana mwamuna wa Elyaza, mwana mwamuna wa Yorimu, mwana mwamuna wa Matthat, mwana mwamuna wa Levi.

LUK 3:31	mwana mwamuna wa melea, mwana mwamuna wa Menn, mwana mwamuna wa Mattatha, mwana mwamuna wa Nathan, mwana mwamuna wa Davidi,
LUK 3:32	mwana mwamuna wa Yesse, mwana mwamuna wa Obed, mwana mwamuna wa Boazi, mwana mwamuna wa salmoni, mwana mwamuna wa Nahashoni.
LUK 3:33	Nahashoni anali mwana mwamuna wa Aminadabu, mwana mwamuna wa Adimini, mwana mwamuna wa Arni, mwana mwamuna wa Heziron, mwana mwamuna wa Perezi, mwana mwamuna wa Yuda,

LUK 4:0	MUTU 4
LUK 4:1	Koma Yesu, kunkhala ozozedwa ndi muzimu oyela, Anabwelela ku musinje wa Yodan, Ndiponso nasogoledwa ndi muzimu oyela kuyenda muchipululu
LUK 4:2	mwamene anaenda masiku makumi ndi anai kuyesedwa ndi satana.Sianadye chilichonse masiku yaja, Ndiponso pokusila kwanthawi ija anamvela njala.
LUK 4:3	Satana ananena kwaiye, ''Ngati ndiwe mwana wa Mulungu, Sandula mwala izi kunkhala Mukate.''
LUK 4:4	Yesu anamuyankha, '' Nicholembedwa, '' Kuti munthu siazankhalila mukate weka.''
LUK 4:5	Koma satana anamusogolela Yesu kumupeleka pamalo yapamwamba ndiponso anamulangiza maufumu yapaziko pakanthawi kang'ono.
LUK 4:6	Ndi satana ananena kwaiye, ''Kuti nizakupasa mphamvu zonse ndi ulemelelo, chifukwa wapasiwa kuli ine, ndiponso ningapase aliyense.
LUK 4:7	Chifukwa chaichi, ngati unganigwadile pansi ndiponso unipempeze ine, chisankhala chako.
LUK 4:8	Koma Yesu anayanka naku kamba kuti, "nicholembewa, 'Upembeze Ambuye Mulungu wako, ndiye wamene eve eka uzatumikila.'"
LUK 4:9	Komanso satana anasogolela Yesu ku Yelusalemu nakumupeleka pamalo yotalimpisa yapa tempele, Ndiponso ananena kwaiye, ''Ngati ndiwe mwana wa Mulungu zitaye weka pansi kuchokela pano.
LUK 4:10	Chifukwa chinalembedwa, 'Azatuma angelo abo ameneazakusamalila, ndi kukuchingiliza iwe,'
LUK 4:11	'Ndiponso, ' Bazakunyamula mumanja yao nakukunyamula pamwamba, kuti usazigwesele pamwala.''
LUK 4:12	Napakumuyankha, Yesu ananena, '' Chinanenewa, '' Kuti usafake Mulungu wako mumayeso.''
LUK 4:13	Pamene satana anasiliza kumuyesa Yesu, Anamusiya iye ndikuyenda paka panthawi ina.
LUK 4:14	Koma Yesu anabwelela ku Galili mumphamvu zamuzimu. ndiponso utenga pali Iye unamwazikana malo yonse yenzo zingulila chija chigao.
LUK 4:15	Ndiponso anayamba kupunzisa mutempele ndiponso bonse anamutamanda.
LUK 4:16	Iye anabwela ku Nazareti, muzinda mwamene anakulila, ndiponso kulinganiza na mwambo wake, Enze kungena mutempele pasiku la sabata, kulingana ndi mwambo, Ndiponso enze kuimilila ndi kubelenga naliwu lapamawmba.
LUK 4:17	Buku ya muneneli Aizaya Inapasidwa kuli Iye. Analikusegula buku ija, Ndiponso anapeaza pamalo pamene chinalembedwa,
LUK 4:18	'' Muzimu wa Mulungu alipali ine, chifukwa anizoza ine kulalika utenga wa bwino kuosauka. Anituma ine kulalikila pa kumasusila omangidwa, ndiponso kubwezedwa kwa manso osapenya, ndi kumasula ogwedezeka,
LUK 4:19	ndi kunenela pachaka za chisomo cha Mulungu.''
LUK 4:20	Komanso anaivala buku ija, ndikubwezela bamene analikusunga ndi kunkhala pansi. Manso yabonse muja mutempele yanalipaliche pali enve.
LUK 4:21	Anayamba kukamba kuli iwo,'' Kuti lelo ayamalemba yafikilizika mukumvela kwanu.''
LUK 4:22	Bonse muja mumalo anapelekela umboni pazamena ananena ndiponso bonse banadabwisiwa pamau yachisomo yamene yanalikuchoka mukamwa kake. Banali kunena kuti, '' Uyu ni mwana wa Yosefe, kodi sichocho?''
LUK 4:23	Ananena kwa iwo, '' Chachendi muzanena proverb iyi kuli ine, ''Adotolo, zichiliseni mweka.Vilivonse vamene tinamvela mulikuchita mu kapenamu, chitani chimozi mozi muno mumuzinda wanu.''
LUK 4:24	Koma ananena, '' Chonadi ninena kwainu, kulibe muneneli wamene analandilidwa mumuzinda wake.
LUK 4:25	Koma muchoonadi nikuuzani kuti kunali mazenela yambiri mu Izilaeli munthawi ya Elijah, pamene mulengalenga unavaliwa zaka zitatu ndi makakumi asanunu ndi kamozi, ndiponso njala yaikulu inagwela pantaka ija.
LUK 4:26	Koma Elijah sianatumiwe kulialionse, koma chabe ku zerepata wa mu sidoni, kuli ofedwa wamene analikunkhala kuja.
LUK 4:27	Ndiponso kunali akungu ambiri mu Izilaeli ija nthawi ya muneneli Elisha, Koma kulibe anachilisiwapo kucheselako Namani waku sirian.''
LUK 4:28	Banthu bonse musinagogi anazozedwa ndi ukali pamene anamvela izi zinthu.
LUK 4:29	Onse anachamuka, ndikumupatikiza kuchoka mumuzinda, ndiponso anamusogolela pamwamba pa phiri kwamene muzinda unamangiwa, kuti bamutaye kuchokela pamwamba paphiri.
LUK 4:30	Koma anapitila pakati kao ndikuenda kumaloena.
LUK 4:31	Ndipo anaenda kukapenamu, muzinda wa mu Galilileyo, ndiponso anayamba kubapunzisa paza sabata.
LUK 4:32	Anadabwisiwa pakupunziza kwake, chifukwa anali kunena ndi ulamulilo.
LUK 4:33	Koma mumasinagogi kunali mwamuna wamene anali namuzimu onyansa, ndiponso analila ndi liu lapamwamba,
LUK 4:34	'' Ah! nanga nichani chamene tingachite na iwe, Yesu waku Nazareti? Kodi wabwela kutiononga? Niziba kuti ndiwe _ oyela wa Mulungu.''
LUK 4:35	Yesu anazuzula muzimu onyansa, ndikunena, '' Osakambe kuti chokamo mwaiye!'' Pamene muzimu onyansa anagwesa mwamuna pansi pakati paiwo, anachoka mwa iye, ndiponso sianamuononge munjila iliyonse.
LUK 4:36	Banthu bonse banadabwa, ndiponso anapitiliza kukambapo pali izi kuliwina ndi muzake. Bananena kuti, Kondi ni mau yabwanji aya? Alamulila ndi mizimu zonyansa ndi ulamulilo ndipo ndi mphamvu ndiponso zichoka.''
LUK 4:37	Ndiponso utenga pali iye unayamba kuyenda pasogolo pamalo yaliyonse yanazungulila yaja malo.
LUK 4:38	Ndiponso Yesu anaenda choka musinagogi ndiponso anangena munyumba ya Simoni. Koma bapongozi ba Simoni bakazi analikuvutika ndimatenda, ndiponso anabapapatilako.
LUK 4:39	Koma anaimilila pali iye ndiponso anazuzula matenda, ndiponso yanatuluka mwaiye.Pameneapo ananyamuka ndiponso anayamba ndi kuatumikila.
LUK 4:40	Pamene zuba anali kungena, banthu onse analeta odwala kuli Yesu anali ndimatenda osiyanasiyana. Anafaka zanja palialionse ndiku achilisa.
LUK 4:41	Mizimu zonyansa nazo zinachoka mulibambiri, na kulila ndikunena kuti, '' Ndiwe mwana wa Mulungu.''Yesu anazuzula mizimu zonyansa ndiponso sianazisilile kukamba, chifukwa anaziba kuti ndiwe Kristhu.
LUK 4:42	Pamene nthawi yamuzuba inafika, Anayenda mumalo yobisika. Banthu bambiri banali kumusakila ndiponso anabwela kumamalo kwamene enzelili. banayeselela kumulesa kuti asayende nakubasiya.
LUK 4:43	Ndiponso ananena kwaiwo, '' Nifunikilanso kulalikila utenga wabwino pazaufumu wa Mulungu kumizinda zinangu, nichifukwa chaichi ninatumiwa.''
LUK 4:44	Ndipo anapitiliza kulalilila mumasinagogi mumalo yonse ya mu judeya.
LUK 5:0	MUTU 5
LUK 5:1	Koma chinachitika kuti, pamene banthu bambiri analikuzingulila Yesu ndiponso kumvelela kumau ya Mulungu, analikuimilila pa nyanje ya Genazareti.
LUK 5:2	Anaona maboti yabili yamene analikudonseledwa pamwamba  ndikuya chosanakupeleka kumbali yamusinje. Baja bogwila nsomba ninshi bachokamo kudala ndiponso anali kusuka vogwililamo nsomba.
LUK 5:3	Yesu anangena mu boti ina, yamene inali ya Simoni, ndiponso anamufunsa kuchosamo mumanzi pamalo yafupika muliyaja malo.Komanso anankhala pansi ndi kubauza bonse banali muboti.
LUK 5:4	Pamene anasiliza kukamba, Ananena kuli Simoni, ''Tenga boti ndiponso uipeleka pamanzi yamene yalimumalo mombila maningi pakuti mugwile.''
LUK 5:5	Simoni anayankha ndikunena kuti, ''Mfumu, tasebenza usiku onse, ndiponso sitinagwilepo kalikonse, koma kamba kamau yanu, nizangenesa zogwililamo nsomba pamanzi yombila.''
LUK 5:7	Pamene bana chita izi, bana unjika nsomba zambiri, ndiponso zogwililamo zao zinali kung'ambika.
LUK 5:6	Koma banaenda kulibanzao bamene banali muboti inangu kuti babwele babatandizile. Banabwela ndiponso bana zuzha maboti yonse yabili, chakuti yanayamba nakumbila.
LUK 5:8	Simoni Petulo, pamene anaona ichi, anagwela pansi pamapazi ya Yesu, ndikunena, '' Chokani paliine, chifukwa ndine munthu ochimwa, Ambuye.''
LUK 5:9	Chifukwa chinamudabwisa, ndiponso ndi iwobameneanalinabo, pakugwila kwansomba zamene banatenga.
LUK 5:10	Aba banali kuikilako Yakob ndiponso Yoani, mwana mwamuna wa Zebedi, bamenebanali kugwilizana nabopamozi ndi Simoni. Ndiponso Yesu ananena kuli Simoni, '' Usayope, chikukwa kuchokela manje uzayamba kugwila banthu.''
LUK 5:11	Pamene banaleta zongwililalo nsomba kunthaka, banasiya zonse ndikumukonka.
LUK 5:12	Chinabwela chachitika kuti pamene akali mumuzinda winangu, Munthu wamene anali ndi lepulosi analipo, Pamene anaona Yesu anagwesa manso yake ndi kumupempa, nakunena, ''Abuye, ngati mufuna, nitubiseni.''
LUK 5:13	Ndipo Yesu antambusula kwanja kwake ndi kumugwila, nakunena, ''Nifuna, nkhala otubisiwa.''
LUK 5:14	Anamuuza kuti asauze aliyense, Koma anamuuza, '' Kuti enda njila yako, Ndiponso ukazilangize kuopeleka ansembe ndiponso upeleke chansembe pakutubisiwa kwako, kulinganiza mwane mose analamulila, monga umboni kwaiwo.''
LUK 5:15	Koma mbiri paliiye anamwazikana patali, Ndiponso magulu yabanthu bambiri benzebanabwela kumvela vamene enze kupunzisa ndiponso anachilisa bambiri bamene benze bodwala.
LUK 5:16	Koma anali kuchokapo nthawi yambiri nakubasiya noenda mumalo yobisika mukupempela.
LUK 5:17	Chinabwela chachitika chakuti, muyaja masiku yamene analikupunzisa, Ndiponso kunali afalisi ndi apunzisi amalamulo analichinkhalile kwamenekuja amene anabwela kumalo yambiri yaminzi zosiyana muzigao zija za muGalileyo ndiponso mu Judeya, ndiponso mumunzi wamu Jelusalemu.Mphamvu za Mulungu zochilisa zinali paliiye.
LUK 5:18	Koma bamuna bena bana bwela, ananyamula pampasa mwamuna wamene sianali kuyenda, Ndiponso anaona njila yomubweleselamo mukati pakuti amufake kuntangu na Yesu kuti amufakepo zanja.
LUK 5:19	Sibana pezenjila yomupelekelamo mukati chifukwa kunali chigulu chabanthu, kamba kaichi banaenda pamwamba pa nyumba ndiponso banamuselusila pansi, pa mpasa yake, pakatika banthu, pantangu pamene analili Yesu.
LUK 5:20	Pakuona chikulupilo chao, Yesu ananena, '' Mwamuna, machimo yako yakululukidwa.''
LUK 5:21	Akalembela ndiponso Afalisi banayamba kufunsa izi, ndikunena, ''Kodi ni ndani uyu wamene akamba manyozo? Ni ndani angakululukile machimo koma Mulungu eka?''
LUK 5:22	Koma Yesu, pakuziba zamene banali kuganiza, anayankha ndi kunena kwaiwo, '' Kodi nichani chamene mufunsila izi mumitima yanu?
LUK 5:23	Nanga nichani chopepuka kunena, 'Kuti machimo yako yakululukidwa' loka kunena, 'Kuti ima uyende?'
LUK 5:24	Koma kuti muzibe kuti mwana wa Munthu alina ulamulilo pazikolapansi kukululukila machimo, 'Ninena kwa iwe, 'Nyamuka uime, 'Tenga mpasa yako uyende ndiponso uyende kunyumba kwako.''
LUK 5:25	Pamene apo anapita kuntangu kwao na kunyamula mpasa yamene analikugonapo. Ndiponso anabwelelamo kunyumba kwao, ndikutamanda Mulungu.
LUK 5:26	Alionse anadabwa ndiponso banalemekeza Mulungu. Banazozedwa ndi kuyopa, nakunena, ''Kuti taona zinthu zamene zopambana lelo.''
LUK 5:27	Pochoka kuchitika zinthu izi, Yesu anachoka mumalo yaja ndiponso anaona wamusonko zinalake ni Levi Analinkezi pajapa tenti pamene batengela musonko. Ananena kwaiye, '' Nikonke ine.''
LUK 5:28	Pomwepo Levi anaima ndiponso anamukonka, ndikusiya zonse pambuyo.
LUK 5:29	Koma Levi anapasa pwando ikulu kuli Yesu munyumba yake. Kunali bamisonko bambiri kujakumalo ndiponso banthu benangu banali kufendela kufupi na tebulo nakuyamba kudya ndi iye.
LUK 5:30	Koma bafalisi ndiponso bakalembela banali kudandaula kubophunzila bake, nakunena, ''Kuti kodi nichani chamene udyela ndi kumwa nabamisonko ndiponso ndi ena ochimwa?''
LUK 5:31	Yesu anabayankha, ''Kuti banthu bamene sibanadwale sibangafune obachilisa, koma chabe bamene bodwala ndiye bangafune.
LUK 5:32	Sininabwele kuitana bathu bolungama kulapila, koma kuitana ochimwa kulapila.''
LUK 5:33	Ananena kwaiye, ''Kuti ophunzila ba Yoani bamakonda kupempela ndi kusala kudya kambiri, ndiponso ophunzila abafalisi bachitachimozimozi.Koma afalisi bako bakudya na kumwa.''
LUK 5:34	Yesu ananena kwaiwo, '' Kodi munthu angapange ukwati wa banthubake bamukwati nakubaleka kutibasale kudya, pamene mukwati akalinabo?
LUK 5:35	Koma masiku yazabwela pamene mukwati azatengewa kwaiyo, Ndiponso masiku yaja bangasale kudya.
LUK 5:36	Koma Yesu ananena kwaiwo mukanthano. Kulibe anga ng'ambe chinyula muzigao kuchoka kuchanyowani ndiponso kusebenzesa kutungila kuchovala chakudala.Ngati anachita izi, Afunika ang'ambe chanyowani, Ndiponso chigao chanyula kuchoka kuchanyowani, sichinga fanile ndi chinyula chakudala.
LUK 5:37	Ndiponso kulibe angafake vinyu vanyowani mu vinyu vachikumba chakudala. Ngati angachite ivo, Ninshi vinyu vanyowani vinga pwanye chikumba.
LUK 5:38	Koma vinyu vasopano vifunika kufaka muchikumba chanyowani.
LUK 5:39	Ndiponso kulibe anamwa vinyu vakudala wamene angafune kumwa vanyowani, chifukwa anena, '' Kuti vakudala vilibwino.''
LUK 6:0	MUTU 6
LUK 6:1	Manje chinabwela chachitika pa sabata kuti Yesu analikuyenda mumunda mwamene balima mbeu ndiponso bopunzila bake banali kudoba mitu zambeu, ndikuzinyanyaula mumanja yao ndiponso banalikudwa izi mbeu,
LUK 6:2	Koma wina wa afalisi ananena, '' Kodi nichifukwa chachani chamene muchitila chinthu chamene sicholamulidwa kuchita pasikula sabata?''
LUK 6:3	Ndiponso pakumuyankha iye, Yesu ananena, ''Kodi siunabelenge vamene David anachita pamene enze nanjala, Iye ndiponso nabamene analinabo?
LUK 6:4	Anaenda munyumba ya Mulungu, nakutenga mukate wamene unali munso yake ndi kudyapo mbali yamukate, ndiponso anatengapo mukate wina nakupasa amuna bamene analinao kuti badye, angankhale chinali chabe chovomelezewa kuopeleka ansembe kudya.''
LUK 6:5	Ndiponso ananena kwaiyo, ''Kuti mwana wamuthu ni Mulungu wa sabata.''
LUK 6:6	Chinachitika pa sabata inangu pamene anaenda musinagogi ndi kuuza banthu bena muja.Munali mwamuna muja wamene anali nazanjalamanja lolemala.
LUK 6:7	Akalembela ndi afalisi analikumuyangana chabe pafupipafupi nakuona ngati azapolesa wina pasabata, pakuti bapezelepo chifukwa chomuzuzulilapo.
LUK 6:8	Koma anaziba zamene banali kuganiza ndiponso ananena kuli mwamuna wamene kwanja yake inali yolemala, ''Anati ima, ndiponso uimilile pakati palialionse.'' Ndiponso mwamuna  anaima ndiku imilila pamene paja.
LUK 6:9	Yesu ananena kwaiwo, ''Nikufunsa iwe, Kodi sicholamulidwa pasabata kuchita zabwino kuchila kuchita voipa, kupulumusa moyo kuchila kuuononga?''
LUK 6:10	Ndiponso anayanga baja bonse banamuzungulila ndikunena ku mwamuna, ''Tambusula kwanja yako.'' Anachita chomwecho, ndiponso kwanja kwake kunabwezewa.
LUK 6:11	Ndiponso banazozedwa naukali ndiponso ananena kuliwina ndi muzaka chamene bangamuchite Yesu.
LUK 6:12	Chinabwela chachitika masiku yaja nichakuti anaenda kuluphiri kupempela. Anapitiliza kupempela kwa Mulungu usiku onse.
LUK 6:13	Pamene kunali muzuba, anaitana opunzila bake, ndiponso anasankha kumi ndi tuwili bamene analikuitana ati maapostoli.
LUK 6:14	Mazina yama apostoli banali Simoni (wamene anainika ati Peter) ndiponso abale bake, Andeleo, Yakobu, Yoani, Philipo, Batilomeo,
LUK 6:15	Mateyo, Tomasi, Yakobu mwana wa Alifas, Simon wamene anali kuitananiwa Ziloti,
LUK 6:16	Judasi mwana wa Yakobu, Ndiponso Judasi Esikalyoti wamena anali ogulisa.
LUK 6:17	Koma Yesu anabwela pansi paluphiri ndi iwo nakuimilila pamalo pamene panali polingana ndi ophunzila bake bambiri ndiponso gulu ikulu yabathu baku Judeya ndiponso Jelusalemu ndiponso akuchimana chaku Tyre ndiponso Sidoni.
LUK 6:18	Banabwela kumvelela kwaiye ndiponso kuchilisiwa kumatenda yao. Banthu bamene anavutisiwa ndi mizimu zonyansa anachilisiwa.
LUK 6:19	Alionse mugulu analikuyeselela kumugwila chifukwa mphanvu zochilisa zinalikuchoka mwaiye, ndiponso anabachilisa bonse.
LUK 6:20	Ndiponso anayanganila paophunzila bake, ndi kunene, ''Ndimwe odala imweamene aliosauka, chifukwa ufumu wa Mulungu ndiye wanu.
LUK 6:21	Ndimwe odala bamene mulinanjala, chifukwa muzazozedwa. Ndimwe odala imwe bamene mulila, chifukwa muzaseka.
LUK 6:22	Ndimwe odala ngati banthu banthu bakuzondani ndiponso kukupatulani ndiponso kukutukwanani, chifukwa chamwana wa munthu.
LUK 6:23	Sekelelani muli ija siku ndiponso ndi chimwemwe, chifukwa muzankhala ndi mphatso yaikulu kuchoka kumwamba, ndi mibado yao inachita kuaneneli babo munjila imozimozi.
LUK 6:24	Koma vuto ilikuli imwe bamene olemela, chifukwa mwalandila kudala tontozo lanu.
LUK 6:25	Vuto ilikuli imwe bamene aliokutila manje, chifukwa muzamvela njala pasogolo.ilikuli imwe bamene baseka manje, chifukwa muzalila malilo pasogolo
LUK 6:26	Vuto lili kwainu bamene banthu banena zabwino paliimwe, chikukwa iyo ndiye njila mwamene mibado yanu inivutisilamo ananeneli baboza.
LUK 6:27	Koma ninena kwainu bamene bamvela, kondani badani banu ndiponso mubachitile vabwino baja bamene bakuzondani.
LUK 6:28	Dalitsani baja bamene bakutembelelani ndiponso mubapempelele baja bamene bakuvutisani.
LUK 6:29	Kuli iwo bamene bakumenyani kutobo, mupasenso ndi kwinakwache.Ngati munthu wina atenga koti yako, usagwilililenso chovala chako.
LUK 6:30	Pasa aliyense wamene akupempa.Ngati munthu wina atenga chinthu chako, usamufunse kuti akubwezele.
LUK 6:31	Monga mwanene ufuna banthu bena kukuchitila, Naiwe uchite chimodzimodzi kulibemve.
LUK 6:32	Ngati ukonda chabe baja bamene bakukonda, Kodi nipindu bwanji yamene ingankale kwaiwe? chifukwa ndi ochimwa akonda kuchita chimodzimodzi.
LUK 6:33	Ngati uchita vintu vabwino chabe kuli baja bamene bakuchitila vabwino iwe, nanga pindi kuli iwe ni chani?
LUK 6:34	Ngati ukongolesa chabe kuli banthu bamene uganizila kuti ndibemve bazakubwezelanso, Kodi nipindu bwanji iyo kuliiwe? Ndi ochimwa amakongolesa kuochimwa, kuti alandile mumuyeselo umodzi.
LUK 6:35	Koma kondani adani banu ndiponso bachitileni vabwino.Kongolesani koma musaganizile kulandila chilichonse ndiponso mphatso yanu izankhala yaikulu ndiponso muzankhala bana babapamwamba, chifukwa iye mwinewake niwabwino kulibaja banthu bamene sibayamika ndiponso kuli boipa.
LUK 6:36	Nkalani bachifundo, monga mwamene tatewanu ali wachifundo.
LUK 6:37	Musaweluze , ndiponso simuzaweluzidwa, musasule, ndiponso naimwe simuzasuliwa. Kululukila benzanu ndiponso naimwe muzakululukidwa.
LUK 6:38	Pasani, ndiponso naimwe musapasidwa. mumueselo umodzi ndi chisangalalo_nakusindila pansi, ndiponso kuzisunkhani pamodzi ndiponso nakutaikila-zizatikila mumanja mwako.Koma mumuyeselo wamene muzasebenzesa, chizabwezedwa kwaiwe.
LUK 6:39	Ndiponso anabauza fanizo, ''Kodi nanga munthu osaona angasogolele muzake wamene siaona? ngati angachiti, Ndiponso bonse bazagwela mumugodi, kodi simwamene?''
LUK 6:40	Ophunzila simukulu kupambana muphunzisi, koma alionse ngati afikapo pakuphunzisiwa azanhkala monga muphunzisi wake.
LUK 6:41	Ndiponso nichifukwa chani muyanganila pakanthu kang'ono kali mulinso lamubale wako, Koma iwe siunazindikila mutengo ukulu mulinsolako?
LUK 6:42	Ungakambe bwanji kumubalewako, mubale, ' Lekanichose kanthu kang'ono mulinsolako; ngati iweweka siungaone chimutengo chikulu mulinsolako? Imwe onama! choyamba chosa chija chimutengo chikulu mulinsolako,ndiponso uzaona bwinobwino pakuti uchose kaja kumutengo kang'ono mulinso lamubale wako.
LUK 6:43	Koma kulibe chimutengo chabwino chamene chingabeleke zipaso zoola, angankale chimutengo choola chamene chingabeleke zipaso zabwino,
LUK 6:44	Koma chimutengo chilichonse chizazibika kulinganiza nazipaso zamene chibeleka.Banthu sibama kolola visepo kuchimutengo chaminga zamusanga, angankhale kukolola magrepusi ku mabriya yamusanga.
LUK 6:45	Munthu wabwino kuchokela muchipao chaubwinowake wamumutima amabeleka za bwino, ndiponso munthu oyipa kuchokela muchipao chakuipa kwamumutima wake amabeleka zoipa. Koma kuchokela mu unyinji waza mumutima kamwa kazanena.
LUK 6:46	Nichifukwa chani chamene muniitanila, 'Ambuye, Ambuye,' ndiponso simumvelela zinthu zamene nikuuzani?
LUK 6:47	Alionse wamene abwela kwaine ndiponso nakumvelela mau yanga, Nizakuuzani mwamene alili.
LUK 6:48	Ali monga munthu wamene amanga nyumba, wamene anakumba pansi pantaka ndiponso nakumanga chi manyumba pamwala olimba.pamene kuziliwa kwamanzi kunabwela, kupopota kwamanzi kunachaya nyumba ija, koma siinagwedezeke, chifukwa yenze inamangiwa bwino.
LUK 6:49	Koma munthu wamene amvela mau, ndiponso siayamvelela, alimonga munthu wamene anamanga nyumba pamwamba pantaka kopanda chiyambi. pamene kupopota kwamanzi kunachaya munyumba, pamene apochabe inagwa, ndiponso chibadwile chaija nyumba chinasila.''
LUK 7:0	MUTU 7
LUK 7:1	Pamemene Yesu anasiliza zonse zamene analikunena mukumvela kwabanthu, anangena mu kapenamu.
LUK 7:2	Koma musenchulion anali ndi kapolo wake wamene anakwezewa ngi iye, ndiponso analiodwala pafupi nakufuna kufa.
LUK 7:3	Pamene musechulyoni anamvela paza Yesu, anatuma kwaiye akulu bama jews, nakumufunsa kuti abwele achilise wanchinto wake.
LUK 7:4	Pamene banabwela kuli Yesu, Banamufunsa mosilizika, ndikunena, '' Nioyenela kuti iwe umuchitile izi,
LUK 7:5	chifukwa akonda zikolatu, ndiponso niwamene anatimangila sinagogu yatu.''
LUK 7:6	Pokapo Yesu anapitiliza munjila yake ndibemve.Koma pamene akalibe kufika patali nanyumba, Uja musenchulyoni anatuma banzake kuli iye, '' Ambuye, musazivutise, chifukwa inesindine oyenela kuti mubwele munyumba yanga.
LUK 7:7	Kamba kachamene ichi sininazione kuti ndine oyenela kuti mubwele kwaine, Koma kamabani chabemau ndiponso wanchinto wanga azapola.
LUK 7:8	chifukwa naine ndine munthu wamene alamulila asilikale. Nimane kuli uyu, 'kuti enda', ndiponso ayenda, ndiponso amanena kuli wina, ' bwela, 'ndiponso abwela, ndiponso kuli wanchito wanga, ' chita ichi, 'ndiponso amachita,''
LUK 7:9	Pamene Yesu anamvela izi, Analiodabwisiwa ndi iye, ndiponso pakubwelela ku gulu lamene linali kumukonka, '' Ndikunena kuti, nikalibekupezapo chikululupilo monga ichi mu Izilaeli.''
LUK 7:10	Ndiponso banebenze naye banatumiwa kubwelela kunyumba, ndiponso banapeza kuti wanchito alibwino.
LUK 7:11	Kuchekela pamene apo Yesu anaenda kumuzinda wina oitanidwa Nani, Ndiopunzilabake ndiponso nagulu ikulu inaenda ndi iye.
LUK 7:12	Pamene anafika pafupi ndikomo yamuzinda, Koma, mwamuna enzeokufa ananyamulidwa kuenda kunja, mwana mwamunaeka wamene bamaibake banali naye ( wamene anali ofedwwa), ndiponso gulu ikulu kuchoka mumuzinda banali ndi iye.
LUK 7:13	Pamemene ambuye anamuona, Analiotengedwa ndichifundo paliemve ndiponso ananena kwaiye, '' kosalila.''
LUK 7:14	Ndiponso anapita kugwila mapulanga mwamene bananyamulila tupi, ndiponso bamene bana nyamula banaimilila.Ananena kwaiye, mwamuna wachichepele, ninena kwaiwe, nyamuka.''
LUK 7:15	Mwamuna wakufa anankala nakuyamba kukamba, ndiponso Yesu anamupasila kuli bamai bake.
LUK 7:16	Ndiponso bonse banagwilidwa ndi mantha, ndiponso banapitiliza kutamanda Mulungu, nakunena, '' Kuti muneneli mukulu anyamulidwa paliise'' ndiponso '' Mulungu ayanganila bana bake.''
LUK 7:17	Uyu utenga wabwino pali Yesu unasalangana konse mu Judeya ndiponso kulionse uzungulila zigao.
LUK 7:18	Aphunzila ba Yoani anamuuza palizonse izi.
LUK 7:19	Ndiponso Yoani anaitana ophunzila bake babili ndikubatuma kwa ambuye ndikunena, '' Kodi ndimwe amene mufunika kubwela, olo tiyangani kuli winangu?''
LUK 7:20	Pamene bana bwela pafupi ndi Yesu, Azimuna ananena, '' Kuti Yoani mubadizi atituma kwaiwe ndikunena, ' Kuti kodi ndiwe wamene azabwela, olo tiyanganile winangu?''
LUK 7:21	Paliija nthawi anachilisa  banthu bambiri banalnda ndiponso analiomangidwa ndiponso kumizimu zonyansa, ndiponso kupasa menso kuosaona.
LUK 7:22	Yesu anayankha ndikunena kwaiwo, '' pamene muzaenda munjila yanu, mukamu uze Yoani zamene mwaona ndiku mvela. bakungu bapenya, olemala alikuenda, bodwala kate batubisiwa, ovala matu bamvela, bakufa baukisiwa nakubwelela kumoyo, ndi aja opelebela auziwa utenga wabwino.
LUK 7:23	Munthu wamene siasiya kukulupilila mwaine chifukwa chazinthu zamene nilikuchita niodalisika.''
LUK 7:24	Kuchoka pamene batumiki ba Yoani bana enda, Yesu anayamba kunena pali Yoani, ''
LUK 7:25	Nichani chamemene mwenzemwaendela panja muchipululu kuona? matete ananyan'ganisiwa ndi mpepo? Nanga wenze waenda panja kuona chani? Mwamuna ovala vovala vabwino? Onani, baja bamene bavala vovala vodula nabaja bamene bankala mankalidwe yapa mwamba bankala mumanyumba ya ufumu.
LUK 7:26	Koma mwenze maenda kuona chani? Muneneli? Eeeh, ikuuzani imwe, naku chilapo pali muneneli.
LUK 7:27	Uyu ndiye wamene vinalembewa kuti, 'Ona, Nituma mutola nkani kukusogolela, wamene azakukonzela njila.'
LUK 7:28	Niku uza iwe, pali bantu bamene banabadwa kuli bakazi kulibe mukulu ochila Yohane. Koma uja wamene nimungóno mu ufumu wa Mulungu nimukulu kumuchila eve.
LUK 7:29	(Pamene bantu bonse banamwela ichi, pamozi na bamisonko, banakamba kuti Mulungu niolungama, chifukwa banabatiziwa na ubatizo wa Yohane.
LUK 7:30	Koma ba Falisi na bozibisisa malamulo banakana lingo ya Mulungu pa myoyo zabo, chifukwa sibana batiziwe na Yohane.)
LUK 7:31	"Nanga nikuli chani, manje, chamene ninga linganizane uyu mubadwe?
LUK 7:32	Uli monga chani kansi? Uli monga bana bamene basobela kumalo kogulisilako, bamene bakankala pansi baitanana wina na muzake kukamba kuti, 'Tinakulinzila mutolilo iwe, koma siuna vine. Tinaimba nyimbo ya malilo, koma iwe suna lile.'
LUK 7:33	Chifukwa Yohane mubatizi anabwela sanali kudya buledi kapena kumwa vinyu, koma imwe mukamba kuti, 'Ali na chibanda.'
LUK 7:34	Mwana wa Muntu anabwela mokudya na kumwa, imwe mukamba kuti, muzake waba misonko na bama chimo!'
LUK 7:35	Koma nzelu zima weluzika zolungama na bana bake bonse."
LUK 7:36	Manje umozi wa a Falisi anaitana Yesu kuti akadye naye. Pamene Yesu anangena mu nyumba ya mu Falisi uja, anankala podyela kuti adye.
LUK 7:37	Onani, kunali mukazi wina mu muzinda wamene anali wama chimo. Pamene anaziba kuti ana nkala podyela munyumba ya mu Falisi, anabwelesa mpika munali mafutga yonunkila.
LUK 7:38	Pamene ana imilila kumbuyo kwake, anali kulila, anayamba kunanisa mendo yake na misozi, nakuya puputa na sisi zake naku mpyompyona mendo nakuya zoleka na mafuta yonunkila.
LUK 7:39	Pamene uja mu Falisi wamene anaitanila Yesu anaona ichi, anaganiza mumutima mwake kuti, "Ngati uyu mwamuna ni muneneli, asembe amuziba uyu muntu na kuti ni muntu wamu nkalidwe bwanji wamene amugwila, chifukwa niwama chimo."
LUK 7:40	Yesu anamuyanka kuti, "Simoni, nili na chintu chamene nifuna kuku uza iwe." Anamuyanka kuti, "Kambani, Apunzisi!"
LUK 7:41	Yesu anakamba kuti, "Muntu umozi okongolesa ndalama anali na babili ba nkongole. Umozi anali na nkongole zokwanila 500 dinali, wina 30.
LUK 7:42	Pamene banakangiwa kubweza nkongole, anabakululukila bonse. Mwa ichi, pali aba niuti wamene azamukonda maningi?"
LUK 7:43	Simoni anamuyanka kuti, "Niwona monga ni uja wamene anamukululukila zambili." Yesu anamu uza kuti, "Waganizila bwino."
LUK 7:44	Yesu anapindamuka kulangana mukazi uja naku uza Simoni kuti, "Wamu ona mukazi uyu. Ine nangena munyumba mwako. Siunani pase manzi yosambila kumendo, koma eve ananisa mendo yanga na misozi zake naku ya puputa na sisi zake.
LUK 7:45	Iwe siunani mpyompyone, koma kuchokela pamene ine nabwelela eve sanaleke ku mpyompyona mendo yanga.
LUK 7:47	Iwe siuna zoleke mutu wanga mafuta, koma eve azoleka mendo yanga na mafuta yonunkila. Chifukwa chake niku uza iwe kuti, machimo yake, yamene yanali yambili, yakululukiliwa-chifukwa eve akonda maningi. Koma wamene akululukiliwa tung'ono, amakonda pang'ono."
LUK 7:48	Anamu uza mukazi uja kuti, "Machimo yako yakululukiliwa."
LUK 7:49	Baja bamene banali nkale podyela pamozi na eve bana yamba kukamba pakati pabo kuti, "Kansi nindani uyu wamene akululukila namachimo?"
LUK 7:50	Yesu anauza mukazi uja kuti, "Chikululupililo chako chakupulumusa. Enda mwamu tendele."
LUK 8:0	Mutu 8
LUK 8:1	Chinabwela chachitika kuchokela apa kuti Yesu anayamba ulendo mu mizinda yosiya-siyana na minzi, kulalikila na ku ulusa utenga wabwino wa wamulungu. Bopunzila kumi na babili banali na eve,
LUK 8:2	na bazikazi bena bamene banachilisiwa ku mizimu zonyansa na kumatenda: Maliya wamene analikuitanidwa Magadalena, wamene anachosewamo mizimuzonyansa zinali tusanu nditubili;
LUK 8:3	Yoana mukazi wachuza, Mukulu paoyanganila wa Herode; Suzeni, ndiponso nabenangu bambiri , bamene, mukuchokela muzimene banalinazo, anasamalila zofunikila zao.
LUK 8:4	Pamene gulu ikulu yabanthu yenzeli kukumana, na banthu benze kubwela kuchokela mumizinda, anabauza fanizo:
LUK 8:5	"Mulimi anaenda kushanga mbeu. Pamene enzeli kushanga, zinangu zinagwela mumbali mwa njila na kudyakiwa, na nyoni zamumwamba zina zidya.
LUK 8:6	Zinangu zinagwela pa mwala, na pamene zina kula chabe, zinayuma, chifukwa zinalibe manzi.
LUK 8:7	Zinangu zinagwela pa minga, minga zinakula pamozi nambeu na kulasa mbeu zija.
LUK 8:8	Koma zinangu zinagwela panthaka ya bwino naku mela naku bala vipaso vambili." Pamene Yesu anasiliza kukamba ivi vinthu, anabaitana kuti, "Aliense wamene alina matu yakumvela, lekani amvele."
LUK 8:9	Bophunzila beke banamufunsa chamene fanizo iyi itanthauza.
LUK 8:10	Anaba yankha, "Kuziba kwa visinsi vaufumu wa Mulungu kwa pasiwa kuli imwe, koma kuli benangu nikamba muma fanizo, kuti 'kuona sibangaone, na kumvela sibanga mvesese.'
LUK 8:11	Manje iyi ndiye tanthauzo ya fanizo. Mbeu ni mau ya Mulungu.
LUK 8:12	Zamene zili mumbali mwanjila nibaja bamene bamvela, koma mudyelekazi abwela nakutenga mau mumitima yao kuti bsakhulupilile naku pulumusiwa.
LUK 8:13	Zamene zili pa mwala nibaja bamene, bakamvela mau, bayalandila nachimwemwe. Koma balibe muzyu; bakhulupilila kanthawi kangono, dipo munthawi yama yeso wamagwa.
LUK 8:14	Mbeu zamene zinagwela pa minga nibaja banthu wamne bamvela mau, koma pamene baenda, balasiwa navo desankhaba na chuma na vomvesa bwino thupi vaumoyo una, ndipo vipaso vao sivikiphya.
LUK 8:15	Koma mbeu zamene zina gwela pa nthaka yabwino, abo nibaja bamene, bamvela mau muchilungamo na mutima wabwino, kuya gwililila na kubala vipaso mukuyembekeza nakupilila.
LUK 8:16	kulibe wamene amayasha nyali nakuivinikila na mbiya kapena kufaka pansi pa bedi. koma,amaifaka  pachoikapo nyali kuti aliyense wamene angena aone kuunika.
LUK 8:17	pakuti kulibe chobisika chamene sichizakazibika,kapena chisinsi chilichonse chamene sichizakazibika naku bwela poonekela.
LUK 8:18	Manje nvesesani,kuliwamene alinavo,vinangu vizapasiwa kuli eve,koma wamene alibe,navonse vamene aganiza kuti alinavo vizapokewa kuchoka kuli eve.
LUK 8:19	Kuchoka apo amai baka naba bale bake bana bwela kuli iye, koma sibana kwanise ku fika pafupi naye chifukwa chakupaka kwa  bantu.
LUK 8:20	Anauziwa,"Amai bako naba bale bako bali imilile panje, kufuna kukuona."
LUK 8:21	Koma Yesu anayanka naku kamba kuli beve kuti, "Amai banga naba bale banga ni abo bamene banvela mau ya Mulungu naku yachita."
LUK 8:22	siku imozi ana kwela mu bwato nabo punzila bake, ndipo anabauza kuti, "tiyeni kumbali inangu kwa nyanja." Banayambako.
LUK 8:23	Koma pamene banali kuyenda mubwato iye anagona. kunabwela chimpepo chikulu pa nyanja, namu bwato mwao munayamba kuzula manzi, ndipo banali mu chiyopezo.
LUK 8:24	Ndipo bophunzila ba Yesu bana bwela kuli eve na kumu usha, kukamba kuti, "Ambuye! Ambuye! Tili pafupi nakufa!" Anauka  na kukalipila chimphepo na  manzi yenze kunyamuka, vinaleka, ndipo kunali mutendele.
LUK 8:25	Ndipo anakamba kulibeve, "Chukhulupililo chanu chili kuti?" Koma bana yopa naku dabwa, naku funsana wina namunzake, "Kansi uyu nindani, wamene alamulila mphepo na manzi, ndipo vimumvelela?"
LUK 8:26	Bana yenda pamanzi kumalo ya Gerasenesi, yamen yali ku mbali inangu ya Galilea.
LUK 8:27	Pemena Yesu anaseluka mu bwato, anakumana na mwamuna winangu wamene anili na vibanda. Kwa nthawi itali sanavalepo vovala, ndipo senzo nkhala munyumba koma pakati ka manda
LUK 8:28	Pamene anona Yesu, analila nagwa pansi pamaso pake na kukamba mokuwa, "Muzachita chani naine, Yesu, Mwana wa Mulungu Mukulu? Nikupehphani, musani nzunze."
LUK 8:29	Chifukwa Yesu analamulila muzimu oipa kuti uchoke muli uja munthu. Ndaba nthawi zambili wanzo mugwila, nagu enzeli omangiwa nakulondewa, enzodula vomumangila ndipo vibanda venzo mulengasa kuyenda musanga.
LUK 8:30	Ndipo Yesu anamufunsa, "Ndiwe ndani?" Anakamba, "Legoni," chifukwa vibanda vambili vinamugena.
LUK 8:31	Venze kungo mupapatila kuti asavitume ku gahena.
LUK 8:32	Penzeli nkhumba zambili zenzo kudya kumbali kwa chulu. Vibanda vinamu pempha kuti avivomeleze kuti vingene munkhumba, ndipo anavi vomeleza.
LUK 8:33	Ndipo vibanda vonachoka muli uja munthu nakungena munkhumba, na gulu yankhumba zija tamanga nakuzi ponyela munyanja nakumbila.
LUK 8:34	Pamene oyanganila nkhumba banaona vamene vina chitika, bana thamanga naku uza bamu mzunda na kumbali kwa ziko iyo.
LUK 8:35	Ndipo banthu bana yenda kuti baone vamene vachitika, naku bwela kuli Yesa nakupeza munthu wamene vibanda vachokamo. Enze nkhale pama pazi ya Yesu, wovala na nzelu zake; ndipo mbanamvela mantha.
LUK 8:36	Ndipo bame banaona vinacitika banaba uza mwemene uja munthu enzeli ogwiliwa na vibanda anachilisiwa.
LUK 8:37	Banthu bonse baku dela ya Gerasenesi banamu pempha Yesu kuti achoke kuli beve, chifukwa bana tengeka namantha kyakulu. Mwaicho anagena mu bwato kuti ba bwelelemo.
LUK 8:38	Munthu  wamene vibanda vina choka anamu papatila kuti aende nae, kom Yesu namubweza, kukamab kuti,
LUK 8:39	"Bwelela kunyumba kwako nakupasa umboni okwanila pali vemen mulungu akuchitila." Uja munthu anayenda, kulalikila mumzinda onse vamene pa vamene Yesu ana muchitila.
LUK 8:40	Manje pamene Yesu ana bwelela, gulu ina mulandila, chufukwa benzeli kumu yembekeza.

LUK 11:25	Pamene ubwelela, ukapeza ija nyumba niyopyangiwa naku ikiwa mumalo yake.
LUK 11:26	Umayenda naku bwelela pamozi na mizimu zina zili 7 zoipisisa kuichila nakubwela kunkala munyumba ija. Posilizila pake nipakuti uja muntu amankala osila kuchilapo na poyamba."
LUK 11:27	Chinachitika kuti, pamene anali kukamba ivi vintu, mukazi winangu anakwezeka liu yake pa gulu naku kamba kuti,"Niyodala mimba yamene inakubala na mabele yamene yanakunyonsha."
LUK 11:28	Koma anayanka kuti, "Kuchilapo, bodalisika nibaja bamene bamvela mau ya Mulungu naku yasunga."
LUK 11:29	Pamene magulu yanayamba kukula, Yesu anayamba kukamba kuti, "Uyu mubadwe ni mubadwe oipa. Usakila cholangizila, koma kulibe cholangizila chamene chizapasiwa koma cha Yona.
LUK 11:30	Monga mwamene Yona anankalila cholangizila kuli bantu Nineve, chimozi mozi Mwana wa Muntu azankala cholangizila kuli mubadwe uyu.
LUK 11:31	Mfumu yayi Kazi yaku mwela izakaima pa siku yoweluza pamozi na bantu ba mubadwe uno naku uweluza, chifukwa eve anabwela kuchokela kosilila ziko kuti amvele nzelu za Solomoni, ndipo onani, mukulu pali Solomoni ali pano.
LUK 11:32	Bantu baku Nineve bazaimilila pa chiweluzo na mubadwe uyu naku wu weluza, chifukwa beve bana tembenuka chifukwa cha kulalika kwa Yona, ndipo onani, mukuli ochila Yona ali pano.
LUK 11:33	Kulibe muntu, pamene ayasha nyali, ai ika mumalo yobisika kapena pansi pa basiketi, koma poikapo nyali, kuti baja bamene bangena baone ku unika.
LUK 11:34	Linso yanu ni nyali ya thupi. Ngati linso ili bwino, thupi yonse izula na ku unika. Koma ngati linso yanu si ili bwino, thupi yanu izula na mfinzi.
LUK 11:35	Mwa ichi, nkalani osamalila kuti ku unika kwamene kuli mukati mwanu usankale mfinzi.
LUK 11:36	Ngati thupi yanu yonse niyozaza na ku unika, ilibe mbali ili yonse ya mufinzi, thupi yanu yonse izankala monga pamene nyali iwala mofikapo kuli imwe."
LUK 11:37	Pamene anasiliza kukamba, mu Falisi anamupempa kuti ayende akadye kunyumba kwake, Yesu ana enda naku nkala.
LUK 11:38	Mu Falisi anadabwa kuti Yesu sanayambilile kusamba akalibe kudya chakudya chamu mazulo.
LUK 11:39	Koma Ambuye banakamba kuli eve kuti, "Manje apa, imwe ba Falisi mumasuka kunja kwa chomwelamo na mbale, koma mukati muli mozula na kuzikonda na voipa.
LUK 11:40	Imwe bantu mulibe nzelu! Nanga wamene anapanga kunja siwamene anapanga namukati?
LUK 11:41	Pasani kuli bosauka vamene vili mukati, mwamene umu vintu vonse vizankala vokuwamilani imwe.
LUK 11:42	"Koma soka kuli imwe ba Falisi, chifukwa mupasa chakumi chavonse vamene mulinavo na volima vamudimba, koma mumakana kuweluza na chikondi cha Mulungu. Ni chofunikila kuchita muchilungamo na kukonda Mulungu, kosa kangiwa  kuchita na vinthu vinangu.
LUK 11:43	Soka kwa imwe Afalise, chifukwa mukonda mipando ya kusogolo mu masinagogi na moni waulemu mu malo yogulisila.
LUK 11:44	Soka kwa imwe, chifukwa muli monga manda yosalembewapo yemene banthu bayendapo osaziba.
LUK 11:45	Umozi wa bakaswili mu malamulo anakamba kuti, "Aphunzisi, vamene mukamba viti tukwana naise."
LUK 11:46	Yesu anakamba, "Soka kwa imwe, aphunzisi bama lamul! Chifukwa munyamulisa banthu  katundu yoleme yovuta kunyamula, koma imwe simugwilako kutatundu nangu na chukumo chanu chimozi.
LUK 11:47	Soka kwa imwe, chifukwa mumanga manda yaba neneli, koma nima kolo yanu yanaba paya.
LUK 11:48	Ndimwe mboni na kuvomeleza zinchito zama kolo yanu, chifukwa zoona anabapaya ndipo mumanga manda zao.
LUK 11:49	Ndiponso chifukwa chaichi, Mulungu munzelu zake ankamba, 'Nizabatumila baneneli na batumiki, ndipo baza nzunza nakupayapo benengu.'
LUK 11:50	Uno mubadwo, ndipo, uzapasiwa mulandu pa magazi yonse yabaneneli yana khesewa kuchokela chiyambi cha ziko,
LUK 11:51	kuyambila magazi ya Abelo mpaka magazi ya Zakaria, wamene anapaiwa pakati pa guwa na malo oyela. Inde, niku uzani, uno mubadwo uzapasiwa mulandu.
LUK 11:52	Soka kwaimwe bakaswili ba lamulo, chifukwa mwatenga chosegulila cha kuziba, imwe bene simungena, ndipo muchingiliza baja bamene bangena."
LUK 11:53	Pamene Yesu anachokako uko, balembi na bafalise banamu susha na kukangana nae pavinthu vambili,
LUK 11:54	kuyesa kuti bamugwila mu mau yake.
LUK 12:0	Mutu 12
LUK 12:1	Manje, pamene bantu bokwanila ma 1,000 yambili banakumana pamozi mpaka kuyamba kudyakana, anayamba ku uza bopunzila bake choyamba kuti, "munkale bochenjela na chotupisa chaba Falisi, chamene ni umoyo waboza.
LUK 12:2	Koma chintu chamene chizabisika chamene sichizazibika.
LUK 12:3	Mwa ichi vamene vikambiwa mu mfinzi chiza onekela poyela, nachamene chikambiwa mu kutu mu chipinda chamukati chiza zibisiwa pamwamba pa malata.
LUK 12:4	Nikamba kuli imwe, banzanga, kuti musayope baja bamene bapaya thupi, koma kulibe chinangu chamene bangachite kuchilapo.
LUK 12:5	Koma nikuchenjezani pali wamene muyenela kuyopa. Muyope wamene, akapaya, alinayo mpavu kukutayani mu gehena. Zoona, niku uzani, muyopeni.
LUK 12:6	Kansi tunyoni tusanu situgulisiwa na ndalama zibili? Koma kulibe nangu kamozi kamene kaibaliwa pa menso ya Mulungu.
LUK 12:7	Ngakale na sisi za kumutu kwanu nizopendewa. Musayope. Ndimwe bapa mwamba kuchita tunyoni twambili.
LUK 12:8	Ni kamba kuli imwe kuti, ali onse wamene anivomela pamenso pa bantu, Mwana wa Muntu azaka muvomela pamenso pa ba ngelo ba Mulungu,
LUK 12:9	koma uja wamene anikana pamenso pa bantu azakakaniwa pamenso pa bangelo ba Mulungu.
LUK 12:10	Ali onse wamene akamba mau yonyozela Mwana wa Muntu, azakululukiliwa, koma uja wamene anyozela Muzimu Oyela, sazakululukiliwa.
LUK 12:11	Ngati balikuletani kuma Sinagogo, basogoleli, na bolamulila, musankale bovutika mutima mwamene muzazichingizila, kapena vamene muzakamba,
LUK 12:12	chifukwa Muzimu Oyela uzakupunzisanii pantawi yamene iyo vamene muyenela kukamba."
LUK 12:13	Pamene apo umozi mugulu ija anakamba kuti, "Apunzisi, mu uzeni mubale wanga agabane naine chuma chamasiye."
LUK 12:14	Yesu anamuyanka kuti, "Mwamuna, nanga nindani ananipanga oweluza kapena oimililako iwe?"
LUK 12:15	Anabauza kuti, "Samalilani kuti muzisunga kutaba vintu vozikonda, chifukwa umoyo wa muntu sunkala mu kupaka kwa vchuma."
LUK 12:16	Yesu anabauza fanizo, kukamba kuti, "Munda wa muntu olemela inabeleka kwambili,
LUK 12:17	anaganizila pa eka, kukamba kuti, 'Nanga nizachita chani kansi, chifukwa nilibe malo kosungila vokolola vanga?'
LUK 12:18	Anakamba kuti, 'Ichi ndiye chamene ine nizachita. Nizagwesa nkokwe zanga naku manga zikulu, mwamene muja nizasungilamo mbeu zanga zonse na katundu.
LUK 12:19	Nizauza moyo wanga kuti, "Moyo, iwe uli nacho chuma chamene chasungiliwa cha zaka zambili. Pumula mosavutika, imwa, nkala osangalala."'
LUK 12:20	Koma Mulungu anamu uza kuti, 'Opusiwa iwe, usiku walelo moyo wako uzatengewa, na vintu vamene wakonzekela, kansi vizankala vabandani?'
LUK 12:21	Umu ndiye mwamene muntu wamene azisungila chuma chake koma siolemela pa menso pa Mulungu."
LUK 12:22	Yesu anauza bopunzila bake kui, "Mwa ichi ine nikamba kuli imwe kuti, osaganizila pali umoyo wanu, vamene muzadya; kapena pali thupi, vamene muzavala.
LUK 12:23	Chifukwa umoyo uchila vakudya, na thupi ichila vovala.
LUK 12:24	Ganizilani vikwangwala, kuti sivishanga kapena kukolola. Vilibe mosungila kapena nkokwe, koma Mulungu amavidyesa. Onani mwamene imwe mupambanilapo kuchila tunyoni!
LUK 12:25	Nanga kansi nindani pali imwe wamene mukupitila movutikila mutima angaikileko ora ku moyo wake?
LUK 12:26	Kansi ngati imwe mukangiwa kuchita kantu aka kang'ono, nanga nichani chamene muvutikila mutima pali vamene vasala?
LUK 12:27	Yanganani pali maluba-mwamene yamelela. Siyasebenza, kapena kutunga vovala. Koma niku uzani imwe kuti, ngakale Solomoni mu ulemelelo wake sana vale vovala monga ivi.
LUK 12:28	Ngati Mulungu akwanisa kuvalika ma uzu yamu munda, yamene yakuti lelo yaliko, koma mailo yataiwa mu mulilo, nikuchilapo kwa bwanji mwamene eve azakuvalikilani imwe, bochepa chikulupililo!
LUK 12:29	Musasakile vamene muzadya na vamene muzamwa, musankale bovutika mutima.
LUK 12:30	Chifukwa maziko yonse ya pa ziko yasakila vintu vamene ivi, ndipo ba Tate banu baziba kuti imwe muvifuna.
LUK 12:31	Koma funani ufumu wake, na vintu vonse ivi vizapasiwa kuli imwe.
LUK 12:32	Osayopa, nkosa zochepa, chifukwa ba Tate banu chibamvesa bwino kukupasani ufumu waku mwamba.
LUK 12:33	Gulisa chuma chako upase kuli bosauka. Zipangile paweka chikwama chamene sichi sili-chuma kumwamba chamene sichisila, kwamene kulibe kawalala wamene abwela pafupi, kapena zimbili kuononga.
LUK 12:34	Chifukwa kwamene kuli chma chako ndiye kwamene kuli mutima wako.
LUK 12:35	"Nkalani bokonzekela na nyali zanu zikanzinkala zoyaka,
LUK 12:36	ndipo munkale monga bantu bamene bwana wabo pamene abwelela kuchoka ku pwando ya ukwati, kuti pamene abwela kukonkosha, mosachedwa bazamu segulilako.
LUK 12:37	Bodalisika nibaja bantchito bamene bwana wabo azabapeza balanganila pamene abwelela. Zoona, niku uzani kuti, azakonzekelatu naku baitana kuti bankale podyela, ndipo azabwela naku batumikila.
LUK 12:38	Ngati bwana abwela pa ntawi ya chibili ya usiku, kapena yachitatu, naku bapeza bali bokonzekela, nibo bodalisika bantchito abo.
LUK 12:39	Koma mvesesani ichi, asembe mwine wa nyumba anaziba ntawi yamene kawalala azabwela, sangalekelele nyumba yake kuti angenemo.
LUK 12:40	Naimwe nkalani bokonzekela, chifukwa simuziba ntawi yamene Mwana wa Muntu azabwela."
LUK 12:41	Petulo anakamba kuti, "Ambuye, nanga mukamba iyi fanizo ku uza ise chabe, kapena kuli bonse?"
LUK 12:42	Ambuye banamuyanka kuti, "Nanga kansi niuti okululupilika futi wanzelu olanganila wamene mbuye wake azaika kuti apase mbali yao yacha kudya pa ntawi yake yoenela?
LUK 12:43	Odalisika ni uja wantchito wamene mbuye wake amupeza achita chamene ichi pamene abwela.
LUK 12:44	Zoona niku uzani kuti azamu kwezeka kunkala olanganilka katundu wake wonse.
LUK 12:45	Koma ngati uja wantchito azakamba mumutima wake kuti, 'Mbuye wanga achedw kubwelela,'nakuyamba kumenya bantchito bamuna na bakazi nakuyamba kudya nakukolewa,
LUK 12:46	mbuye wauja wantchito azakabwela pa ntawi yamene sazayembekela na pa ola yamene sazaziba naku mujuba mu vidunswa vidunswa naku mugabila malo pamozi nabaja bosakululupilika.
LUK 12:47	Uja wantchito, wamene anaziba chofuna cha bwana wake koma sanakonzekele kapena kuchita kulingana na chofuna chake, azamenyewa na kwambili.
LUK 12:48	Koma uja wamene sanazibe koma anachita chamene chofunikila kumenyewa, azamenyewa pangóno. Koma ali onse wamene anapasiwa vambili, kuli beve vambili vizafunsiwa, nauja wamene anali ana pasiwa vambili, vambili vizanfusiwa kuli eve.
LUK 12:49	"Nina bwela kutila mulilo paziko, ningafunisise kuti unali oyaka kudala.
LUK 12:50	Koma nili nao ubatizo wamene nifunika kubatiziwa nao, ndipo mwamene nili ovutika mpaka chifikiliziwe!
LUK 12:51	Nanga muganiza kuti ine ninabwela kuleta mutendere pa ziko? Iyayi, Niku uzani imwe, koma kugabikana.
LUK 12:52	Chifukwa kuchokela apa kuzankala basanu munyumba imozi bogabikana-batatu kushushana na babili, na babili kushushana na batatu.
LUK 12:53	Bazankala bogabikana, tate kushusha mwana na mwana kushusha tate, muzimai kushusha mwana na mwana kushusha mai, mupongozi-mukazi kushusha mupongozi mukazi na mupongozi mukazi kushusha mai mupongozi."
LUK 12:54	Yesu anali ku uza magulu nafuti kuti, "Ngati mwaona kumbi i'ima kuchokela kumazulo, pamene apo mumakamba kuti, 'Mvula ingóno ibwela.' chimachitika munjila yamene iyo.
LUK 12:55	Ngati chimpepo chochokela kumwela chitimba, mumakamba kuti, 'kuzapya maningi,' ndipo chimachitika.
LUK 12:56	Baboza, muzima tantauzo ya ziko na makumbi, nanga bwanji imwe simuziba tantauzo ya ntawi yamanje?
LUK 12:57	Nanga kansi nichifukwa chani imwe simukwanisa kuweluza cholungama pa imwe mweka?
LUK 12:58	Chifukwa ngati imwe muyenda na mudani wanu ku oweluza milandu, munjila yesesani kuti mukambilane mulandu uyo kuti asakupelekeni kuli oweluza, mwakuti oweluza asakupelekeni kuli kazembe, na kazembe asakupelekeni mundende.
LUK 12:59	Niku uzani imwe kuti, simuzakachoka mundende mpaka mukasilize kulipila ndalama zonse."
LUK 13:0	Mutu 13
LUK 13:1	Pa ntau ija, bantu benangu kuja ba namu-uza pali baku Galileya bamene Pilato anasanganiza magazi yabo na nsembe.

LUK 13:3	Iyai, niku uzani. Koma ngati simutembenuka, monse muza onogeka munjila imozi.
LUK 13:4	Olo baja bantu bali 18 mu Siloamu banagwelewa na nyumba yapamwamba naku bapaya, Muganiza kuti baanali bochimwa maningi kuchila bantu bonse mu Yelusalema?
LUK 13:5	Iyai, Nikamba. Koma ngati simutembenuka, monse muza onogeka."
LUK 13:6	Yesu anakamba fanizo iyi, "Muntu winangu anali na Mutengo wampesa  woshangiwa mumunda wake na mpesa anabwela kusakila vipaso mu mutengo koma sana vipeze.
LUK 13:7	Muntu ana uza bolima mmuunda, "Ona, zaka zitatu manje nibwela na kuyesa kupeza vipaso pa mutengo wampesa uyu koma sini na peze chii chonse. Chijube. Nanga nichani kuchilekelela ku ononga ntaka?'
LUK 13:8	"Olima mu munda anayanka naku kamba kuti, 'Chisiyeni chka chino pamene ni limila mumbalu mwake na kuyikamo manyowa.
LUK 13:9	Ngati chaba vipaso chaka chibwela, chabwino; koma ngati sichina bale, uchi jube!'"
LUK 13:10	Manje Yesu enze ounzisa mu sinagogo inangu ntawi ya Sabata.

LUK 13:17	Pamene enzo kamba ivi vintu, bonse benzo mu ukila banamvela, koma gulu yonse inali kusangalala pali vintu vonse va ulemelelo vamene anachita.
LUK 13:18	Pamene apo Yesu anakamba kuti, "Ufumu wamulungu uli monga chani, elo ninga ulinganize nichani?
LUK 13:19	Uli monga ka mbeu ka mupilu kamene muntu anatenga nakuka ponyela mumunda mwake, ndipo ina kula kunkala  chimutengo  chikulu, na nyoni zamu mwamba zina manga tunchisa twake mu mwama mwake,"
LUK 13:20	Anakamba futi, Nichani chamene ninga linganize ufumu wa Mulungu?
LUK 13:21	Uli minga chofufumisa mukate chamene muzimai anatenga naku sankaniza na unga wa mukate okwanila mupimo utatu mpaka china mwazyika mu unga wa mukate onse."
LUK 13:22	Anabwela Yesu anayenda kupita mumizinda na munzi, kupunzisa na kupanga njila yake yoyenda ku Yelusalema.

LUK 13:24	"Lwishani ku ngena mukaseko kang'ono, chifukwa nikamba kuli iwe, bambili bazayesa ku ngena, koma sibaza kwanisa kungena.
LUK 13:25	Chabe mwine wa nyumba aka nyuka na kukoma chiseko, Ninshi uza ilimila panja naku menya chiseko nakukamba, 'Ambuye, Ambuye, tingeneseni.' "azayanka nakukamba kuli iwe, 'Sini kuziba olo kwamene uchokela.'
LUK 13:26	"Koma uza kamba, 'tinadya na kumwa pa menso pako elo una punzisa mu njila zatu.
LUK 13:27	"Koma aza yanka, "NIkamba kuli imwe, siniziba kwamene mu chokela. chokani pali ine, imwe bamene muchita uchimo!'
LUK 13:28	Kuzankala kulila na kukokota meno mukaona Abrahamu, Isaki, Yakobo, na bonse baneneli mu ufumu wa Mulungu, koma mwa ponyewa panja.
LUK 13:29	Baza choka kumaba, kumazulo, kumpoto na kumwela, na kunkala pa ome mu ufumu wa Mulungu.
LUK 13:30	Zibani ivi, abo basiliza baza nkala boyamba, na abo bofunikila bazankala bosiliza."
LUK 13:31	Mu ntau yamen ija, afalisi benanfo bana bwela nakukamba kuli enve, "yendani naku choka apa chifukwa Heoda afuna ku kupaya."
LUK 13:32	Yesu anakamba kuti, "Yendani mukayi uze nkandwe ija, 'onani ni chosa madimoni na kupolesa lelo na mailo, na siku ya chitatu nizafika pamene nifuna kufika.'
LUK 13:33	Ngati si ivo, nicho funikila kuti ni pililize lelo, mailo, siku yo konkapo, pakati si chovomelezewa kuti muneneli awonongewe panja pa Yelusalema.
LUK 13:34	Yelusalema, Yelusalema, wamene apaya baneneli na myala abo botumiwa kuli imwe. mwanene nenzo funisisila ku sonkanisa bana bako monga mwamene nkuku imasonkanisila tubana twake pansi pa mapapiko yake, koma simuna funisise ichi.
LUK 13:35	Ona, nyuma yako ya siyiwa. nikamba kuli iwe, si uzani ona mpaka ukambe, 'wodalisika ni wamene abwela muzina ya Ambuye.'"
LUK 14:0	Mutu 14
LUK 14:1	Chinachitika sabata imozi, pamene nanangena mu nyumba ya musogolelei umozi wa bafalise kuti adye buledi, banali kumu yanganisisa.
LUK 14:2	Onani, pasogolo pake panali mwamuna  wamene enzeli kunzunzika na matenda yovimbisa manja na mendo.
LUK 14:3	Yesu anafunsa bakaswili ba lamulo yaba Yuda na ba Falise, "Nishoyenela kuchilisa pa Sabata, nagu iyai."
LUK 14:4	Koma bana nkhala zii. Mwaicho Yesu anamugwila, kumuchilisa, naku mu uza ayende.
LUK 14:5	Anabauza, "Nindani pali imwe ali namwana mwamuna, nagu ngombe yamene yagwela mumgodi pa siku ya Sabata sangamumchose pamene apo?"
LUK 14:6	Sibana kwanise kupasa yankho kuli ivi vinthu.
LUK 14:7	Pamene Yesu anaona mwamene baja bamene banaitaniwa benzeli kusankhila mipando yolemekezeka, anakamba fanizo, kubauza kuti,
LUK 14:8	"Pamene uitaniwa na nawinangu kuphwando ya ukwati, usankhale pa malo yolemekezeka, chifukwa kapene baitana winangu wolemekezaka kupambana iwe.
LUK 14:9	Pamene munthu wamene akuitanini bonse babili afika, azakuuza, 'Pasa uyu munthu malo yako,' ndipo na nsoni uzayenda nakutenga malo yakosilizila.
LUK 14:10	Koma bakakuitana, yenda na kunkhala pamalo yakosilizila, kuti pamene wamene akuitana abwela, angaku uze kuti, 'Munzanga, yenda pamwaba.' Ndipo uza lemekezika pamenso pa bonse beli nkhale pa thebo naiwe.
LUK 14:11	Chifukwa alionse wamene azikweza azachepesewa, ndipo wamene azichepesa azakwezewa."
LUK 14:12	Yesu anauza futi mwamuna wamene anamuitana, "Pamene upasa chakudya cha mumazulo kapena phwando, osaitana banzako kapena babale bako kapena babululu bako kapena bapafupi bo;lemela, chifukwa naiwe banga kuitane kubwezela ndipo uzabwezelewa malipilo.

JHN 4:16	Yesu naye anamuyanka kuti, "iwe yenda ku nyumba kwako uyitane mwamuna wako, mubwele bonse kuno."
