JHN 4:18	chifukwa iwe unakwatiwapo ku ba muna bali 5, ndipo wamene uli naye apa simwamuna wako. Chamene wakamba ni chazoona."
JHN 4:19	Muzimayi anakamba kuti, "Bambo, naona kuti imwe ndimwe muneneli.
JHN 4:20	Makolo batu banalambila pa luphiri apa, koma imwe mukamba ati ku Yerusalemu ndiye kumalo kwamene bantu bafunika kulambilila."
JHN 4:21	Yesu anamuuza kuti, "nikulupilile ine, muzimayi, ntawi ibwela yamene simuzalambila Tate pa phili apa, kapena mu Yerusalemu.
JHN 4:22	Imwe  mulambila chamena simuziba. Ife  tilambila chamene tiziba, chifukwa chipulumuso chichokela kwa Ayuda.
JHN 4:23	Koma, ntawi ibwela ndipo ntawi yafika, yamene bolambila ba zoona bazalambila batate mu muzimu na mu choonadi; chifukwa Batate basakila banthu basochabe kuti bankale womulambila.
JHN 4:24	Mulungu ni Muzimu, ndipo bonse bolambila bafunika kulambila Ambuye mu muzimu na muchoonadi.
JHN 4:25	Muzimayi anakamba kuli eve kuti "niziba kuti  Mesiya abwela,   (wamene aitaniwa Kristu). Akabwela azatipunzisa zintu zonse."
JHN 4:26	Yesu anamuuza kuti, "ndine wamene, wamene akamba naiwe."
JHN 4:27	Pa ntawi yamene ija, wopunzila bake banabwelela.  Manje  banadabwa kupeza Yesu akamba namuzimayi, koma kulibe anakamba kuti, "nichani chamene ufuna?" kapena kuti "nanga nichani ukamba nauyu muzimayi?"
JHN 4:28	Ndipo uyu muzimayi anasiya poto yake yamanzi nakubwelela ku komboni noyenda kuuza bantu kuti,
JHN 4:29	"Bwelani, muone mwamuna wamene aniuza zonse zamene ninachita. Uyu sangankhale Kristu, angankhale?"
JHN 4:30	Banachokamo mu komboni nakuyenda kwa eve.
JHN 4:31	Pantawi yamene ija, bopunzila bake benze kumulimbikisa kuti, "Mupunzisi, dyani."
JHN 4:32	Anabayanka kuti, "ine nili nachakudwa chamene inu bonse simuziba olo pang'ono."
JHN 4:33	Bopunzila nawo bayamba kufunsana, "kulibe wamene amubwelesela chilichonse chakudwa,  nanga bamuletela?"
JHN 4:34	Yesu abauza  kuti "chakudya changa nikuchita chifunilo cha eve wamene ananituma na kusiliza nchito yake.
JHN 4:35	Kodi simumakamba kuti 'kwasala chabe myezi 4 kuti kukolola kuchitike?' Nikuuzani kuti nyamulani manso yanu nakuona  minda, chifukwa  minda yakonzekela ku kolola naku bweza va mu minda.
JHN 4:36	Uyo wamena akolola amalandila malipilo yake, ndipo akututa mbeu ku moyo osasila, kuti ofesa na okolola akondwelee pamozi.
JHN 4:37	Ndipo ichi chikamba kuti, 'wina afesa, wina akolola,' nicha zoona.
JHN 4:38	Ine nakutumani kuti mukolole  minda yamene simunalime. Benangu banasebenza, imwe mwangena chabe munchito yamene banzanu banasebenza kudala.
JHN 4:39	Ba Samariya bambili mu muzinda uja banayamba kumukulupilila Yesu chifukwa cha umboni wamene enzekupasa muzimayi uja, kuti, "ananiuza vonse vamene ninachita."
JHN 4:40	Pamene ba Samaliya banabwela kwa iye banamupempa kuti ayambe kunkala nabo, naye anankala nabo masiku yabili.
JHN 4:41	Na bambili banakulupilila chifukwa cha mau yake.
JHN 4:42	Banamuuza muzimayi kuti, "sitinakhulupilile futi chifukwa cha mau yamene watiuza,  takhulupilila chifukwa cha mau yamene tazinvelea na mutu watu, ndipo taziba kuti uyu ni mupulumusi wa ziko lonse."
JHN 4:43	Patapita masiku yabili, anachokako kuja nakuyenda ku Galileya.
JHN 4:44	Chifukwa Yesu wamene anakamba kuti muneneli sibamamupasa ulemu mu ziko yake.
JHN 4:45	Pamene anangena mu Galileya, banthu bamu Galileya banamulandila bwino. Benze banaona zonse zamena anachita kuja ku Pwando inankhalila ku Yerusalemu, chifukwa aba banthu nabo benzeko ku Pwando yameni iyi.
JHN 4:46	Anabwelelanso  ku Kana ku muzinda wa Galileya, kwamene anasandusa manzi vinyo. Ndipo kunali mukulu wina wa ufumu, mwana wake anali odwala ku Kapernaumu.
JHN 4:47	Pamene ananvela kuti Yesu  achokako ku Yudeya nakubwela ku Galileya, anayenda kwa Yesu nakumupempha kuti abwele achilise uja mwana enze pafuti na kufa.
JHN 4:48	Yesu anabauza kuti, "imwe ngati simunaone vizindikilo na vodabwisa, simuzakulupilila."
JHN 4:49	Mukulu uyu anamuuza kuti, "Ambuye imwe, bwelani kuno mwamusanga mwana wanga akalibe kufa!"
JHN 4:50	Yesu anamuyankha kuti, "Yenda. Mwana wako ali namoyo." Mwamuna uyu anakulupilila zamene anakamba Yesu nakuyenda anayenda.
JHN 4:51	Akali kuyenda, ba nchito bake banakumana naye pa njila nakumuuza kuti mwana wako ali namoyo.
JHN 4:52	Ndipo anabafunsa ntawi yamene mwana anachilisidwa, nabo banamuyanka kuti "anachilisidwa mailo na ntawi ya wanu koloko ya muzuba."
JHN 4:53	Ndipo tate wamwana anazindikila kuti iyo nthawi yenze pamene Yesu anamuuza kuti "mwana wako ali namoyo." Iye na banja yake yonse  inakhulupilila mwa Yesu.
JHN 4:54	Ichi ndiye chizindikilo chachibili anachita  Yesu  paneme anachoka ku Yudeya no yenda ku Galileya.
JHN 5:0	Mutu 5
JHN 5:1	Pamene vinasila ivi penzeli chikondwelero  cha Ayuda; ndipo Yesu anayenda ku Yelusalemu.
JHN 5:2	Manje mu Yelusalemu pa geti ya mberere, mwenzeli mugodi wa manzi mu chiyebele benzo kaita ati Betesida, yenzeli namakholido yanamutenje yali faivi.
JHN 5:3	Mwamene umu munagona banthu bambili odwala, balibe menso, olemala nabozizila mendo kuyembekezela manzi yavundulike.
JHN 5:4	Mungelo wa Mulungu  enzopitako nthawi zinangu kukavundula manzi, ndipo wamene angenamo pa festi manzi yakali yobvundulika enzo pola matenda yaliyonse yamene anali nayo.
JHN 5:5	Mudala winangu enzeli wodwala kwa zaka 38.
JHN 5:6	Pamene Yesu anamuwona kuti aligone,  nobwela kuzindikila ati anankhalapo nthawi itali, anabwela amufunsa ati, ufuna kuti upolesewe?
JHN 5:7	Mudala uja odwala anabwela ayankha ati, "Ambuye, nilibe munthu oningenesa mu mugodi ngati manzi yavundulika. Nikafuna kungenamo, winangu abwela angenamo."
JHN 5:8	Yesu anabwela akamba ati "Nyamuka, tenga mphasa yako, yenda."
JHN 5:9	Pamene apo mudala uja anapola notenga mphasa yake, noyenda. Manje ija siku penzeli pa Sabbatha
JHN 5:10	So baYuda anabwela akamba namudala wamene anapola ati, "Lelo nipa Sabbatha, sufunika kunyamula mphasa yako."
JHN 5:11	Anabwela ayankha ati, "Uja wamene wanipolesa waniuza kuti, 'Tenga mphasa yako yenda."
JHN 5:12	Banabwela bamufusa ati, "Nindani mudala wamene akuuza kuti, 'Tenga mphasa yako, yenda?"
JHN 5:13	Koma uja mudala anapolesewa sanamuzibe kuti nindani cifukwa Yesu anayenda yanoziba aliyense, cifukwa penzeli banthu bambili.
JHN 5:14	Pamene vinasila ivi, Yesu anamupeza yeve mu Tempele nobwela kumuuza ati, "Ona, wapola manje! Usakacimwe futi, kuti coyipa cocila apo cisakacitike kuli iwe."
JHN 5:15	Mudala uja anayenda ndipo anauza baYuda kuti niYesu wamene anamucilisa.
JHN 5:16	Manje cifukwa ca ivi vinthu baYuda banamusausa Yesu, cifukwa cakuti anacita ivi vinthu pa Sabbatha.
JHN 5:17	Yesu anabwela abayankha ati, "baTate banga akali kusebenza namanje so, naine nisebenza manje so."
JHN 5:18	Cifukwa caici, baYuda anafunisisa kumupaya cifukwacakuti sanapwanye cabe siku la sabatha, koma anaitana Mulungu kunkhala Atate bake eve, nozipanga eve kulingana na Mulungu.
JHN 5:19	Yesu anabwela ayankha ati, "Nikuuzani coonadi kuti mwana Mwamuna sangacite vinthu payeve yeka, koma vamene awona baTate bake kucita, vonse vamene baTate acita, mwana mwamuna naive avicita.
JHN 5:20	BaTate akonda mwana Mwamuna nakuti bamuwonesa vonse vamene bacita, nakuti bazamuwonesa vinthu vikulu maningi kucila apa ndipo muzadabwa.
JHN 5:21	Monga baTate bausha ba kufa nobapasa moyo, namwana Mwamuna apasa moyo kuli aliyense yeve afuna.
JHN 5:22	BaTate sibaweluza aliyense, koma apasa mwana Mwamuna kuweluza konse
JHN 5:23	kuti bonse balemekeze mwana Mwamuna mwamene alemekezela baTate. Wamene salemekeza mwana Mwamuna salemekeza baTate wake bamene anamutuma
JHN 5:24	Kukamba zoonadi, yeve amene anvela mau anga nakukhulupira wamene ananituma anaumoyo wosasila ndipo kulibe ciweluzo, koma wacoka ku imfa wabwela ku moyo
JHN 5:25	Kukamba zoona, nthawi ibwela, ndipo yabwela kudala, pamene bakufa bazanvela mau ya mwana Mwamuna wa Mulungu, ndipo amene azanvela azankhala na moyo.
JHN 5:26	Monga mwamene baTate banamoyo mulibeve, bapasako futi namwana Mwamuna kuti ankhale namoyo muliyeve,
JHN 5:27	nakuti baTate bapasa mwana Mwamuna ulamulilo kuti angapeleke ciweluzo cifukwa nimwana Mwamuna wa munthu.
JHN 5:28	Osadabwa naici, ibwela nthawi pamene bonse bali mumanda wazanvela mau yake,
JHN 5:29	ndipo bazacoka: baja bamene bacita bwino kukauka kwa moyo, baja bamene bacita zooipa kukauka ku ciwereluziro.
JHN 5:30	Siningacite ciliconse paine neka. Pazamene nivela, niweluza, ndipo ciweluzo canga nicolungama cifukwa sinicita mwamene nifunila ine koma nicita kulinga mwamene ananitumila.
JHN 5:31	Ngati nizakamba zaine neka, umboni wanga suzankhala wa zoona.
JHN 5:32	Koma kuli winangu amene apereka umboni wanga, ndipo niziba kuti umboni wamene apereka pali ine niwazoona.
JHN 5:33	Imwe munatuma kwa Yohane, ndipo wapereka umboni wa zoona.
JHN 5:34	Koma umboni wamene ndilandila siwucokela kumunthu. Nikamba vonse ivi kuti mupulumuke.
JHN 5:35	Yohane anali nyali yoyaka nayowala ndipo imwe munafuna kuti mukodwela mukuwala kwake panthawi ing'ono cabe.
JHN 5:36	Koma umboni wamene nili nabo upambana wa Yohane, pa zinchito zamene baTate bananipasa kuti nizikwanilise, zinchito zamene izi zamene nicita, zipeleka umboni kuti baTate bananituma ine.
JHN 5:37	BaTate bamene bananituma ine bevebeka bapelekela umboni pazaine. Simunaveleko mau yabo kapena kubona vamenene abonekela.
JHN 5:38	Mulibe namau yake yamene yankhala mwa imwe, cifukwa simukhulupilira muli iye wamene iye anatuma.
JHN 5:39	Musakila mau aMulungu cifukwa muganiza kuti muliyeve muli umoyo bosasila, ndipo mau yamene aya yapereka umboni pali ine,
JHN 5:40	ndipo simufuna kubwela kwa ine kuti mukhale nabo moyo
JHN 5:41	Sinilandila mayamiko kuchokela kubanthu,
JHN 5:42	koma niziba kuti mulibe cikondi ca Mulungu muli imwe.
JHN 5:43	Nabwela muzina la baTate banga, koma simunilandila. Koma winangu akabwela muzinalake mungamulandile.
JHN 5:44	Mungakhulupilile bwanji, imwe amene mulandila mayamiko kubanzanu koma simufuna kulandila mayimiko kuchokela kuli Mulungu aliyeka.
JHN 5:45	Musanganize kuti ine nizakunenelani kuli baTate. Wamene akunenelani ni Mose, wamene mukhulupilira.
JHN 5:46	Ngati mukhulupilira Mose, mungakhulipilire naine cifukwa Mose analemba zaine.
JHN 5:47	Ngati simukhulupilira vamene analembe, mungakhulupilire bwanji mu mau yanga?"
JHN 6:0	Mutu 6
JHN 6:1	Pathapita izi, Yesu anayenda kusidya kwa chimana ca Galileya, chochedwanso chimana ca Tibeliya.
JHN 6:2	Gulu likulu la Anthu linamusata iye chifukwa linaona vodabwisa vimene anachita pa wodwala.
JHN 6:3	Yeso anakwela ku lupili nakhala pansi ndi wophunzila ake.
JHN 6:4	( Tsopano pwando, la Yuda ya pasaka, inali pafupi.)
JHN 6:5	Yeso anakweza maso naona gulu likulu la anthu ilikubwela kwa iye, ndipo anati kwa Filipo, "Tizagula kuti buledi kuti tidyese Anthu awa?"
JHN 6:6	(Koma Yesu anafunsa Filipo kumuyesa chabe, Chifukwa iye anaziwa camene ayenera kucita.)
JHN 6:7	Filipo anamuyankha nati, " Ngakale makobili miyanda iwili  (200)  kugula buledi singakwanila aliyense kuti adye ngakale kang'ono chabe.
JHN 6:8	M'modzi wa uphunzila ake, Andeleya mbale wa Simoni Petulo anati kuli Yesu,
JHN 6:9	"Alipo pano mnyamata aliko na buledi faive na nsomba ziwili, koma izi kulinganiza ndi anthu zingathandize?"
JHN 6:10	Yesu anati, " Awuzeni anthu ankhale pansi." ( Panali uzu wambiri pamalo  paja) Amuna amene anakhala pansi enzopitilila pa faive sauzande, (5,000).
JHN 6:11	Yesu anathenga buledi atayamika anawapasa waja  anankhala pansi Anachitanso chimodzi mozi ndi nsomba, anadya mwakufuna kwawo.
JHN 6:12	Pamene banakhuta wonse iye anati kwa ophunzila ake, Tengani vasalapo kuti visaonongeke."
JHN 6:13	Conco iwo anasonkhanisa vesiyapo vakudya mabasiketi ya buledi twelufu kuchokela kuli faivi buledi yamene banadya.
JHN 6:14	Anthu pamene anaona chizindikilo chamene anacita anati, "Zoonadi munthu uyu ndi mneneli  uyo amene akuza pa ziko lapansi."
JHN 6:15	Pamene Yeso anazindikila kuti afuna kumufaka pa ufumu, mwachikakamizo anachokapo nokwela ku lupili kwa yekha.
JHN 6:16	Pamene kwenzofipa  mazulo, ophunzila ake anayenda  ku chiimana.
JHN 6:17	Anakwela muboti noyambapo kuyenda kutauka chimana ku Kapenaumu. Kwenze  kunafipa panthawi iyo,  koma Yesu enze akalibe  kubwela kuli beve.
JHN 6:18	Kwenze kunayamba chimphepho cikulu pa chimana nipo cinayofya.
JHN 6:19	Atayenda makilomita faivi kano sikisi, anamuona Yesu alikuyenda pa chimana alikubwela kufupi na boti, ophunzila anachita mantha.
JHN 6:20	Koma Yesu anabauza, " Musachite mantha! ndine!"
JHN 6:21	Analola kumlandila mu boti, nthawi yomweyo boti inafika ku sidya uko kwamene benzoyenda.
JHN 6:22	Siku yokonkhapo, gulu likulu la anthu limene linali kuyembekeza kusidya  kwina kwa chimana, anaona kuti kunalibe boti iliyonse koma cabe  yamene ija  Yesu sanangenemo na ophunzila ake, koma kuti ophunzila anayenda woka.
JHN 6:23	Ndipo maboti yena yochokela ku Tibeliya anafika pafupi na pamalo  pamene anadyela buledi ija ambuye anayamika.
JHN 6:24	Pamene gulu la anthu linazindikila kuti Yesu na ophunzila wake sanalipo pamalo paja, anazitengela woka ma boti  noyenda ku kapenaumu kukamufuna-funa Yesu.
JHN 6:25	Pecimupeze kusidya ina ya chimana, anumufunsa kuti, "Rabbi munafika  nthawi yanji kuno?
JHN 6:26	Yesu anayankha nati, "Zoonadi ndithu inu munifuna-funa kosati kuti munaona zizindikilo zodabwisa yai koma cikukwa munadya nokutha buledi.
JHN 6:27	Katani nchito, kosati chifukwa cha vakudya voonongeka koma pavakudya vamene suvuonongeka mphaka kumoyo wosasila, vamene mwana wa Munthu azakupasani. Chifukwa Mulungu atate anasindikizya ndi chizindikilo chomuvomeleza."
JHN 6:28	Ndipo anamufunsa iye nati, "Ticite chani kuti, tichite nchito ya Mulungu?
JHN 6:29	Yesu anayankha nati, "Nchito ya Mulungu  ndi iyi; Khukulupilila muli yeve amene anatumiwa.
JHN 6:30	Ndipo anamufunsa kuti, " kodi nga chizindikilo chodabwisa camene muzatipasa nicha bwanji kuti ife tikukhukulupilileni? Muchitepo ca bwanji?
JHN 6:31	Makolo athu anadya manna m' chipululu, monga analembela malembo, " kuti anapasidwa buledi kucokela kumwamba kuti adye."
JHN 6:32	Yesu anayankha nati, "Zoonadi,  senze Mose enze ekupasani  buledi yofumila kumwamba koma ndi atate wanga wamene okupasani buledi yeni-yeni yochokela ku mwamba.
JHN 6:33	Buledi ya Mulungu  ndiye yocokela kumwamba, nopasa moyo ku chalo cha pansi."
JHN 6:34	Nawo anamufunsa nati, "Ambuye, tipaseni buledi nthawi zyonse."
JHN 6:35	Yesu anayankha nati, " Ine ndine Buledi wa moyo; aliyense azabwela kwaine sazamvela  njala soti, nauyo ati anikhulupilire sazamvela  njonta soti.
JHN 6:36	Koma ndakuuzani kale, mwaniona koma simundikhulupilila.
JHN 6:37	Aliwonse amene atate azanipasa azabwela kwa ine, nauyo wamene azabwela kwaine sindizamutaya konse.
JHN 6:38	Chifukwa ndinaza ine kuchokela ku mwamba, kosati kuzocita chifunilo canga koma caiye amene ananituma ine.
JHN 6:39	Ici niye chifunilo cauyo enituma cakuti nisataye ngakale umodzi wa iwo amene anandipasa iye, koma kuti nikawause pa siku yomaliza.
JHN 6:40	ici ndiye chifunilo cha Atate, kuti aliyense waona Mwana nomukhulupirila ankhale ndi moyo wosata, ndipo ndizamuusa kwa akufa pa siku lomaliza.
JHN 6:41	Pamenepo Ayuda anayamba kung'ung'uzila chifukwa anati, " Ine ndine buledi wocokela ku mwamba."
JHN 6:42	Anati, " Si Yesu uyu mwana wa Yosefe, Mayi ake ndi Abambo wake timawaziba? bwanji akamba ati, ine ndinachokela ku mwamba'?"
JHN 6:43	Yesu anayankha anati, "musang'ug'uze mweka-mweka.
JHN 6:44	palibe munthu angabwele kwa ine ngati Atate anandituma sanamubwelese kwanga, ndipo ndizamuusa  kwakufa pa siku yomaliza.
JHN 6:45	Zinalembedwa ndi aneneli, 'wonse azaphunzisidwa ndi Mulungu' Aliwonse amene amamva ndi kuphunzira kwa Atate amabwela kwa ine.
JHN 6:46	Palibe amene anamuonapo Atate, kuchoselako chabe uyo anachokela kwa Mulungu yekhayo ndiye anaona Atate.
JHN 6:47	Zoonadi yense amene akhulupirila alinawo moyo wosatha.
JHN 6:48	Ine ndine buledi wa moyo.
JHN 6:49	makolo anu anadya mana mchipululu, ndipo  anafa.
JHN 6:50	Buledi yamene unachokekela kumwamba, kuti munthu aliyense akadyako sazafa.
JHN 6:51	Ndine buledi wa moyo wamene inachokele ku mwamba. Ngati wina wadyako buledi iyi azakhala na moyo nthawi zonse. Buledi yamene nikupasani ni thupi yanga kuti anthu pa dziko lapansi akhale ndi moyo."
JHN 6:52	Ayuda anaphya mtima noyamba kutsutsana kwambili pakati pawo kuti, "Uyu munthu angatipase bwanji thupi yake kuti tidye?"
JHN 6:53	Yesu anayankha nati, "Zoonadi ndikuuzani ine ngati simukudya thupi la Mwana wa Munthu ndi kumwa mlopa wake simuzankhala na moyo mwaimwe.
JHN 6:54	Aliwonse azadya thupi yanga nakumwa magazi yanga, azankhala na moyo wosatha, ndipo ndizamuusha pa siku yosiliza.
JHN 6:55	Pakuti thupi langa ndi chakudya cheni-cheni ndi magazi yanga ndi Chakumwa cheni-cheni.
JHN 6:56	Iye amene azadya thupi langa ndi kumwa magazi yanga azankhala mwa ine ndi ine mwa iye.
JHN 6:57	Monga Atate wa moyo ananituma, ndipo ndili ndi moyo chifukwa cake aliyense amene azadya ine azakhalanso ndi moyo chifukwa ca ine.
JHN 6:58	Iyi ndiye buledi yamene yochokela ku mwamba, osati ija yamene anadya makolo yathu nakufa. Iye amene azadya buledi iyi azakhala ndi moyo wosatha."
JHN 6:59	Yesu analankhula zinthu izi pamene anali kuphunzitsa musunagoge mu kapanawo.
JHN 6:60	Ambiri  ophunzila bake pamene anamvwa izi  anati, " Ici ndichiphunzitso chovuta ni ndani angacivomele?"
JHN 6:61	Yesu, pozindikila mwaiye yeka kuti ophunzila bake alikung'ung'unzila,  anawafunsa nati, " ivi vakukalipisani?"
JHN 6:62	Manje nanga mukazaona Mwana wa Munthu akukwela kumene anachokela!
JHN 6:63	Mzimu  apasa moyo, thupi siipindulapo kanthu. Mau amene nakamba namwe ni mzimu ndipo ndi amoyo.
JHN 6:64	Alipo ena aimwe amene simukhulupilila, "Yesu anazindikila kuyambila pachiyambi amene samkhulupirila ndi amene azamugulisa.
JHN 6:65	Iye anati, "Ndichifukwa chake ndinakuuzani kuti palibe amene azabwela kwa ine pokhapo Atate andipasa iye kwa ine.

JHN 10:1	Indetu indetu ndinena kwainu wamene sangenela pa kageti koma angena chokwela pamwamba pa yakhola nikawalala kapena wachifwamba.

JHN 10:3	Osunga khomo amusegulila eve. Nkhosa zimvela mau ake ndipo mubusa aitana nkhosa zake na mazina yake.
JHN 10:4	pamene wachosa nkhosa,azisogolela komanso zimulondola chifukwa zimvela mau ake.
JHN 10:5	nkhosa sizilondola mulendo koma zimuthaba,chifukwa ziziba mau ya mulendo.
JHN 10:6	Yesu anabauza Nthano iyi koma sanamvesese zinthu zamene analikulankhula kuli beve.
JHN 10:7	Yesu anati kwa iwo indetu indetu ndinena kwa inu,ine ndiye khomo lankhosa.
JHN 10:8	Aliyense wamene abwela pambuyo panga nikawalala ndipo nkhosa sizinamvele mau ache.
JHN 10:9	Ine ndine khomo,aliyense amane alobela pali ine azapulumusidwa,azalowa nakutuluka ndipo azapeza musipu.
JHN 10:10	Kawalala amabwela na lingo ya kuba,kupha ndikuononga.ine ninabwela kuti akhale nao umoyo wochuluka.
JHN 10:11	Ine nine mubusa wabwino,ndipo mubusa wabwino apeleka umoyo wake  ku nkhosa zake.
JHN 10:12	Kapolo olembedwa ntchito sakhala mubusa chifukwa alibe Nkhosa.akaona mimbulu ibwela amasiya nkhosa zake nakuthaba.ndipo mimbulu imatenga nkhosa nakuzimwazya.
JHN 10:13	Iye amathawa chifukwa nikapolo wamene analembedwa chabe ntchito ndipo sasamalila Nkhosa.
JHN 10:14	Ine  ndine mubusa wabwino,niziba nkhosa na nkhosa ziniziba.
JHN 10:15	Atate aniziba nainenso niziba atate chifukwa nipeleka umoyo wanga monga nsembe ku nkhosa zanga.
JHN 10:16	Nilinazo nkhosa zinangu zamene sizichokela mukhola iyi.Nizazibwelesa mukhola kuti zinkhale pamozi,zizmvela mau aga ndipo zizakhala zimozi na mubusa umozi.
JHN 10:17	Ichi ndiye chifukwa chake atate banga banikonda chifukwa nimapeleka umoyo wanga nakuutenga futi.
JHN 10:18	Kulibe wamene atenga umoyo wanga koma ine neka niupeleka kunkhosa.Nilinawo ulamulilo wopeleka umoyo wanga komanso nikuutenga.Iyi nilamulo yamene ninalandila kuchokela kwa atate.
JHN 10:19	Mukangano unauka pakati pao pamene amvela mau aya.
JHN 10:20	Bambili anayamba kuti uyu alina dimoni komanso niwofuntha.Kodi nichiani mumumvelela?
JHN 10:21	Bena banakamba kuti aya siyangankhale mau ya Dimoni.Kodi Dimoni Ingakwanise kusegula menso ya munth wakhungu?
JHN 10:22	Ndipo iyi inali nthawi ya madyelelo yo peleka kachisi,
JHN 10:23	Inali nthawi ya mphepo ndipo Yesu anali kuyenda yenda mu Tempele ya solomo.
JHN 10:24	Ndipo Ayuda anamuzungulila nakuyamba kumufunsa kuti"kodi nichani tiuziletu poyera kuti tikhulupilile,Kodi ndiwe Mesiya?
JHN 10:25	Yesu anabayankha,Namuuzani koma simukhulupirla.Zintchito zamene nichita muzina la atate zinichitila umboni ine.
JHN 10:26	Koma simukhulupilila chifukwa sinimwe nkhosa zanga.
JHN 10:27	Nkhosa zanga zimvela mau anga ndipo niziziba elo zimanilondola.
JHN 10:28	Nimazipasa umoyo wosatha ndipo sizizafa ndipo kulibe azazichosa kuli ine.
JHN 10:29	Atate amene ananipasa nkhosa izi nimukulu kuchila onse ndipo kulibe wamene angazichoseko kuli Atate.
JHN 10:30	Ine ndi Atate ndise bamozi
JHN 10:31	Ndipo Ayuda anatenga myala kuti amteme yeve.
JHN 10:32	Yesu anati Nakuonesani nchito zambiri kuchokela kuli Atate,mufuna muniteme myala panchito ziti?
JHN 10:33	Ayuda anati sitizakutema myala patchito zabwino zamene wachita koma pa kunyozela mulungu pamene wazipanga kunkhala mulungu.
JHN 10:34	Yesu anabayankha,sichinalembedwa kuti "Ninanena kwainu kuti ndinu milungu,ana a Mulungu waphamvu zonse.
JHN 10:35	Ngati anabaitana milungu  kwamene mau yanabwelela( ndipo malembo siyangapwanyike.)
JHN 10:36	Kodi mukamba bwanji kuli wamene Mulungu anatuma kubwela muziko kuti"Unyozela Mulungu"Kamba kakuti namuuzani kuti ndine mwana wa Mulungu.
JHN 10:37	Ngati sinichita ncthito ya Atate musanikhulupilile,
JHN 10:38	koma ngati nichita ntchito za Mulungu olo kuti simukhulupilila ine,khulupilililani munctito kuti muzindikile naku mvesesa kuti Atate alimwaine ndipo ine nilimuliyeve.
JHN 10:39	Anayesa kuti amuchite chifwamba koma anachoka mumanja yao.
JHN 10:40	Anapitanso kuja ku Yolodani kwamene Yohane anali kubatiza banthu ndipo anakhala kwamene kuja.
JHN 10:41	Bambili banabwela kuliyeve nakumuuza kuti Yohane sanachite miraculi iliyose,koma vilivonse vamene Yohane anakamba pali uyu munth nivazoona.
JHN 10:42	Bambili banamukhulupilila kwamene kuja.
JHN 11:0	MUTU 11
JHN 11:1	Koma panali munthu wodwala,Lazaro wa ku betaniya,wa m'muzinda wa Mariya ndi mbale wake  Marita.
JHN 11:2	koma ndi Mariya wamene anadzoza Mbuye ndi mafuta onunkhira bwino ndiponso anapokuta mendo yake na sisi zake,amene mbale wake Lazaro anali odwala.
JHN 11:3	Aba abale anaitana Yesu,nakukamba kuti, ''Mbuye,onani,iye wamene mukonda adwala."
JHN 11:4	pamene Yesu ana mvela izi,anakamba kuti,''ayamatenda siyo peleka ku infa,koma ni ku ulemelelo wa Mulungu kuti mwana wa Mulungu aka lemekezedwe pali ichi.
JHN 11:5	Koma Yesu anakonda Marita ndi Mariya na Lazaro.
JHN 11:6	pamene ana mvela kuti Lazaro ni odwala,Yesu anankhalako  masiku awili kumalo kwamene analili.
JHN 11:7	koma kuchokela apa,anakamba ku ophunzira bake,"Tiyeni tiyende ku Yudeya nafuti."
JHN 11:8	Aba ophunzila anakamba, "Aphunzisi,apa manje ayuda ayeselela kuku lasani myala,muyendako futi?"
JHN 11:9	Yesu anayanka,''kodi simuli ma awala kumi imozi ndi awiri mukuunika kwa siku?ngati wina wake aendela mu ntawi ya siku, siazazibuntula,chifukwa aona na nyali ya zikolino.
JHN 11:10	Koma,ngati munthu ayenda usiku,azazibuntula chifukwa nyali si ili muli iye."
JHN 11:11	Ndipo    anakamba  zinthu, kuchokela izi zinthu,Anakamba kuli bemve,"mubale watu Lazaro agona mutulo,koma niyenda kuti nikamuchoseko mutulo."
JHN 11:12	Bopunzhira bake bana kamba kuli Iye,"Mbuye,ngati agona mutulo,muzamuusha."
JHN 11:13	koma Yesu anakambapo pali iyi infa,koma anaganizila kuti akamba pakugona kopumula.
JHN 11:14	koma Yesu anabauza potuba, "Lazaro afa.
JHN 11:15	Ndipo ndine okondwela,kamba kaimwe,kuti sininalipo pakuti mukakulupilile.Tiyeni tiyende kwamene alili."
JHN 11:16	Thomasi anali kuitanidwa Didimasi,anakamba kuophunzira anzake,''Tiyeni naise tikafe ndi Yesu.''
JHN 11:17	Pamene Yesu anabwela,anapeza kuti Lazaro anaikidwa mu manda anankalamo ndi masiku anai.
JHN 11:18	Koma Betaniya inali pafupi ndi yerusalemu,panali muyeselo kumi ndi asanu katalamukila.
JHN 11:19	Ayuda ambiri anabwela kuli Mariya ndi Malita, anabwela kuatontoza paza mubale wao.
JHN 11:20	koma Malita,pamene anamvela kuti Yesu alikubwela,anaenda kuka mukumanya,koma Mariya analinkhezi mu nyumba.
JHN 11:21	Marita ananena kuli Yesu,"Mbuye, asembe mwenzepo, mubale wanga sembe  sianafe.
JHN 11:22	Angankhale manje,niziba kuti chilichonse chamene ungapempe kwa Mulungu, azakupasa."
JHN 11:23	Yesu anamuyanka kuti, mubale wako azaukafuti."
JHN 11:24	Marita ananena ndi iye, ''Niziba kuti azauka nso pakuuka kosirizira."
JHN 11:25	Yesu ananena kuli iye, "Ndine kuuka ndiponso ndine umoyo; iye wamene akululupila muli ine, angankale kuti afe, azankala ndi moyo;
JHN 11:26	Ndiponso alionse alina moyo ndi kukulupilila ine siazafa.kodi ukulupilila ichi?"
JHN 11:27	Ananena ndi iye, "Inde, Ambuye, nikulupilila kuti ndi mwe kristhu, mwana wa Mulungu, wamene alikubwela muno muziko."
JHN 11:28	pamene anakamba izi, anaenda kuitana mubale wake Mariya pambali, ndi kunena, "kuti aphunzisi akuitana iwe."
JHN 11:29	pamene anamvela izi anaenda kamusana kuli iye.
JHN 11:30	Koma Yesu siana bwele pamene apo mumuzinda koma anali kumalo ena kwamene Marita anamukumanya.
JHN 11:31	Ndi iwo ayuda,amene anali ndi emve mu nyumba anali kumutontoza,anaona  Maria kunyamuka kwamusanga kuchoka panja,ndi kumukonka, ndi kuganizila kuti analikuyenda ku manda kuyenda kulila.
JHN 11:32	Ndiponso Mariya pamene anafika pamene Yesu anali ndi kumuona, anagwela pamapazi yake nikunena kuti, "Mbuye,asembe mwenze pano, mubale wanga sembe sianafe."
JHN 11:33	Pamene Yesu anamuona kulila, ndi ayuda ameneana bwela kuli iye ndi iwonso analikulila, chinamukata kumutima ndi kumuvuta;
JHN 11:34	Ananena, ''kuti mwamu goneka kuti?"   Anakamba kuli iye, "Ambuye, bwelani muone."
JHN 11:35	Yesu analila.
JHN 11:36	Koma ayuda anane, "Onani mwamene anali kumukondela Lazaro!"
JHN 11:37	koma benabake ananena,kodi ngati uyu munthu anaseguliwa menso aleka bwanji kuti uyu munthu afe?''
JHN 11:38	Ndiponso Yesu, popezeka okumudwisiwa mwa iye eka, anaenda ku manda.koma kunali chimugodi, ndiponso kuna fakiwa mwala.
JHN 11:39	Yesu ananena, "chosaniko mwala." Marita, mubale wa Lazaro, wamene anafa, ananena kuli Yesu , "Mbuye, zino ntawi natupi yayamba kuola, ankala okufa masiku anai."
JHN 11:40	Yesu ananena kuli iye, "kodi sininakambe kuli iwe kuti, Ngati mwakulupilila muzaona ulemelelo wa mulungu?''
JHN 11:41	Koma anachosako mwala.Yesu ananyamula menso yake ndi kunene kuti, "Atate, nikuyamikani popezakuti mumani mvela ine.
JHN 11:42	Ninaziba kuti mumani mvela lyonse, koma ni chifukwa chagulu yamene yaimilila ndikuzinguluka ndi kukamba kuti ninanena izi, pakuti akulupilile kuti munanituma.''
JHN 11:43	Pochoka kukamba izi, analila ni liwu lapamwamba, "Lazaro, choka!"
JHN 11:44	Ndi  munthu okufa anachoka; mapazi yake ndi manja zinali zomangidwa na nyula, ndi pamanso pake panamangiwa na nyula.Yesu ananena kuli bemve, "  Mumangusuleni na kumusiya aende."
JHN 11:45	Ndiponso ayuda ambiri amene anabwele kuona Mariya ndi zamene Yesu anachita, Ana mukulupilila;
JHN 11:46	koma benangu bana enda kuona afarisi ndiponso anabauza zinthu zamane Yesu anachita.
JHN 11:47	Ndiponso akulu ansembe ndi afarisi anaita kabungwe pamodzi ndi kunena," kodi tingachite bwanji? Uyu muntu achita zodabwisa zambiri,
JHN 11:48	Ngati tamusiilila chabe eka, onse azakulupilila muli iye; Aroma azabwela  pamodzi ndi kutenga  malo yatu ndi zikolatu."
JHN 11:49	Koma umozi palibemve, kefasi,wamene anali mukulu wansembe chija chaka,ananena kulibemve   "Simuziba chilichonse.
JHN 11:50	simuganiza kuti ni chabwino munthu umodzi kufela banthu bonse pakuti ziko lonse lisaonongeke."
JHN 11:51	Koma ichi, sianakambe kuchokela kwa iye eka.koma, kunkala mukulu wa nsembe chaka chija, Anapeleka uneneli kuti Yesu azafela ziko;
JHN 11:52	osati zikochabe leka, Ndiponso kuti bana onse a Mulungu amene anasalangana akabwerere pamodzi mu umozi.
JHN 11:53	pakuti kuchokela lamene lija siku banapangana mwamene anga mupayile Yesu.
JHN 11:54	Kuchokela apo Yesu sianaendelepo potuba ku Ayuda, koma anaenda kuchokakuja muziko inali pafupi na chipululu mumuzinda oitanidwa Efuremu.Kuja anankala ndi ophunzila bake.
JHN 11:55	Koma pasakha ya Ayuda, inali pafupi, Ndiponso ambiri anaenda mu yerusalemu kuchoka mu ziko bakalibe kuenda ku pasakha kuti akaziyelese iwo oka.
JHN 11:56	Analikusakila Yesu,ndi kukambisana iwo oka pamene anaimilila mutempele," kodi muganiza chani? Kuti siazabwela ku phwando?"
JHN 11:57	Koma mukulu wa nsembe ndi afarisi anapasa ndandanda kuti ngati alionse anaziba kwamene Yesu anali, afunika akambe pakuti amugwire iye.
JHN 12:0	Mutu 12
JHN 12:1	Masiku asanu na imozi pamene pasaka sinafike, Yesu anabwela ku Betani, kwamene Lazalo analili, wamene Yesu anaukisa ku bakufa.
JHN 12:2	Kwamene kuja banamu konzela chakudya cha usiku, Malita anali kugabanisa chakudya, koma Lazalo anali pamozi nabaja bamene banankala pa malo yodyelapo pamozi na Yesu.
JHN 12:3	Chinakonkapo kuti Maria anatenga ka gubu ka mafuta onunkila yopangiwa na Nalidi yotuba ya mutengo wapatali, naku zoleka mendo ya Yesu, naku yapuputa mendo na sisi zake. Nyumba yonse inazula na kununkila kwa yaja mafuta.
JHN 12:4	Yudas Iskarioti, umozi mwa bopunzila wa Yesu, wamene anamugulisa Yesu, anakamba kuti,
JHN 12:5	"Nanga nichani aya mafuta siyanagulisiwe ndalama zokwanila fili hundredi denarii naku pasa bosauka?"
JHN 12:6	Koma ichi anakamba eve, osati chifukwa asamalira bosauka, koma chifukwa anali kawalala. Ndiye wamene anali na kasaka kosungilamo ndalama ndiponso anali kuba ndalama zamene zinali kuikiwamo muja.
JHN 12:7	Yesu anakamba kuti, "Mulekeni asunge vamene ali navo kufikila siku yoni ika mumanda ine.
JHN 12:8	Bosauka muzankala nabo ntawi zonse pakati panu. Koma ine simuzankala naine ntawi zonse."
JHN 12:9	Manje gulu ya ba Yudainaziba kuti Yesu analiko kumalo kuja, ndipo bana bwela, osati kukonka Yesu, koma kuona Lazalo, wamene Yesu anaukisa ku bakufa.
JHN 12:10	Bakulu ba nsembe banapangana kuti bamupaye Lazalo;
JHN 12:11	chifukwa chake nichakuti kamba ka eve bambili banachokako naku kulupilila mu Yesu.
JHN 12:12	Pa siku yokonkapo gulu ikulu inabwela ku pwando. Pamene bana mvela kuti Yesu azabwela ku Yelusalema,
JHN 12:13	banatenga matambi ya mitengo ya Palm naku yenda kukumana naye na ku punda kuti, "Hosanna!" Odala ni muntu wamene abwela mu zina ya Ambuye, mfumu ya Isirayeli.
JHN 12:14	"Yesu anapeza ka Kavalo kaka ngóno naku ka kwelapo; monga mwamene chinalembelewa kuti,
JHN 12:15	"Osayopa, mwana wa Ziyoni; ona, Mfumu yako ibwela, yankala pa chonkalapo chapa Kavalo."
JHN 12:16	Koma bopunzila bake sibanavimvesese ivi poyamba; koma pamene Yesu anakwezekewa, banakumbukila kuti ivi vintu vinalembewa kukamba pali eve ndiponso bana chita ivi vintu kumuchitila eve.
JHN 12:17	MAnje gulu yonse inapeleka umboni kuti banali naye pamene anaitana Lazalo kuchoka mumanda naku mu-ukisa kubakufa.
JHN 12:18	Nichifukwa cha ichi chamene gulu ina enda kumukumana eve, chifukwa banamvela kuti anachita chamene ichi.
JHN 12:19	Beve ba Falisi banakamba pakati pabo kuti, "Onani, kulibe chamene mungachite; onani, ziko yonse ya enda kumukonka eve."
JHN 12:20	Manje benangu ba chi Giliki banalipo pa gulu ya baja banali ku yenda ku pembeza ku pwando.
JHN 12:21	Aba bana enda kuli Filipo, wamene anachokela ku Betisaida  malo ya Galili, naku mufunsa,  kuti, "bambo, tifuna kuona Yesu."
JHN 12:22	Filipo ana enda ku-uza Andulu; Andulu ana enda na Filipi, naku mu uza Yesu.
JHN 12:23	Yesu ana bayanka beve nakukamba kuti, "Ntawi yafika kuti Mwana wa Muntu akwezewe.
JHN 12:24	Zo-ona, zo-ona, niku-uzani imwe, ngati mbeu ya tiligu sinagwele mu ntaka nakufa, izankala yeka; koma ngati yafa, iza bala zipaso zambili.
JHN 12:25	Eve wamene akonda umoyo wake azautaya; koma uja wamene auzonda moyo wake mu ziko ino azausungila umoyo wamene si usila.
JHN 12:26	Ngati muntu aliyense ani sebenzela, mulekeni anikonke; na kwamene nilili, na eve nikwamene azankala wanchito wanga. Ngati muntu aliyense anisebenzela, Atate bazamu kwezeka.
JHN 12:27	Manje umoyo wanga wavutika nanga nizakamba chani ine? 'Atate, nipulumuseni kunichosa kuntawi iyi?'Iyayi nichifukwa cha ivi chamene nabwelela muntawi iyi.
JHN 12:28	Atate, lemekezani zina yanu." Mau yanachoka ku mwamba kukamba kuti, "Na ilemekeza komanso nizailemekeza nafuti."
JHN 12:29	Pamene apo gulu yamene inaimilila pamozi na eve inamvela mau inamvela monga kuna gwedezeka. Benangu banakmba kuti, "Mungeli ndiye akamukambisa."
JHN 12:30	Yesu anakamba kuti, "Iyi liu si inakambe chifukwa changa ine, koma imwe.
JHN 12:31	Manje ni ntawi yachiweluzo cha ziko: Manje eve olamulila ziko ino azataiwa panja.
JHN 12:32	Pamene ine nikwezewa kuchoka pa ziko yapansi, niza donsa bonse kuli ine."
JHN 12:33	Ichi anakamba ku langiza njila ya imfa yamene eve aza mwalilila.
JHN 12:34	Gulu ina muyanka eve, "Tinamvela mu lamulo kuti Kristu azankala na umoyo osasila. Manje iwe ungakambe bwanji kuti, 'Mwana wa Muntu ayenela ku imisiwa mumwamba?' Nanga wamene uyu Mwana wa muntu nindani?"
JHN 12:35	Yesu anayanka kuti, "Ku unika kuzankala na imwe kwa ka ntawi ka kangóno. Endani pamene mukali na ku unika, mwakuti mfizi isaku pitilileni. Eve wamene aenda mu m'mfizi saziba kwamene aenda.
JHN 12:36	Pamene mukali na ku unika, kululupilani mu ku unika mwakuti munkale bana baku unika." Yesu anakamba ivi vintu naku chokapo kuyenda kubisama.
JHN 12:37	Ngankale kuti Yesu anachita volangiza vambili pamaso pabo, koma sibana kululupile muli eve
JHN 12:38	kufikiliza mau ya muneneli Yesaya, yamene anakamba kuti: "Ambuye, nanga nindani wamene anakululupila mau yatu, komanso nikuli uti kwamene kwanja ya Ambuye ina onesewa?"
JHN 12:39	Nichifukwa cha chamene ichi sibana kululupile, chifukwa Yesaya anakamba futi kuti,
JHN 12:40	"Anaba vala pamenso pabo, ndipo anaba kosesa mitima zabo; ndaba asembe banakwanisa kuona na menso yabo naku mvesesa na mitima zabo, naku tembenuka, ndipo asembe ninaba polesa.
JHN 12:41	Yesaya anakamba ivi vintu chifukwa anaona ulemelelo wa Yesu na kukamba pali eve.
JHN 12:42	Koma ngankale kuti vinali njila iyi, bambili basogoleri banakulupilila muli Yesu; koma chifukwa cha Afalisi, sibanali kuvomela kuyopa kuti bangaba pishe mu Synagogo.
JHN 12:43	Bana konda matamando yochoka kuli bantu kuchila matamando yochokela kuli Mulungu.
JHN 12:44	Yesu anapunda naku kamba kuti, "Wamene akulupilila muli ine, akulupilila osati muli ine chabe koma na muli wamene anani tuma ine,
JHN 12:45	ndiponso wamene aona ine aona wamene ananituma.
JHN 12:46	Ine ninabwela ngati nyali mu ziko, mwakuti eve wamene akulupilila muli ine asasale mu m'mfizi.
JHN 12:47	Ngati aliyense amvela maau yanga koma saya sunga, Sinimuweluza; chifukwa ine sininabwelele kuweluza ziko, koma kuipulumusa.
JHN 12:48	Eve wamene akana ine na uja wamene salandila mau yanga, ali naye wamene amu weluza. Mau yamene nakamba yazamu weluza pa siku yosiliza.
JHN 12:49	Chifukwa ine sinina kambe vanga paneka, koma ni Atate bamene banani tuma, bamene banani pasa lamulo ya vamene niyenela kukamba na vokambapo.
JHN 12:50	Niziba kuti lamulo yake ni moyo wamene susila, ichi nichamene nikamba-monga mwamene Atate banakambila kuli ine, nimwamene nikambil."
JHN 13:0	Mutu 13
JHN 13:1	Manje pamene ikalibe kufika Phwando ya Pasaka pamene Yesu anaziba kuti nthawi yake yakwana kucoka kuno kudziko kuyenda kwa Atate -mwamene anabakondela bake amene anali muziko -anabakonda kufikila kulasti.
JHN 13:2	Manje satana enze anaika kudala m'mtima wa Yudasi iskarioti mwana mwamuna wa Simoni, kuti apacike Yesu
JHN 13:3	Anaziba kuti ba Tate anamupasa zonse kwayeve mumanja mwake ndipo kuti anacokela kwa Mulungu ndiponso enzobwelela kwa Mulungu.
JHN 13:4	Ananyamuka penzo dyela ndipo anavula vovala vake vakunja. Pamene apo anatenga tawelo noimanga mumsana.
JHN 13:5	Pameneapo anatila manzi mu dishi noyamba kusambika mendo ya ophunzira nobapukuta na tawelo yamene enze anamanga mu msana mwake.
JHN 13:6	Anabwela kwa Simoni Petulo, ndipo Peturo anakamba ati kwa yeve, "Ambuye, nishi muzasambika mendo yanga?"
JHN 13:7	Yesu anamuyankha nokamba ati, "camene nicita suvesesa manje, koma uzavesesa pasogolo."
JHN 13:8	Petulo anakamba ati kwa eve, "Suzasambikako mendo yanga." Yesu anamuyankha ati, "Ngati sinizakusambika iwe, ulibe mbali naine."
JHN 13:9	Simoni Petulo anamuuza kuti, "Ambuye, musasambike mendo yanga cabe, komaso manja yanga ndi mutu wanga
JHN 13:10	Yesu anamuuza ati, Yeve wamene wasambikiwa alibe cofuna, koma cabe kusambika mendo yake, koma nibotubilatu, ndiwe otuba, koma sibonse."
JHN 13:11	(Cifukwa Yesu anaziba wamene azamupacika; nicifukwa cake anakamba ati, sibonse botuba.")
JHN 13:12	Ndipo pamene Yesu anabasambika mendo notenga vovala vake nonkhala pansi futi, nobwela ukamba ati kulibeve, bushe muziba vamene nakucitilani?
JHN 13:13	Muniitana kuti 'm'mphunzisi' ndi 'Ambuye' ndipo mukamba bwino, cifukwa ndiye mwamene nilili.
JHN 13:14	Manje ngati ine, Mbuye ndi M'mphunzisi, nasambika mendo yanu, mufunika naimwe kusambikana mendo mweka-mweka.
JHN 13:15	Cifukwa cakuti nakupasana cokopelako kuti mucite mwamene nacitila kwa imwe
JHN 13:16	Nikamba zoona, nikamba kwa imwe, wanchito sapambana bosi wake; kapena otumikila kupambana wamene amutuma.
JHN 13:17	Ngati muziba ivi vinthu, ndimwe odalisika ngati muvicita.
JHN 13:18	Sinikamba za imwe monse; niziba baja bamene ninasankha -koma ciliso kuti mau ya Mulungu yakwanilisike: 'yeve wamene akudya buledi yanga kanyamulidwa katende kake kasushana naine.'
JHN 13:19	Nikuuzani izi manje vikalibe kucitika kuti vikacitika, mungakhulupilile kuti NDINE INE.
JHN 13:20	Kukamba zoona, nikamba kuli imwe, yeve wamene alandila wamene natuma, alandila ine, ndipo yeve wamene walandila ine, alandila wamene ananituma ine."
JHN 13:21	Pamene Yesu anakamba izi, anavutika m'mzimu, anaperekela umboni nokamba ati, "Nikuuzana coonadi, nikamba kuli imwe kuti umozi waimwe azanipacika."
JHN 13:22	Ophunzila banayanganana, kudabwa-dabwa kuti nindani wenzo kambapo.
JHN 13:23	Umozi wa bomphunzila wake, wamene Yesu anakonda, analigone pa tebo kusamila pa pacifuwa ca Yesu.
JHN 13:24	Simoni Peturo pameneapo anaceula kuli ophunzira uyo nokamba ati, "Tiuze wamene akambapo."
JHN 13:25	Pamene apo anasamila pa chifuwa pa Yesu nokamba kuliyeve ati, "Ambuye nindani?"
JHN 13:26	Pamene apo Yesu anayankha ati, "niwuyo wamene nizasunsa ka bledi nopasa yeve." So pamene anasunsa ka buledi, anapasa Yudasi mwana mwamuna wa Simoni Iskalioti.
JHN 13:27	Manje, pambuyo pa buledi, satana anangena mwa yeve, ndipo Yesu anakamba nayeve ati, "Pavamene ucita, cita mwamusanga."
JHN 13:28	Manje kulibe wamene anali gone pa tebo wamene anaziba cifuka camene anakambila so kwa yeve.
JHN 13:29	Benangu anaganiza kuti, cifukwa cakuti Judasi enzeli na chola ca ndalama, Yesu anakamba nayeve, Gula vamene vifukika pa phwando," kapene apaseko vinangu kuli bosauka.
JHN 13:30	Pamene Yudasi analandila buledi, anabwela acokapo pamene apo. Kwenzeli usiku.
JHN 13:31	Pamene Yudasi anayenda, Yesu anakamba ati, "Manje mwana Mwamuna wa Munthu walemekezeka, ndipo Mulungu walemekezeka mwa yeve.
JHN 13:32	Mulungu azamulemekeza yeve mwa yeve yeka, ndipo azamulemekeza yeve pamene apo.
JHN 13:33	Bana bang'ono, nili na imwe pakanthawi ka ng'ono. Muzanisakila, ndipo mwamene ninakambila kuli baYuda, 'Kwamene niyenda, simungabweleko.' Manje nikamba cimozi -mozi kwa imwe.
JHN 13:34	Nikupasani lamulo ya manje, kuti mukondane wina ndi mzake; monga mwamene nakukondelani, cimozi-mozi mukondane wina ndi mzake.
JHN 13:35	Mwaici aliyense azaziba kuti ndimwe uphunzila banga, ngati mulinaco cikondi cawina na mzake."
JHN 13:36	Simoni Petro anakamba kwa yeve ati, "Ambuye, muyenda kuti?" Yesu anayankha ati, "Kwamene niyenda, sunganikonkhe manje, koma uzanikonkha pambuyo pake"
JHN 13:37	Petro anakamba kwayeve ati, "Ambuye, cifukwa nicani siningakonkhe manje? Nizapasa moyo wanga cifukwa caimwe."
JHN 13:38	Yesu anayankha ati, " Kansi ungapase moyo wako cifukwa caine? Nikamba zoonadi, nikamba kwa iwe, tambala akalibe kulila uzanikana ine katatu."
JHN 14:0	Yohane mutu 14
JHN 14:1	"Musaleke mitima yanu ivutike. Khulupirilani mwa Mulungu, ndipo khulupirilani mwainenso.
JHN 14:2	Munyumba ya Tate wanga alimo malo yonkalamo yambiri. ngati sichinali so, sembe ninakuuzana, chifukwa nayenda kukonza malo anu imwe.
JHN 14:3	Nikaenda no kukonzhelani malo imwe, nizabwela ndipo nizakulandilani kwaine pakuti kwamene nili naimwe mukhankeleko.
JHN 14:4	Muiziba njiila ya kwamene niyenda."
JHN 14:5	Thomasi ananena kwa Yesu, "Ambuye, sitiziba kwamene muyenda, nanga njiila tingaiziba bwanji?"
JHN 14:6	Yesu anamuuza ati, ine "ndine njiila, ndine choonadi ndipo ndine moyo, kulibe wina angabwele kwa Tate kupanda mwaine.
JHN 14:7	Ngati mwenze kuniziba asembe munamuziba naeve Tate wanga. Kuchoka apa mwamuziba, ndipo mwamuona."
JHN 14:8	Filipo anakamba kwa Yesu, Ambuye, tilangizeni Atate, icho chabe chizatikwanila."
JHN 14:9	Yesu anakamba kwa iye, "nankala naimwe ntawi itali maninga koma sumuniziba, Filipo? Aliense aniona amuona Tate. Manje iwe ungakambe bwanji ati, 'tilangize Tate'?
JHN 14:10	Ninshi sukhulupirila kuti ine nili muli Tate na Tate ali mwaine? Mau yamene nikuuzani imwe sinikamba mu mphavu zanga iyayi, koma ni Tate wamene ankhala mwaine wamene achita chinto yake.
JHN 14:11	Nikhulupirileni kuti ine nili mwa Tate, na Tate ali mwaine, ndiponso khululupirani chamachitidwe yamene.
JHN 14:12	Choonadi, Choonadi, nikuuzani kuti uyo wamene akhulupirila mwaine azachita nchito zamene nichita, ndipo azachitanso nchito zikulu kupambana nazamene izi chifukwa ine niyenda kwa Tate.
JHN 14:13	Zonse zamene muzapempa muzina langa, nizakuchitilani pakuti Tate alemekezediwe mu Mwana mwamuna.
JHN 14:14	Mukanipempa chilichonse muzina yanga, nizakuchitilani.
JHN 14:15	Ngati munikonda imwe, muzasungu malamulo yanga.
JHN 14:16	Ndipo nizakupempelelani kwa Tate wanga, naye azakupasana Omipuzya(Omitontoza) wina pakuti akankhale naimwe masiku onse:
JHN 14:17	Muzimu wa choonadi. Wamene ziko singalandile chifukwa sinamuonepo ndipo simuziba iyayi. Koma inu mumuziba, chifukwa ankhala naimwe ndipo anzankhala mukati kaimwe.
JHN 14:18	Sinizakusiyani mweka; nizabwela futi kwainu.
JHN 14:19	Ndipo ntawi ing'ono ziko sizanionanso, koma imwe muniona. Chifukwa ine nili na umoyo,  nainu muzankala na umoyo.
JHN 14:20	Pasiku ija muzaziba kuti ine nili mwa Tate, ndipo inu muli mwaine, naine nili mwainu.
JHN 14:21	Wamene ali namalamula yanga ndipo ayasunga ninsi niwamene anikonda, elyo wamene anikonda azakondewa na Tate wanga, nainenso nizamukonda na kuilangiza ine kwaeve.
JHN 14:22	Yuda (uyu si Isikario iyayi) anuuza Yesu ati, "Ambuye, nanga nichani muzazilangizi mweka kwaise osati ku ziko?"
JHN 14:23	Yesu anamuyanka no kamba kwaeve kuti, "ngati muntu aliyense anikonda, azasunga mau yanga. Tate wanga azamukonda, ndipo tizabwela kwaiye nakumanga nyumba yatu naye.
JHN 14:24	Wamene sanikonda samasunga mau yanga. Mau yamene munvela siyachokela kwaine koma niyochokela kwa Tate wamene ananituma.
JHN 14:25	Nakuuzani zinthu izii, nikali kunkhala naimwe.
JHN 14:26	Koma, Mutonthozi - Muzimu Oyela wamene Tate azatuma muzina langa - iye azakupunzisani zonse ndipo azakukumbusani zonse zamene nakuuzani ine.
JHN 14:27	Nakusiyilani mutendere; nakupasani mutendere. Sinikupasani mwamene ziko ipasila. Mutima wanu usavutike, ndipo musayope.
JHN 14:28	Munanvela kuti nakuuzani imwe, 'Ine niyenda, ndipo nizabwelanso kwaimwe.' Ngati mwenzonikonda, asembe mwakondwera kuti niyenda kwa Tate, chifukwa Tate nimukulu kunichila ine.
JHN 14:29	Manje nakuuzani chikalibe kuchitika, chikachitika muzakulupirila.
JHN 14:30	Sinizakambanso futi zambiri na imwe, chifukwa olamulila ziko ili lapansi abwela. Alibe mphavu pa ine,
JHN 14:31	koma pakuti ziko izibe kuti ine nikonda Tate, nichita chabe mwamene Tate ananilamurila. Tiyeni tinyemuke, tichokepo apa.
JHN 14:30	Sinizakamba vambili manje na imwe, chifukwa eve oweluza ziko ino abwela. Eve alibe mpavu pali ine,
JHN 14:31	koma kuti ziko izibe kuti ine nikonda Atate, nichita monga mwame Atate banani uzila. Tiyeni ti ime tichokepo pano."
JHN 15:0	Mutu 15
JHN 15:1	Ine ndine mpesa weni-weni, Atate wanga ndiye mlimi wa dimba.
JHN 15:2	Iye amajuwa msambo uliwonse mwaine wamene siubala viphaso, koma amajuwilila msambo uliwonse wamene ubala viphaso, kuti ubale viphaso vyambiri.
JHN 15:3	Inu ndinu woyela kale chifukwa ca mau amene nalankhula namwe.
JHN 15:4	Nkalililani mwaine, naine mwa inu. Monga msambo suungabale viphaso pa weka pokapo ngati wankhala  ku chimutengo ca mpesa, pokapo  munkhalilile mwaine.
JHN 15:5	Ine ndine mpesa, inu ndinu msambo wanga. Yense amene ankhala mwaine na ine mwa iye, azabala viphaso zambiri; popanda ine simukacite kanthu.
JHN 15:6	Ngati aliwonse sankhalilila mwaine, ataidwa ngani msambo na kuyuma, Misambo yatele imatengedwa ndikuyiponya ku moto kuti ipye.
JHN 15:7	Ngati muzankhalilila mwaine, na mau anga muli imwe,  Pemphani ciliconse camene mufuna, cizacitidwa kwa inu.
JHN 15:8	Atate anga amalemekezedwa muli izi, kuti mubale viphaso zambiri ndipo muzionese kuti ndinu wophunzila wanga.
JHN 15:9	Monga atate andikondela, nainenso ndikukondani. Nkhalililani mu Chikondi canga.
JHN 15:10	Ngati musunga malamulo anga, muzankalilila muchikondi canga, monga ine nisunga malamulo ya Atate nonkhalilila mu Chikondi cake.
JHN 15:11	Nalankhula namwe izi kuli imwe kuti chimwemwe canga cikale mwainu, ndipo kuti chimwemwe cikwanile.
JHN 15:12	Lamulo langa ndi iyi, kuti mukondane wina ndi muzace, monga mwamene ine ndikukondelani inu.
JHN 15:13	Palibe amene alindi chikondi copambana ici, kuti anataya moyo wake chifukwa ca azake.
JHN 15:14	Ndinu anzanga tsopano ngati muchita zimene ndikulamulilani.
JHN 15:15	Sindizakuyitanani inu anchito, chifukwa wanchito saziba zimene mbuye wake acita. Ndikuitanani inu anzanga, chifukwa zonse zimene ndinamvwa kuchokela kwa Atate, nakuziwisani.
JHN 15:16	Inu simunandisankhe ine, koma ndinakusankhani, nosakiwa kuti mupite mukabale viphaso ndipo viphaso vinkalilile. Ndipo Atate azakupasani ciliconse cimene muzapempha muzina langa azakupasani.
JHN 15:17	Izi zimene nikulamulilani kuti mukondane wina ndi muzace.
JHN 15:18	Ngati dziko lapansi ikuzondani, zibani kuti inayamba kuzonda ine, ikalimbe kukuzondani inu.
JHN 15:19	M'kanankhala  anthu a dziko lapansi, likana kukondani ngati anthu ake. Koma chifukwa simulibadziko lapansi ndipo chifukwa ndinakuitanani kukucosani mudziko, nchifukwa cake dziko ikuzondani.
JHN 15:20	Kumbukilani mau amene ndinalankhula nanu kuti,  palibe wanchito amene  apambana bwana wake. Ngati bananisausa ine, bazakusausani naimwe; Ngati anasunga mau anga azasunganso yanu.
JHN 15:21	Azacita zonse izi kwainu chifukwa ca ine, samuziba wamene ananituma ine.
JHN 15:22	Kuti ine sindinabwele nakukamba nawo, sembe balibe kucimwa, koma manje balibe cokanila mlandu wawo.
JHN 15:23	Amene azonda ine azondanso Atate anga.
JHN 15:24	Ine kuti ndilibe cite nchinto iliconse pakati pawo zinthu zimene wina sanacitepo iwo sakanakala wocimwa. Manje  chifukwa aona zodabwisa izi, ndipo andizonda ine pamodzi ndi Atate anga.
JHN 15:25	Koma zacitika telo kuti zikwanilise zimene malembo analembedwa mumalamulo; "Ananizonda ine popanda chifukwa."
JHN 15:26	Pamene muthontozi - wamene ndizathuma kucokela kwatate, amane ali Mzimu wa coonadi, wocokela kwa Atate - azacitila umboni za ine.
JHN 15:27	Inu municitila umboni, chifukwa mwankhala naine kucokela poyamba.
JHN 16:0	Mutu 16
JHN 16:1	Nakamba ivi vintu kuli imwe kuti musataike.
JHN 16:2	Bazakupilikisani muma Sinagogo. Koma ntawi izabwela yamene aliyense wamene azapaya imwe azaganizila kuti asebenzela Mulungu.
JHN 16:3	Bazachita ivi vintu chifukwa sibana bazibe Batate olo Ine.
JHN 16:4	Nakamba ivi vintu kuli imwe mwakuti ngati ntawi yabo yafika, muzakakumbuka kuti ninaku-uzani pa va bemve. Sininaku-uzeni pali ivi vintu poyamba, chifukwa Ninali nikali naimwe.
JHN 16:5	Koma apa ma je Noiyenda kuli wamene ananituma, koma kulibe aliyense pali imwe wamene anifunsa, 'Nanga muyenda kuti?'
JHN 16:6	Koma chifukwa nakamba ivi vintu kuli imwe, chifundo chazuka mu mitima zanu.
JHN 16:7	Koma chazoona niku-uzani imwe, nichabwino kuti ine niyende. CHifukwa ngati ine sinizaenda, eve Otontoza sazabwela kuli imwe, koma ngati ine naenda, nizamutuma kuli imwe.
JHN 16:8	Pamene azabwela, eve Otontoza azalangiza ziko kuti niyolakwa pa za chimo, paza chilungamo, komanso napali chiweluzo -
JHN 16:9	pa chimo, chifukwa sibakulupilira muli Ine;
JHN 16:10	pali za chilungamo, chifukwa Ine niyenda kuli Batate, ndipo simuzayamba kuniona;
JHN 16:11	komanso pali chiweluzo, chifukwa eve olamulila ziko anaweluziwa.
JHN 16:12	Nikali navambili vamene nifuna kukamba naimwe, koma simungavimvesese apa manje.
JHN 16:13	Koma pamene eve, Muzimu wa Chazo-ona, azabwela, azaku sogolelani muvazo-ona vonse, chifukwa eve sazakamba vake eka. Koma azakamba vonse vamene azamvela, ndipo azaku-uzani vintu vamene vamene vizabwela.
JHN 16:14	Azapeleka ulemelelo kuli ine, chifukwa azatenga kuchosa pali vanga nakuku-uzani imwe.
JHN 16:15	Vonse vamene Batate balinavo nivanga. Chifukwa cha ichi, nakamba kuti Eve Muzimu azatenga kuchosa pali vanga nakuku-uzani imwe.
JHN 16:16	Kwa ntawi ingóno imwe simuzaniona nafuti, ndipo pakapita kantawi kangóno muzaniona.
JHN 16:17	Manje bena pabopunzila bake banakamba wina na muzake kuti, "Nanga ichi chamene atiuza ise kuti, 'Kantawi kangóno imwe simuzaniona futi koma futi kantawi kangóno muzaniona,' futi, 'chifukwa ine nienda kuli Batate'?"
JHN 16:18	Mwa ichi banakamba kuti, "Nanga ichi nichani chamene akamba kuti, 'Kwa ka ntawi kangóno'? Ise sitiziba vamene akambapo."
JHN 16:19	Yesu anaona kuti banali kufuna kumufunsa, ndipo anabauza kuti, "Nanga ichi ndiye chamene muzifunsa pamweka, chamene nitantauza pakukamba kuti, 'Kwa ka ntawi kangóno koma simuzaniona nafuti, ndipo mwa ka ntawi kangóno koma muzaniona'?
JHN 16:20	Chazo-ona, chazo-ona, niku-uzani imwe, muzakalila momvesa chifundo, koma ziko izakakondwela. Muzankala bozula na chifundo, koma chifundo chanu chizasandulisiwa kunkala chimwele.
JHN 16:21	Pamene muzimai abala amamvesa chifundo chifukwa ntawi yake yafika, koma akabala mwana, samakumbukila vomvela kubaba chifukwa chakuti muntu abadwa paziko.
JHN 16:22	Onani apa mu mvesa chifundo manje, koma nizakuonani nafuti, ndipo mitima zanu zizakondwela, ndipo kulibe aliyense wamene azakwanisa kuchosa chimwemwe mumitima zanu.
JHN 16:23	Pasiku ija simuzakanipempa ine kantu kali konse. Zo-ona, zo-ona, nikamba kwa imwe, ngati muzapempa chintu chilichonse kuli Batate muzina yanga, bazakupasani imwe.
JHN 16:24	Kufikila apa kulibe chamene imwe mwapempa muzina yanga. Pempani ndipo muzapasiwa, mwakuti chimwemwe chanu chinkale chofikilisiwa.
JHN 16:25	"Nakamba ivi vintu kuuza imwe kupitila muma pinda, koma ntawi izafika yamene nizaleka kukamka naimwe muma pinda, koma nizaku-uzani po-onekela paza Batate.
JHN 16:26	Pasiku ija imwe muzapempa muzina yanga koma sinikamba kuti nizakupempelani imwe kuli Batate,
JHN 16:27	chifukwa Batate beve bakukondani imwe chifukwa imwe munanikonda ine ndiponso chifukwa chakuti manakululupila kuti ine ninachokela kuli Batate.
JHN 16:28	Ninachokela kuli Batate, ndipo ninabwela muziko. Futi, nizasiya ziko naku enda kuli Batate.
JHN 16:29	Bopunzila bake banakamba kuti, "Onani, apa manje mwakamba momvekesesa mosasebenzesa mapinda.
JHN 16:30	Manje tiziba kuti imwe muziba vintu vonse, ndipo simufunika kuti muntu aliyense afunse ma funso. Chifukwa cha ichi, tikulupilila kuti imwe munachokela kuli Mulungu."
JHN 16:31	Yesu anabayanka nati, "Nanga mwakulupilila manje?
JHN 16:32	Onani, ntawi izabwela, zo-ona, koma futi yafika, pamene imwe muzapatuliwa, aliyense kunyumba kwake, ndipo imwe muzanisiya neka. Koma sinili neka chifukwa Batate bali naine.
JHN 16:33	Nakamba ivi vintu ku-uza imwe mwakuti mwa ine munkale na mutendere. Muziko muzankala na vovutisa, koma nkalani bolimba mutima, Nagonjesa ziko."
JHN 17:0	Muntu 17
JHN 17:1	Pamene Yesu anasiliza kukamba ivi,ananyamula menso yake kumwamba nakukamba; Atate,nthawi yafika, lemekezani mwana wanu kuti mwana wanu akulemekezeni.
JHN 17:2	Mwamene munamupasila ulamuliro pa munthu ali wonse pakuti akapase umoyo osata kuli bonse bamene anapasiwa.
JHN 17:3	Uyu nimoyo osata ;kuti bamizibeni, mulungu eka wachonadi, ndipo wamene otumiwa Yesu Kristu.
JHN 17:4	Ninamulemekezani pa ziko.   Ninasiliza nchito yamene munanipasa kucita.
JHN 17:5	Manje,atate,nilemekezeni pamodzi nainu   na ulemelelo wamene  ninali nawo pamene ziko ikalibe kupangiwa.
JHN 17:6	Ninaionesa dzina lanu ku anthu amene munanipasa kuchokela mu dziko. Banali anthu anu, ndipo munanipasa, ndiponso banasunga mau wanu.
JHN 17:7	Apa baziba ati vonse vamene munanipasa vinachokela kuli inu,
JHN 17:8	ndiponso ninabapasa mau wonse munanipasa. Banalandila nakuziba banaziba ati ninachokela kuli inu, ndiponso bana khululupilira kuti munanituma.
JHN 17:9	Nibapempelela, sinipempelela ziko koma baja bamene munanipasa.
JHN 17:10	Vonse vanga nivanu, navanu nivanga, ndiponso  nilemekezezdwa muli iwo.
JHN 17:11	Sinili muziko, koma aba bantu bali muziko ndiponso nibwela kwainu. Atate oyela, basungeni muzina lanu munanipasa  kuti bankale umodzi, monga ise tili umodzi.
JHN 17:12	Pamene ninali nabo, ninabasunga muzina lanu, lamene munanipasa. Nina bacingiliza, kulibe aliyose anaonongeka, kuchoselako chabe mwana wa chitayiko, kuti lembo likwanisidwe.
JHN 17:13	Apa nibwela kwainu koma nikamba izi zinthu muziko pakuti bankale nachmwemwe chosililila  mulibeve.
JHN 17:14	Ninabapasa mau yanu, ndipo ziko yaba zonda cifukwa sibamu ziko, monga ine sinili wamu ziko.
JHN 17:15	Sinimpempa kuti mubachose muziko, koma mubasunge kuchokela kumudani.
JHN 17:16	Siba muziko monga ine sindine wamu ziko.
JHN 17:17	Bapatululeni muchonadi, cifukwa mau yanu ni chonadi.
JHN 17:18	Monga mwamene munanitumila muziko, naine nabatuma muziko.
JHN 17:19	Cifukwa chabeve ninazi pantulula, pakuti nabeve bapatuluke muchonadi.
JHN 17:20	Sinimpempelela chabe aba,koma nabonse abo bazakhululupira muli ine kupitila mumau yabo.
JHN 17:21	Pakuti bonse bankale umodzi,monga inu,Atate muli muli ine,ndiponso nilimuli inu. Nipempela kuti bankale muli ise pakuti chalo chika khululupire ati munani tuma.
JHN 17:22	Ulamelelo wamene munanipasa, ninabapasa, pakuti bankale umodzi, monga mwamene tili bamodzi.
JHN 17:23	Ine muli inu, ndipo inu muli ine. Pakuti basilizike muli umodzi, pakuti ziko ikazibe ati munanituma ndiponso mubakonda monga mwamene munikondela.
JHN 17:24	Atate, nifuna kuti bonse abo munanipasa bankale naine kwamene nilili pakuti bakaone ulemelelo, wamene mwanipasa. Cifukwa munanikonda pamene pakalibe kupangiwa kwa ziko.
JHN 17:25	Oyela atate, ziko sinamizibeni, koma ninamizibani; ndiponso aba baziba ati munanituma.
JHN 17:26	Ninazibisa zina lanu kulibeve, ndiponso nizazibisa pakuti chikondi chamene munanikondelako chinkale muli beve, ndpo nizankala muli beve.''
JHN 18:0	MUTU 18
JHN 18:1	Pamene Yesu ananena aya mau, anayenda ndi ophunzila bake kumhalo yenangu muchigwa cha Kidironi, mumunda mwamene  Iye na ophunzila bake anangena.
JHN 18:2	Koma Yudase, wamene enzofunika kumugulisa iye, naye enzo yaziba malo yaja, chifukwa kambiri Yesu analikuyenda kumhalo aja ndi ophunzila bake.
JHN 18:3	Koma Yudase, pamene analandila gulu ya masilikari kuchoka kubakulu bansembe ndi ku Afalise, ndiponso  alonda, anabwela ndi miyuni, ndi nyali, ndi zida.
JHN 18:4	Koma Yesu, wamene analikuziba zonse zamene zenzo chitika kuli iye, anapitiliza ndi kuba funsa, '' kodi musakila ndani?''
JHN 18:5	Bana muyanka iye, ''Yesu waku Nazareti,'' Yesu anabayankha, ''Ndine.'' Yudase, wamene anamugulisa iye, aniyimilila na asilikale.
JHN 18:6	Ndipo pamene anakamba kulibemve, ''Ndine,'' anabwerela kumbuyo na kugwela pansi.
JHN 18:7	Ndiponso anabafunsa kuti, ''Nanga ni ndani wamene musakila?'' Nafuti ananena, ''Yesu waku Nazareti''.
JHN 18:8	Yesu anayanka, "nenze nakuuzani kuti Ndine. ngati ndine wamene musakila, siyani baja bayende.''
JHN 18:9	Ichi chinali mu ndondomeko yofikiliza mau yamene enze anakamba: "pali baja bamene munanipasa, sininasobese alionse."
JHN 18:10	Ndiponso Simoni Petulo, wamene anali na lupanga, anaichosa ndi ku chaya wa nchito wabakulu bansembe ndikujuba kwatu kwake. Uyu wamene wa nchito enze kuyitaniwa  Malikasi.
JHN 18:11	Yesu ananena kuli Petulo, '' Bwezelamo lupanga mumhalo yake. Kodi nisamwe mu kapu yamene Atate anipasa?''
JHN 18:12	Koma gulu yama soja ndi mukulu wama soja  na alonda  Ayuda, anamugwila Yesu na kumumanga.
JHN 18:13	Banayambirila kumupeleka kwa Annasi, anali mupongozi wa Kefasi, wamene anali mukulu wansembe chaka chija.
JHN 18:14	Koma Kefasi analiwamene anatandizila Ayuda kuti chingawame kuti munthu umozi afele banthu.
JHN 18:15	Simoni Petulo anakonka Yesu, ndiwina wao ophunzila bake anachita chamene icho, koma uja ophunzila  analiozibika kubakulu ba nsembe, ndiponso anangena ndi Yesu mumhalo mwa akulu ansembe;
JHN 18:16	koma Petulo anali imilile panja pakomo. Koma wina wa ophunzila bake, wamene anali kuzibika kubakulu bansembe, anayenda panja ndikukamba namukazi wamene anaimilila pakomo ndi kumungenesa mukati Petulo.
JHN 18:17	Koma wanchito mukazi, wamene anaimilila pakomo, ananena kuli Petulo, ''Kodi sindiwe wa amozi ophunzila wa uyu munthu?'' Anakamba, ''sindine.''
JHN 18:18	Koma anchito ndi alonda anayimilila paja, anapanga mulilo, chifukwa kunali ko zizila, ndiponso anali kuzifundisa iwo oka. Petulo anali nabeve, anayimilila nao pamene enza kuzifundisa eka.
JHN 18:19	Ndipo mkulu wa ansembe anafunsa Yesu pa ophunzila bake ndi chipunziso.
JHN 18:20	Yesu anamuyankha, ''Ninakamba potuba tutu kuziko. Ninali kupunzisa muma sinagogi ndi mu tempele mwamene Ayuda amakumanilana pamodzi. Sininakambe mwakabisili.
JHN 18:21	Nichifukwa chani munifunsa?Funsani baja bamene benze bamvela vamene nenzokambapo. Onani aba banthu baziba vamene nenze nakamba.''
JHN 18:22	Pamene Yesu anakamba izi zinthu, umozi wao pa alonda  ana imilila pafupi anamumenyamo ndikunena kuti, "nanga ndiye mwamene ungayankile akulu ansembe?''
JHN 18:23	Yesu anayankha, ngati nayankha kuipa, pelekani umboni pazoipa, koma ngati ni volungama, nichani chamene munimenyela?''
JHN 18:24	koma Annasi anamutuma akali omangiwa kuli Kefasi mukulu wansembe.
JHN 18:25	Koma Simon Petulo anayimilila ndi kuzifundisa eka. Ndi aba banthu bananena kuli iye, ''kodi sindiwe mbali wa aja ophunzila ake?'' anakana ndikunena, ''sindine.''
JHN 18:26	Umozi waophunzila wa bakulu bansembe, wamene anali mubale wa uyu munthu wamene Petulo anajuba kutu, anakamba, ''kodi sininakuone ndi iye mu munda na yeve?''
JHN 18:27	Petulo anakana kachiwiri, ndipo pamene apo kombwe analila.
JHN 18:28	Pamene apo anamutenga Yesu kuchokela kuli Kefasi ndikumu peleka kuli akulu la boma. Kunali kuseniseni, koma sanangene munyumba ya boma kuti asaziononge pamene akalibe kudya Pasaka.
JHN 18:29	Koma Pilato anayenda kwaiwo ndi kubauza, ''nanga chamene mumususila uyu munthu nichani?''
JHN 18:30	Anamuyanka ndi kunena kulu iye, ''ngati munthu uyu sinali oyipa, asembe sitinamutume kwa iye.''
JHN 18:31	Pamwepo Pilato ananena kuli beve, '' mutengeni imwe mweka, ndikumuweluza kulinganiza na ulamulilo wanu.'' Ayuda ananena kuli iwo. ''Sichili choenela kulinganila namalamulo kuti tipaye munthu alionse.''
JHN 18:32	Anakamba ichi pakuti mau ya Yesu yafikilize chamene chinakambidwa kuti ni infa yabwanji yamene azafa.
JHN 18:33	Koma Pilato anangena mumalo ya alonda a boma nafuti ndi kumuitana Yesu nakukamba kuli iye, ''Kodi  ndiwe mukulu waba Yuda?''
JHN 18:34	Yesu ananena, ''kodi ukamba kwaine weka, olo kapena banthu bena banakambapo kwa iye pali ine?''
JHN 18:35	Pilato anayankha, ''sindine muyud?, kodi ndine  muyuda banthu bako ndi akulu ansembe anakupasa kwaine. Kodi unachita bwanji?''
JHN 18:36	Yesu anayankha, ''ufumu wanga si wamuno mu ziko. Ngati ufumu wanga unalimbari ya ziko lino, koma banchito banga ngati bamenya ngondo kuti musanipeleke kwa Ayuda. Koma manje ufumu wanga siuchoka pano.''
JHN 18:37	Pilato ananena kuli iye, ''kodi ndiwe mfumu?'' Yesu anayankha, ''Wakamba kuti ndine mfumu. ninabadwila chamene ichi, koma nichifukwa chamene ichi nina bwela paziko kuti nikapeleke umboni wa choonadi. Aliwonse amene alikumbali ya choonadi amamvelela mau anga.''
JHN 18:38	Pilato ananena kuli iye, '' Choonadi ni chichani?'' pamene anakamba izi, anayenda kabiri kwa Ayuda naku auza, "sininapeze chifukwa chili chonse muli uyu munthu.
JHN 18:39	Koma kulingana na mwambowatu nilinayo danga yomasulila umozi pa pasaka. Kodi mufuna nimasulile Mfumu ya Ayuda kuli imwe?''
JHN 18:40	Ndiponso analila kachibili ni kunena, ''siuyu munthu, koma Baraba.'' koma Baraba ni kawalala.
JHN 19:0	Mutu 19
JHN 19:1	Pilato ana tenga Yesu naku kumukwapula.
JHN 19:2	Basilikali bana panga chisote cha minga. Bana chiika pamutu wa Yesu naku muvalika chovala cha purple.
JHN 19:3	Bana bwela kuli eve naku kamba kuti, "Taonani, Mufumu wa ba Yuda!" Ndiponso bana mu menya.
JHN 19:4	Pamene apo Pilato ana enda panja nafuti naku bauza kuti, "Onani, nizamuleta panja kuli imwe kuti muzibe kuti uyu muntu sinina mupeze na mulandu."
JHN 19:5	Pamene paja Yesu anabwela panja, anavala chisote cha umfumu cha minga na chovala cha purple. Pilato anabauza kuti, "Onani, umuntu muntu ali apa!"
JHN 19:6	Pamene beve bakulu ba nsembe na ba silikali bana muona Yesu, bana punda naku kamba kuti, "Mupachikeni uyu muntu, mupachikeni uyu muntu." Pilato anabauza kuti, "Mutengeni imwe mweka mumupachike, chifukwa ine sinina mupeze na mulandu."
JHN 19:7	Ba Yuda bana muyanka kuti, "Ise tili nayo lamulo, kulingana na lamulo uyu ayenela kupaiwa chifukwa anali kukamba kuti ni Mwana wa Mulungu."
JHN 19:8	Pamene Pilato anamvela  aya mau, ana gwiliwa na manta kwambili,
JHN 19:9	ana enda kungéna mu malo yakulu ya boma nafuti naku mu-uza Yesu, "Nanga uchokela kuti?" Koma Yesu sana muyanke kalikonse.
JHN 19:10	Kukonkapo Pilato ana uza Yesu kuti, "Nanga nichani suniyanka? Nanga suziba kuti nili nazo mpavu zo kuchosa, na mpavu zo ku pachika?"
JHN 19:11	Yesu anamuyanka kuti, "Ulibe mpavu zilizonse pali ine kapena chabe zija zamene zina pasiwa kuli iwe kuchokela kumwamba. Mwa ici, wamene anani peleka kuli iwe ndiye ali na chimo ikulu maningi."
JHN 19:12	Pamene anamuyanka mau aya, Pilato anayesa ku mu chosa, koma ba Yuda bana punda, kukamba kuti, "ngati uza muchosa uyu muntu, ninshi sindiwe muzake wa Kaisala. Aliyense wamene amazipanga kunkala mfumu anyoza Kaisala."
JHN 19:13	Pamene Pilato anamvela mau aya, anamuleta Yesu panja naku munkalika pansi pa mupando wa chiweluzo mu malo oitaniwa kuti "Popita," koma mu chitundu cha chi Alamaiki bama itanamo kuti, "Gabata."
JHN 19:14	Manje inali ntawi ya kukonzekela kwa Pasaka, ntawi ya 12 koloko. Pilato anakamba ku-uza ba Yuda kuti, "Onani, uyu mfumu apa mfumu wanu!"
JHN 19:15	Bana punda naku kamba kuti, "Tiyeni naye uko, tiyeni naye uko; mupachikeni!" Pilato anabauza kuti, "Nanga ni-ipachike mfumu yanu?" Bakulu ba nsembe bana yanka naku kamba kuti, "Ise tilibe mfumu koma chabe Kaisala."
JHN 19:16	Pamene apo Pilato anamupeleka Yesu kuli beve kuti bamu pachike.
JHN 19:17	Banamutenga Yesu, anachoka, ninshi anyamula mutanda wake, kuyenda kumalo oitaniwa kuti "Malo ya mafupa ya kumutu," yamene mu chitundu cha ku Aramaiki yaitaniw kuti "Gologota."
JHN 19:18	Banamu pachika kwamene kuja, pamozi na bantu babili benangu, umozi ku kwanja ya kumanzele wina ku kwanja ya ku manja, Yesu pakati.
JHN 19:19	Pilato analemba chikwangwana naku chi ika pa mutanda. Pana lembewa mau yokamba kuti: YESU WA KU NAZALETI, MFUMU WA BA YUDA.
JHN 19:20	Bambili ba Yuda bana belenga mau aya chifukwa chakuti malo yamene Yesu anapachikiwako yanali pafupi na Muzinda. Chikwangwana ichi china lembewa mu chilembewe cha chi Aramaki, Latini, na chi Giliki.
JHN 19:21	Pamene apo bakulu ba nsembe ba a Yuda bana uza Pilato kuti, "Osalemba kuti, 'Mfumu ya ba Yuda,' koma mulembe kuti, 'Uyu anali kukamba kuti, "Ine ndine mfumu ya ba Yuda.'"
JHN 19:22	Pilato ana bayanka kuti, "Chamene ine nalemba nalemba."
JHN 19:23	Pamene basilikali banamu pachika Yesu, bana tenga vovala vake, banavigabana muvigabo vi nai, aliyense pali beve anatengapo chimozi; na chovala chovala pamwamba. Koma chovala chamene ichi chakunja chinalibe joini, chotungiwa mbali imozi chabe kuchokela pamwamba.
JHN 19:24	Bana uzana beka kuti, "Osati tichingámbe chovala ichi, koma tiyeni titeye njuga kuti tizibe wamene azachitenga." Ichi chinachitika kuti mau yakwanilisike yolembewa yamene yakamba kuti, "Bana gabana vovala vanga pakati pabo naku chita kuteya njuga chifukwa cha vovala vanga." Ichi nichamene ba silikali bana chita.
JHN 19:25	Manje bamene bana imilila pafupi na mutanda wa Yesu banali bamaike bake, ba kalongosi ba bamai bake, Maria mukai wa Klopas, na Maria Madalena.
JHN 19:26	Pamene Yesu anaona bamai bake na opunzila wake wamene anali kukonda anaimilila pafupi, ana uza ba mai bake kuti, "Amai, onani, mwana wanu uyo!"
JHN 19:27	Anauza uja opunzila wake kuti, "Ona, bamai bako!"Kuchokela pamene apo uja opunzila anaba tenga kuba peleka kunyumba kwake.
JHN 19:28	Kuchokela apa, pamene anaziba kuti ntawi yakwana yamene vonse vina kwanilisiwa na kuti malemba yakwanilisiwe, Yesu anakamba kuti, "Namvela njota."
JHN 19:29	Ka gubu kamene kanali na vinyo vosasa kanaikiwa paja, banatenga tonje yozula na vinyo vosasa pa ndodo ya hisopo na kuimya kupeleka kukamwa kwake.
JHN 19:30	Pamene Yesu ana mwamo vinyo vosasa, anakamba kuti, "Chasilizika." Anagwedesa mutu wake na kupeleka muzimu.
JHN 19:31	Pamene apo ba Yuda, chifukwa iyi inali siku yokonzekela, mwa ichi ma tupi siyanga nkale pa mutanda pa ntawi ya Sabata (chifukwa ija Sabata inali yolemekezeka maningi), bana pempa Pilato kuti baba tyole mendo naku bachosapo.
JHN 19:32	Pamene apo ba silikali banabwela naku tyola mendo ya uja oyamba pamutanda na ya uja okonkapo wamene ana pachikiwa pamozi na Yesu.
JHN 19:33	Pamene bana fika pali Yesu, bana ona kuti anamwalila kudala, mwa ichi sibana mutyole mendo.
JHN 19:34	Koma, umozi pali basilikali anamu lasa lupenga kumbali, pamene apo kuna choka magazi na manzi.
JHN 19:35	Wamene anaona ivi apeleka umboni, na umboni wake niwa zo-ona. Aziba kuti vamene akamba nivazoona kuti mukulupilile naimwe.
JHN 19:36	Chifukwa ivi vintu vinachitika kuti malemba yakwanisiwe, "Kulibe fupa yake ili yonse yamene izapwanyiwa."
JHN 19:37	Nafuti, mau yena yakamba kuti, "Bazamu yangana wamene banalasa."
JHN 19:38	Kuchoka ivi vintu, Yosefe waku Alimatiya, chifukwa chakuti anali opunzila wa Yesu (koma mu chisinsi chifukwa anali kuyopa ba Yuda), anapempa kuli Pilato kuti atenge tupi ya Yesu. Pilato anamuvomelesa. Kuchoka apa Yosefe anabwela nakutenga tupi.
JHN 19:39	Nikodemas na eve anabwela, wamene anabwela kuli Yesu poyamba usiku. Analeta vosiyana-siyana monga myrrh na aloe, yokwanila monga ma lita yali hundredi.
JHN 19:40	Pamene apa banatenga tupi ya Yesu na kui ika mu vovala va lineni na vonunkila, monga mwamene chinalili kunkalila ku mwambo wa ba Yuda pa kuika mutembo mu manda.
JHN 19:41	Manje mu malo mwamene anapachikiwa panali munda; ndipo mu munda uja munali manda ya sopano yamene sibana ikemo muntu aliyense.
JHN 19:42	Chifukwa inali siku ya kukonzekela kwa ba Yuda koma futi manda yanali pafupi, banaika tupi ya Yesu.
JHN 20:0	Mutu 20
JHN 20:1	Kuseniseni mukuyamba kwa sabata, pamene kunali ko fipa, Mariya Magadalena anayenda kumanda ndipo anaona chimwala ni chochosewa pa manda.
JHN 20:2	Anatamanga nakuyenda kuli Simoni Petulo nakuli wina ophunzila wamene Yesu enzokonda, naku bauza ati, "Ba muchosako Ambuye mu manda ndipo sitiziba kwamene bamufaaka."
JHN 20:3	Petulo nabenangu bopunzila baake banachoka, bana yenda ku manda,
JHN 20:4	Bana tamanga pamozi, ndipo wina opunzila anamangisa kuchila Petulo nakufika ku manda musanga.
JHN 20:5	Ndipo pamene anabelama anaona nyula yankala, koma sanangene mo mukati.
JHN 20:6	Simoni Petulo pambuyo pake anafika nongena mumanda. Anaona nyula ili pansi yankala
JHN 20:7	Na nyula yenze pamutu wake . Sinankhale na manyula koma yenze yopetewa  pamalo payeka.
JHN 20:8	Manje winangu ophunzila,  uja ana fika musanga kumanda, nayeve ana'ngena, ndi kuona naku kukulupilila.
JHN 20:9	Kufikila ija ntawi sibanazibe malembo kuti azawuka kuwokufa.
JHN 20:10	Ndipo bopunzhila bana bwelele ku nyumba nafuti.
JHN 20:11	koma Maria enze ana yimlila panja alila.Pe'anzo'lila,ana'ngena mu'manada.
JHN 20:12	ana'ona ba ngelo babili  banavala voyela, wina anankala kumutu wina kumendo, panali tupi yo gona ya Yesu.
JHN 20:13	Bana kamba kwaeve,  "Mukazi, mulila chani?''  Ana bauza, "Chifukwa batenga Ambuye, ndipo siniziba kwamene bamufaka."
JHN 20:14	Pamene ana kamba izi, ana pindamuka naku ona Yesu ayimilila paja, koma sanazibe kuti ni Yesu anayimilila.
JHN 20:15	Yesu anakamba kwa iye, "Muzimai ulila chani? nindani wamene usakila muno?''  Anaganiza kuti ni mulimi wa munda, ndipo anamuuza, "Ambuye, ngati mwamutenga, niwuzeni kwamene mwa mufaka, ni zamuchosako."
JHN 20:16	Yesu ana muuza, ''Mariya.'' Ana pindamuka, ndipo ana muuza muchi Aramaika, ''Rabboni" (kutantauza "Mupunzisi")
JHN 20:17	Yesu ana muuza iye, "Osanigwila, nikalibe kuyenda kumwamba kuli ba Tate, koma yenda ku'abale anga naku'bauza ati niku yenda ku mwanba kwa Tate wanga ndi Tate wanu,  Na Mulungu wanga ndi Mulungu wanu."
JHN 20:18	Mariya Magadalene ana bwela na ku bauza bophunzila ati, "Namuona Ambuye," ndipo anakamba izii kwaeve.
JHN 20:19	Pamene mumazulo unafika, siku ija, siku yoyamba ya sabata, ndipo visiko kunali bophunzila vinali vo valiwa kuyopa Ayuda, Yesu ana bwela ayimilila pakati pao naku bawuza, "Mutendere kwa inu.''
JHN 20:20	Pamene ana kamba ivi, ana ba langiza manja yake na kumbali kwake. Bophunzila bana muona Yesu, ndipo bana kondwela
JHN 20:21	Yesu anabauza nafuti, "Mutendere kwainu. Mwamene Atate ananitumai, naine nikutumani."
JHN 20:22	Pamene Yesu anakamba izi anaba pemela mpepo na ku'kamba kuli beve, "Pokelelani Muzimu Oyela."
JHN 20:23	Ngati mwakululukila machimo yamuntu aliense, azakhululukidwa; ndipo alionse  wamene simunakululukila machimo yake, yazasungika.
JHN 20:24	Thomasi, umozi wa bopunzila, woitaniwa Didimusi, sanalipo pamene Yesu anabwela.
JHN 20:25	Bena bophunzila  pa nthamwe  inangu anamuuza iye, "Tabaona Ambuye.'' Anakamba kwa iye, koma chabe nikaona mu'manja yake navibala vamisomali, na ku yika manja yanga pa vibala va misomali, nakufaka manja yanga kumbali yake, ndiye pamene nizakupilila.''
JHN 20:26	Panapita masiku eyiti (8) bophunzila bake banali mukati na futi, ndipo Tomasi  anali nabo. Yesu ana bwela ninshi chiseko nicho valindwa, anayimilila pakati kao nakunena ati, "Mutendere unkale nainu."
JHN 20:27	Ndipo analankula kuli Thomasi,'' Fikiza pano vikumo vako, ndipo uzaona manja yanga, fikisa kwanja kwako uyike kumbali yanga, usankhale wosa khulupilirila koma wokhulupilila.
JHN 20:28	Thomasi anayanka nokambaati kwaiye,''Ambuye wanga ndi Mulungu wanga.''
JHN 20:29	Yesu anakamba kwa iye ati, "Chifukwa waniona wakulupilila. Wodala ndi  wonsa amene sananione koma  akhulupilila."
JHN 20:30	Manje Yesu anachita zizindikilo zambili pamaso pa bophunzila bake, zizindikilo zamene sizinalembedwa mubooku,
JHN 20:31	koma izi zalembedwa kuti mukulupilile ati Yesu ni Kristu, Mwana wa Mulungu, ndi kuti uka kulupilila, unkhale na moyo muzina yake.
JHN 21:0	Mutu 21
JHN 21:1	Pamene vinasila ivi vintu Yesu anaonekela nafuti kuli bopunzila bake pa mumana wa Tibelias. Iyi ndiye njila yamene anaonekela:
JHN 21:2	Simoni Petulo anali pamozi na Tomasi oitaniwa kuti Didimas, Nataniyeli ochokela ku Kana mu Galileya, bana ba Zebedi, na babili benangu bopunzila ba Yesu.
JHN 21:3	Simoni Petulo anakamba kuli beve kuti, "Niyenda kukasha nsomba." Banamu uza kuti, "Naise, kansi, tikukonka."Bana enda naku kwela mu bwato, koma sibana gwileko kali konse usiku onse.
JHN 21:4	Manje, pamene kunali kuseni-seni kudala, Yesu anaimilila ku mbali kwa mumana, koma opunzila bake sibana zibe kuti ni Yesu.
JHN 21:5	Yesu anakamba nabo kuti, "Imwe bafana, nanga muli nacho cha kudya chili chonse?" Bana yanka nakumba kuti, "Iyayi."
JHN 21:6	Ana bauza kuti, "Ponyani nsumbo zanu ku zanja la manja kwa bwato, ndipo  muzapezako nsomba." Bana ponya nsumbo yabo ndipo banakangiwa kui donsa chifukwa chakuti munali nsomba zambili maningi.
JHN 21:7	Ndipo uja opunzila wa Yesu wamene Yesu anali kumukonda anauza Petulo kuti, "Ni Ambuye." Pamene Simoni Petulo anamvela kuti banali niba Mbuye, anamangilila chovola chakunja (Chifukwa anali chintako), nakuziponya mu mumana.
JHN 21:8	Bopunzila baja benangu banabwela mu bwato (chifukwa sibanali kutali  na kunja kwa manzi, kulingana monga ma kilomita yali naini), banali kudonsa nsumbo yozula na nsomba.
JHN 21:9	Pamene banachoka kufika panja pa mumana, banaona mulilo wamalasha na nsomba zili pamulilo, na mukate.
