ACT 4:15	Koma pamene analamulila ma apostozi kuti acoke mu msokhano, banakambisana beke beke.
ACT 4:16	Anakamba kuti, tizacita bwanji na aba banthu? Ca zoona nicakuti codabwisa coonekelatu cacitika kupitila muli aba banthu bamene bankhala mu Yelusalemu; sitingacikane.
ACT 4:17	Koma kuti cisamveke maningi pakati pa banthu, tiyeni tibacenjeze kuti asakambenso na aliyense mu zina iyi."
ACT 4:18	Anaita Petulo na Yohane mukati nobalamulila kuti basakambenso kapena ku phunzisa mu zina la Yesu.
ACT 4:19	Koma Petulo na Yohane anayankha nokamba kwa beve, "Ngati nicabwino mumeso ya Mulungu kumvelela imwe kupambana Mulungu, weluzani.
ACT 4:20	Sitingakwanise kuleka kukamba pavinthu vamene taona nakumvela."
ACT 4:21	Pobacenjezanso Petulo na Yohane, babatailila. Sibanapeze cifukwa camene angabapasile cilango, cifukwa banthu bonse benzo tamanda Mulungu pavamene vinacitika.
ACT 4:22	Mudala uja analandila milako yocilisiwa enze nazaka zopitilila 40.
ACT 4:23	Pamene banabamasula, Petulo na Yohane anabwelela kuli banthu bawo nobauza vonse vamene akulu ansembe na akulu anabauza beve.
ACT 4:24	Pamene banavela ici, banapunda pamozi kwa Mulungu nokamba, "Ambuye, imwe wamene anapanga kumwamba na pansi, na mumana, navonse vamene vilimo,
ACT 4:25	imwe wamene mwa Mzimu Oyela, mwa mukamwa mwa atate bathu Davide kapolo wanu, anakamba, 'Nicifukwa nicani vialo va akunja akalipa, nakuti banthu aganiza vinthu vilibe nchito?
ACT 4:26	Mafumu yapaziko bazifaka pamozi, nabolamulila bakumana pamozi kusushana na Ambuye, na Kristu wake.'
ACT 4:27	Zoona, Herode na Pontiasi Pilato, pamozi na akunja na banthu ba Israeli, banakumana pamozi mutauni ino kusushana Yesu kapolo wanu oyela, wamene munazoza.
ACT 4:28	Banakumana pamozi kucita zonse zamene kwanja kwanu nakufuna kwanu kunafuna kuti kucitike.
ACT 4:29	Manje, Ambuye, onani cenjezo yabo ndipo mupase bakapolo banu kukamba mau anu namphamvu zonse.
ACT 4:30	Kuti pamene mutambasula kwanja kwanu kuti mucilise, masaini na vodabwisa vingacitke kupitila muzina la Yesu kapolo wanu oyela."
ACT 4:31	Pamene banasiliza kupemphela, pamalo pamene banakumana pamozi panagwendezeka, ndipo bonse banazuzhiwa na Muzimu Oyela, ndipo banakamba mau ya Mulungu na mphamvu.
ACT 4:32	Namba ya banthu bambili bamene anakhulupilla benzeli na mtima na maganizo amozi: ndipo penzelibe nangu munthu umozi wamene anakamba kuti katundu wamene analibo wenzeli wake wake, mumalo mwake, banagabana wina na muzake.
ACT 4:33	Namphamvu zambili ma apostoli benzo kamba za umboni wabo pa kuuka kwa Ambuye Yesu, ndipo cisomo cikulu cenzeli pali beve onse.
ACT 4:34	Kwenzelibe nangu munthu umozi pakati pabo wamene anasoba kanthu, cifukwa baja bamene enzili na malo na manyumba banayagulisa
ACT 4:35	noleta ndalama kucokela kuvamene banagulisa nozifaka pamendo yama apostoli. Ndipo kwezeli kupasa kuli okhulupilila aliyense, kulingana navamene enzofuna.
ACT 4:36	Yosefe, mu Levi, munthu ocokela ku Saipulasi anapasiwa zina Banabasi nama apostoli (yamene itanthauza kuti mwana wa cilimbikiso).
ACT 4:37	Yeve ponkhala namunda, anaugulisa noleta ndalama nozifaka pa mendo yama Apostoli.
ACT 5:0	Mutu 5
ACT 5:1	Manje munthu winangu zina lake Ananiasi, namukazi wake Saphira, anagulisa katundu wabo,
ACT 5:2	nosungako ndalama zinangu (nakuti mukazi izoziba pali ici), noletako zinangu nozifaka pamendo yama apostoli.
ACT 5:3	Koma Petulo anakamba ati, "Ananiyasi, cifukwa nicani Satana wazula mumtima wako kuti uname boza kwa Mzimu woyela nakuti usungepo ndalama inangu yamalo yamene wagulisa?
ACT 5:4	Pamene ukalibe kuyagulisa, kansi siyenzeli pansi paulamulilo wako? Cifukwa nicani waganiza pali ici mumtima mwako? Sunaname boza kubanthu, koma kuli Mulungu."
ACT 5:5	Pakumvela mau aya, Ananiyasi anagwa pansi nopeme kalasti. Ndipo mantha yakulu yanafika pali onse bamene banamvela izi.
ACT 5:6	Banyamata banabwela pasogolo nobwela umupomba, nobwelwela kumunyamula noyenda kumushika.
ACT 5:7	Pamene panapita 3 hours, mkazi wake anabwela, sanazibe camene cinabwela cacitika.
ACT 5:8	Petulo anakamba kwa yeve, "Niuza ngati munagulisa malo pa mtengo wa so." Anabwela akamba, "Eye, pamtengo wa so."
ACT 5:9	Pamene apo Petulo anabwela akamba kwa yeve ati, Cifukwa nicani mwangwilizana kuti muyese Mzimu wa Ambuye? Ona, mendo yabaja bamene ashika ba muna bako yali paciseko, ndipo bazakunyamula panja naiwe."
ACT 5:10	Pamene apo anabwela anagwela pamendo pake, nobwelo peme ka lasti, banyamata banangena nobwela kumupeza wakufa; banamunyamula noyenda kumushika pafupi namwamuna wake.
ACT 5:11	Mantha yakulu yanabwela pa mupingo bonse, napali bonse bamene banamvela izi zinthu.
ACT 5:12	Vizindikilo na vodabwisa vambili vezocitika pa banthu kupitila mumanja yama apostoli. Benzeli bonse pamozi mu kholido ya Solomoni.
ACT 5:13	Koma kwenzelibe aliyense enzeli olimbikila kuti abajoine, koma banabapasa ulemu banthu.
ACT 5:14	Nangu cenzeli so, bokhulupila benzo bwelelapo kwa Ambuye,  bamuna na bakazi bambili,
ACT 5:15	paka benzo nyamula nabodwala mumiseu nobagoneka pama bedi napama cila, kuti pamene Petulo anabwela, cimvwili-mvwila cake cingagwele pali bena ba iwo.
ACT 5:16	Kunabwela futi banthu bambili kucoka kuma tauni yozungulila Yelusalemu, kubwelesa odwala nabonse bovutikila na vibanda voipa, ndipo bonse banacilisiwa.
ACT 5:17	Koma mukulu wa asembe ananyamuka, nabonse benzeli na yeve (yamene nigulu yama saduki); benzeli anakhala na jelasi
ACT 5:18	ndipo banagwila ma apostoli nobamanga nobafaka mundende za banthu bonse.
ACT 5:19	Koma panthawi ya usiku mu ngelo wa Ambuye anasegula viseko vamundende nobacosa panja, nobauza ati,
ACT 5:20	"Yendani mukaimilile mu tempele nokamba kubanthu mau yonse ya umoyo uyu."
ACT 5:21	Pamene banamvela izi, banangena mu tempele camumawa ndipo anaphunzisa. Koma mukulu wa asembe anabwela, nabanja enzeli nayeve, noitanisa musonkhano pa mozi, bonse bakulu ba banthu baku Israyeli, nobatuma ku ndende kuti babwelese ma apostoli.
ACT 5:22	Koma ma ofisazi bamene anatumiwa sanabapezemo mu ndende, ndipo banabwelela nopeleka repoti,
ACT 5:23	"Napeza ndende niyokhomewa bwino ndipo magadi oyimilila pa ciseko, koma pamene tinasegula, tinapeza mulibe munthu mukati."
ACT 5:24	Manje pamene kaputeni wamu tempele na mukulu wa asembe banamvela mau aya, banadabwa maningi naveve pazamene zinacitika.
ACT 5:25	Ndipo winangu anabwela abauza, "Bamuna bamene munafaka mundende ayimilila mu tempele ndipo aphunzisa anthu."
ACT 5:26	Ndipo kaputeni anayenda nama ofisazi, nowabwelesa, kulibe viongo, cifukwa cakuti banayopa kuti anthu angabateme miala.
ACT 5:27	Pamene banababwelesa, banaba nkhazika pali pa khanso. Mkulu wa asembe anabafunsa beve,
ACT 5:28	kukamba kuti, "Tinakulamulilani maningi kuti musaphunzise muzina iyi, ndipo manje, mwazuzya Yelusalemu naziphunziso zanu, ndipo mufuna kuleta mwazi wa uyu munthu pa ise."
ACT 5:29	Koma Petulo nama apostozi wanayankha, "Tifunika kumvelela Mulungu kupambana banthu.
ACT 5:30	Mulungu waba tate bathu anamuusha Yesu, wamene munapaya pakumupacika pamtengo.
ACT 5:31	Mulungu anamukweza yeve kukwanja kwake kwa manja kunkhala mwana wa mfumu na mupulumusi, kupasa kutembenuka kuli Israyeli, naku khululukiwa kwa macimo.
ACT 5:32	Ndise mboni pali ivi vinthu, cimozi-mozi na Muzimu Oyela, wamene Mulungu anapasa kuli baja bamene amumvelela iye."
ACT 5:33	Pamene ba khaso banamvela izi, banakalipa ndipo banafuna kupaya ma apostozi.
ACT 5:34	Koma mfarisi zina yake Gamaliyeli, mphunzisi wama lamulo, wamene enze olemekezeka na banthu wonse, ananyamuka nolamulila kuti ma apostozi bapelekewe panja pakanthawi kang'ono.
ACT 5:35	Ndipo anakamba kwa beve, " Ba muna ba Israyeli, mvesesani pazamene mukamba kucita kuli aba banthu.
ACT 5:36	Panthawi yapita iyi, Teudasi ananyamuka nokamba kuti anali munthu wapandela, ndipo amuna ambiri, okwanila ngati 400 anamujoina iye. Anapaiwa, ndipo bonse benzomumvelela banamwazikana, nosililatu.
ACT 5:37	Pamene anacoka uyu munthu, Yudasi waku Galileya ananyamuka pamasiku ya cibelengelo ndipo anadonsa banthu kukonkha yeve. Nayeve anaonongeka, nabonse benzo mumvelela banamwazikana.
ACT 5:38	Manje nikamba kwa imwe, nkhalani kutali na aba banthu ndipo basiyeni, ngati iyi plani kapena nchito niya banthu, izagonjesewa.
ACT 5:39	Koma ngati niya Mulungu, simuzakwanisa kubagonjesa; mungapeze kuti mwina mumenyana na Mulungu." Pamene apo anamvelela.
ACT 5:40	Pamene apo anabaitana ma apostozi kuti bangene nobamenya nobalamulila kuti basakambe futi muzina la Yesu, nobwelo batailila.
ACT 5:41	Banacoka ku khanso wosangalala kuti banabelengelewa boyenela kuvesewa nsoni cifukwa ca Zina.
ACT 5:42	Pambuyo pake siku na siku, mu tempele ndipo kucoka kunyumba noyenda nyumba kwinangu, banapitiliza kuphunzisa nolalikila Yesu kunkhala Kristu.
ACT 6:0	Mutu 6
ACT 6:1	Manje mumasiku ayo, pamene namba ya ophunzila yenzo pakilako, dandaulo kucokela kuli Ayuda baku Gilisi anayamba kusushana na Aheberi, cifukwa akamukafilwa babo bacikazi benzo bapitilila mukagabidwa ka zakudya za siku na siku
ACT 6:2	Bali 12 (Ma apostozi) anaitana gulupu ya ophunzila kuti abwele kuli beve ndipo anakamba, "Sikwabwino kuti ise tileke mau ya Mulungu kuti tiyambe kugaba vakudya.
ACT 6:3	Mufunika musankhe, abale, amuna bali 7 pakati panu, amuna bali na mbili yabwino, ozula na Mzimu na nzeru, bamene tizasankha pali iyi nchito.
ACT 6:4	Kwa ise, tizapitiliza muma pemphelo namu utumiki wa mau."
ACT 6:5	Kukamba kwao kuna kondwelesa gulupu yonse. So banasankha Stefano, mwamuna ozula nacikhulupililo na Mzimu Oyela, na Filipo, Prokoro, Nikanora, Timoni, Parmena na Nikolasi wosinthika wocokela ku Antioku.
ACT 6:6	Okhulupilila anabwelesa aba banthu kuli ma apostozi, wamene anapemphela noika manja yao pali beve.
ACT 6:7	So mau aMulungu yanayenda patali; ndipo namba ya ophunzila inapaka maningi mu Yelusalemu; ndipo namba ikulu ya asembe banankala osatila cikhulupililo.
ACT 6:8	Manje Stefano, ozula na cisomo na mphamvu, enzo cita zodabwisa zikulu na zioneselo pakati pa banthu.
ACT 6:9	Koma kunanyamuka banthu benangu benze baku sinagoge yoitaniwa sinagoge banthu omasulidwa, baku Sailini na Alekizanda, ndipo benagu wocokela ku Silisia na Azia. Aba banthu benzo cita musano na Stefano.
ACT 6:10	Koma sibanakwanise kusushana na nzeru na Mzimu wamene Stefano anakamba.
ACT 6:11	So mwacisinsi banagomjesa banthu benangu kuti bakambe kuti, "Tamvela Stefano kukamba manyozo kuli Mose na Mulungu."
ACT 6:12	Banatufya banthu, akulu, na alembi, ndipo aba banamufikila Stefano nomumanga nomuleta ku Khanso.
ACT 6:13	Banaleta mboni za boza, zamene zinakamba kuti, "Uyu munthu saleka kukamba mau yosusha aya malo oyela nalamulo.
ACT 6:14	Cifukwa ise tamumvela kukamba kuti uyu Yesu waku Nazareti azaononga aya malo nosintha myiambo ya Mose yamene yanapasiwa kwa ife."
ACT 6:15	Aliyense anakhala mu khanso anaika meso yeka pali yeve ndipo anaona kuti pa menso pake pali ngati pa menso pa mungelo.
ACT 7:0	Mutu 7
ACT 7:1	Mukulu wa asembe anakamba kuti, Kansi izi zinthu nizazoona?
ACT 7:2	Stefano anakamba kuti, "Abale naba tate onse, munivesese ine: Mulungu wa ulemelo anawonekel kuli batate bathu Abrahamu pamene enzeli ku Mesopotamia, pamene akalibe kukhala mu Harani;
ACT 7:3	anakamba kwa yeve, 'Siya malo yako na abululu bako, ndipo uyende kumalo yamene nizakuonesa.'
ACT 7:4	Ndipo anacoka pamalo ya Chaodiyanzi noyamba kunkhala mu Harani; kucoka apo, pamene atate bake anamwalila, Mulungu anamubwelesa mulalo aya, mwamene munkhala manje.
ACT 7:5	Sanapaseko malo yaliyonse kuli yeve, awe, ngankhale podyaka kwendo kwake. Koma analonjeza -ngankhale kuti Abrahamu analibe mwana -wamene angapase malo ngati katundu wake nabazukulu bake.
ACT 7:6	Mulungu enzo kamba nayeve socabe, kuti bazukulu bake azankhala pakanthawi muziko labene, nakuti bamene bankhalamo bazabapeleka mu ukapolo nobanzunza maningi zaka zili 400.
ACT 7:7	Ndipo nizaweluza ziko yamene bazankhalamo mu ukapolo,' Mulungu anakamba, ndipo vikasila ivi bazacokamo ndipo bazanipembeza ine mu malo yano.'
ACT 7:8	Ndipo anapasa Abrahamu pangano ya mdulidwe, so Abrahamu anankhala tate wake wa Isaki nomucita mdulidwe pasiku ya namba 8; Isaki anakhala tate bake wa Yakobo, naYakobo tate bake wabana bali 12
ACT 7:9	Banali bali 12 banamucitila jelasi Yosefe nomugulisa ku Egypto, ndipo Mulungu enze nayeve,
ACT 7:10	nomucosa kumabvuto yake yonse, nomupasa cisomo na nzeru pamenso ya Farao, mfumu ya Egypto. Farao pamene apo anamupanga kunkhala gavana wa Egypto napanyumba pake ponse.
ACT 7:11	Ndipo kunabwela njala pali ponse mu Egypto namu Kenani, namabvuto yakulu ndipobazitate bathu sibana peze vakudya.
ACT 7:12	Koma pame Yakobo anamvela kuti kuli vakudya ku Egypto, anatuma makolo bathu nthawi yoyamba.
ACT 7:13	Nthawi yacibili Yosefe anazibonesela kuli ba bale bake; ndipo banja ya Yosefe inazibika kuli Farao.
ACT 7:14	Yosefe anatuma abale bake kuti abwelele kuti akauze Yakobo atate bake kuti babwele ku Egypto, pamozi nababululu bake bonse, banthu 75 pamozi.
ACT 7:15	So Yakobo anayenda ku Egypto, ndipo anamwalila, yeve namakolo yathu.
ACT 7:16	Banabapeleka ku Shekemu nobaika mu manda yamene Abrahamu anagula namutengo wa siliva kucokela ku bana ba muna ba Hama ku Shekemu.
ACT 7:17	Pamene nthawi yalonjezo inafika, lonjezo yamene Mulungu anapasa Abrahamu, banthu banakula nopaka mu Egypto,
ACT 7:18	paka mfumu inangu inayamba kulamulila mu Egypto, mfumu yamene sinazibe za Yosefe.
ACT 7:19	Mfumu yame iyi ina namiza banthu bathu nozunza makolo yanthu maningi, banapeleka bana babo kuciopyezo, kuyembekezela kuti bazapulumuka.
ACT 7:20	Panthawi iyo nishi Mose wabadwa; enze okongolla pamenso ya Mulungu ndipo banamusamalila mwezi itatu munyumba ya atate bake.
ACT 7:21	Pamene banamutulusa panja, mwana mukazi wa Farao anamutenga nomukulisa ngati mwana wake.
ACT 7:22	Mose anaphunzira maphunziro yonse yaku Egypto; ndipo enze wamphamvu mu mau na zinchito zake.
ACT 7:23	Koma pamene anakwanisa zaka 40, ananganiza mu mtima mwake kuti ayendele abale bake, bana ba Israyeli.
ACT 7:24	Pakuona mu Israyeli anzunziwa, Mose anamuteteza iye nomubwezelako uja wamene anazunziwa pakumenya waku Egypto:
ACT 7:25	ananganiza kuti abale bake azamvesesa kuti Mulungu kupyolela kukwanja kwake enzo bapulumusa, koma sibanamvesese.
ACT 7:26	Pasiku yokonkhapo anabwela kuli ma Israyeli pamene benzo yambana; anayesesa kunkhazikisa mtendere pakati pao; nokamba ati, 'Azibambo, ndimwe paubululu; nicifukwa nicani muwonongana?'
ACT 7:27	Koma uja analakwila muzake anamukankha, nokamba ati, wakupanga kunkhala olamulila nawoweluza pali ise nindani?
ACT 7:28	Ufuna unipaye mwamene unapayila waku Egypto mailo?
ACT 7:29	Mose anathaba pamene anamvela izi; anankhala mulendo muziko ya Midiani, kwamene anankhala tate wa bana amuna abili.
ACT 7:30	Pamene zaka 40 zinasila, mungelo anabonekela kwa yeve mucipululu ca Lupili ya Sinai, mucisamba coyaka mulilo.
ACT 7:31	Pamene Mose anabona mulilo, anadabwa pazamene anabona; ndipo pamene anafendela kuti abonesese, munacoka mau ya Ambuye, kunena,
ACT 7:32	Ndine Mulungu waba tate bako, Mulungu wa Abrahamu, na Isaki, na Yakobo.' Mose ananjenjeme ndipo sanafune futi kuyanganako.
ACT 7:33	Ambuye anakamba kwa yeve ati, Bvula sapato zako, cifukwa malo yamene waimililapo nimalo yoyela.
ACT 7:34	Nabonesesa maningi kuvutika kwa banthu banga mu Egypto; namvela kulila kwao, nabwela pansi kuzaba pulumusa; manje bwela nizakutuma ku Egypto.'
ACT 7:35	Uyu Mose wamene anakana, pamene anakamba ati, ' Nindani wamene anakupanga ulamulila na uweluza?' -ndiye wamene Mulungu anatuma monga oweluza na omasula. Mulungu anamutuma nakwanja kwa mngelo wamene anabonekela kuli Mose mumatepo.
ACT 7:36	Mose anabasogolela kuwacosa mu Egypto, pambuyo po cita zodabwisa nazi zindikilo mu Egypto napa Mumana wa Matete, namucipululu munthawi ya zaka 40.
ACT 7:37	Ni Mose wamene uyo wamene anakamba ku banthu ba Israyeli, 'Mulungu azanyamula mneneri pakati pa abale wanu, mneneri monga ine.'
ACT 7:38	Uyu ndiye munthu wamene enzeli pa gulu mucipululu na mngero wamene anakamba naye Palupili ya Sinai. Uyu ndiye munthu wamene anali na azitate bathu; uyu ndiye munthu wamene analandila mau ya moyo kuti atipase ife.
ACT 7:39	Uyu ndiye munthu wamene azitate bathu anakana kumumverela; anamukankhila patali kucoka kuli beve, ndipo kuti mumitima yabo banabwelela ku Egypto.
ACT 7:40	Pali nthawi iyo banakamba kuli Aroni, 'Tipangile milungungu yamene izatisongolela. Cifukwa pali uyu Mose, wamene anatisogolela kucoka mu malo ya Egypto, sitiziba camene cacitika kuli yeve.
ACT 7:41	So banapanga ng'ombe mumasiku ayo noleta sembe kuli mafano, nosangalala cifukwa ca nchito za manja yabo.
ACT 7:42	Koma Mulungu anaba pindimukila nobalekelela kuti bapembeze nthandala ku mwamba, monga cinalembwa mu buku ya aneneri, 'Kansi munapeleka kwa ine nyama zakufa na nsembe zaka zili 40 mucipululu, nyumba ya Israyeli?
ACT 7:43	Munalandila tenti ya Moleki na ntandala za mulungu Refani, na vithunzi-thunzi vamene munapanga kuti muvipembeze: ndipo nizakuperekani kutali kupitilila Babiloni.'
ACT 7:44	Azitate bathubenze na tenti ya umboni mucipululu, monga mwamene Mulungu analamulila pamene anakamba na Mose, kuti ayipange monga patani yamene anaonapo.
ACT 7:45	Iyi ndiye tenti yamene azitate bathu, pobwelela kwabo, yamene anabwelelsa kumalo pamozi na Yoshua. Ici cinacitika pamene analoba mukutenga malo yamene Mulungu anacosa pameso pa azitate bathu. Cinali socabe kufikila nthawi ya Davide,
ACT 7:46	wamene anapeza cisomo mumeso ya Mulungu; anapempha kuti apeze malo okhalamo kwa Mulungu wa Yakobo.
ACT 7:47	Koma Solomoni anamangila Mulungu Nyumba.
ACT 7:48	Koma Olemekezeka sankhala munyumba zo pangidwa namanja; cili monga mwamene muneneri anenela,
ACT 7:49	'Kumwamba nipando wanga wacimfumu, pansi nipoponda mendo yanga. Kansi ni nyumba yabwanji yamene mungamangile ine? akamba Ambuye: olo yalikuti malo yopumulila yanga?
ACT 7:50	Kansi simanja yanga anapanga zonse izi?'
ACT 7:51	Imwe banthu amene muli oyuma na bosadulidwa mu mtima na mumatu, nthawi zonse mukana Muzimu Oyela; mucita mwamene azitate banu anacitila.
ACT 7:52	Nibati aneneri bamene azitate banu sibananzunze? Banapaya aneneri bamene anabwelelatu pamene Olungama sanabwele; ndipo manje mwankhala opacika na wopaya yeve futi,
ACT 7:53	imwe banthu amene analndila lamulo yamene angelo anankhazikisa, koma simunaisunge."
ACT 7:54	Manje pamene ma membala ba khanso banamvela izi, banakhuziwa ku mtima, ndipo banamulumila meno Stefano.
ACT 7:55	Koma yeve kunkhala ozula na Mzimu Oyela, anayanganisisa kumwamba nowona ulemelo wa Mulungu; ndipo anaona Yesu oyimilila kukwanja kwa rayiti kwa Mulungu.
ACT 7:56	Stefano anakamba ati, "Onani, niwona kumwamba koseguka, ndipo Mwana Mwamuna wa Munthu oyimilila kukwanja kwa rayiti kwa Mulungu,"
ACT 7:57	Koma ma membara ya khanso yanapunda maningi, noleka kumvera, nothamangila pali yeve pamozi;
ACT 7:58	banamuponya panja pa tauni nomutema miala: ndipo wotambako banafaka vovala vabo vakunja pali munyamata oyitaniwa Sauli.
ACT 7:59	Pamene benzo mutema miala Stefano, anapitiliza kuitana Ambuye kukamba kuti, "Ambuye Yesu, landilani mzimu wanga."
ACT 7:60	Anagwada pansi nobwela kuitana maningi, "Ambuye, musasunge cimo iyi kuli beve." Pamene anakamba ivi, anamwalila.
ACT 8:0	Mutu 8
ACT 8:1	Sauli anavomelezana nayo ifa yake. So mpingo unali ku Yelusame unayamba kusausidwa kwakukulu siku yamene iyo; ndipo okhulupirila anamwazikana ponse ponse kumizinda ya Yudeya na Samaria, kucoselako ma apostozi.
ACT 8:2	Amuna ozipileka anamushika Stefano ndipo anamulila maningi yeve.
ACT 8:3	Koma Saulo ananzunza mpingo maningi; anayenda nyumba na nyumba nodosa amuna na akazi, nobafaka mu jele.
ACT 8:4	Koma okhulupilila amene anamwazikana anapitana-pita kulalikila mau.
ACT 8:5	Filipo anayenda ku tauni ya Samaria nobalalikila beve Kristu.
ACT 8:6	Pamene banthu bambiri banamvera nowona vizindikilo vamene Filipo anacita, banafakako nzelu pamozi kuzamene enzokamba.
ACT 8:7	Cikufakwa kucoka kubanthu ambili amene anali navo, mizimu yonyansa inacoka mopunda maningi; ndipo bambili ozizila nabolemala mendo anacilisiwa.
ACT 8:8	Ndipo mwenzeli cisangalalo cikulu mu tauni.
ACT 8:9	Koma mwenzeli munthu winangu mu tauni zina lake ni Simoni, wamene kumbuyo inzo citata vaufwiti; enzo badabwisa banthu baku Samaria, pamene enzo kamba kuti nimunthu ofunikila maningi.
ACT 8:10	Ba Samaria bonse, kucokela kumwana kufikila mukulu, enzno mufakila nzeru yeve; anakamba, "Uyu munthu ndiye ija mphambu ya Mulungu yamene iyitaniwa kuti Yaikulu."
ACT 8:11	Anamumvelera yeve, cifukwa cakuti anabadabwisayeve kwa nthawi kwa nthawi itali na ufwiti ake.
ACT 8:12	Koma pamene banakhulupila Filipo pazamene analalikila pa uthenga okamba paza ufumu wa Mulungu na zina ya Yesu Krsitu, anabatizika, amuna nabazimai nabo.
ACT 8:13	Ndipo Simoni nayeve anakhulupilila, anapitiliza kunkala na Filipo; pamene anabona visanzo na zocita zikulu kucitika, anadabwa.
ACT 8:14	Manje pamene ma apostozi banamvera kuti Samaria inalandila mau amulungu, anabatumizila Peturo na Yohane.
ACT 8:15	Pamene banabwela, anabapemphelera , kuti alandile Mzimu Oyela.
ACT 8:16	Cifukwa kufikila ija nthawi, Mzimu Oyela enze akalibe kubwela pali aliyense wa beve; benze banapatizika cabe mu zina la Ambuye Yesu.
ACT 8:17	Pamene apo Peturo na Yohane anafaka manja yabo pali beve, ndipo analandila Mzimu Oyela
ACT 8:18	Manje pamene simoni anabona kuti Mzimu Oyea wapaswa kupitila mukuikapo manja yama apostozoi, anabwela abapasa ndalama.
ACT 8:19	Anabwela akamba ati "Ninepaseni izi mphamvu, naine, kuti aliyense wamene nizafakaka manja yanga payeve azalandil a Mzimu Oyela."
ACT 8:20	Koma Peturo anakamba kwa yeve, leka siliva yako ibonongeke pamozi naiwe, cifukwa waganiza kuti ungalandile mphaso ya Mulungu nandalama.
ACT 8:21	Ulibe mbali pali ici, cifukwa mtimwa wako sulibwino na Mulungu.
ACT 8:22	Cifukwa caici tembenuka kuzoipa zako, ndipo upemphere kwa Ambuye, kuti mwina akukhululukile manganizo umumtima mwako.
ACT 8:23	Cifukwa nabona kuti uli mu poisoni yalukhubwa ndi maunyolo ya ucimo."
ACT 8:24	Simoni anayankha nokamba ati, Nipempherele kwa Ambuye, kuti visacitike kwa ine pavamene wakamba."
ACT 8:25	Pamene Petro na Yohane anankhala na umboni nokamba mau ya Ambuye, anabwelela ku Yelusalemu; penzo yenda munjira, analalikila uthenga ku minzi yambili ya Asamaria.
ACT 8:26	Manje mungelo wa Ambuye anakamba na Filipo kuti, "Nyamuka ndipo uyende kumazulo ku njila yamene icokela ku Yelusalemu kuyenda ku Gza." (Iyi njila ili mucipululu.)
ACT 8:27	Ananyamuka noyenda. Onani apo, kunali munthu ocokela ku  Ethiopia, olemekezeka wamene anali naulamulilo ukulu kuli mafumu, mkazi wa mfumu yama Ethiopians. Ndiye enzeli osunga ndalama za mkazi wa mfumu. Enzeli anabwela ku Yelusalemu kumbela ku pembeza.
ACT 8:28	Enzo bwelelamo nishi wankhala mucikocikali,  ndipo enzo belenga mneneri Yesaya.
ACT 8:29	Mzimu unakamba kuti kwa Filipo, "Yenda pafupi nokhala pafupi na cikocikali."
ACT 8:30	So Filipo anathamangila kuli yeve, nomumvera abalenga Yesaya mneneri, ndipo anakamba ati, "Kansi umvela vamene ubelenga?"
ACT 8:31	Mu Ethiopian anakamba ati, Ningamvele bwanji, koma kapena winangu anisogolele?" Anapempha Filipo kuti angene mucikocikali nonkhala nayeve.
ACT 8:32	Manje ndime ya mau yenzo belenga mu Ethiopian yenze iyi, "Anapelekewa ngati mberere kuyenda upaiwa; monga mwana wa mberere akhalila zii kuli uja wamene agela usako wake, sasegula pakamwa:
ACT 8:33	Mukumupepusa ciweluzilo cake wacicosa: azakamba zamubado wake nindani? cifukwa umoyo wake unacosewa pa ziko lapansi."
ACT 8:34	So uyu olemekezeka anafunsa Filipo, nokamba ati, nikupempha, nindani wamene mneneri akamba? Akamba zayeve olo munthu winangu?"
ACT 8:35	Filipo anayamba kukamba; anayamba na mau yali mu Yesaya kulalikila pali Yesu kuli Yeve.
ACT 8:36	Pamene anapitiliza kuyenda mnjila, anafika panali manzi; wolemekezeka anakamba ati, Ona pali manzi apa; cizanilesa kubatizika nicani?"
ACT 8:37	(Filipo anakamba ati, ngati ukhulupilila na mtima wako bonse, ungabatiziwe." Olemekezeka anakamba ati, "Nikhulupilila kuti Yesu Kristu nimwana mwamuna wa Mulungu.")
ACT 8:38	So mu Ethiopian analamulila kuti cikocikali kuti ci imilile. Banayenda mu manzi, bonse babili Filipo na wolemekezeka, ndipo Filipo anamubatiza yeve.
ACT 8:39	Pamene banacoka mu manzi, Mzimu wa Ambuye unamutenga Filipo; wolemekezeka sanauone futi, ndipo anapitiliza na ulendo wake wosangalala.
ACT 8:40	Koma Filipo anabonekela ku Azotasi. Anapitila ku mzinda wamene uja nolalikila uthenga kuma tauni yonse, mpaka anafika ku Sizalia.
ACT 9:0	Mutu 9
ACT 9:1	Koma Sauli, akali kuyofya zopaya ophunzira ba Ambuye,  anayenda kwa akulu asembe
ACT 9:2	nomupempha makala yakuma sinagoge mu Damasiko, kuti ngati wapeza wina aliyense olondola Njira ya Chikristu, amena kapena azimai, ababwelese omangiwa ku Yelusalemu.
ACT 9:3	Pamene enzo yenda, cinacitika kuti pamene anafika pa fupi na Damasiko, mwazizi kunabonekela pali yeve laiti kucoka ku mwamba;
ACT 9:4	ndipo anagwa pansi novela mau kukamba kuti, "Sauli, Sauli, cifukwa nicani unisausa ine?"
ACT 9:5	Sauli anayankha ati, "Ndimwe ndani, Ambuye? Ambuye anamuyankha ati, Ndine Yesu wamene usausa;
ACT 9:6	koma nyamuka ngena mu tauni, uzauziwa vamene ufunika kucita."
ACT 9:7	Bamuna banali nayeve anlibe cokamba, kumvela mau, koma osaona aliyense.
ACT 9:8	Sauli ananyamuka pansi, ndipo pamene anasegula menso, kulibe cili conse camene anaona; so banamugwila pa kwanja nomuleta mu Damasiko.
ACT 9:9	Pamasiku yatatu senzoona, ndipo sadye kapena kumwa kali konse.
ACT 9:10	Manje kunali ophunzira mu Damasiko zina lake Ananiya; ndipo Ambuye anakamba nayeve mu maso mphenya, "Ananiya." Ndipo anakamba ati, " Onani, Nilipano Ambuye."
ACT 9:11	Ambuye anakamba nayeve, "Nyamuka, ndipo yenda munjila yamene iyitaniwa kuti Siteleti, ndipo pa nyumba ya Yudasi akafunse kuti ufuna mwamuna wamene acoka ku Tasasi oyitanidwa Sauli; cifukwa ali kupemphera;
ACT 9:12	ndipo awona maso mphenya ya munthu zina lake ni Ananiya kubwela noyika manja pa iye, kuti ayangane futi."
ACT 9:13	Koma ananiya anayankha, "Ambuye, nemvera kuli ambili pali uyu munthu, kuwononga kwamene awononga ku banthu oyela ali ku Yelusalemu.
ACT 9:14	Ali na mphamvu kucoka kuli mkulu wa nsembe kuti amange aliyense wamene ayitana pa zina lanu."
ACT 9:15	Koma Ambuye anakamba ati kuli yeve, "Enda, cifukwa nicosebenzela canga co sankhika, kunyamula zina langa kuli akunja na mafumu na bana ba Israyeli;
ACT 9:16	cifukwa nizamubonesa mwamene afunika ku vutisiwa cifukwa ca zina langa."
ACT 9:17	So Ananiya anayenda, noloba munyumba. Pakuika manja yake pali yeve, anakamba ati, "Mubale Paul, Ambuye Yesu, wamene anabonekela kuli iwe pa njila pamene wenzobwela, anituma kuti uyangana futi ndipo ulandila Mzimu Oyela."
ACT 9:18	Pamene apo vinthu monga mamba vinacoka kucoka mu menso ya Sauli, ndipo anayangana; ananyamuka ndipo anabatizika;
ACT 9:19	ndipo anadya nonkhala na mphamvu. Anankala na omphunzira ku Damasiko pama siku ambili.
ACT 9:20	Pa nthawi yamene iyo analalikila za Yesu mumasinagoge, kukamba kuti iye nimwana mwamuna wa Mulungu.
ACT 9:21	Bonse bamene anamumvela banadabwa nokamba kuti, " Kansi siuja wamene anabononga baja wamene anaitana pali iyi Zina? Ndipo abwela kuno kuti ababwelese womangidwa kuli mukulu wa nsembe."
ACT 9:22	Koma Sauli anankhala maningi namphamvu, ndipo analeta vuto pali ba Yuda amene enzo nkhala mu Damasiko pakuwasimikizila kuti Jesu ni Kristu.
ACT 9:23	Pamene panapita masiku ambili, Ayuda anapanga zakuti ba mupaye yeve.
ACT 9:24	Koma plani yabo inazibika kuli Sauli. Banayanganila pa geti usiku na muzuba nausiku kuti bamupaye.
ACT 9:25	Koma ophunzira bake banamutenga usiku nomupitisa kucipupa, kumupeleka pansi mu basiketi.
ACT 9:26	Pamene anabwela ku Yelusalemu, Sauli anayesa kujoina ophunzira, koma bonse banamuyopa yeve, sabanakhulupilile kuti enzeli ophunzila.
ACT 9:27	Koma Banabasi anamutenga nomupeleka kuli ma apostozi. Ndipo anabauza mwamene Sauli anabonele Ambuye pa njila nakuti Ambuye anakamba nayeve, namwamene Sauli analalikilila mwamphamvu muzina la Yesu ku Damasiko.
ACT 9:28	Anayenda nayeve pamene benzongena nocoka mu Yelusalemu. Anakamba mwamphamvu muzina la Ambuye Yesu
ACT 9:29	nokambilana na aYuda aCigiliki; koma banapitiliza kufuna kumupaya.
ACT 9:30	Pamene abale banaziba pali ici, banamupeleka ku Sizelia nomutuma ku Tasisi.
ACT 9:31	So manje, mupingo monse mu Judeya, mu Galileya, mu unali namutendele ndipo unalimba; noyenda mukuyopa Ambuye ndiponso mucitonthozo ca Mzimu Oyela, mupingo unakula mu namba.
ACT 9:32	Manje cinabwela cacitika kuti, pamene Petro anapitamo muzinda bonse, anabwela kuli ba okhulupilila benzo nkhala mu tauni ya Lida.
ACT 9:33	Kuja anabwela apeza mwamuna winangu zina lake ni Aneyasi, wamene anali cigonele pabedi yake zaka 8, cifukwa enzeli olemala mendo.
ACT 9:34	Petro anakamba kwa yeve kuti, "Aneyasi, Yesu Kristu akucilisa iwe. Nyamuka noyanzula bedi yako." Ndipo pamene apo ananyamuka.
ACT 9:35	So aliyense wamene enzonkhala mu Lida namu Sharoni anamuona uja mwamuna ndipo anatembenukila kwa Ambuye.
ACT 9:36	Manje kwenzeli ophunzira winangu ku Yopa zinalake ni Tabita, yamene itanthauza "Dokasi." Uyu mzimayi enzeli maningi wazinchito zabwino na zacifundo zamene anacitila osauka.
ACT 9:37	Cinabwela cacitika kuti mumasiku ayo anadwala nomwalila; pamene banamusambika, banamugoneka mucipinda capamwamba.
ACT 9:38	Cifukwa cakuti Lida yenzeli pafupi na Jopa, nakuti ophunzila banamvera kuti Petro enzeli kwamene kuja, banatumako bamuna babili kuli yeve, kumupempha, bwela kuno mosawaya-waya."
ACT 9:39	Petro ananyamuka noyenda nabeve. Pamene anafika, banamupeleka mucipinda capamwamba. Ndipo wonse bazimayi ofedwa anayimilila pafupi nayeve nishi balila.
ACT 9:40	Petro anabacosa panja bonse, anagwada pansi, nopemphela; nobwela upindimukila kuli thupi, anakamba ati, "Tabita, nyamuka." Anasegula menso yake, ndipo pamene anaona Petro ananyamuka nonkhala.
ACT 9:41	Petro anamugwila kwanja nomunyamula; ndipo pamene anaitana okhulupilila na azimai ofedwa, nomupeleka kulibeve wamoyo.
ACT 9:42	Iyi nkhani inazibika mu Yopa monse, ndipo banthu bambili anakhulupila mwa Ambuye.
ACT 9:43	Cinabwela cacitika kuti Petro anakhala masiku ambiri mu Yopa na mwamuna ocedwa Simoni, bopanga vikumba.
ACT 10:0	Mutu 10
ACT 10:1	Manje kwanzeli mwamuna winangu mu tauni ya Sizelia, Koniliyasi zina lake, msilikali wamene enzo itanidwa msilikali waci Italiani.
ACT 10:2	Enze mwamuna ozipeleka, wamene anapempheza Mulungu na banja yake yonse; anapeleka ndalama zambili kuli banthu baci Yuda ndipo nthawi zonse kupempela kwa Mulungu.
ACT 10:3	Panthawi ya 3 koloko mumazulo, anaona bwino-bwino mumaso mphenya mngelo wa Mulungu kubwela kwa iye. Mngelo anakamba kwa eve,
ACT 10:4	"Koniliyasi!" Koniliyasi anayangana mngelo ndipo anayopa maningi nokamba ati, "Nicani, akulu?" Mngelo anakamba ati kwa yeve, "Mapemphelo yako napaso kuli osauka zayenda kumwamba monga sembe yokumbukilika kwa mu ulemelelo wa Mulungu.
ACT 10:5	Manje tuma wamuna ku tauni ya Yopa kuti wakabwelese mwamuna wocedwa Simoni oyitanidwa kuti Petro.
ACT 10:6	Ankhala na opanga vikumba ocedwa Simoni, wamene nyumba yake ili mumbali yamumana."
ACT 10:7	Pamene mngelo anakamba nayeve anayenda, Koniliyasi anaitana banchito bake bamunyumba babili, namusilikali wamene enzo pembeza Mulungu pakati pa asilikali bamene benzo musebenzela yeve.
ACT 10:8	Koniliyasi anababuza vamene vinacitika ndipo anabatuma ku Yopa.
ACT 10:9	Manje pasiku yokonkhapo panthawi ya 12 koloko, pamene benzeli pa ulendo wao nishi bankhala pang'ono kufika mu tauni, Petro anayenda pamwamba panyumba kuyenda kupemphera.
ACT 10:10	Abwela amvera njala ndipo ezno funana vamene angadye,  anpasiwa maso mphenya,
ACT 10:11	ndipo anaona kumwamba kwaseguka nakontena inangu kucoka kumwamba, cinthu cinangu monga cinyula cikulu kubwela pansi, colekelelewa namakona yake yali 4.
ACT 10:12	Muliceve mwenzili nyama zonse zosiyana siyana zamendo 4 navinthu voyenda pansi, nanyoni za mumwamba.
ACT 10:13	Pamene apo mau yanakamba nayeve: Nyamuka Petro, Paya nakudya."
ACT 10:14	Koma Petro anakamba ati, Osati so, Ambuye; cifukwa sininadyepo vinthu vilivonse vodesedwa."
ACT 10:15	Koma mau yanabwela kwa yeve futi kacibili: Camene Mulungu watubisa, osaciitana codesewa."
ACT 10:16	Ici cinacitika katatu; ndipo cikontena cinabwela cacosewapo pamene apo kubwelera kumwamba.
ACT 10:17	Manje pamene Petro enze akali osokonezeka camene masophenya yamene anaona camene yatanthauza, pamene apo, amuna bane Koniliyasi enze anatuma banimilila pa gate, nishi beze banafunsa njila yakunyumba.
ACT 10:18	Ndipo anaitana nofunsa ngati Simon , wamene enzoitainiwa Petro, ngati enzo nkhala paja.
ACT 10:19	Petro nishi akali kunganiza za maso mphenya, Mzimu anakamba nayeve, ona, bamuna batatu basakila iwe. (Mau inangu yakamba ati, "bamuna babili akusali." olo "bamuna benangu bakusakila").
ACT 10:20	Nyamuka ndipo uyende nabeve. Osawaya waya kuyenda nabeve, cifukwa nabatuma."
ACT 10:21	So Petro anayenda kuli baja bamuna nokamba ati, Ndine wamene musakali. Mwabwelera cani?"
ACT 10:22	Banakamba ati, Musilikali ocedwa Koniliyasi, munthu wangwilo ndipo wamene apembeza Mulungu, ndipo muntundu bonse waba Yuda ukamba zabwino za yeve, anauzidwa namungelo woyela wa Mulungu kuti ayitane iwe ubwele kunyumba kwake, kuti amvere uthenga kucokela kwa iwe."
ACT 10:23	So Petro anabaitana kuti bangena nonkhala nayeve. Pasiku yokonkhapo, ananyamuka noyenda nabeve, ndipo babale benangu kucoka ku Yopa anayenda nayeve.
ACT 10:24	Pasiku yokokhapo anafika ku Sizeliya. Koniliyasi enzo bayembekezela beve; enza anaitana banja lake pamozi nabazake maningi.
ACT 10:25	Cinabwela cacitika kuti pamene Petro anangena, Koniliyasi anakuma nayeve ndipo anamugwadila pamendo pake kuti amupembeze.
ACT 10:26	Koma Petro anamuthandiza kunyamuka, nukamba ati, "Nyamuka! Naine ndine munthu."
ACT 10:27	Pamene Petro enzo kamba nayeve, anangena nopeza banthu bambili basonkhana pamozi.
ACT 10:28	Anakamba nabeve, "Imwe mweka muziba kuti silamulo kuti munthu waci Yuda angayanjane nabo olo kuyendela munthu ocokela kuziko kwinangu. Koma Mulungu wanionesa kuti sinifunika kuitana munthu aliyense wodesedwa.
ACT 10:29	Cifukwa sinasushe pobwela, pamene ninatumiwa. So nikufunsa nicani camene waniitana ine."
ACT 10:30	Koniliyasi anakambaati, Masiku 4 yapita panthawi yamene ino, nenzo pemphera panthawi ya 3 koloko mumazulo munyumba mwanga; ndipo ona, munthu anaimilila pa maso panga mumalaya yowala.
ACT 10:31	Anakamba ati, 'Koniliyasi, pemphero yako yaveka kwa Mulungu, ndipo nsembe yako kuli osauka yakumbusa Mulungu pali iwe.
ACT 10:32	So tuma winangu ku Yopa, ndipo uyitana munthu ocedwa Simoni wamaene ayitaniwa kuti Petro. Ankhala munyumba ya wopanga vikumba ocedwa Simoni, mumbali yamumana.'
ACT 10:33	(Pamene apo ninakuitana. Ndiwe wabwino mtima kuti wabwela. Manje, tilipano tonse pamozi pamenso pa Mulungu, kuti timvele zonse zamene wauziwa na Ambuye kuti ukamba).
ACT 10:34	Pamene apo Petro anabvula kamwa kake  nokamba ati, "Zoonadi, naona kuti Mulungu satenga mbali yamuthu aliyense.
ACT 10:35	Mmalo mwake, muziko iliyi yonse aliyense wamene amupembeza nocita nchito zacilungamo nowolandiliwa kwa yeve.
ACT 10:36	Uziba uthenga wamene unatumiwa kuli banthu baku Israyeli, pamene ana naunsa za uthenga wabwino pazamutendele kupyiolela mwa Yesu Kristu, wamene ali Mbuye wa bonse -
ACT 10:37	imwe mweka muziba pazamene zinacitika, zamene zinacitaka mu Yudeya monse, kuyambila mu Galileya, utasila ubatizo wamene Yohane ana naunsa;
ACT 10:38	zocitika zokhuza Yesu waku Nazareti, mwamene Mulungu anamuzozela na Mzimu Oyela na mphamvu. Anayenda kucita zabwino nocilisa bonse benzeli opondelezedwa na satana, cifukwa Mulungu enzeli nayeve.
ACT 10:39	Ndise mboni pazonse zamene anacita muziko la Ayuda namu Yelusalemu -uyu Yesu wamene anapaya, pakumupacika pa mutengo.
ACT 10:40	Uyu munthu Mulungu anamubusha pasiku yanamba 3 nomupasa kuti azibike,
ACT 10:41	osati kubanthu bonse, koma kuli mboni zamene zinasankhika kale na Mulungu -ise bamene, wamene tinadya nakumwa naye pamene anauka kwa akufa.
ACT 10:42	Anatilamulila kuti tilalikile ku banthu nopelekela umboni kuti uyu ndiye wamene anasinkhiwa na Mulungu kunkhala oweluza bamoyo nabakufa.
ACT 10:43	Nikwayeve kwamene aneneri bonse apelekela umboni, kuti aliyense wamene akhulupilila muli yeve azalandila kukhululukiwa kwa macimo kupitila muzina yake.
ACT 10:44	Pamene Petro enze akali kukamba izi zinthu, Mzimu Oyela anagwela onse benzo mvelera ku uthenga wake.
ACT 10:45	Banthu bamene benze ku gulu ya mdulidwe ya okhulupilila -bonse baja banabwela na Petro -banadabwa, cifukwa mphaso ya Mzimu Oyela inathilidwa pali akunja.
ACT 10:46	Cifukwa banamvela aba bakunja kukamba vitundu vinangu noyamika Mulungu. Pamene apo Petro anayankha,
ACT 10:47	"Kansi kuli aliyense angalise manzi kuti aba banthu basabatizike, aba banthu bamene balandila Mzimu Oyela monga ise?"
ACT 10:48	Pamene apo analamulila kuti abatizike muzina la Yesu Kristu. Ndipo anamupempha kuti ankhale nabeve masiku yambili.
ACT 11:0	Mutu 11
ACT 11:1	Manje ma apostozi na abale benzeli mu Yudeya banamvela kuti ba Kunja nabeve balandila mau ya Mulungu.
ACT 11:2	Pamene Petro anabwela ku Yelusalemu, baja bamene benzeli ku gulu ya amudulidwe banamususha;
ACT 11:3	banakamba ati, unayanjana na banthu osadulidwa nakudya nabo!"
ACT 11:4	Koma Petro anayamba kubafotokozela nkhani yonse mufikapo; anakamba ati,
ACT 11:5	Nenzeli kupemphera ku tauni ya Yopa, ndipo nenzeli namaso mphenya pali contena ibwela pansi, monga cinyula cikulu kucokela kumwamba kubwela nama kona yake yali 4. Cinabwela kwa ine.
ACT 11:6	Ninayanganamo ndipo ninaganizilapo. Ninabona nyama zamendo yali 4 zili muziko, nyama zamusanga, nyama zokalaba pansi, na nyoni zamumwamba.
ACT 11:7	Ninamvera mau kukamba naine, "Myamuka, Petro; paya nakudya!"
ACT 11:8	Ninakamba ati, osati so, Lord: kulibe cosayela kapena codesedwa camene cinalowapo mukwamwa mwanga."
ACT 11:9	Koma mau yanayankha futi kucoka kumwamba, Camene Mulungu wayelesa, usaciitane codesedwa."
ACT 11:10	Ici cinacitika katatu, ndipo zonse zinabwelelamonso kumwamba.
ACT 11:11	Ndipo apo onani, pamena apo panali bamuna batatu oyimilila pasogolo ya nyumba mwamene tenzelili; wanatumiwa kwa ine kucoka ku Sizeliya.
ACT 11:12	Mzimu unanituma kuti niyende nabeve, ndipo kuti nisapusanise paki beve. Aba ba bale bali 6 banayenda naine, ndipo tinaloba munyumba ya uyu munthu,.
ACT 11:13	Anatiuza mwamene anabonela mngelo kuyimilila mnyumba mwake nokamba ati, "Tuma amuna ku Yopa kuti babwelese Simoni ocedwa Petro.
ACT 11:14	Azakamba naiwe uthenga wamene uzapulumuka nabo -iwe na nyumba yako yonse."
ACT 11:15	Pamene ninayamba kukamba nabeve, Mzimu Oyela unabwela pali beve, monga cenzeli kwa ife poyamba paja.
ACT 11:16	Ninakumbukila mau ya Ambuye, mwamene anakambila, "Yohane zoonadi anabatiza na mazi; koma muzabatizika mu Mzimu Oyela."
ACT 11:17	So ngati Mulungu anabapasa beve mphaso monga anatipasila pamene tinakhulupilila pali Ambuye Yesu Kristu, ndine ndani ine, kuti nitalikane na Mulungu?"
ACT 11:18	Pamene anamvera izi zinthu, palibe camene anakamba moyankha, koma anayamika Mulungu nokamba ati, "Kansi Mulungu wapasa kutembenuka kwa moyo kuli akunja nabeve."
ACT 11:19	Manje baja bamene banamwazikana cifukwa cakusausidwa kwamene kunayamba nopaiwa kwa Stefano banafika paka ku Fonisia, Saipulasi, naku Antioku, koma anakamba za uthenga wa Yesu cabe kuli ba Yuda.
ACT 11:20	Koma benangu pali beve, bamuna ocokela ku Saipulasi na Sailini, anabwela ku Antioku nokambanso nama Giliki, kubauza za uthenga wabwino wa Ambuye Yesu.
ACT 11:21	Ndipo kwanja kwa Ambuye kwenzeli nabeve; namba ikulu maningi inakhulupilila notembenukila kwa Ambuye.
ACT 11:22	Uthenga pali beve unafika mumatu ya mpingo ku Yelusalemu: ndipo banatuma Banabasi kufika mpaka ku Antioku.
ACT 11:23	Pamene anabwela nobona mphaso ya Mulungu, anakondwela, ndipo anabalimbikisa bonse kuti ankhale mwa Ambuye namtima wabo bonse.
ACT 11:24	Cifukwa enzeli munthu wabwino nabozula na Mzimu Oyela, nacikhulupililo,  ndipo banthu bambili banafakiliwako kwa Ambuye.
ACT 11:25	Banabasi apo anayenda ku Tasisi kuyendo sakila Sauli.
ACT 11:26	Pamene anamupeza, anamuleta ku Antioku. Cinabwela cacitika nicakuti, caka conse banasonkhana pamozi namupingo nophunzisa banthu bambili. Ophunzira banaitanidwa kuti Akristu koyamba ku Antioku.
ACT 11:27	Manje pamasiku aya aneneri benangu banabwela kucoka ku Yelusalemu kubwela ku Antioku.
ACT 11:28	Umozi mwa beve, Agabasi mwazina lake, anaimilila nobonesela mwa Mzimu kuti njala izacitika paziko lonse. Izi zinacitika mumasiku ya Kilaudiyasi.
ACT 11:29	So, ophunzira, kulingana mwamene anakwanisila aliyense, anaganizila kutuma thandizo kuli abale ku Yudeya.
ACT 11:30	Anacita ici; anatuma ndalama kuli akulu mumanja ya Banabasi na Sauli.
ACT 12:0	Mutu 12
ACT 12:1	Manje pali iyo nthawi mfumu Herode anamanga bengu bamene anali bamumpingo kuti abasause.
ACT 12:2	Anapaya Jemusi m'bale wake wa Yohane na lupanga.
ACT 12:3	Pamene anabona kuti ici cinakondwelesa Ayuda, anamanga futi Petro naye. Ayo yanali masiku yapwando la pasaka.
ACT 12:4	Pamene anamunga, anamuyika mujele anayika basilikali bali 4 mumagulu 4 kuti bamuyanganile yeve, ananganiza zomuleta kuli banthu pwando Yasaka itasila.
ACT 12:5	So Petelu anamusungila mujele, koma banamupempherera maningi kuli baja benzeli mumpimgo.
ACT 12:6	Siku pamene Herode akalibe kumucosa, usiku uja Petro anagona pakati pa asilkali babili, omangidwa namacheni yabili, ndipo omuyanganila benzeli pasogolo paciseko benzo yanganila jele.
ACT 12:7	Onani apo, mngelo wa Ambuye anabonekela mwazizi pali yeve, ndipo laiti inabonekela mu celo. Anamugunduza Petro pambali nomubusha nokamba ati, "Nyamuka mwamsanga." Ndipo ma cheni yake yanacoka mumanja mwake. Mngelo anakamba nayeve kuti,
ACT 12:8	" Zivalike wake ndipo vala namasanda. Petro anacita socabe. Mngelo anakamba nayeve ati, "Vala malaya yakunja ndipo unikonkhe."
ACT 12:9	So Petro anamukonkha ndipo anacoka. Sanazibe kuti camene cinacitika na mngero cenzeli ca zoona. Ananganiza kuti enzo ona maso mphenya.
ACT 12:10	Pamen anapita oyanganila oyamba nawacibili, anafika pageti yasimbi yamene yenzoyenda mu tauni; inazisegukila yeka kuli beve. Banacoka ndipo banayenda mumsebo, ndipo pamene apo mngero anamusiya yeka.
ACT 12:11	Pamene Petro anazindikila zamene zinacitika, anakamba ati, "Manje niziba kuti Ambuye atumu mngero wabo kunicosa mumanja ya Herode, nakuciyembezo ca banthu aci Yuda."
ACT 12:12	Pamene anazindikila izi, anayenda kunyumba ya Maria maiwake wa Yohane wamene ciwongo cake ni Mariko; okhulupilila bambili benzeli banakumana kwamene ndipo benzopemphera.
ACT 12:13	Pamene anagogoda paciseko ca gedi, wanchito mkazi zina lake Roda anayankha.
ACT 12:14	Pamene anazindikila mau yaPetro, mwacimwemwe anakangiwa kusegula ciseko; m'malo mwake anabwela anathamangila mucipinda; norepota kuti Petro enzeli imilile paciseko.
ACT 12:15	Ndipo anakamba kuti kwa yeve, "Ndiwe ofuntha." Koma analimbikila kuti ndiye mwamene cilili. Banabwela bakamba ati, "Nimungelo wake."
ACT 12:16	Koma Petro anapitiliza kugogoda, ndipo pamene anasegula ciseko, banamuona ndipo anadabwa.
ACT 12:17	Petro anabakambisa nakwanja kwake kuti bankhale zii, ndipo anabauza mwamne Ambuye banamucosela mujele. Anakamba ati, Muripote ivi vinthu kuli Jemusi na abale." Ndipo anacoka noyenda kumalo yenangu.
ACT 12:18	Manje pamene kunaca, kwenzelibe cisangalaro ciliconse pakati pa asilikali, pazamene zinacitika pali Petro.
ACT 12:19	Pamene Herode anamusakile yeve ndipo sanamupeze, anafunsa oyanganila ndipo anapeleka lamulo kuti apayiwe. Ndipo anacoka ku Yudeya noyenda ku Sizeliya nonkhala kwamene kuja.
ACT 12:20	Manje Herode enzeli okalipa nabanthu baku Taila na Sidoni. Banayenda kuli yeve pamozi. Banagonjesa Bulatasi, othandizila mfumu, kuti abathandize. Anapempha mtendere, cifukwa ziko lao inalandila vakudya kucoka ku ziko la mfumu.
ACT 12:21	Pasiku yoikika Herode anazivalika zovala va ufumu nonkhala pamu pando wacifumu, anapeleka mau kwa beve.
ACT 12:22	Banthu banapunda ati, "Aya nimau yakamulungu, osati yamunthu!"
ACT 12:23	Pamene apo mngero wa Ambuye anachaya yeve, cifukwa sanapase Mulungu ulemelero; anadyewa nanyongolosi nomwalila.
ACT 12:24	Koma mau ya Mulungu yanafalikila nopakilako.
ACT 12:25	Pamene Banabasi na Sauli anasiliza nchito yao ku Yelusalemu, banacokako uko; banatenga Yohane wamene ciongo cake ni Mariko. (Ma baibolo yene yebelenga kuti, Banabasi na Sauolo anabwelela ku Yelusalemu (olo kuja))
ACT 13:0	Mutu 13
ACT 13:1	Manje mpingo waku Antioku, mwenzela ma aneneri na aziphunzisi. Benzeli Banabasi, Simiyoni (oyitanidwa Niga, Lusiyasi waku Sailini, Maniyani (muzake wa Herode), na Sauli.
ACT 13:2	Pamene benzeli kutamanda Mulungu nosala kudya, Mzimu Oyela anakamba ati, "munipatulile Banabasi na Sauli, kuti bacite nchito yamene nabaitanila."
ACT 13:3	Pamene banasiliza kusala kudya, nopephela, nobafaka manja yabo pali aba bamuna, banacoka.
ACT 13:4	So Banabasi na Sauli banamvelera Mzimu Oyela ndipo banayenda ku Seleusia; kucoka kuja banakwela boti noyenda kumalo ya Siprasi.
ACT 13:5	Pamene benzeli mu tauni ya Salamisi, banalalikila mau ya Mulungu mumasinagoge ya Ayuda. Benzelinso na Yohane Mariko monga obathandiza.
ACT 13:6	Pamene banayenda pamala ponse pa Pafosi, anapeza wamajiki winangu, mneneri waboza Waciyuda, wamene zina lake ni Bar Yesu.
ACT 13:7	Uyu wamajiki anagwilizana na govana, Segiayasi Paulusi, wamene enzeli mwamuna wa nzelu. Uyu munthu anaitana Banabasi na Sauli, cifukwa enzo funa kumvera mau ya Mulungu.
ACT 13:8	Koma Elimasi "wamajiki" (ndiye mwamene zina lake imasulilidwa) anabasusha; anayesesa kuosa govana kucoka kucikhulupiliro.
ACT 13:9	Koma Saulo, wemenenso ezoitaniwa kuti Paulo, ozazidwa na Mzimu Oyela, anamuyanganisisa maningi nokamba ati,
ACT 13:10	"Iwe mwana wa Satana, ndiwe ozula na maboza yonse nakuipa. Ndiwe mudani paciliconse cabwino. Suzakwanisa kubendesa njila za straiti za Ambuye,    kansi uzacita so?
ACT 13:11	Manje ona, kwanja kwa Mulungu kuli paiwe, ndipo uzankhala ulibe menso. Suzaona zuba pakanthawi." Pamene apo panagwela pali Elimasi vambuu namudima; anayamba kuyenda yenda kupempha banthu kuti bamugwile pa kwanja nomusogolela.
ACT 13:12	Pamene govana anawona vamene vinacitika, anakhulupilila, cifukwa anadabwa pali viphunziso pali Ambuye.
ACT 13:13	Manje Paulo nabazake banayenda ku Pafosi nofika ku Pega ku Pafilia. Koma Yohane anabasiya nobwelera ku Yelusalemu.
ACT 13:14	Paulo nabazake anayenda kucoka ku Pega noyenda ku Antioku ku Pisidiya. Kuja banayenda mumasinagoge pa Sabata ndipo anankhala pansi.
ACT 13:15	Pamene banabelenga lamulo naba neneri, asogoleli bamusenagoge anabatumila uthenga kukamba kuti, "Abale, ngati muli nauthenga olimbikisa aba banthu, ukambeni.
ACT 13:16	So Paulo ananyamuka nonyamula kwanja; nokamba ati, "Bamuna baku Israyeli naimwe bamene mulemekeza Mulungu, mverani.
ACT 13:17	Mulungu wa aba banthu waku Israyeli anasankha azitate bathu nopanga banthu kupaka pamene banankhala mumalo ya Egypto,Nakwanja kwamphamvu anabacosamo.
ACT 13:18	Kwazaka ngati 40 anabalekela mucipululu. (Ma baibulo yenengu yebelenga kuti, ko kwanila zaka 40 anabasamalila mu cipululu.)
ACT 13:19	Pamene anabononga vialo vili 7 mu malo ya Kenani, anapasa banthu bathu malo yabo kunkhala yabo.
ACT 13:20	Vonse ivi vocitika vanacitika pazaka zili 450. Pamene vinasila ivi vonse, Mulungu anabapasa oweluza mpaka Samuyeli muneneri.
ACT 13:21	Banthu panapempha kuti abapase mfumu, ndipo Mulungu anabapasa Sauli mwana wa Kishi, mwamuna ocokela ku banja ya Benjamini, kuti ankhale mfumu zaka zokwanila 40.
ACT 13:22	Pamene Mulungu anamucosa pa ufumu, ananyamula Davide kuti ankahale mfumu. Cenzeli pali Davide pamene Mulungu anakamaba, 'Napeza Davide mwana wa Jeseckunkhala mwamuna wapa mtima panga, wamene acita vilivonse vamene nifuna iye acita.'
ACT 13:23	Kucoka kumubado wauyu munthu Mulungu waleta kwa Israyeli mphulumusi, Yesu, monga mwamene analonjezela.
ACT 13:24	Ivi vanayamba kucitika pamene, Yesu sanabwele, Coyambilila Yohane ananounsa upatizo wotembenuka ku wanthu onse waku Israyeli.
ACT 13:25	Pamene Yohane enzosiliza nchito yake, anakamba ati, 'Kodi munganiza kuti ndine ndani? Sindine wamene. Koma mvesesani, kuliwina abwela pasogolo panga, wamene nthambo za sapato zake sindine oyenela kuzimasula.'
ACT 13:26	Abale, bana ocoka kuli Abrahamu, naimwe pakati panu wamene mulambila Mulungu, sikwaise kuti mau yacipulumuso yatumidwa.
ACT 13:27	Kwa iwo wamene ankhala mu Yelusalemu, nabolamulila bawo, sibanamuzindikile iye, ndipo wanakwanilisa zokambika za aneneri zamene zibelengedwa sabata iliyonse pakumuweluza iye.
ACT 13:28	Ngankhale kuti sibana peze cifukwa cenini comupaila iye, anauza Pilato kuti amupaye.
ACT 13:29	Pamene banasiliza zinthu zonse zamene zinalembedwa za yeve, banamucosa mumtengo nomushika mumanda.
ACT 13:30	Koma Mulungu anamuusha kuli wakufa.
ACT 13:31	Banamuona masiku ambili nawaja bamene wanabwela nayeve kucoka ku Galileya kubwela ku Yelusalemu.
ACT 13:32	So tibwelesa uthenga wabwino pamalonjezo yanapangiwa kuli azitate bathu:
ACT 13:33	Mulungu anasunga aya malonjezo kwa ise, kubana bawo, kuti anausha Yesu kubwelesa kumoyo. Izi ndiye zamene zinalembedwa muma Salimo wacibili: 'Ndiwe mwana wanga, lero nankhala Tate wako.'
ACT 13:34	Pali zoona kuti anamuusha kwa kufa kuti thupi yake sizabwele mkubola, akamba socabe: 'Nizakupasani zoyela namadaliso yene ya Davide.'
ACT 13:35	Nicifukwa cake akamba futi muma Salimo inangu, 'Suzalola Oyela wako kuti abole.'
ACT 13:36	Pamene Davide apanga mubado wake kutumikila zenzo funa Mulungu, anagona (anamwalila), noshikiwa na azitate bake, ndipo anabola,
ACT 13:37	koma iye wamene Mulungu anausha sanabole.
ACT 13:38	So lekani cizibika kwa inu, abale, kupitila muli uyu munthu kulalikidwa kukhululukidwa kwa macimo.
ACT 13:39	Kupitila mwa iye aliyense wakhulupilila alungamisiwa kuzithu zonse zamene lamulo ya Mose sinakwanise kulungamisa.
ACT 13:40	So cenjelani kuti zinthu zamene aneneri anakambapo siziza ciktika kwa imwe:
ACT 13:41	'Onani, imwe opepusa, mudabwisike ndipo mubonongeke; cifukwa nicita nchito mumasiku yanu, Nchito yamene simuzaikhulupilila, ngakhale kuti winangu ayinaunsa kuli imwe.'"
ACT 13:42	Pamene Paulo na Banabasi wenzocoka, banthu anabapempha kuti baka kambe futi aya mau yamozi nayamozi sabata yamene ibwela.
ACT 13:43	Pamene musonkhano wamusinagoge unasila, Ayuda bambili nabaja ozipeleka kuciyuda anakonkha Paulo na Banabasi, banakmba nawo nobalimbikisa kuti apitiliza mucisomo ca Mulungu.
ACT 13:44	Sabata yokonkhapo, pafufupi tauni yonse banakumana pamozi kuti bamverele mau ya Ambuye.
ACT 13:45	Pamene Ayuda anabona gulupu, banamvela jelasi noyamba kukamba mosushana navamene enzo kamba Paulo nomunyoza.
ACT 13:46	Koma Paulo na Banabasi anakamba mwaphamvu nokamba ati, "Cenzeli cofunikila kuti mau ya Mulungu ya yambilile kulalikilidwa kuli imwe. Kuoona kuti muyapushing'a kutali kuli imwe ndipo muziyesa osayenela ku umoyo osatha, onani, tizayenda kuli Akunja.
ACT 13:47	Cifukwa Ambuye atilamulila, kunena kuti, 'Nakuikani kunkhala nyali kwa Akunja, kuti mupeleke cipulumuso kumalekezelo yonse ya calo.'"
ACT 13:48	Pamene Akunja banamvera izi, banakondwela noyamikila mau ya Ambuye. Pabambili bamene anasankhidwa ku umuyo osatha banakhulupilila.
ACT 13:49	Mau ya Ambuye yanaperekewa ponse ponse mumzida onse.
ACT 13:50	Koma Ayuda analimbikisa azimai ozipeleka naboyenela, nabamuna benze osogolela  mutauni. Banapangisa kusausidwa kwa Paulo na Banabasi nobaponya kupitilila kunja kwa tauni.
ACT 13:51	Koma Paulo na Banabasi anabana kukhumula kalukungu kucoka kumendo yabo. Pamene apo anayenda ku Tauni ya Ikoniyamu.
ACT 13:52	Ndipo ophunzila anambela cimwemwe nozuzhiwa na Mzimu Oyela.
ACT 14:0	Mutu 14
ACT 14:1	Cinacitika mu Ikoniyamu kuti pame Paulo na Banabasi alowa pamozi mu sinagoge ya Ayuda nokamba munjila yakuti banthu bambili Ayuda na Acigiliki anakhulupilila.
ACT 14:2	Koma Ayuda amene senzomverela anapangisa manganizo ya Akunja kunkhala okalipa pali abale.
ACT 14:3	So banankhala kuja nthawi itali, kukamba mwamphamvu namphamvu ya Ambuye, pamene enzo peleka umboni pali uthenga wacisomo. Anacita ici pakusa visanzo navodabwisa vingacitika kupitila mu manja ya Paulo na Banabasi.
ACT 14:4	Koma bambii mu tauni banagabikana: benengu banthu banankhala kusaidi ya Ayuda, benangu kusaidi yama apostozi.
ACT 14:5	Pamene Akunja pamozi na Ayuda anayesa kukoka asogoleli bawo kuti basause notema myala Paulo na Banabasi,
ACT 14:6	banabwela baziba pali ici nothabila kuma tauni ya Likoniya, Lisitila naDebi, namizinda yozungulila,
ACT 14:7	ndipo kuja benzo lalikila uthenga.
ACT 14:8	Ku Lisitila mwamuna winangu anankhala, alibe mphamvu pamendo pake, olemala kucoka mumala ya amai bake, sanayendepo.
ACT 14:9	Uyu munthu anamvera Paulo ali kukamba. Paulo anaika menso yake pali yevenobwelo uwona kuti ali nacikhulupililo kuti angankhale bwino.
ACT 14:10	So anakamba nayeve mopunda, "Nyamuka." Ndipo uja mwamuna anajumpha noyamba yenda yenda.
ACT 14:11	Pamene gulu inaona vamene anacita Paulo, anakweza mau yawo, kukamba mucithundu caku Likoniya, "Milungu yabwela kwa ise mukupiltila mu banthu."
ACT 14:12	Banaitana Banabasi kuti "Ziyasi," na Paulo, kuti "Hemasi," cifukwa enzeli mwine wokamba.
ACT 14:13	Wa sembe wa Ziyasi, wamene tempele yake inali panja pa tauni, analeta ng'ombe namaluba pageti; yeve nagulupu benzofuna kupeleka nsembe.
ACT 14:14	Koma pamene ma apostozi, na Banabasi na Paulo, anamvera za ici, banang'amba malaya yawo ndipo mwamsanga banayenda pagulu, kulila
ACT 14:15	nokamba kuti, Bamuna imwe, nicifukwa nicani mucita ivi vinthu? Ise nase ndise banthu nazomvera monga zanu. Tikubwelesalena uthenga wambwino, kuti mucoke kuli ivi vinthu vilembe nchito nobwela kuli Mulungu wamoyo, wamene anapanga  kumwamba, na ziko lapansi, namimana navonse vamene vilimo.
ACT 14:16	Kumbuyo uku, anavomeleza vialo vonse kuyenda munjila zawo.
ACT 14:17	Koma apo, sanazisiye yeka kunkhala alibe umboni, cifukwa cakuti anacita bwino nopasa imwe mvula kucoka kumwamba nanyengo zocita bwino, kukwanilisa mitima yanu navakudya nacimwemwe."
ACT 14:18	Ngankhale na mau aya, Paulo na Banabasi sanakwanise kulesa gulu kupeleka nsembe kuli beve.
ACT 14:19	Koma Ayuda benangu ocokela ku Antioku na Ikoniyamu anbwela kugonjesa gulupu. Banamutema myala Paulo nomucosa mu tauni, kuganizila kuti anafa.
ACT 14:20	Koma pamene aphunzila benze anaimilila kuzungulila yeve, ananyamuka noloba mu tauni. Siku yokonkhapo, anayenda ku Debi pamozi na Banabasi.
ACT 14:21	Pamene banalalikila uthenga mu tauni muja nopanga ophunzila ambili, banabwelela ku Lisitira, paka ku Ikoniya na Antioku.
ACT 14:22	Anapitiliza kulimbikisa moyo wa ophunzila nobalimbikisa kuti apitilize mucikhulupilillo, kukamba kuti, "Tifunika kuloba mu Ufumu wa Mulungu kupitila muma sauso yambili."
ACT 14:23	Pamene banaba sankhila akulu ampingo mumpingo ulibonse, ndipo anapemphela nosala kudya, anabapeleka kwa Ambuye, mwa iye wamene anakhulupilila.
ACT 14:24	Ndipo apo anapitila mu Pisidiya nobwela ufika ku Pafaliya.
ACT 14:25	Pamene banalalikila mau mu Pega, banayenda ku Attaliya.
ACT 14:26	Kucoka uko banayenda ku Antioku, kwamene benzeli ozipeleka ku cisomo ca Mulungu pa nchito yamene manje banasiliza.
ACT 14:27	Pamene banafika mu Antioku nobwelesa mpingo pamozi, banarepota vinthu vonse vamene Mulungu anacita pamozi nabeve, namwamene anasegulila njila yacikhulupililo kuli bakunja.
ACT 14:28	Banankhala thawi itali nawophunzila.
ACT 15:0	Mutu 15
ACT 15:1	Bamuna benangu banacoka ku Yudeya nomphunzisa abale, kunenakuti, pokhapo mukadulidwa monga pa mwambo wa Mose, simungapulumusidwe."
ACT 15:2	Pamene Paulo na Banabasi anakangana nocita nawo ndale, abale anaganiza kuti Paulo, Banabasi nabena afunika kuyenda ku Yelusalemu kuli ma apostozi na akulu pali iye nkhani.
ACT 15:3	Ndipo apo, pakutumidwa nampingo, anapitila ku Fonisiya na Samaria nocita anaounsi kutembenuka kwa Akunja. Anabwelesa cisangalalo cacikulu kuli abale onse.
ACT 15:4	Pamene anafika ku Yelusalemu, analandliwa na mpingo nama apostozi na akulu, ndipo analipota zonse zinthu zamene Mulungu anacita pamozi naiwo.
ACT 15:5	Koma amuna bena bamene anakhulupilila, enzeli ku gulupu ya Afalisi, anaimila nokamba ati, "nicofunikila kubacita mdulidwe nakubalamulila kuti asunge malamo ya Mose.
ACT 15:6	So ma apostozi na akulu anakuma pamozi kuti ayanganepo iyi nkhani.
ACT 15:7	Pamene banakambilana kwa nthawi itali, Petulo ananyamuka nokamba kwa iwo, "Abale, muziba kuti panthawi yambwino yamene yapita Mulungu anasankha pakati pawo, kuti kupitila mukamwa mwanga Akunja amvele mau awuthenga, nokhulupilila.
ACT 15:8	Mulungu, aziba mtima, abapasa umboni, kubapasa Mzimu Oyela, monga mwamene anacitila ise;
ACT 15:9	ndipo sanapange kupatula pakati pa ise nabeve, kupanga mitima kuyela mwacikhulupililo.
ACT 15:10	Mwanje nicifukw ninji muyesa Mulungu, kuti muyike joko pamikosi yaophunzila yamene ngakhale azitate bathu kapena banakwanisa kucilandila?

ACT 15:12	Gulu yonse inankhala zii pamene benzomvela Banabasi na Paulo penzo repota pa visanzo na vodabwisa Mulungu anacita pakati pa Akunja kupyolela mwabeve.
ACT 15:13	Pamene banaleka kukamba, Jemusi anayankha, nokamba ati, Abale, mvelani kwa ine.

ACT 15:21	Kucoka ku mibado yakudala kulibanthu mu tauni iliyonse bamene alalikila nobelenga Mose mumasinagoge sabata ili yonse."
ACT 15:22	Ndipo cinaboneka bwino kuli ma apostozi na akulu, namupingo bonse, kusankha Yudasi oyitanidwa Basabasi, na Sailasi, amene anali azisogoleli mu mpingo, nobatuma ku Antioku pamozi na Paulo na Banabasi.

ACT 15:25	So cinatibonekela bwino tonse kuti tigwilizane kuti tisankhe banthu nobatuma kwa imwe okondedwa Banabasi na Paulo,
ACT 15:26	banthu bamene baika moyo wabo pangozi cifukwa ca zina la Ambuye Yesu Kristu.
ACT 15:27	Tatuma cifukwa caici Yudasi na Sailasi, bamene azakuuzani zinthu zimozi nazimozi.
ACT 15:28	Cifukwa cinaoneka bwino kwa Mzimu Oyela na kwa ise, kuika paimwe katuntdu olema kupambana izi zinthu zofunikila:
ACT 15:29	kuti mucoke ku vinthu vopelekewa nsembe kumafno, mwazi, vakufa veka, nakuciwele wele. Ngati muzisunga kuli ivi vinthu, zizankhala bwino na imwe. Mukhale bwino."
ACT 15:30	Ndipo beve, pamene banamasulidwa, anabwela ku Antioku; anabwelesa banthu pamozi, anapeleka kalata.
ACT 15:31	Pamene anaibelenga, banakondwela cifukwa ca cilimbikiso.
ACT 15:32	Yudasi na Sailasi, na neneri, analimbikisa abale namau ambili nobalimbikisa.
ACT 15:33	Pamene banankhalako pakanthawi, banabamasula mwamutendele kucoka ku abale kuli beve bamene anabatuma.
ACT 15:34	(Koma cinamuonekela bwino Sailasi kusalila).

ACT 15:36	Pamene panapita nthawi Paulo anakamba ati kwa Banabsi, "Tiye tibwelele manje tikayendela abale mutauni iliyonse kwamene tinalalikila mau ya Ambuye, nobona mwamene alili.
ACT 15:37	Banabasi anafunanso kuti atenge Yohane woitanidwa Mariko.

ACT 15:39	Ndipo kunapezeka kusushana kwambili, kufika mpaka banapatukana, ndipo Banabasi anatenga Mariko noyenda ku Sipulasi.
ACT 15:40	Koma Paulo anasankha Silasi ndipo anacoka, pambuyo pobapasa kuti asamalile mwacisomo ca Ambuye.

ACT 16:0	Mutu 16
ACT 16:1	Paulo anabwelanso ku Debi na Lisitila; ndipo onani, ophunzira wina zina lake Timoteyo analiko, mwana wa mzimai waci Yuda wamene anali okhulupilila; atate bake enzeli waci Giliki.
ACT 16:2	Banakamba zambino za iye abale bamene anali ku Lisitira na Ikoniyamu.
ACT 16:3	Paulo anamufuna kuti ayende naye; so anamutenga iye nomucita mudulidwe cifukwa ca Ayuda amene anali kumalo ayo, cifukwa bonse banaziba kuti atate bake benzeli ba Giliki.
ACT 16:4	Pamene benzo kupitila mu matauni, banapeleka ku mipingo malamulo kuti iwo amverele, malamulo yamene yanalembedwa nama apostozi na akulu mu Yelusalemu.

ACT 16:8	So popitila ku Masiya, anafika kutauni ya Traosi.
ACT 16:9	Masophenya yanamuonekela Paulo usiku: mwamuna waku Masedoniya anali imilile paja, kumuitana nokamba ati, Bwela kuno ku Mesedoniya utithandizile."
ACT 16:10	Pamene Paulo anabona masophenya, pamene apo tinayenda ku Mesedoniya, kuganizila kuti Mulungu anabaitana iwo kuyendo lalikila uthenga kwa beve.

ACT 16:12	kucoka uko tinayenda ku Filipi, yamene ni tauni ya Mesedoniya, tauni yofunikila maningi mu boma na mu Roma, ndipo tinankhala mu tauni iyi masiku yambili.
ACT 16:13	Pa Sabata tinayenda panja pa geti kumbali kwa mumana, kwamene tinaganiza kuti kuli malo yopemphelerako. Tinankhala pansi nokamba na azimai bamene enze anabwela pamozi.
ACT 16:14	Mkazi winangu ocedwa Lidiya, ogulisa va pepo kucoka ku tauni ya Tiyatira, wamene anapembeza Mulungu, anativelela. Ambuye anasegula mtima wake kumverela kuvamene Paulo anakamba.
ACT 16:15	Pamene anabatizika, nanyumba, anatilimbikisa, nakukamba kuti, "ngati mwaniweluza kunkhala okhulupililika kwa Ambuye, bwelani kunyumba kwanga, nonkhala naine." Ndipo atigonjesa.
ACT 16:16	Cinabwela cacitika kuti, pamene tenzoyenda kumalo yopemphelerako, msikana winangu wamene enzeli namuzimu olota anakumana nase. Anapangila abosi bake ndalama zambili muzokamba zake.
ACT 16:17	Uyu msika anakonkha Paulo na ise nopunda, kukamba ati, " Aba banthu nibanchito ba Mulungu Mkulu kulu. Balalikila kwa imwe njila ya cipulumuso.
ACT 16:18	Anacita ici masiku yambili. Koma Paulo, pamene anakalipa maningi naive, anapindimuka nokamba kwa mizimu, Nikulamulila muzina la Yesu Kristu kuti ucoka mwa yeve." Ndipom cinacoka pamene apo.
ACT 16:19	Pamene ba bosi bake anabona kuti popangila ndalama payenda, banamumanga Paulo na Sailai nobapeleka pamaketi  pamenso yaolamulila.
ACT 16:20	Pamene anabaleta kuli oweluza, anakamba ati, " aba banthu na Yuda ndipo bapanga mambuto yambili mu tauni mwathu.
ACT 16:21	Baphunzisa zinthu zosaloledwa kuti ise tilandile or kulondola ngati Aroma."
ACT 16:22	Ndipo gulu inanyamukila pamozi ku ukila Paulo na Sailasi; oweluza banang'amba malaya yabo nakubavula nolamulila kuti bamenyedwa nandodo.
ACT 16:23	Pamene banabamenya maningi, banabaponya mundende nolamulila wogading'a kuti abafakeko nzeru maningi.
ACT 16:24	Pamene analandila lamulo iyi, wogading'a anabaponya mukati maningi mwa jele nomanga mendo yawo maningi.
ACT 16:25	Pakati pa usiku Paulo na Sailasi benzo pemphela noyimba nyimbo kwa Mulungu, ndipo bakaidi benangu benzo bamvelerela.
ACT 16:26	Mwazizi kwenzeli kung'ambika pansi kukulu, mpaka maziko yamujele yanagwendezeka; ndipo pamene apo viseko vinaseguka, ndipo macheni ya aliyense yanamasuka.
ACT 16:27	Wogading'a anauka patulo nowona kuti viseko vamujele nivoseguka; anacosa cinayifi cake nonkhala pang'ono kuzipaya, cifukwa anaganiza kuti bakaidi bathaba.
ACT 16:28	Koma Paulo anapunda maningi, kukamba kuti, osazipanga ngozi, cifukwa tonse tilimo muno."
ACT 16:29	Wogading'a anaitanisa laiti nobwelo ngena, nishi anjenjema namantha, nokugwa pansi pali Paulo na Sailasi,
ACT 16:30	nobacosa panja nobwelo akamba ati, Kansi ningacite bwanji kuti nipulumuke?"
ACT 16:31	Banakamba ati, Khulupilila mwa Ambuye Yesu, ndipo uzapulumusiwa, iwe na banja lako lonse.
ACT 16:32	Banakamba mau ya Ambuye kwa yeve, pamozi nabonse benzeli munyumba mwake.
ACT 16:33	Pamene apo gadi anabatenga pa nthawi yamene iyo yausiku, nobasanbika mendo vilonda vabo, ndipo yeve nabanja lake lonse banabatizika pamene apo.
ACT 16:34	Anabwelesa Paulo na Sailasi kunyumba kwake nobapasa vakudya. Anasangala maningi nanyumba yake yonse, cifukwa bonse anakhulupilila Mulungu.
ACT 16:35	Pamanje pamene kwenzeli muzuba, oweluza anatuma mau kuli magadi nokamba ati, Leka abo banthu bayende."
ACT 16:36	Gadi anarepota mau kwa Paulo, kukamba ati, "Oweluza anituma mau kuli ine kuti nibamasule: manje so cokani, muyende bwino.
ACT 16:37	Koma Paulo anakamba ati kuli beve, "Banatimenya pacigulu, banthu balibe mulandu aci Roma, ndipo mwatifaka mujele; manje apa bafuna baticose mwaci sinsi? Yai ndithu, balekeni babwele beka kuti baticose.
ACT 16:38	Magadi anapeleka aya mau kuli oweluza; oweluza anamvera mantha pamene banmvera kuti Paulo na Sailasi benzeli ba Roma.
ACT 16:39	Oweluza anabwela kubapapata; ndipo pamene anabacosa mukele, anauza Paulo na Sailasi kuti acoke mu tauni.
ACT 16:40	So Paulo na Sailasi anacoka mujele noyenda kunyumba kwa Lidiya. Pamene Paulo na Sailasi anabona abale, anabalimbikisa ndipo banacoka mu Tauni.
ACT 17:0	Mutu 17
ACT 17:1	Manje pmene banapita mumatauni ya Amfipolisi na Apoloniya, banafika ku tauni ya Thesalonika, kwamene kwenzeli sinagoge ya Ayuda.

ACT 17:3	Enzo sengula malemba nofotokoza kwa beve kuti cenzeli cofunikila kwa Kristu kubvutika ndiponso ku ukanso kwa bakufa. Anakamba kuti, Uyu Yesu wamene nilalikila kwa imwe ndiye Kristu."

ACT 17:6	Koma pamene sanabapeze, banadosa Jasoni nabenangu ba bale pamenso ya bakulu bakulu bamutani ninshi, balila kuti,

ACT 17:8	Pamene gulu naba kulu bakulu ba tauni banamvela izi zinthu, benzeli mumabvuto.

ACT 17:12	Cifukwa caici bambili banakhulupilila, kufakilapo nabazimai baci Giliki na azibambo bambili.

ACT 17:14	Ndipo pamene apo, abale banatuma Paulo ayende kucimuna, koma Sailasi na Timoteyo banankala kwamene kuja.
ACT 17:15	Baja bamene benzo sogolela Paulo banamupeleka paka ku tauni ya Athenzi. Pamene banamusiya Paulo kuja, banalandila vofunika kucita va Sailasi na Timoteyo kuti wabwele msanga kwa yeve monga cili cofunikila.
ACT 17:16	Manje pamene Paulo enzo bayembekezela ku Athenzi, mzimu wake unabvutika pamene anaona kuti tauni yenzeli yozula namafano.
ACT 17:17	So anakambilana mu sinagoge naba Yuda nabonse benzo lambila Mulungu nabonse bamene benzo kumana nabo siku na siku pamalo yamaketi.
ACT 17:18	Komanso anakumana nabengu baku Ipiquliyani nabaja bokamba kuti chalo cinapangiwa mwa chansi. Ndipo benangu banakamba ati, kansi uyu okamba-kamba afuna kukamba cani?" Benangu banakamba ati, "Aboneka ngati nimulaliki watumilungu twacilwendo," cifukwa enzo lalikila pali Yesu naku ukisidwa.
ACT 17:19	Banamutenga Paulo nomuleta kuli Ayelopagasi, nokamba kuti, Tifuna tizibe ici ciphunziso cacilwendo camene wenzo kambapo?
ACT 17:20	Cifukwa uleta zinthu zacilwendo mumatu yathu. Cifukwa caici, tifuna tizibe tanthauzo ya izi zinthu."
ACT 17:21	(Manje bonse ma Atheniyanzi nabalendo bonkhala muja bana sebenzesa nthawi yawo mukukamba kapena kumvelela cinthu cinangu ca manje.)
ACT 17:22	So Paulo anaimilila pakati pali Ayelopagasi nobwelokamba ati, "Imwe bamuna baku Athenzi, nawona kuti ndiwe bacipembezo munjila iliyonse.
ACT 17:23	Cifukwa pamene nenzo pita nowona kuti zinthu zaciyamiko zanu, napeza guwa yolembewa kuti, "Kwa Mulungu osazibika." Pacamene mulambila mosaziba, ici cebve ninaunsa kwa imwe.
ACT 17:24	Mulungu wamene anapanga calo navonse vilimo, cifukwa ni Ambuye wa kumwamba nacalo capansi, sankhala mumatempele yopangiwa namanja.
ACT 17:25	Kapena kutumikiliwa namanja yabanthu, monga ngati enzofuna kalikonse, cifukwa cakuti yebve apasa banthu umoyo namphepo nazonse cabe.
ACT 17:26	Ndipo kucokela kumunthu umozi anapanga ziko iliyonse yabanthu bamene bankhala pano pacalo capansi,pakubapangila nyengo yawo yo ikika nomolekezela ponkhala pawo.
ACT 17:27	Cifukwa ca ici afunika kusakila Mulungu, ndipo mwina bangamufike yebve nomupeza, ndipo zoona, salipatali kuli aliyense wa ise.
ACT 17:28	Cifukwa mwa yeve tiyenda nonkhala na moyo, monga winangu mwaimwe alina ndakatulo wakamba kuti, 'Naise futi ndise bana bake.'
ACT 17:29	So, cifukwa cakuti ndise bana ba Mulungu, sitifunika kuganiza kuti umulungu uli ngati golide, olo siliva, olo miyala, yosemedwa nabosema kapena maganizo ya munthu.
ACT 17:30	Cifukwa ca ici Mulungu analekelela nthawi yakusaziba, koma manje alamulila banthu bonse kulikonse kuti atembenuke.
ACT 17:31	Ici nicifukwa baika sikupamene azaweluza calo mucilungamo mwabanthu bamene anasankha. Mulungu anapasa pulufu pali uyu mmwamuna kuli aliyense pakumuusha kwa akufa."
ACT 17:32	Manje pamene bamuna baku Athenzi banamvera za kuuka kwa akufa, benangu banamuseka Paulo; koma binangu banakamba ati, Tizakakumverela futi pali iyinkhani."
ACT 17:33	Pambuyo pake, Paulo anayenda.
ACT 17:34	Koma banthu benangu banamujoina nomukhulupilila, kufakilapo Dionishasi oweluza, nabenangu benzeli nawo.
ACT 18:0	Mutu 18

ACT 18:15	Koma cifukwa cakuti aya nimafunso pa mau nama zina nalamulo yanu, kambilanani. Sinifuna kunkhala oweluza pali izi nkhani."

ACT 18:19	Pamene anafika kwa Aifenso, Paulo anasiya Prisila na Akwila kuja, koma iye anayenda mu sinagoge nokambilana na Ayuda.
ACT 18:20	Pamene banapempha Paulo kuti ankhaleko nthawi itali, anakana.
ACT 18:21	Koma pocokapo pali beve, anakamba ati, "Nizabwela futi kwa imwe ngati nicifuniro ca Mulungu." Anabwela acoka kwa Aifenso.
