ACT 19:0	Mutu 19
ACT 19:1	Cinabwela cacitika kuti pamene Apolosi enzeli ku Korinto, Paulo anapitila kuziko yakumwamba nofika ku tauni ya Aifenso, nopeza ophunzira benangu.
ACT 19:2	Paulo anakamba ati kwa beve, Bushe munalandila Mzimu Oyela pamene munakhulupilila?" Banakamba ati kwa yeve, "Yayi, sitinamveleko za Mzimu Oyela."
ACT 19:3	Paulo anakamba ati, "Bushe munabatizika mucani?" Banakamba ati "Mu ubatizo wa Yohane."
ACT 19:4	So Paulo anayankha ati, Yohane anabatiza ubatizo wotembenuka. Anauza banthu kuti afunik kukhulupila muli yeve wamene azabwela yeve akacoka, umu ndiye mwa Yesu."
ACT 19:5	Pamene banthu banamvela izi, banabatizika muzina la Ambuye Yesu.
ACT 19:6	Ndipo pamene Paulo anaika manja yake pali beve, Mzimu Oyela anabwela pali Beve ndipo anakamba mubvitundu vinangu nobwela ucita uneneri.
ACT 19:7	Namba yonse pamozi enzeli azibabo bali 12.
ACT 19:8	Paulo anangena mu SInagoge nokamba molimbika kwa myezi itatu. Ozosogolela zokambilana nakusimikizila banthu pazinthu zokhuzana na ufumu wa Mulungu.
ACT 19:9	Koma pamene Ayuda benangu banalimbisa mtima nakukhala osamvelera, banayamba kukamba voipa pa njila ya Kristu pamenso ya gulu. So Paulo anacokapo pali beve nocosapo wokhulupilila. Anayamba kukamba siku na siku mukilasi ya Tiranasi.
ACT 19:10	Ici cinapitiliza kwa zaka zibili, mpaka bonse wonkhala mu Asia anamvela mau ya Ambuye, Ayuda na Agiliki pamozi.
ACT 19:11	Mulungu enzocita vinthu vikulu kupitila kumanja ya Paulo,
ACT 19:12	kuti ngankhale wodwala benzopola, mizimu yoipa yenzocoka muli beve, pamene benzotenga tunyula pa thupi ya Paulo.
ACT 19:13	Koma kwenzeli wocosa vibanda baci Yuda benzoyenda kupitila kuja kumalo bamene anatenga zina la Yesu kuyisebenzesa mwacabe. Banayikamba pali baja benzeli na mizimu yoipa; banakamba ati, "Nikulamulila muzina la Yesu wamene Paulo alalikila kuti ucoke."
ACT 19:14	Aba banacita ici benzeli bana ba wansembe mukulu, Sikeva.
ACT 19:15	Muzimu onyasa unabayankha, Yesu nimuziba, na Paulo nimuziba; Koma nanga ndiwe ndani iwe?"
ACT 19:16	Muzimu oyipa unali mu munthu uja unabajumpila baja ocosa vibanda nowapambana mphamvu nobamenya. Banathaba kucoka munyumba muja cinthaku nabvilonda.
ACT 19:17	Ici canizibika kuli bonse, baci Yuda naci Giliki bonse, benzonkhala mu Aifenso. Banankhala na mantha maningi, ndipo zina ya Ambuye Yesu enalemekezeka.
ACT 19:18	Ndiponso, bambili okhulupila banalapa nobvumela voipa vamene enze anacita.
ACT 19:19	Bambili benzocita vamagiki banaleta mabuku yawo noyashoka pamenso ya aliyense. Pamene banabelengela mtengo wake yenze inakwana fifite sauzande mapisi ya siliva.
ACT 19:20	So mau ya ambuye yanayenda maningi munjila yamphamvu.
ACT 19:21	Manje pamene Paulo anasiliza utumiki wake mu Aifenso, anacipanga mumzimu kuti apitile ku Mesedoniya na Akaya pamene enzo yenda ku Yelusalemu; anakamba ati, "Nikankhalako nkhalako, nifunika kuyenda ku Romu."
ACT 19:22	Paulo anatuma ku Mesedoniya ophunzila bake babili, Timoteyo na Erasitasi, bamene benze banamuthandiza. Koma yeve anasala ku Asia pakanthawi.
ACT 19:23	Panthawi yamene ija kunauka msokonezo mu Aifenso kukhuzana na cikristu.
ACT 19:24	Winangug wopanga voumba kucokela ku siliva zina lake Demetiriyasi, amene anapanga coumba ca Diana, zinamupangila maningi malonda uyu opanga voumba.
ACT 19:25	So anabwelesa pamozi banyanchito bonse pancito ija  nchito nokamba ati, "Azikulu, muziba kuti iyi buzinesi imatipangla ndalama.
ACT 19:26	Muona nomvela izi, osati cabe ku Aifenso, koma pafupi fupi mu Asia monse, uyu Paulo wadonsa notembenula banthu bambili. Akamba kuti kulibe milungu yopangiwa namanja.
ACT 19:27	Sikuzankhala cabe kuti malonda yathu siyazafuniwa, komanso kuti tempele ya mukulu mulungu mukazi Diana ezayesewa ilibe nchito. Nakuti azalusing'a ukulu wake, wamene Asia yonse naziko yonse apembeza."
ACT 19:28	Pamene bamvela izi, banakalipa nolila, "Mukulu ni Diana waku Aifenso."
ACT 19:29	Tauni yonse mwenze musokonezo, ndipo bathu banathabila pamozi mu holo. Banagwila benzo yenda na Paulo, Gayasi, na Aristakasi, bamene banacoka ku Mesedoniya.
ACT 19:30	Paulo anafuna kungena pamozi nacigulu, koma ophunzila banabalesa.
ACT 19:31	Cimozi mozi bakulu bakulu bamuzinda wamu Asia bamene benzeli bazake banamutumila uthenga kumupempha kuti asalobe mu holo.
ACT 19:32	Banthu binangu benzo punda cinthu cimozi, cifukwa gulu yenze mumusokonezo. Bambili ba iwo sanazibe cifukwa nicani banabwela pamozi.
ACT 19:33	Ba Yuda banacosesa Alekizanda pacigulupu kumuyika pasogolo pabanthu. Alekizanda ananyamula kwanja kwake kuti abafotokozele banthu.
ACT 19:34	Koma pamene banaziba kuti ni Yuda, bonse banalila na mau yamozi kwa 2 awazi, "Mukulu ni Diana wabanthu baku Aifenso."
ACT 19:35	Pamene kalaliki watauni anauza banthu kuti ankhale zii, anakamba ati, Imwe bamuna baku Aifenso, nindani munthu wamene saziba kuti tauni ya Aifenso ni tempele yamene isunga mukulu Diana navonsema vamene vinagwa kumwamba?
ACT 19:36	Kuwona kuti izi zinthu sizingakaniwe, nkhalani zii, ndipo musathamangile.
ACT 19:37	Cifukwa mwaleta aba banthu kukhoti bamene sibakawalala wamu tempele kapena onyozela mulungu wathu mukazi.
ACT 19:38	Cifukwa ca ici, ngati Demetiriyasi nabaja osema bamene ali nayeve bali nayeve mulandu, makhoti niyoseguka ndipo oweluza baliko. Lekani bapasane milandu beka beka.
ACT 19:39	Koma ngati usakila nkhani zinangu, zizakambiwa mumisonkhano yanthawi na nthawi.
ACT 19:40	Cifukwa zoonadi tili padenja kupasiwa mulandu pacongo cacitika lero. Palibe coyofya pali ici congo, ndipo sitizakwanisa kuvifotokoza."
ACT 19:41	Pamene anakamba izi, anang'ondola musonkhano.
ACT 20:0	Mutu 20
ACT 20:1	Pamene rayoti inasila, Paulo anaitana ophunzila ndipo anabalimbiksa. Ndipo anabalayila noyenda ku Mesedoniya.
ACT 20:2	Pamene anapitila mizinda ayo nolimbikisa okhulupila maningi, anangena mu Girisi.
ACT 20:3	Pamene anankhalako myezi itatu kuja, kumu ukila kunapangiwa na Ayuda nishi wankhala pang'ono kuyenda ku Siliya, so anaganiza kubwelela kupitila ku Mesedoniya.
ACT 20:4	Kumupelekeza iye kufika ku Asia enzeli Sopata mwana mwamuna wa Filasi ocokela ku Beriya; Arisitakasi na Sekundasi, bonse ocokela kwa okhulupila waku Thesalonika; Gayesi waku Debi, Timoti' na Ticikasi na Trofimasi ocokela ku Asia.
ACT 20:5	Koma aba banthu banasogolako ndipo benzo tiyembekeza ku Tiraosi.
ACT 20:6	Tinayenda kucoka ku Filipi pambuyo pacikodwelelo ca pasaka, ndipo pamasiku yali 5 tinabwelela kwa iwo ku Tiraosi. Kuja tinankhalako masiku 7.
ACT 20:7	Siku yoyamba mu sabata, pamene tinakumana pamozi kti tinyemela buredi, Paulo anakamba kuli wokhulupilila. Enzo pulana kuyenda siku yokokhapo, so anapitiliza kukamba mpaka pakati pa usiku.
ACT 20:8	Kunali manyale yambili mucipinda capa mwamba mwamene tinakumana.
ACT 20:9	Pa windo panankhala Munyamata wingu zina yake Utikasi. wamene anagona maningi. Pamene Paulo anatenga nthawi itali kukamba, uyu munyamata, akali gone, anagwa kucoka pamwamba ndipo anamudoba wakufa.
ACT 20:10	Koma pamene Paulo anayenda pansi, Paulo anamugonela yeve, numukumbatila. Ndipo anakamba ati, osakalipa futi, cifukwa ali moyo."
ACT 20:11	So anayenda pamwamba futi nonyema buredi nakudya. Pamene anakamba nabeve nthawi itali nishi kufuna kucha, anayenda.
ACT 20:12	Anamubwelesa munyamata wa moyo ndipo anatothozidwa maningi.
ACT 20:13	Ise bamene tinayenda pasogolo pali Paulo na boti noyenda ku Asosi, kwamene tinaganiza kuti tiyenda nayeve Paulo. Ici ndiye camene anafuna yeve kucita, cifukwa anapulana kuyenda pansi.
ACT 20:14	Pamene tinakumana nayeve ku Asosi, tinamutenga mu boti ndipo tinayenda ku Mitileni.
ACT 20:15	Tinayenda kucoka paja nofika siku yokokhapo pafupi na pamalo ya Chiyosi. Siku yokokhapo tinafika pamalo ya Samosi, ndipo siku yokokhapo tinafika ku tauni ya Miletasi.
ACT 20:16	Cifukwa Paulo anagaza kuyenda kupitilila Aifenso, kuti asataye nthawi ili yonse mu Asia; cifukwa enzo thamangila ku Yelusalemu kuti apezekeko ku siku ya Pentekositi, kati cenzeli cokwanilisika kwa yeve kucita so.
ACT 20:17	Kucoka ku Miletasi anatuma banthu ku Aifenso ndipo anaitana akulu amu mpingo.
ACT 20:18	Pamene anabwela kuli yeve, anakamba ati kuli beve, kucoka siku yoyamba pamene ninangena mu Asia, mwamne lyonse nimakhalila na imwe.
ACT 20:19	Ninapitiliza kutumikila Ambuye mozicepesa na misozi, namasauso yamene yananicitikila ine cifukwa ca kuniteya kwa Yuda.
ACT 20:20	Muziba mwamene sinina nkhalile zii pakukuuzani camene cinali cofunikila, namwamene ninakuphunzisilani pagulupu nakupitamo muma nyumba.
ACT 20:21	Muziba mwamene ninapitiliza kucenjeza ba Yuda naba Giliki pakutembenukila kuli Mulungu na cikhulupililo mwa Ambuye Yesu.
ACT 20:22	Koma manje, onani, niyenda omangiwa mu Mzimu Oyela ku Yeslusalemu, siniziba zamene zizanicitikila kuja,
ACT 20:23	kucosako cabe kuti Mzimu Oyela amakamba naine mu tauni iliyonse nokamba ati macheni nakubvutika kuku yembekezela.
ACT 20:24	Koma sinibelengela kuti umoyo wanga niwabwino kwa ine, kuti nisilize nchito yanga nautumiki wamene ninalandila kucokela kwa Ambuye Yesu, kuti nipeleke umboni pali uthenga wa cisomo ca Mulungu.
ACT 20:25	Ndipo manje, onani, niziba kuti monse, bamene ninapitamo kulalikila za ufumu, simuzaniwona futi.
ACT 20:26	Cifukwa ca ici nipelekela umboni kwa imwe lero, kuti nilibe mulandu pa mwazi wamunthu aliyense.
ACT 20:27	Cifukwa sininankhale zii kukamba kwa imwe cifunilo conse ca Mulungu.
ACT 20:28	So nkhalani ozisamalila imwe mweka, na nkhosa zonse zamene Mzimu Oyela anakupanga kunkhala oyanganila. Nkhalani osamalila kucita ubusa pa mpingo wa Mulungu wamene anagula na mwazi wake. (Malemba yenangu yakamba ati,  Nkhalani ocenjela kusamalila mupingo wa Mulungu wamene anagula namwazi wa mwana wake).
ACT 20:29	Niziba kuti ngati nacoka, mimbulu yolusa izaloba pakati panu, ndipo si izalekelela nkhosa.
ACT 20:30	Niziba kuti ngankhale pakati panu bamuna binangu azabwela nokamba vinthu voononga, kuti bakoke ophunzila kuli beve.
ACT 20:31	So nkhalani pa gadi. Kumbukilani kuti kwa zaka zitatu sininaleke kuuza aliyense wa imwe vocita namisozi usiku na muzuba.
ACT 20:32	Manje nikupelekani kwa Mulungu nakumau yacisomo cake, yamene yakwanisa kukumangani imwe ndiponso kukupasani colowa pakati pabonse bamene bali oyelesedwa.
ACT 20:33	Sininakhubwile siliva, golide kapena malaya yamunthu.
ACT 20:34	Imwe mweka muziba kuti mwanja yanga yananipasa zamene nezofuna nazofuna zabaja bamene nenzeli nabo.
ACT 20:35	Muzinthu zonse ninakupasani cisanzo mwamene mufunikila kuthandizila ofoka pakusebenza, namwamene mufunikila kukumbukila mau ya Ambuye yesu, mau yamene yeve yeka anakamba: "nikodalisika kupasa kupambana kulandila."
ACT 20:36	Pamene anakamba munjila yaso, anagwada pansi nopemphela nabo pamozi bonse.
ACT 20:37	Bonse banalila maningi nomukumbata mumkosi nomu kising'a.
ACT 20:38	Banamvela cifundo maka maka pazamene anakamba, kuti sazamuwonanso. Ndipo anamupelekeza ku boti.
ACT 21:0	Mutu 21
ACT 21:1	Pamene anacoka pali beve nobwelo yambapo, tinayenda njila ya siteleti ku tauni ya Kosi, ndipo siku yokokhapo ku tauni ya Rodesi, ndipo kucoka apo ku tauni ya Patara.
ACT 21:2	Pamene tinapeza boti itauka kuyenda ku Fonisiya, tinakwelamo nobwelo yambapo.
ACT 21:3	Pamene tinabona mzinda wa Sipurasi, tinausiya ku mazele, noyenda ku Siliya, ndipo tinafika pa tauni ya Taya, cifukwa ndiye kwamene boti yenzofunika kusiya katundu.
ACT 21:4	Pamene tinapeza ophunzila, tinakhalako masiku yali 7. Aba bophunzila banakamba ati kuli Paulo kupitila mwa Mzimu kuti safunika kudyekamo kwendo mu Yelusalemu.
ACT 21:5	Pamene masiku yanasila, tinacoka nopitiliza na ulendo wathu. Bonse, pamozi nabazikazi nabana bawo, anatipelekeza mpaka ninacoka mu tauni. Ndipo tinagwada mumbala yamumana, nopemphela, nolailana wina namuzake.
ACT 21:6	Tinakwela boti, pamene beve benzo bwelelanso kunyumba.
ACT 21:7	Pamene tinasiliza ulendo waku Taya, tinafika pa Ptolemasi. Luja ninapasa moni abale nonkhalako siku imozi.
ACT 21:8	Siku yokokhapo tinacoka noyenda ku Sezariya. Tinangena mu nyumba ya Filipo, mlaliki wa uthenga, wamene anali umozi pali baja 7, ndipo tinankhala naye.
ACT 21:9	Manje uyu mwamuna enzeli naba namwali bali 4 bamene benzo nenera.
ACT 21:10	Pamene banakhalako kuja kwa siku, Kunabwela kucoka ku Judeya mneneri winangu zina lake ni Agabasi.
ACT 21:11	Anabwela kwa ise notenga beoti ya Paulo. Anazimanga nayo mendo na manja yake nokamba ati, "Icindiye camene akamba Mzimu Oyela, ' Cimuzi mozi ndiye mwamene azacitila Ayuda mu Yelusalemu kumanga mwinewake wa beoti iyi, ndipo azamupeleka mumanja ya Akunja.'"
ACT 21:12	Pamene tinamvela izi zinthu, ise pamozi nabaja banthu benzonkhala malo yaja tinamupepha Paulo kuti asayendeko ku Yelusalemu.
ACT 21:13	Koma Paulo anayankha, "Mucita cani, kulila nobabisa mtima wanga? Cifukwa ndine okonzekela, osati kumangidwa cabe koma kumwalila mu Yelusalemu cifukwa ca zina la Ambuye Yesu."
ACT 21:14	Cifukwa Paulo sanafune kugonjela, tinaleka kumulesa ndipo tinakamba ati, Lekani cifunilo ca Ambuye cicitike."
ACT 21:15	Pamene masiku aya yanasila, tinatenga viola vathu noyenda ku Yelusalemu.
ACT 21:16	Kuja nakwebve anayendela naise pamozi ophunzira ocokela ku Sezeriya. Anabwela namunthu zina lake ni Mnasoni, mwamuna ocokela ku Sipurasi, ophunzila oyamba, wamene tenzonkhala nayeve.
ACT 21:17	Pamene tinafika mu Yelusalemu, ba bale banatiladila mokodwela.
ACT 21:18	Siku yokonkhapo Paulo anayenda naise kuli Jemusi, ndipo akulu bonse benzelipo.
ACT 21:19	Pamene anabapasa moni anarepota umozi, umozi vinthu vamene Mulungu anacita pakati pali Akunja kupitila mu utumiki wake.
ACT 21:20	Pamene banazimvela, banayaminka Mulungu, ndipo banakamba ati kwa yeve, "Woona, mubale, nibangati ma sauzande bamene bakhulupilila pakati pali Ayuda. Bonse nibofunisisa kusunga  malamulo.
ACT 21:21	Banauziwa za iwe, kuti uphunzisa a yuda bonse bamene ankhala pakati pa Akunja kuti aleke Mose, ndipo kuti ubabuza kuti asacite mdulidwe bana bawo, ndipo kuti basakonkhe mwambo wakudala.
ACT 21:22	Kansi nizacita bwanji? Bazamvela kuti unabwela.
ACT 21:23	So cita camene tikuuza manje: nina bamuna bali 4 bamene banapanga pangano.
ACT 21:24	Tenga aba banthu ndipo uziyelese wake pamozi nabeve, ndipo ubalipilile, kuti agele mitu yawo. Kuti wina aliyense azibe kuti vinthu vamene banauziwa pali iwe nivaboza. Bazaziba kuti naiwenso uknkha lamulo.
ACT 21:25	Koma pali ba Kunja bamene banakhulupilila, tinabalembela kubauza kuti bazisunge kuvinthu vopelekewa ku mafano, mwazi, cakufa ceka na ciwele wele."
ACT 21:26	Ndipo Paulo anatenga baja bamuna, ndipo siku yokonkhapo, anaziyelesa yeve na beve, analoba mu tempele nonaunsa masiku yakuyelesedwa, paka copeleka cinapelekwedwa kwa beve bonse.
ACT 21:27	Pamene masiku yali 7 yanankhala pang'ono kusila, Ayuda baku Asia banona Paulo mu tempele, ndipo anatufya bonse kuti bapange congo, ndipo banamugwila yeve.
ACT 21:28	Benzo punda, "Bamuna ba Israyeli, tithandizeni. Uyu ndiye munthu wamene aphunzisa banthu bonse vinthu vosushana na banthu, lamulo na malo yano. Kucosapo izi, anabwelesanso a Giliki mu tempele nofifya malo aya yoyela."
ACT 21:29	Cifukwa banaonapo Trofimasi waku Aifenso nayeve mu tauni, ndipo banganiza kuti kapena Paulo ndiye anamuleta mu tempele.
ACT 21:30	Tauni yonse inakalipa, ndipo banthu banathamanga pamozi nomugwila Paulo. Banamucosa mu tempele, ndipo viseko vinavaliwa pamene apo.
ACT 21:31	Pamene benzo yesa kumupaya, nkhani inafika kuli capitawo mukulu wama gadi kuti Yelusalemu yonse yenze mucongo.
ACT 21:32	Pamene apo anatenga asilikali nothamangila kwamene kwenze gulu. Pamene gulu inawona kapitawo mukulu na asilikali, banaleka kumumenya Paulo.
ACT 21:33	Pamene apo kapitawo mukulu anafika nogwila Paulo, nolamulila kuti amagidwe na macheni yabili. Banamufunsa kuti iye nindani nacamene wacita.
ACT 21:34	Banthu benangu mucigulu benzo punda ici benagu cija. Cifukwa cakuti kapitawo sanazibe cokamba cifukwa cacongo, analamulila kuti Paulo apelekewe mumalo yothabila.
ACT 21:35	Pamene anafika pama sitepu yamalo pothabila, asilikali banamunyamula cifukwa ca congo ca gulu.
ACT 21:36	Cifukwa gulu inakonkha ndipo benzo punda kuti, "Sitimufuna yeve!"
ACT 21:37	Pamene anankhala pang'ono Paulo kuti afika pa malo yothabila, anakamba ati kuli kapitawo mukulu, "Kansi ningakambeko cinthu cinangu kwa iwe?" Kapitawo anakamba ati, umakamba ci Giliki?
ACT 21:38	Sindiwe waku Egypto, wamene manje manje apa unaleta ku ukila notenga bowukila bali 4 sauzande mucipululu?"
ACT 21:39	Paulo anakamba ati, Ndine mu Yuda, kucoka ku tauni ya Tarsasi mu Silisiya. Ndine sitizeni wa tauni yofunikila. Nikupempha, nilole nikambe nabanthu."
ACT 21:40	Pamene kapitawo mukula anamubvomeleza, Paulo anaimilila pama sitepu nonyamula kwanja kubanthu. Pamene kunankhala zii maningi, anakamba na yeve muci Heberi. Anakamba ati,
ACT 22:0	Mutu 22
ACT 22:1	"Abale na batate, mvelani kuzidifenda kwanga kwamene nipeleka kwa imwe."
ACT 22:2	Pamene gulu inamvela Paulo kukamba nabeve mucitundu caci Heberi, banankhala zii. Anakamba ati,
ACT 22:3	Ndine mu Yuda, obadwila mu Tasasi ku Silisiya, koma ophunzilila mu tauni ino kuli Gamaliyelo.Ninaphunzisiwa kulingana na njila zacilamulo zamakolo bathu. Ndine wacangu pali Mulungu, monga mwamene mulili imwe monse lero.
ACT 22:4	Ninasausa ba kristu kufika nopaya; ninamanga bamuna nabakazi pamozi nobapeleka mujele.
ACT 22:5	Ndipo mkulu wa nsembe na azikulu angapelekele umboni kuti ninalandila makalata kucoka kuli beve pali ba bale ali ku Damasikasi, kuti ine niyende kuja. Nenzo funika kuleta akristu womangidwa ku Yelusalemu kuti bapanishiwe.
ACT 22:6	Cinacitika kuti pamene nenzo yenda nonkhala pafupi na Damasiko, camuzuba mwazizi laiti ikulu kucoka kumwamba inasanika kuzunguluka ine.
ACT 22:7	Ninagwa pansi nakumvela mau kukamba naine, 'Sauli, Sauli, nicifukwa nicicani unasausa ine?
ACT 22:8	Ninayankha, Ndimwe ndani Ambuye?' Anakamba naine kuti, 'Ndine Yesu waku Nazareti, wamene unzunza.'
ACT 22:9	Baja bamene anali naine banaiwona laiti, koma sibanamvesese mau yauja wamene anakamba naine.
ACT 22:10	Ninakamba ati, Nicite bwabji, Ambuye?' Ambuye anakamba naine ati, ' Nyamuke uyende ku Damasikasi; kuja uzauziwa zonse zamene ufunika kucita.'
ACT 22:11	Sinenzo kwanisa kubona cifukwa ca kuyaka ca laiti ija, so ninayenda ku Damasikasi kusogolelewa nabaja wamene enzeli na ine.
ACT 22:12	Kuja ninakuma namwamuna zina lake ni Ananiyasi, mwamuna ozipeleka kulingana nalamulo ndipo ba Yuda bonse bonkhala kuja banakamba zabwino pali yeve.
ACT 22:13	Anabwela kwa ine, noimila pafupi naine, nokamba ati, 'Mubale Sauli, landila maso yako.' Munthawi yamene iwo ninayangana.
ACT 22:14	Ndipo anakamba ati, Mulungu wamakolo yathu akusankha iwe kuti uzibe cifunilo cake, kuti uwone Iye Olungama, ndipo kuti umvele mau yocokela pakamwa pake.
ACT 22:15	Cifukwa uzankhala mboni yake kubanthu bonse pazamene waona nomvela.
ACT 22:16	Manje nicifukwa nicani uyembekezela? Nyamuka, nobatizika, nosunka macimo yako, kuitana pazina lake.'
ACT 22:17	Pamene ninabwelela ku Yelusalemu, ndipo pamene nenzopemphela mu tempele, cinacitika kuti ninapasiwa maso mphenya.
ACT 22:18	Ninamuwona akamba naine, Indisa yenda ku Yelusalemu mwamusanga, cifukwa sibazalandila umboni wako pali ine.'
ACT 22:19	Ninakamba ati, Ambuye beve beka baziba kuti ninamanga nomenya baja bamene anakhulupilila mwa imwe mu sinagoge ili yonse.
ACT 22:20	Pamene mwazi wa Stefano mboni yanu unatika, nenzo yembekezela nogwilizana nazo, ndipo nizogading'a malaya baja bamene anamupaya.'
ACT 22:21	Koma anakamaba ati kwa ine, 'Yenda, cifukwa nizakutuma kwa Akunja."
ACT 22:22	Banthu banamulo kuti akambe kufika apa. Koma banapunda nokamba ati, Mupayeni sitimufuna pano pacalo: sicofunikila kuti ankhale na moyo."
ACT 22:23	Pamene benzeli kupunda, kumuponyela malaya yabo, noponya kalukungu mumwamba,
ACT 22:24	kapitawo mukulu analamulila kuti Paulo apelekewe mu malo yothabila. Analamulila kuti afunsiwe namikwapu pamene, kuti yeve aziba nicifukwa nicani benzo pundila yeve monga so.
ACT 22:25	Pamene banamumanga navinthambo, Paulo anakamba kuli musilikali wamene enze cilili pafupi, Kansi nicololedwa kukwapula munthu wamene ni mu Roma ndipo wamene sanaweluzidwe?"
ACT 22:26	Pamene musilikali anamvela izi, anayenda kuli kapitawo mukulu nomuuza kuti, kansi ufuna ucite cani? Uyu munthu ni sitizeni waku Roma.
ACT 22:27	Kapitawo mukulu anabwela nokamba ati kwa yeve, "Niuze, ndiwe sitizeni waku Roma?" Paulo anayankha ati, "Inde."
ACT 22:28	Kapitawo mukulu anayankha ati, "ninasebenzesa ndalama zambili kuti ninkhale sitizeni." Koma Paulo anakamba ati, ine ninabadwa sitizeni wa Roma."
ACT 22:29	Ndipo banthu benzo yenda umufunsa banamusiya pamene apo. Kapitawo mukulu nayeve anayopa, pamene anaziba kuti Paulo enze sitizeni wa Roma, cifukwa anazimangilila yeka.
ACT 22:30	Siku yokokhapo, kapitawo mukulu enzofuna kuziba coonadi pali mulandu wamene Ayuda anapasa Paulo. So anamumasula nolamulila akulu asembe na khanso yonse kuti bakumane. Pamene apo analeta Paulo nomuyika pakati pawo.
ACT 23:0	Mutu 23
ACT 23:1	Paulo anayangana pali ma membala ba nkhanso nokamba ati, "Abale, nankhala pamaso pa Mulungu mumaganizo abwino kufikila lelo."
ACT 23:2	Mukulu wa nsembe Ananiyasi analamulila baja bamene naimilila pafupi nayeve kuti amumenye pakamwa.
ACT 23:3	Ndipo Paulo anakamba ati kwa yeve, Mulungu azakumenya iwe, iwe cipilala ca waiti. Kansi wankhala kuniweluza ine mwa lamulo, koma ulamulila kuti banimenye, mosushana na lamulo?"
ACT 23:4	Baja bamene banaimilila pafupi banakamba ati, "Umu ndiye mwamene unyozela mukulu wansembe wa Mulungu?"
ACT 23:5	Paulo anati, Sininanyozele , abale, kuti enzeli mukulu wa nsembe. Cifukwa kunalembewa, Suzakamba zoipa pali  wolamulila wa banthu bako."
ACT 23:6	Pamene Paulo anabona kuti mbali imozi yaba khanso anali a saduki ndipo mbali imozi apharise, anakamba mopunda mu khanso, "Abale, ndine Mupharise, mwana mwamuna wa Mupharise. Nicifukwa cakuti nilinaco cisimikizo kuyembekezela bakufa kuuka ndiye camene niweluziliwa."
ACT 23:7	Pamene anakamba izi, kusushana pakati pa Apharise na Saduki kunayamba, ndipo gulu inagabikana.
ACT 23:8	Cifukwa Asaduki akamba kuti kulibe kuuka, kulibe angelo, namizimu, koma Apharise bagwilizana nazo zonse.
ACT 23:9	So mukangano ukulu unacitika, ndipo olemba binangu benzeli kumbali ya Pharisi anaimilila nosusha, kukamba kuti, "Sitipeza mulandu nauyu munthu. Nanga ngati muzimu kapena mungelo akamba naiye?"
ACT 23:10	Ndipo apo kunauka kukangana maningi, kapitawo mukulu anayopa kuti Paulo azamupweteka, so analamulila asilikali kuti bamutenge mwacikakamizo pakati pama membara ba khanso, nakumubwelesa pamalo yothabila.
ACT 23:11	Usiku okokhapo Ambuye anaimilila pafupi nayeve nomuuza kuti, "Osayopa, monga mwamene wapelekela umboni pali ine mu Yelusalemu, so ufunika kupeleka umboni mu Roma."
ACT 23:12	Pamene kunakhala kuseni, bena ba Yuda banagwilizana noitana tembelelo pali beve: banakamba ati sibazadya kapena kumwa ciliconse paka maupaye Paulo.
ACT 23:13	Benzeli wokwanila ngati bamuna bali 40 bamene banapanga iyi pangano.
ACT 23:14	Banayenda kuli mukulu wa nsembe na azikulu nokamba ati, tazifaka pa tembelelo ikulu, sitizadya kanthu paka tipaye Paulo.
ACT 23:15	Manje so, lekani khanso iwuze kapitawo mukulu alete Paulo kuli iwe, cifukwa ungaweluze mulandu wake bwino. Kuli ise, ndise wokonzekela kumupaya iye akalibe kufika kuno."
ACT 23:16	Koma mwana wa sisita wa Paulo anamvela kuti benzo muyembekezela, so anayenda noloba mumalo yothabilapo numuuza Paulo.
ACT 23:17	Paulo anaitana umozi wa asilikali nokamba ati, "Mupeleke uyu nyamata kuli mukulu wa asilikali, cifukwa ali navamene afuna kumuuza."
ACT 23:18	So musilikali anatenga munyamata nomuleta kuli kapitawo mukulu nokamba ati, Paulo kaidi ananiitanila yeve, noniuza kuti nilete uyu munyamata kwa iwe. Alinacokamba kwa iwe."
ACT 23:19	Kapitawo mukulu anamutenga pakwanja pamalo yobisika nomufunsa, "Ufuna kuniuza cani?"
ACT 23:20	Mnyamata anakamba ati, Ayuda bagwilizana kuti bakupemphe kuti ulete Paulo mailo ku khanso, monga ngati bafuna kumufunsa bwino bwino pali uyu mulandu.
ACT 23:21	Koma usabvomele, cifukwa kuli bamuna wopitilila bali 40 bamene bamuyembekezela. Bazifaka tembelelo, kuti sibazadya kapena kumwa mpaka bamupaye Paulo. Namanje so, niwokonzekela, kuyembekezela kuti ubvomele."
ACT 23:22	So kapitawo mukulu anamusiya mnyamata kuti ayende, nishi amuuza kuti, "Usauze aliyense kuti waniuza izi zinthu."
ACT 23:23	Pamene apo anamuitanila asilikali babili nokamba ati, Konzekelani basilikali bali 200 kuti bayende ku Sezariya, nabali 70 bamahosi, nabamikondo bali 200. Muzayenda na 9:00 koloko."
ACT 23:24	Anabalamulila kuti bamupase nyama yamene Paulo aza yenzanomupeleka kuli govana Felike.
ACT 23:25	Ndipo analemba kalata kuti:
ACT 23:26	Klaudiyasi Lisiyasi kuli olemekezeka Govana Felike, nikupasa moni.
ACT 23:27	Uyu munthu anamagidwa na Ayuda ndipo enzofuna upaiwa nabeve, pamene apo tinabwela nabasilikali nomumasula, cifukwa ninamvela kuti enzeli sitizeni waku Roma.
ACT 23:28	Ninafuna kuziba camene banamupasila mulando, so ninamupeleka ku khanso yabo.
ACT 23:29	Ninabvela kuti banamupasa mulandu pamafunso ya malamulo tabo, koma kwenzelibe mulandu pali yeve wenzofunika kui bamupaye kapena kumufaka mujele.
ACT 23:30	So ninazibisiwa kuti penzeli pangano pali uyu munthu, so mwamusanga musanga ninamutuma kuli imwe, ndipo ninauza womupasa mulandu kuti balete milandu zake kuli imwe. Bayi."
ACT 23:31	So asilikali anabvelela kulamulila kwawo: banatena Paulo usiku nomuleta kuli Antipatirisi.
ACT 23:32	Siku yokokhapo, basilikali bambili anasiya baja benzeli pamahosi kuti bayende nayebve ndipo beve babwelele kumalo yothabilapo.
ACT 23:33	Pamene baja benzeli pamahosi banafika Sezariya nopeleka kalata kuli govana, ndiponso banapeleka Paulo kuli yeve.
ACT 23:34	Pamene govana anabelenga kalata, anafunsa kumuzinda kwamene Paulo anacokela; pamene anamvela kuti anacokela ku Silisiya,
ACT 23:35	anakamba ati, nizakubvela mofikapo pamene bamene bakupasa mulandu bafika." So analamulila kuti bamusungile mu hedikota yaboma ya Herode.
ACT 24:0	Mutu 24
ACT 24:1	Patapita masiku 5, Ananiyasi mukulu wansembe, akule bena, na loya zina lake Tetulasi, anayendako kuja. Aba banthu banaleta milndu ya Paulo kuli govana.
ACT 24:2	Pamene Paulo anaimilila  pamenso pa govna, Tetulasi anayamba kumupasa mulandu nokamba ati kuli govana, "Cifukwa ca iwe tinamutendele ukulu, ndipo masomphenya yako yatiletela kusinthika muziko yathu;
ACT 24:3	so naciyamiko consetilandila zonse zamene ucita, wolemekezeka Felike.
ACT 24:4	Kuti nisakusungeni futi, nipempha kuti mwamusanga munimvele mokoma mtima.
ACT 24:5	Cifukwa napeza uyu munthu kunkhala kantha ta nawamene apanga Ayuda bonse paziko yonse kuti baukile. Nimusogoleli wa kagulu kaba Nazarene.
ACT 24:6	Enzo funa nonyoza tempele, so tinamumanga. (Ndipo tenzofuna kumumanga kulingana na lamulo).
ACT 24:7	(Koma Lisiyasi ofisala, anabwela ndipo mwacikakamizo anamutenga mumanja mwathu).
ACT 24:8	Pamene munamunsa Paulo pali zonse nkhani, imwe, naimwe, muzaziba vamene timupasila milandu."
ACT 24:9	Ba Yuda pamozi banamupasa mlandu Paulo, nabeve, nokamba ati izi zinthu nizazoona.
ACT 24:10	Koma pamene govana anauza Paulo kuti akambe, Paulo anayankha, Ninamvela kuti paka nthawi katali wankhala oweluza kucalo icic, ndipo mokondwela nifotokoza izi zinthu kwa iwe.
ACT 24:11	Ukwanisa kupeza kuti sipana pite masiku 12 pamene ninayenda kulambila ku Yelusalemu;
ACT 24:12	ndipo pamene ananipeza mu tempele, sininasushane na munthu aliyense, ndipo sininabushe viongo, mumasinagoge olo mu tauni,
ACT 24:13	ndipo sibangaku simikizile pa milandu zamene anipasa apa manje.
ACT 24:14	Koma nibvomela ici kuli iwe, kuti kulingana namwamene baitanila ka gulu kan'ono, munjila yamene iwo nitumikila Mulungu ya azitate bathu. Ndine okhulupililika kulingana nazamene zili mucilamulo novolembewa muli aneneri.
ACT 24:15	Nili naco cisimikizo ca semu muli Mulungu, monga aba banthu nabeve baciyembekeza, kuukisidwa kwa akufa kwamene kubwela, kwa oulangama nabaja bosalungama;
ACT 24:16	ndipo mwa ici nisebenza kuti ninkhale namaganizo yalibe vuto pamaso ya Mulungu na banthu muzinthu zonse.
ACT 24:17	Ndipo pamene panapita zaka zambili ninabwela kuleta thandizo kucalo canga na mphaso za ndalama.
ACT 24:18	Pamene ninacita ici, Ayuda benangu ocokela ku Asia banipeza mumwambo wozitubisa mu tempele, kwenzelibe gulu kapena ku usha viongo.
ACT 24:19	Aba banthu bafunika kunkhala pa menso pako manje kuti bakambe zamene bali nazo pali ine, ngati bali nazo.
ACT 24:20	Olo kapena, aba banthu bamene akambe voipa vamene bapeza muli ine pamene ninaimilila pamenso ya khanso Yaciyuda;
ACT 24:21	pokhapo ngati cili pali camene nakamba mopunda pamene nenze naimila pali beve, 'nipali kuuka kwa akufa pamene niweluziwa lero naiwe.'"
ACT 24:22	Felike enzeli ozibisiwa bwino pa nkhani yacikristu, so mulandu anabupeleka pa sogolo. Anakamba ati, "Nthawi iliyonse pamene Lisiyasi olamulila azabwela kucoka ku Yelusalemu, nizaweluza mulandu wako."
ACT 24:23	So analamulila musilikali kuti agading'e Paulo, koma  ankhale namutendele, ndipo pasankhale aliyense azalisa bazake kumuthandiza kapena kuyendela yeve.
ACT 24:24	Patapita masiku, Felike anabwelela ku Durusila mkazi wake, Waciyuda, ndipo anaitasa Paulo ndipo anmumvelela mwamene anakambila pa cikhulupililo mwa Kristu Yesu.
ACT 24:25	Koma pamene Paulo anakambilana nayeve pali ciyelo, kuzilesa, naciweluzilo camene cibwela, Felike anankhala namantha nokamba ati, "Coka apa pali ine. Koma nikankala nanhtawi inangu zizakuitana."
ACT 24:26	Panthawi yamene iyo, enzoyembekezela kuti Paulo azamupasa ndalama yeve, so enzomuitana kabili kabili nokamba nayeve.
ACT 24:27	Koma pamene zaka zibili zinapita, Ponshasi Fesitasi anakhala govana pamene Felike anacokapo, koma Felike enzo funa kuti Ayuda bamukonde, so anasiya paulo alioganding'iwa.
ACT 25:0	Mutu 25
ACT 25:1	Manje Fesitasi anangene mu mzinda, ndipo patapita masiku yatatu, anayenda kucoka ku Sezariya  anafika naku Yelusalemu.
ACT 25:2	Mkulu wa nsembe na Yuda bozibika bwino analeta mulandu pali Paulo kwa Fesitasi, ndipo banakambisisa maningi kwa Fesitasi.
ACT 25:3	Ndipo banapempha Fesitasi kuti aba citeko bwino pali Paulo, kuti amuitane kuti abwele ku Yelusalemu kuti bamupayile munjila.
ACT 25:4	Koma Fesitasi anayankha kuti Paulo anali kaidi waku Sezariya, ndipo kuti yeve manje manje enzobwelela kuja kwamene.
ACT 25:5	"Cifukwa caici, baja bamene bakwanisa," anakamba yeve, afunika kuyende pamozi naise. Ngati pali bvuto iliyonse pali uyu munthu, muzamupasa mulandu."
ACT 25:6	Pamene anankhalako masiku 8 olo 10, anayenda ku Sezariya. Nipo pasiku yokonkhapo, anakhala pamupando oweluzila ndipo analamulila kuti Paulo abwele kwa yeve.
ACT 25:7	Pamene anafika, Ayuda aku Yelusalemu anaimilila pafupi, ndipo analeta milandu yambili yamene sibana puluve.
ACT 25:8	Paulo anazidifenda nokamba ati, "Sininacita kanthu koipa pali lamulo ya Ayuda kapena pali tempele kapena pali Seza."
ACT 25:9	Koma Fesitasi anafuna kuti Ayuda amukonde , ndipo anayankha Paulo nokamba ati, "Ufuna uyende ku Yelusalemu kuti nikakuweluzila pali izi zinthu?"
ACT 25:10	Paulo anakamba, " Ni imilila pamaso pamupandu waciweluzo wa Seza kumwene nifunika kuweluziwa. Sininalakwila Muyuda aliyense, monga iwe uzibila bwino.
ACT 25:11	Koma ngati nacita coipa ndipo nacita camene cifunikila imfa, sinikana kumwalila. Koma ngati palibe milandu, kulibe wamene angani peleke kuli beve. Ni itana Siza."
ACT 25:12	Pamene Fesitasi anakamba naba Nkhanso, anayankha kuti, waita Siza; uzayenda kuli Siza."
ACT 25:13	Patapita masiku, Mfumu Agiripa na Benisi anafika ku Sizariya kuti ayendele mwapadela Fesitasi.
ACT 25:14	Pamene anankalako masiku yambili, Fesitasi anapeleka nkhani ya Paulo kuli mfumu; anakamba ati, Munthu winangu anamusiya Feleki kuno monga kaidi.
ACT 25:15	Pamene  nenzeli ku Yelusalemu, mkulu wa nsembe na akulu ba Ayuda analeta milandu kwa ine pali uyu munthu, ndipo banafuna ine kuti nimuweluze.
ACT 25:16	Pali ici ninayakha kuti simwa mwambo wa Aroma kuweluza munthu monga mwamene bafunila; koma, koma munthu anamulandu ali namupata kuti akumane nabomupasa mulandu kuti azidifende pali milandu yamene anamupasa.
ACT 25:17	So, pamene anabwela pamozi kuno, sininayembekezele, koma siku yokonkhapo ninankhala pamupando oweluzila ndipo ninalamulila kuti amulete.
ACT 25:18	Pamene omupasa mulandu anaimilira nomupasa mulandu, ninanganiza kuti panalibe mulandu wene wene pamilandu yamene anamupasa.
ACT 25:19	Mmalo mwake, enzeli namukangano nayeve pali cipembezo cawo napali  Yesu winangu wamene anafa, wamene Paulo akamba ati alimoyo.
ACT 25:20	Ninasokonezeka mwamene ningafufuzile iyi nkhani, ndipo ninamufunsa ngati tingayende ku Yelusalemu kuti akaweluzidwe kwamene uko pali izi nkhani.
ACT 25:21	Koma pamene Paulo anapempha kuti aganding'iwe kuti amvele nganizo ya empala, ninalamulila kuti amusunge paka nimutume kuli Siza."
ACT 25:22	Agiripa anakamba na Fesitasi, "Nifuna naine nimumvele uyu munthu." "Mailo," Fesitasi anakamba ati, "Uzakamumvela."
ACT 25:23	So siku yokonkhapo, Agiripa na Benise anabwela na mwambo maningi; banangene mu holo nasilikali nabanthu bozibika mu tauni. Pamene Fesitasi anakamba lamulo, Paulo anamubwelesa kuli yeve.
ACT 25:24	Fesitasi anakamba ati, "Mfumu Agiripa, naimwe onse amuna muli naise muno, mwamuona uyu munthu; onse gulu ya Ayuda anapempha nzeli kuli ine mu Yelusalemu na kuno nakweve, ndipo anapunda kwa ine kuti asankhale futi na moyo.
ACT 25:25	Ninazindikila kuti sanapange mulando ufunika kupaiwa; koma anaitana empala, ndipo ninaganiza kumutuma.
ACT 25:26	Koma nilibe cene cene kuti nilembele kuli empara. Cifukwa caici, namubwelesa kwa iwe, maka-maka kwa iwe, Mfumu Agiripa, kuti ningankhale navo volemba pali uyu mulandu.
ACT 25:27	Cifukwa sicioneka bwino kwa ine kupeleka kaidi ndiponso kukamba milandu yake."
ACT 26:0	Mutu 26
ACT 26:1	So Agiripa anakamba kuli Paulo, "Zikambile iwe weka." So Paulo ananyamula kwanja nozidifenda.
ACT 26:2	"Niziyesa okondwela ine neka, Mfumu Agiripa, kuti nikambe mulandu wanga  pameso yanu siku yalero kusushana nazonse zamene Ayuda anipasa;
ACT 26:3	makamaka, cifukwa muziba bwino malamulo namafunso yonse ya Yuda. So nipempha kuti mumvelere bwino bwino.
ACT 26:4	Zoona, a Yuda onse aziba mwamene ninankhalila kucoka ku ufana wanga muzi ziko yanga namu Yelusalemu.
ACT 26:5	Ananiziba kucokela poyamba ndipo afunika kubvomela kuti ndine mu Falisi, kagulupu koikako nzelu pali cipembezo cathu.
ACT 26:6	Koma manje niimilila pano kuti niweluziwe cifukwa nisakila lonjezo yamene Mulungu anapanga kuli azitate anthu.
ACT 26:7	Cifukwa iyi ndiye lonjezo yamene mitundu ili 12 inayembekeza kulandila pamene enzo yamika Mulungu usiku namu zuba. Nipali ciyembekezo ici, Mfumu Agiripa, yamene Ayuda anipasila mulandu.
ACT 26:8	Cifukwa nicani kuti winangu waimwe kuti muganize kuti nicodabwisa kuti Mulungu aukisa akufa.
ACT 26:9	Panthawi inangu ninaganiza paine neka kuti nifunika kucita vinthu vambili vosushana nazina ya Yesu waku Nazareti.
ACT 26:10	Ninacita izi mu Yelusalemu. Nnakhomela okhulupilira ambiri mujele kupitila mu mphabvu zamene ninalandila kucokela kuli mkulu wa nsembe, ndipo pamene anapaiwa, ndipo ninaponya voti yanga kusushana nawo.
ACT 26:11	Ninabapasa cilango nthawi zambiri muma sinagoge ndipo nenzoyesa kubakakamiza kuti anyozele. Ananikwiisa maningi ndipo ninabasausa namumatauni yenangu.
ACT 26:12	Pamene nenzo cita ivi, ninayenda ku Damasikasi namphavu na malamulo yocokela kwa mkulu wa nsembe;
ACT 26:13	ndipo nili munjila, pakati pa siku, Mfumu, ninaona laiti kucoka ku mwamba yamene yenzeli yoyaka maningi monga zuba ndipo inasanika pali ine  nabanthu enzoyenda naine.
ACT 26:14	Pamene tonse tinagwa pansi, ninabvela mau kukamba naine yamene inakamba mucitundu caci Heberi, 'Saulo, Saulo, nicifukwa nicani unisausa ine? Nicovuta kuti iwe umenye Mulungu.
ACT 26:15	Ndipo ninakamba ati, 'Ndimwe ndani, Ambuye?' Ambuye anayakha, Ndine Yesu wamene usausa.
ACT 26:16	Manje nyamuka ndipo imilila; cifukwa pa colinga ici ninaonekela kwa iwe, kukusankha kunkhala wanchito namboni pali zinthu zamene uziba pali ine na zinthu zamene nizakuonesa pasogolo pake;
ACT 26:17	ndipo nizakupulumusa kuli anthu na Akunja kwamene nikutuma,
ACT 26:18	kuti ukasegule menso yabo nobatembenula kucoka ku mdima kubaleta ku laita ndipo kucoka kuli satana kubabwelesa kwa Mulungu, kuti bangalandile Mulungu nakukhululukiwa macimo nakatundu wamene nibapasa wamene nipatula kwa ine mwacikhulupiliro mwa ine.'
ACT 26:19	Cifukwa caici, Mfumu Agiripa, sindinacitile mwano maso mphenya yakumwamba;
ACT 26:20	koma kwa iwo aku Damasikasi coyamba, wokokhapo ku Yelusalemu, ndipo namuziko yonse ya Yudeya, ndiponso na Akunja, ninalalikila kuti atembenuke kwa Mulungu, cocita zinthu zoyenela kulapa.
ACT 26:21	Cifukwa ca ici Ayuda ananimanga ine mu tempele nofuna kunipaya.
ACT 26:22	Mulungu anithandiza kufikila manje, so niimilira kupelekela umboni kuli anthu wamba nakuli olemekezeka sipakhani iliyonse koma zamene aneneri na Mose anakamba zizacitika,
ACT 26:23	kuti Kristu afunika kubvutika, ndipo azankhala oyamba kuuka kwa kufa kuti alalikile laiti kuli Ayuda na Akunja."
ACT 26:24	Pamene Paulo anasiliza kuzidifenda, Fesitasi anakamba mopunda, Paulo, ndiwe ofuntha; pamphunziro yako yakufunthisa."
ACT 26:25	Koma Paulo anakamba ati, sindine ofuntha, olemekezeka Fesitasi; koma molimbika nikamba mau ya zoona namaganizo yali bwino bwino.
ACT 26:26	Cifukwa mfumu iziba pali izi zinthu; ndiponso nikamba momasuka kwa yeve, cifukwa nilinaco cisimikizo kuti kulibe pali izi zili zobisika kuli yeve; cifukwa izi sizina citike mobisika.
ACT 26:27	Mukhulupilira aneneri, Mfumu Agiripa? Niziba kuti mukhulupilira."
ACT 26:28	Agiripa anakamba kwa Paulo, "Pakanthawi kocepa ufuna kuti unikoke nonipanga kunkhala mu Kristu?"
ACT 26:29	Paulo anakamba ati, "Nipemphela kwa Mulungu, kuti ngankhale pakanthawi kocepa kapena nthawi itali, osati imwe cabe, koma onse amene anibvela lero, mungankhale monga ine, koma osati akapolo monga ine."
ACT 26:30	Pamene apo Mfumu inaimilila, na govana, na Benisi, nabaja bamene enze anankhala nabo;
ACT 26:31	pamene anacoka mu holo, anakambisa nokamba ati, "Uyu munthu kulibe camene wacita kuti afe kapena kunkhala mujele."
ACT 26:32	Agiripa anakamba ati kuli Fesitasi, "Uyu munthu sembe anamasuliwa ngati sanapeleke nkhani kwa Siza."
ACT 27:0	Mutu 27
ACT 27:1	Pamene tinagwilizana kuti tiyende ku Itali, anaika Paulo naba kaidi enangu mumanja ya msilikali zina lake Juliyasi wakugula ya Ogasitana.
ACT 27:2	Tinakwela boti kucoka  ku Adaramitiyamu, yamene yenzofunika kupitila ku mbala kwa Asia. So tinayenda ku mumana. Arisitakasi waku Thesalonika ku Masedoniya anyenda na ise.
ACT 27:3	Siku yokokhapo tinafika mu tauni ya Sidoni, kwamene Juliyasi anamusunga bwino Paulo nomulola kuyenda kuli anzake kuti amusamalile.
ACT 27:4	Kucoka apo, tinayenda kumumana noyenda muzungulila pa malo ya Sipurasi kwamene kuchingiliziwa ku mphempo, cifukwa mphempo yenzo bwela kuli ise.
ACT 27:5	Pamene tinatauka manzi yali pafupi Silisiya na Pamfiliya, tinafika ku Mira, tauni ya Lisia.
ACT 27:6	Kuja, msilikali anapeza ciboti cikulu kucokela ku Alekizandiriya yamene yenzo yenda ku itali. Anatifaka mwamene muja.
ACT 27:7	Pamene tinayenda pang'ono pang'ono masiku yambili mpaka tinafika muvutikila pafupi na Sinidasi, sitinayende futi ija njila cifukwa mphepo inali ikulu, so tinayenda kupitila pafupi na Keleti, kumbali kwina kwa Salimoni.
ACT 27:8	Tinapitila kuja kumbali mobvutikila, paka tinafika pa malo inangu yoitaniwa Feya Havenzi, yamene yalipafupi na tauni ya Lasi.
ACT 27:9	Tinatenga nthawi itali, na nthawi yosala kudya ya Ayuda inapita, ndipo cenzeli cobvuta kuyenda. So Paulo anabacenjeza, nokamba ati,
ACT 27:10	"Amuna, niwona kuti ngati tizayenda manje, tizankhala ocitika notaya zinthu, osati cabe katundu na boti ikulu, koma myioyo yathu."
ACT 27:11	Koma msilikali anasamalila abosi namwine wake wa boti kupambana zamene anakamba Paulo.
ACT 27:12	Cifukwa sicenze cotheka kukhala pa haba nthawi ya mphepo, ambili enze paulendo anabauza kuti acokepo, kuti ngati nicokwanisika tingafike ku tauni ya Fonikisi, kuti tikankhale kuja nthawi ya mphepo. Fonikisi ni haba ya Kereti, nakuti iyanga kummawa naku mmazulo.
ACT 27:13	Pamene mphepo yakumazulo inayamba kubwela pang'ono pang'ono, aulendo anaganiza benze nazamene benzo funa. Anafaka visimbi vikulu mumazi noyenda ku Kereti, pafupi kumbali mwa manzi.
ACT 27:14	Pamene panapita nthawi ing'ono ciphepo cikulu cangozi, cochedwa Ulosilidoni, cinabwela na mphabvu kucokela ku Kereti.
ACT 27:15	Pamene cimphepo cikulu cinamenya kusogolo kwa boti namphamvu kuti sitingayende pasogolo, tinagonjela nocikonkelela.
ACT 27:16	Tana thabila kwamene kwenzelibe mphepo maningi  kumbali ya malo yang'ono yocedwa Kauda; ndipo mobvutikila tinakwanisa kupeza tuma boti tung'ono tung'ono.
ACT 27:17	Pamene anaikenesa mukati, anasebenzesa nthambo zake kumanga ku boti ikulu. Anankhala namantha kuti tithabile mumbali mwa mumana wa Siritisi, so anamasula visimbi vikulu ndipo boti inakokhamo.
ACT 27:18	Tinabvutika maningi na mphepo, so siku yokokhapo benze paulendo banayamba kucosa katundu mu boti.
ACT 27:19	Siku yacitatu anayamba kuponya cothandizila boti namanja yawo.
ACT 27:20	Pamene zuba na nyenyezi sizinaoneke sizina wale pali kwa masiku yambili, ndipo cimphepo cikulu kumenya ku boti, ciyembekezo cinasila.
ACT 27:21	Pamene anankhala nanjala nthawi itali, pamene apo Paulo ananyamuka pakati pawo nokamba ati, "Azibambo, simbe mwenze munanibvelela, sembe sitinacoke ku Kereti kuti tipezeke mugozi nakutaya katundu.
ACT 27:22	Mannje nikulimbikisani kuti tilimbikile cifukwa kulibe moyo uzataika pakati paimwe, koma cabe kuonengeka kwa boti ikulu.
ACT 27:24	Cifukwa usiku wasila mngelo wa Mulungu wamene nitumikila, wamene nilambila -angelo wake anaimilila pafupi na ine
ACT 27:23	nokamba ati, "Osayopa, Paulo. Uzaimilila pamaso pa Siza, ndipo ona, Mulungu muchifundo cake wakupasa onse amene uyenda nawo.
ACT 27:25	Cifukwa caici, azibambo, limbikilani, cifukwa nikhululupilira Mulungu, kuti zizacitika monga mwamene anani uzila.
ACT 27:26	Koma mphepo izatikankila pambali.
ACT 27:27	Pamene masiku yali 14 yanasila, pamene mphepo inatikankila uku na uku mu  Cimumana ca Adiriyatiki, pakati pa usiku enze paulendo anaganiza kuti enzofika poyuma.
ACT 27:28	Anatenga copimila kutalimpha kwa manzi ndipo anapeza kuti yenze 40 mitazi, panapita nthawi ing'ono, anapima futi ndipo anapeza kuti yenzeli 15 mitazi.
ACT 27:29	Anayopa kuti angamenye kumwyala, so anaika visimbi vikulu vili 4 mumazi ndipo anapemphela kuti kuce mwamusanga.
ACT 27:30	Baja benze paulendo enzo sakila njila yocokelamo mu boti ndipo anacosa tumaboti tung'ono kutufaka mumazi, noganizila kuti azaponya visimbi kusogolo kwa boti.
ACT 27:31	Koma Paulo anakamba ati kuli msilikali na asilikali, pokhapo ngati aba anthu ankhalilira mu boti ikulu, suzapulumuka.
ACT 27:32	Ndipo asilikali anajuba nthambo za boti noilekela kuti iyende.
ACT 27:33	Pamene kwenzo kuca, Paulo analimbikisa onse kuti adye cakudya. Anakamba ati, "Lero nisiku ya 14 yamene muyembekeza ndipo simukudya; kulibe camene mwadya.
ACT 27:34	So nikupemphani mudye vakudya, cifukwa ici cili pankhukhala na moyo wanu; ndipo kulibe coipa cizacitika kwa imwe."
ACT 27:35	Pamene anakamba izi, anatenga buredi noyamika Mulungu pamenso ya aliyense. Ndipo ananyema buredi noyamba kudya.
ACT 27:36	Pamene apo bonse analimbikisika nakudya vakudya.
ACT 27:37	Tenzeli banthu 276 mu boti ikulu.
ACT 27:38	Pamene anadya mokwanila, banapesusa boti pakucosamo tiligu noyitala mumana.
ACT 27:39	Pamene nunabwela kwacha, sanzibe pamene enzeli, koma anaona poyuma, ndipo banakambila ngati bangayendepo na boti.
ACT 27:40	So banajuba vinsimbi novitaila mu mana. Pantawi yamene ija banajuba nthambo zacidirayivilo nonyamula cinyula capasogolo pa boti kuli mphepo; ndipo anayenda ku mbali kwa manzi.
ACT 27:41	Koma banafika pamalo pamene mimana ibili yakumana, ndipo boti inayenda pansi. Ndipo pansi kusogolo kwa boti kunajama nokanga kuyenda, koma kumbuyo kwa boti kunayamba ku tyoka cifukwa cacimphepo cikulu.
ACT 27:42	Maganizo ya asilikali yenze yakuti apaye akaidi kuti pasankale nangu amozi amene azanyaya nothaba.
ACT 27:43	Koma mu silikali anafuna kupulumusa Paulo, so anabalesa kucita vamene enzo nganiza kucita; ndipo analamulila kuti baja bamene aziba kunyaya ba jumpe poyamba noyenda poyuma.
ACT 27:44	Ndipo bonse osalila bakonkhe pambuyo, benangu benzeli pama pulanga, benangu pazinthu zinangu kucoka mu boti. Munjila iyi cinacitika kuti bonse tinafika bwino poyuma.
ACT 28:0	Mutu 28
ACT 28:1	Pamene tinafika bwino, tinamvela ati penzo itaniwa kuti Mata.
ACT 28:2	Banthu bakwamene kuja, sibanankale babwino cabe, koma banatiyashila mulilo notilandila bonse, cifukwa ca mvula na mphepo yamene siyenzoleka
ACT 28:3	Koma pamene Paulo anatenga tukhuni notufaka pa mulilo, njoka inacoka cifukwa camulilo, nomuluma Paulo nokangamila kukwanja kwake.
ACT 28:4	Pamene banthu bakuja banaona njoka kucoka kukwanja kwake, anakambisana, "Uyu munthu zoona niwopaya wamene anathaba kucoka ku mumana, koma sanaloledwe kuti ankhale namoyo.
ACT 28:5	So anakukhumulira njoka ija pamulilo ndipo sinalumiwe.
ACT 28:6	Benzo yembezela kuti avimbe cifukwa columiwa nanjoka kapena kumwalila. Koma pamene anayembekezela panthawi nowona kuit kulibe cinacitka codabwisa, banasintha maganizo nokamba ati enze ka mulungu.
ACT 28:7	Manje pafupi penzeli malo yenze ya afumu ya baja malo, zina lake Pubiliyasi. Anatilandila ndipo antipasa zofunikala kwa masiku ya tatu.
ACT 28:8	Cinacitika kuti atate bake ba Pubiliyasi anadwala mphepo namumala mwa kamwazi. Pamene Paulo anayenda kuliyeve, anamu pemphelela, nomuyika manja pali yeve, nomucilisa.
ACT 28:9	Pamene ivi vinacitika ivi, banthu bonse  paja pamalo benze odwala anabwela ndipo anacilisidwa.
ACT 28:10	Banthu banatilemekeza nazinthu zambili. Pamene tenzokonzekela  kuyambapo, banatipasa zamene tenzofuna.
ACT 28:11	Pamene panapita mwezi itatu, tinanyamuka mu boti yaku Alezandiriya bamene benze anasiya nthawi ya mphepo, wamene mutu wake wenze mubale wake.
ACT 28:12	Pamene anafika mu tauni ya Sirakozi, ninakhalako masiku yatatu.
ACT 28:13	Kucoka paja tinayenda nofika ku tauni ya Regiyamu. Pamene panapita siku imozi mphepo yaku mazulo inanyamuka, ndipo mumasiku yabili tanafika ku tauni ya Puteoli.
ACT 28:14	Kuja tinapeza abale ndipo banatiitana kuti timkhale nabeve masiku yali 7. Kucokaka apo tinayenda ku Romu.
ACT 28:15	Kucoka paja abale, pamene anamvela za ise, anabwela kukumana nase benangu kucoka ku Mariketi ya Apiyasi naku 3 Taveni. Pamene Apulo anabona abale, anayamika mulungu ndipo analimbikisiwa.
ACT 28:16	Pamene anangena mu Romu, Paulo anavomelezewa kunkhala yeka na msilikali wamene enzo mugandig'a.
ACT 28:17	Ndipo cinacitika kuti patapita masiku yatatu Paulo anaitana pamozi baja banthu benzeli asogoleli pakati pa Ayuda. Pamene anabwela pamozi, anakamba ati kwa beve, "Abale, ngankhale kuti sininapange mulandu kubanthu or mwambo wa atate bathu, ninapelekewa ngati kaidi kucoka ku Yelusalemu kupelekewa mumanja ya  ya Aroma.
ACT 28:18	Pamene bananifunsa, banafuna kunimasula, cifukwa kwenzelibe cifukwa kuti nipaiwe.
ACT 28:19	Koma apmene Ayuda anakamba kusushana zofuna yeve, bananipansa kukamba na Siza, ngakhale kuti sicenzeli monga nenzo leta mulandu kuli calo canga.
ACT 28:20	Cifukwa cakupeleka mulandu kwanga, ndiye apo, napempha kuti nikuwone nokamba naiwe. Nicifukwa cakuti Israyeli ali naco ciyembezo cakuti ndine omangiwa muma cheni aya."
ACT 28:21	Ndipo anakamba ati kwa yeve, Sitinalandile ma kalata kucokela ku Yudeya pali iwe, kapena abale aliwonse anabwela norepota kapena kukamba ciliconse coipa pali iwe.
ACT 28:22	Koma tifuna timvele kuli iwe camene uganiza pali aka ka gulu, cifukwa nocozibika kuli ise kuti pali ponse bakambapo zoipa pali keve."
ACT 28:23	Pamene banamufakila siku, banthu bambilianabwela kuli yeve monga malo yopumulilapo. Anapeleka nkhani kuli beve, nopelekela umboni pali ufumu wa Mulungu. Anayesa kubakonjesa pali Yesu, bonse ba lamulo ya Mose nawocokela ku aneneri, kucoka kuseni paka mumazulo.
ACT 28:24	Benangu anagonjela pazinthu zamene zinakambiwa, koma benangu sibanakhulupilire.
ACT 28:25	Pamene sibanagwilizane beka-beka, banacoka pamene Paulo anakamba aya mau amozi, "Mzimu Oyela anakamba bwino pali Yesaya mneneri kuli makolo banu.
ACT 28:26	Anakamba ati, 'Yenda kuli aba banthu nokamba ati, Pankhani yomvela muzamvela koma simumvesesa, Ndipo kuwona muzaona koma simuzaonesesa.
ACT 28:27	Cifukwa mitima ya aba banthu yankhala yoyuma, Matu yawo yanamvela movutika, banavala menso yawo; kuti basawone na menso yawo, nomvela na matu yawo, novesesa na mitima yawo, notembenuka, ndipo ningabacilise."
ACT 28:28	Cifukwa ca ici, mufunika kuziba kuti ici cipulumuso ca Mulungu cinapelekewa kuli Akunja, ndipo azavela.
ACT 28:29	(Ndipo pamene anakamba izi zinthu Ayuda anacokapo. Kweze kusushana ku kulu pakati pawo.)
ACT 28:30	Paulo anankhala zaka zibili munyumba yamene analenting'a yeka, ndipo analandila bonse bamene anamuyendela.
ACT 28:31	Enzo lalikila ufumu wa Mulungu ndipo enzo phunzisa zithu pali Ambuye Yesu Kristu mopanda mantha. Kulibe anamulesa.

ROM 1:0	Mutu 1
ROM 1:1	Paulo,kapolo wa Yesu Khristu, oitanidwa kunkhala mtumiki, opatulika ku uthenga wa Mulungu.
ROM 1:2	Uyu ndiye uthenga wamene analonjeza kudala kupitira mubaneneli na malemba oyera.
ROM 1:3	Uyu uthenga niwa mwana wake wamene anabadwa mu banja la Davide kulingana na thupi.
ROM 1:4	Kupitila mukuukisidwa kwa akufa, Anamuika kunkhala mwana wa Mulungu wa mphamvu kupitila mu muzimu wa chiyero -Yesu Christu Abuye watu.
ROM 1:5	Kupitila muli eve talandila chisomo na utumiki kamba ka kumvela kwa chikulupililo pakati pamaiko onse, kamba ka zina yake.
ROM 1:6	Pakati pa aya maiko naimwe mwaitaniwa kunkhala ba Yesu Christu.
ROM 1:7	Iyi kalata niyaonse ali ku Roma,okondewa na Mulungu,oitanidwa kunkhala banthu oyera.Chisomo chinkhale naimwe,namtendere kuchokela kwa Mulungu atate wathu na ambuye Yesu Christu.
ROM 1:8	Choyamba niyamika Mulungu kupitila mwa Yesu Christu chifukwa cha imwe monse. Chifukwa chikhulupililo chanu chalalikiwa kuziko yonse.
ROM 1:9	Pakuti Mulungu wamene nitumikila nimboni yanga,mumuzimu wanga,mu uthenga wa mwana wake, mwamene nimakambila pali imwe nthawi zambili.
ROM 1:10	Nimapempha nthawi zonse mumapemphelo kuti munjila iliyonse kuti pothela nizakwanilisa mwachifunilo cha Mulungu kuti nibwele kuli imwe.
ROM 1:11	Pakuti nifunisisa kumuonani,kuti nikamupaseni mphaso ya uzimu,kuti nikamulimbikiseni.
ROM 1:12	kutanthauza kuti nifunisisa ku kulimbikisidwa pamozi naimwe. kupitila mu chikhulupililo cha wina na mzake, imwe naine.
ROM 1:13	Manje sinifuna kuti munkhale osaziba abale, kuti nthawi zonse nenalikufuna kubwela kuli imwe(koma ninalesewa kufikila manje),kuti nikakololepo pali imwe,monga mwamene nakololapo pakati pa akunja.
ROM 1:14	Ndine wankhongole kuli Agiliki nabenangu bobwela kuchokela kwina,kuli ba nzelu nabalibe nzelu.
ROM 1:15	Ine nili okonzeka kulalikila uthenga kuli naimwe muli ku Roma.
ROM 1:16	Pakuti sinichita manyazi na uthenga,chifukwa ndiye mphamnvu ya Mulungu ku chipulumuso kwa aliyense okhulupilila,kuyambila Ayuda nama Giliki.
ROM 1:17	Chifukwa mwamene umo chiyelo cha Mulungu chivumbulusiwa kuchokela kuchikhulupililo kufikila ku chikhulupilo,monga mwamene chinalembewa kuti 'olungama azankala na umoyo mwa chikhulupililo.'
ROM 1:18	Pakuti mkwiyo wa Mulungu wavumbulusiwa kuchokela kumwamba kwa onse alibe umulungu na onse alibe chiyelo,amene posoba chiyelo abweza kumbuyo choonadi.
ROM 1:19	Ichi nichifukwa chakuti chija chamene chizibika pali Mulungu nichoonekela kwabeve.Chifukwa Mulungu wabaunikila.
ROM 1:20	Pakuti zozibika zake zamene sizioneka,zamene ni mphamvu zake zamuyaya na mwamene alili kulingana na umulungu wake,zaonekelatu po onekela, kuchokela pamene ziko lapansi inapangiwa,muvinthu vamene vinapangiwa.palibe angakambe kuti sininazibe.
ROM 1:21	Ichi ni chifukwa chakuti, banazibako vinthu pali Mulungu, sibanamukweze monga mulungu kapena kumuyamika. Koma banankhala opusa mumaganizo yao ndipo mitima yao ilibe nzelu inankala namudima.
ROM 1:22	Banaziona kuti nibanzelu koma banakhala opusa.
ROM 1:23	Banachinjanisa ulemelelo wa Mulungu wamene siungaonongeke na vinthu vamene vionongeka va umunthu, nyoni, vinyama vamendo yanai na nyama zokwaba.
ROM 1:24	Mulungu anabalekelela kuti bachite zolakalaka zao kulingana namutima wao,kuti mathupi yao yankhale yosebanyika pakati pao.
ROM 1:25	Nibeve bana chinjanisa choonadi cha Mulungu na boza,ndipo banapembeza chilengedwe mumalo mopembeza mulungu,wamene alambiliwa kwamuyayaya,Amen.
ROM 1:26	Kamba ka ichi Mulungu anabapasa kuzilakolako zosayenela,chifukwa bazimai babo banachinjanisa zilakolako zabo na vamene vishusana na chilengedwe cha umunthu.
ROM 1:27	Chimozi mozi amuna nao anasiya zilakolako zao na azimai nakuyamba ku kufunana beka beka bamuna. Aba benze bamuna bamene banachita zonyansa na bamuna banzao nakulandila chilango pazonyansa banachita.
ROM 1:28	Chifukwa sibanavomeleze maganizo ya Mulungu mu nzelu zabo, anabapeleka kunzelu zopusa,kuti bachite vinthu vosayenela.
ROM 1:29	Banazuliwa nauchimo wina uliwonse, zoipa, kunkala kwa uchimo, maganizo yoipa.Niwozuliwa na zokumbwila, ndewo, chinyengo,namaganizo yoipa.
ROM 1:30	Nibamijedo,okamba zoipa pabanzao, nakuzonda Mulungu.Niba chiwawa,bantota,nakuzitukumula.Ndiye bamayamba voipa vonse, sibamvelela makolo babo.
ROM 1:31	Balibe kumvesesa, siungabakulupilile,balibe zilakolako zaumunthu, balibe chifundo.
ROM 1:32	Bayaziba malamulo ya Mulungu, kuti bamene bachita ivi bafunika kufa.Koma sibachita chabe ivi veka koma bavomekeza nabamene bavichita.
ROM 2:0	Mutu 2
ROM 2:1	Siuzapasiwa mpata iwe munthu wamene uweluza,chifukwa chamene uweluza muli wina naiwe uzaweluziwa.Pakuti iwe wamene uweluza uchita vimozi mozi.
ROM 2:2	Koma tiziba kuti chiweluzo cha Mulungu chilingana na zoona chikagwela pali bamene bavichita ivi vinthu.
ROM 2:3	Koma ona ichi iwe munthu, wokonda kuweluza banthu bamene bachita ivi olo kuti naiwe uchita vimozi .Nanga uzauthaba chiweluzo cha Mulungu?
ROM 2:4	kapena uganiza pangono pazaulemelelo waubwino  wake,chilango chake chamene kuchedwa kwa chilango chake,na kuleza mtima kwake?Siuziba kuti ubwino wake ufanika kukupeleka kukulapa?
ROM 2:5	Koma nikamba ka kulimba mtima nakusalapa  kwa mtima wanu kuti,kuti muzisungila mweka mkwiyo pasiku ya mkwiyo,ndiye kuti,siku ya chivumbuluso cha chiweluzo cha Mulungu choyera.
ROM 2:6	Azalipila muthu aliyense muyeso wazinthu zamene anachita.
ROM 2:7	Kuli awo olingana na kupitiliza,zochita zabwino,afuna funa kubapembeza,kubalemekeza nakubapasa umoyo wosatha ulibe chiphuphu.
ROM 2:8	Koma kuli baja wofuna chabe zao,bamene sibamnvelela chazoona koma amnvelela uchimo,mkwiyo nakukalipa kopitilila kwamene kuzabwela.
ROM 2:9	Mulungu azaleta mabvuto na kusamnvela bwino pa moyo uliwonse wamene wachita chimo,kuyambila kwa Ayuda na ba Giliki.
ROM 2:10	Koma chiyamiko,ulemu na mtendere vizabwela kuli aliyense wamene achita vabwino.Kwa Ayuda nama Giliki onse.Chifukwa kulibe kusankha kwa Mulungu.
ROM 2:11	Koma kubambili bamene banachimwa kulibe lamulo,bazaonongeka futi kulibe lamulo.
ROM 2:12	Bambili bazachimwa naulemu wa lamulo,bazaweluziwa na lamulo.
ROM 2:13	Pakuti sibaja womnvelela lamulo oyera pamenso pa Mulungu,koma ochita lamulo ndiye bamene bazalungamisiwa.
ROM 2:14	Pakuti akunja,bamene balibe lamulo,bachita mwaumunthu vinthu va lamulo,bankala lamulo kwabeve beka,olo kuti balibe lamulo.
ROM 2:15	Pali ivi bawonesa kuti machitidwe yofunika na lamulo niyolembeka mumitima yao.Chikumbumtima chao chichitila umboni kuli beve,namaganizo yao yabanamizila kapena yabachingiliza kuli beve na kuli Mulungu.
ROM 2:16	Icho chizachitika pasiku yamene Mulungu azaweluza visinsi vabanthu onse,kulingana na uthenga wanga,kupitila mwa Yesu Christu.
ROM 2:17	Koma ngati uziitana muyuda,upumulila pa lamulo nakuzitukumulila mwa Mulungu,
ROM 2:18	Ndipo aziba chifunilo chake,nakuziba zinthu zabwino chifukwa munapasiwa zochita kuchokela ku lamulo.
ROM 2:19	Ngati musimikizikila kuti ndimwe osogolela osayangana,nyali kulibaja bali mumdima.
ROM 2:20	Osogolela opusa,mphunzisi wa bana bangono,nakuti mulinacho mumalamulo,nzelu na choonadi,nanga ichi chimukhuzani bwanji mwamene munkhalila umoyo wanu?
ROM 2:21	Imwe bamene muphunzisa benangu,simuziphunzisa?Imwe bamene mumalalikila kuti osaiba,mumaiba?
ROM 2:22	Imwe bamene mukamba kuti osachita chigololo,mumachita chigololo?Imwe bamene muzonda mafano,mumaba mu chechi?
ROM 2:23	Imwe bamene mumasangalala mumalamulo,simumalekeza Mulungu kupitila mukupwanya lamulo yanu?
ROM 2:24	Pakuti zina ya Mulungu siilemekezeka pakati ka akunja kamba ka imwe,monga mwamene chinalembeka.
ROM 2:25	Pakuti mdulidwe umakuphindulilani nga mumnvelela lamulo,koma ngati mupwanya lamulo mudulidwe wanu siunkhala mudulidwe.
ROM 2:26	Manje ngati munthu osadulidwa asunga zofunika zalamulo,kusadulidwa kwake sikungankhala kudulidwa?Nanga wamene sali odulidwa mu umunthu sazakususani ngati wasunga lamulo?
ROM 2:27	Ichi nichifukwa chakuti muli nalamulo yolembeka na mdulidwe,koma muyipwanya lamulo.
ROM 2:28	Pakuti simuyuda wamene nimuyuda kunja,monga mwamene mdulidwe wakunja simudulidwe.
ROM 2:29	Koma nimu Yuda amene nimu Yuda mkati,koma mdulidwe niwuja wamumtima,mumuzimu osati mukalata.Chiyamiko cha munthu wotelo sichichokela kubanthu koma kuli Mulungu.
ROM 3:0	Mutu 3
ROM 3:1	Nanga kusiyana kwa muyuda kuli kuti?Nanga phindu ya mdulidwe ipati?
ROM 3:2	Nichikulu mnjila iliyonse.Choyamba  pazonse ayuda analandila chivumbuluso kuchokela kwa Mulungu.
ROM 3:3	Nanga ngati Ayuda benangu benzelibe chikhulupililo?Ninsi kusakhulupilila kwao kuzalenga kukhulupilila kwa mulungu kunkhala kulibe phindu?
ROM 3:4	Chisankale telo.Koma lekani Mulungu apezeke wazoona,olo kuti munthu aliyense niwaboza.Monga mwamene chalembedwa,kuti mukaonekele kunkhala oyera mumau yanu,nakuti mukapambane pamene mukumana na chiweluzo.
ROM 3:5	Koma ngati kusalungama kwathu kuonesa kulungama kwa Mulungu.Tingakambe chani?Kodi tizakamba kuti Mulungu siwolungama kuti alete mkwiyo wake pali ise?(Nisebenzesa mkangano waumunthu)
ROM 3:6	Chisankhale telo.Ndaba Mulungu azaweluza bwanji ziko lapansi?
ROM 3:7	Koma ngati choonadi cha Mulungu kupitila muboza yanga chileta chiyamiko chambili,nanga nichani muniweluza kunkhala ochimwa?
ROM 3:8	Nanga nichani monga mwamene batinamizila kukamba,monga mwamene benangu bavomekeza,tiyeni tichite choipa kuti chabwino chibwele?Chiweluzo pali beve nicholinga.
ROM 3:9	Nichani manje?Nanga ise tizichosapo?awe.Chifukwa tinanamizila kudala a yuda nama giliki,onse,kunkhala pansi pachimo.
ROM 3:10	Ichi chilimonga mwamene chinalembeka.Palibe olungama,olo umozi.
ROM 3:11	Palibe wamene amnvesesa.Kulibe wamene afunisisa Mulungu.
ROM 3:12	Aliyense anapita patali.Onse pamozi banankhala balibe phindu.Palibe wamene achita chabwino,palibe olo umozi.
ROM 3:13	Pamkosi pao pali monga manda yoseguka.Malilime yao yanama boza.Ululu wanjoka ulipansi pamalilime yao.
ROM 3:14	Kamwa kao nikozula na matembeleleo na mkwiyo.
ROM 3:15	Mendo yao yanachidwi kukhesa mwazi.
ROM 3:16	Chionongeko namabvuto vili munjila yao.
ROM 3:17	Aba banthu sibanazibe njila yamtendere.
ROM 3:18	Palibe mantha ya Mulungu pamenso pao.
ROM 3:19	Manje tiziba kuti chilichonse chamene lamulo ikamba,ikamba kuli baja bali pansi pa lamulo.Ichi nichakuti kamwa kalikonse kakavalike,nakuti ziko yonse yapansi ikaweluzidwe na Mulungu.
ROM 3:20	Ichi nikamba kakuti palibe thupi izalungamisiwa na ntchito za lamulo mumenso mwake.Kupitila mulamulo mubwela nzelu zauchimo.
ROM 3:21	Koma manje kuchoselako lamulo,chiyelo cha Mulungu chazibika.Chinapelekewa umboni na lamulo na aneneli,
ROM 3:22	Ndiye kuti chiyelo cha Mulungu kupitila muchikhulupililo mwa Yesu Christu kuli baja bokhulupilila.Chifukwa palibe kusiyanisa.
ROM 3:23	Pakuti onse anachimwa nakupelebela ku ulemelelo wa Mulungu.
ROM 3:24	Ndipo balungamisiwa na chisomo kupitila mu kuomboledwa kuli mwa Yesu Christu.
ROM 3:25	Pakuti Mulungu anapeleka Yesu Christu kunkala oombola kupitila muchikhulupililo mumwazi wake.Anapeleka Yesu kuti akaonesele chilungamo,chifukwa sanaikeko nzelu kumachimo yakumbuyo mukuleza mtima kwake.Ivi vonse vinachitika kuti akaonesele chiyelo chake pa nthawi ino.
ROM 3:26	Ichi chenze telo kuti akaziwonesele olungama,nakuonesela kuti alungamisa aliyense kamba ka chikhulupililo mwa Yesu Christu.
ROM 3:27	Manje kuzitukumula kuli kuti?Kuchosewapo.pambali iti?yazitchito?iyai koma pambali ya chikhulupililo.
ROM 3:28	Tilize ninshi kuti munthu alungamisiwa na chikhulupililo osati nancthito za lamulo.
ROM 3:30	Kapena Mulungu ni Mulungu waba Yuda chabe?Nanga si Mulungu wa akunja futi?koma ngati Mulungu niumozi,azalungamisa odulidwa na chikhulupililo,na osadulidwa na chikhulupililo.
ROM 3:31	Ninshi tichosepo lamulo kupitila muchikhulupililo?Chisankhale telo.Tisungilila lamulo.
ROM 4:0	Mutu 4
ROM 4:1	Manje tizakamba chani kuti Abram,atate wathu mwa thupi anapeza?
ROM 4:2	Ndaba ngati Abram analungamisiwa nazitchito,asembe alinayo danga yotumbama,koma osati kutumbama mwa Yesu.
ROM 4:3	Chifukwa malemba akamba chani? Abram anakhulupilila Mulungu ndipo chinapasiwa kwa eve chiyelo.
ROM 4:4	Manje kuli wamene asebenza,malipilo yake sichaulele,koma chamene chilichake.
ROM 4:5	Koma kuli wamene sasebenza koma akhulupilila muli wamene alungamisa osalungama,chikhulupililo chake chiyesewa chiyelo.
ROM 4:6	David naye anakamba daliso kuli muntu wamene Mulungu aona oyera kopanda zintchito.
ROM 4:7	Anakamba kuti odalisika nibaja bamene mphulupulu zao zinakhululukiwa,amene machimo yao yanaphimbiwa.
ROM 4:8	Odalisika niwuja munthu wamene Mulungu sazabelengela machimo yao.
ROM 4:9	Manje nishi iyi nidaliso yokambiwa chabe kuli baja bamene niwodulidwa,olo ili nakuliosadulidwa?Pakuti tikamba kuti chikhulupilio chinabelengewa kwa Abram ngati chiyero.
ROM 4:10	Manje chinabelengewa bwanji?pamene Abram anze mumudulidwe,kapena pamene akalibe kudulidwa?Sichinali Mmudulidwe koma mukusadulidwa.
ROM 4:11	Abram analandila chiwoneselo cha mudulidwe.Ichi chenze chisimikizilo chachiyelo cha chikhulupililo chamene anali nacho kudala pamene sanali mumudulidwe.Chochoka muchiwoneselo ichi chinali chakuti anankhala tate wa onse amene anakhulupilila,olo kuti siwodulidwa.
ROM 4:12	Ichi chitanthauza kuti chiyelo chinabelengewa kwa beve.Ichi futi chitanthauza Abram anankhala tate wa baja wodulidwa osati chabe kuli baja wodulidwa koma nakuli baja wolondola ndondomeko za chikhululupilo cha atate wathu Abram akalibe kudulidwa.
ROM 4:13	Pakuti lonjezo kuti Abram nakuli mubadwo wake wamene unafanika kulobela ziko lapansi,sinabwele kamba ka lamulo kupitila muchiyelo cha chikhululupililo.
ROM 4:14	Ndaba ngati baja bamene bankhala na lamulo bangakhale oloba,nisnhi chikhulupililo chilichabe,ndipo lonjezo ilibe phindu.
ROM 4:15	Chifukwa lamulo ileta mkwiyo,koma pamene palibe lamulo,palibe kuchimwa.
ROM 4:16	Mwaichi nimwa chikhulupililo,kuti lonjezo ikapumulile pa chisomo,nakuti ikasimikiziwe kuli mubadwo wa Abram, osati chabe baja bali pansi palamulo koma nakuli bamene bagabana muchikhulupililo cha Abram. Ni tate wa ise tonse.
ROM 4:17	Monga mwamene nicholembedwa kuti'Nakupanga kunkala tate wamaziko yambili. Abram anali pamenso pa uyo wamene anakhulupilila, Mulungu, wamene apasa moyo kuli bakufa nakuitana vinthu vamene sivilipo monga vilipo kunkhalapo.
ROM 4:18	Kuchoselako vonse vamaonekedwe yakunja,Abram anakhulupilila Mulungu nachisimikizo cha msogolo.Ndipo anakhala tate wama ziko yambili,kulingana navamene vinakambika,Uzakhala mutundu wako.
ROM 4:19	Sanafoke muchikhulupililo.Abram anamnvesesa kuti thupi yake sinali kukwanisa kukhala na bana(Chifukwa anali nazaka makhumi khumi)Anazindikila futi kuti sara naye nalingakwanise kubala bana.
ROM 4:20	Koma kamba ka lonjezo ya Mulungu,Abram sananyalanyaze mukusamukhulupilila,koma anapasiwa mphamnvu muchikhulupililo nakumuyamika Mulungu.
ROM 4:21	Anakhala nacho chisimikizo kuti wamene analonjeza,analinso nayo mphamnvu yofikilisa.
ROM 4:22	Motelo naichi chinabelengewa kwa eve monga chiyelo.
ROM 4:23	Manje sichinalembeke kuti chikaphindulile eve eka, kuti chinabelengeka kwa eve.
ROM 4:24	Chinalembeka futi kwa ise, kwa eve amene chizabelengeka,ise amene tikhulupilila mwa eve wamene anaukisa Yesu mbuye wathu kwa akufa.
ROM 4:25	Uyu ndiye wamene anapelekewa kamba ka mphulupulu zathu ndipo anaukisiwa kutilungamisa ise.
ROM 5:0	Mutu 5
ROM 5:1	Pakuti tinayelesewa na chikhulupililo,Tilinawo mtendere mwa Mulungu kupitila mwa Yesu Christu.
ROM 5:2	Kupitila mulieve tilinadanga kupitila muchikhulupililo,muchisomo chake tiimilila.Tisangalala na chisimikizo Mulungu atipasa chasogolo,Chisimikizo chakuti tizagabana mu ulemelelo wa Mulungu.
ROM 5:3	Osati chabe ichi,koma tisangalala futi mumasauso yathu.
ROM 5:4	Tiziba kuti masauso yabala kupilila,Kupilila kubala kuvomelezewa,ndipo kuvomelezewa kubala chisimikizo cha sogolo lathu.
ROM 5:5	Ichi chisimikizo sichitaisa mtima,chifukwa chikondi cha Mulungu chathiliwa mumitima yathu kupitila mu Muzimu Oyera,wamene anapasiwa kuli ise.
ROM 5:6	Chifukwa pamene tenze tikali ofoka,panthawi yake Yesu anafela banthu osalungama.
ROM 5:7	Pakuti nichovuta kuti umozi afele olungama. Ndiye kuti kapena munthu angafune kufela munthu wabwino.
ROM 5:8	Koma Mulungu aonesela chikondi chake kwa ise, chifukwa pamene tenze tikali ochimwa,Yesu anatifela ise.
ROM 5:9	Kwambiri manje,lomba chifukwa tinalungamisiwa na mwazi wake.
ROM 5:10	Pakuti ngati pamene tenze tikali badani,tinalungamisiwa kwa Mulungu kupitila mu infa ya mwana wake,kupitililapo,pamene talungamisiwa kwa Mulungu,tipulumusiwa na umoyo wake.
ROM 5:11	Osati chabe ichi,koma tisangalala futi mwa Mulungu kupitila muli mbuye wathu Yesu Christu, wamene kupitila mwa eve talandila kulungamisiwa kwa Mulungu.
ROM 5:12	Kotelo manje,kupitila mu munthu umozi chimo inangena muzioko lapansi,munjila yamene iyi infa inangena kupitila mu chimo.Ndipo infa inasefukila ku banthu onse,chifukwa onse anachimwa.
ROM 5:13	Pakuti kufikila pamene lamulo,chimo inali muziko,pakuti palibe kubelengewa kwa chimo ngati palibe lamulo.
ROM 5:14	Kotelonso,infa inalamulila kuchokela kwa Abram kufikila kwa Mose,ngakhale pali baja bamene sibanachimwe kulingana na kusamnvela kwa Adam,wamene alichoonelako cha uyo wamene abwela.
ROM 5:15	Olo kuti vili telo, mphaso siili monga chimo.Koma ngati kupitila muchimo ya munthu omozi,bambili banafa,chisomo cha mulungu chinachita kwambili kupitila na mphaso na chisomo cha munthu umozi,Yesu Christu,vipaka kuli bambili.
ROM 5:16	Pakuti mphaso siili monga vochoka muli munthu ochimwa.Chifukwa munjila imozi,chiweluzo chakususiwa chinabwela kamba ka chimo ya munthu umozi.Munjila inangu,mphaso yochokela mukulungamisiwa inabwela pamene bambili banachimwa.
ROM 5:17	Pakuti ngati kupitila mumachimo ya banthu umozi,infa inalamulila kupitila mu umozi,kwambili futi baja bamene balandila chisomo chambili,na mphaso ya chiyelo izalamulila kupitila mu omuyo waumozi,Yesu Christu.
ROM 5:18	Apa manje kupitila muchimo imozi,Banthu onse anasusiwa,motelonso kupitila mumachitidwe ya chiyelo,kunakhala kulungamisiwa kwa umoyo wa banthu bonse.
ROM 5:19	Kupitila mukusamnvela kwa munthu umozi,bambili banankhala ochimwa,futi kupitila mukumnvela kwa umozi bambili bapangiwa oyela.
ROM 5:20	Koma lamulo inangemo,kuchitila kuti chimo ipake. Koma chimo inapaka, chisomo chinapakilako.
ROM 5:21	Ichi chinachitika kuti mwamene chimo inalamulila mu infa, momwemonso chisomo chikalamulile kupitila mu chiyelo ku umoyo osatha kupitila mwa Yesu Christ mbuye wathu.
ROM 6:0	Mutu 6
ROM 6:1	Nanga chizakamba chani?ninshi tipitilize kuchimwa kuti chisomo chipake?
ROM 6:2	Chisankhale telo. Ise bamene tinafa,tizankhala bwanji futi muchimo?
ROM 6:3	Nanga simuziba kuti bambili bamene banabatiziwa mwa Yesu Christu, anabatiziwa mu infa yake?
ROM 6:4	Tinaikiwa nay,kupitila mu ubatizo mu infa yake.Ivi vinachitika kuti monga mwamene Yesu anaukisidwa kwa akufa,na ulemelelo wa atate,kuti naise tikayende mu umoyo wamanje.
ROM 6:5	Chifukwa ngati taphatikizana naye muchifanizilo cha infa,tizaphatikizana naye mukuukisidwa.
ROM 6:6	Tiziba ichi,munthu wathu wakudala anapachikiwa,kuchitila kuti ya uchimo ikaonongeke.Ichi chinachitika kuti tisankhale futi akapolo ku chimo.
ROM 6:7	Eve wamene anafa anayesedwa oyela na ulemu wa chimo.
ROM 6:8	Koma ngati tinafa na Yesu,tikhulupilila kuti tizankhala na eve futi.
ROM 6:9	Tiziba kuti Yesu anaukisiwa ku infa,nakuti siwakufa futi.Infa ilibe ulamulilo pali eve.
ROM 6:10	Kulingana na infa yamene anafa ku chimo,anafa kamozi pa onse.Koma umoyo wamene ankhala,ankhalila Mulungu.
ROM 6:11	Munjila imozi mufanika muziyese bakufa ku chimo,koma ba moyo kwa Mulungu mwa Christu Yesu.
ROM 6:12	Motelo musalole kuti chimo ilamulile mumathupi yanu kuti musamnvelele zilakolako zake.
ROM 6:13	Osapeleka viwalo va thupi yanu ku chimo,kunkhala zida zosebenzesewa ku vinthu vosaenela. Koma zipelekeni kwa Mulungu monga bakufa bamene manje bali namoyo. Pelekani viwalo vanu kwa Mulungu kuti visebenzesewe ku chiyelo.
ROM 6:14	Musalole chimo kunkhala na ulamulilo pali imwe. Pakuti simuli pansi pa lamulo koma pansi pa chisomo.
ROM 6:15	Nichani manje?tichimwe kamba kakuti sitili pansi pa lamulo? Koma pansi pa chisomo. Chisankhla telo.
ROM 6:16	Nanga simuziba kuti kuwamene muzipeleka monga akapolo ndiye wamene munvela,wamene mufanika kumnvela? Ichi nichazoona olo kuti ndimwe akapolo ku chimo yamene ipeleka ku infa, kapena akapolo ku kumnvela kwamene kusogolela ku chiyelo.
ROM 6:17	Koma chiyamiko kwa Mulungu.pakuti mwenze akapolo ku chimo, koma munamnvelela mumutima ndondomeko ya chiphunziso chamene munalandila.
ROM 6:18	Mwankhala omasuka ku chimo,mwapangiwa akapolo ba chiyelo.
ROM 6:19	Nikamba monga munthu kamba ka zofoka zanuMonga mwamene munapelekela mathupi monga akapolo azinthu zonyansa na zoipa, munjila  imozi manje, pelekani ziwalo zathupi ngati akapolo ku  chiyelo kuyelesedwa.
ROM 6:20	Pakuti pamene mwenze  akapolo ba chimo,mwenze omasulidwa ku chiyelo.
ROM 6:21	Panthawi ija, nizipaso zabwanji zamene mwenze nazo pazinthu zimumnvesenai nsoni manje. Chifukwa vochoka mwa ivo vinthu ni infa.
ROM 6:22	Koma manje pamene mwamasuka ku uchimo,ndipo mwankhala akapolo ba Mulungu.mulinamphaso yanu yoyelesedwa. Zotulukamo ni umoyo osatha.
ROM 6:23	Pakuti mphoto yauchimo ni infa,koma mphaso ya Mulungu ni umoyo osasila mwa Yesu Christu mfumu yathu.
ROM 7:0	Mutu 7
ROM 7:1	Kapena simuziba abale (Chifukwa nikamba nabanthu bamene baziba lamulo), kuti lamulo ima lamulila muntu umoyo wake onse?
ROM 7:2	Pakuti mkazi wokwatiliwa niwomangika na lamulo kuli mwamuna wake pamene akali moyo. Koma ngati mwamuna wake wafa,ankhala omasuka ku lamulo ya chikwati.
ROM 7:3	Kotelo pamene mwamuna wake akali na moyo,ngati ankhala namuna winangu anankhala mkazi wachigololo. Koma ngati mwamuna wake wafa,ankhala omasuka ku lamulo, sankhala wachigololo ngati ankhala na mwamuna winangu.
ROM 7:4	kotelo abale munapangiwa bakufa ku lamulo kupitila muthupi ya Yesu Christu.Ichi chili telo kuti mukaphatikizane kuli wina,ndiye kuti,kuli uja wamene anaukisiwa kwa akufa kuti tikabale zipaso kwa Mulungu.
ROM 7:5	Pakuti pamene tenze muthupi,muzilako lako zauchimo,zoukisidwa na lamulo,zinali pantchito mumathupi athu kubala zipaso za infa.
ROM 7:6	Koma lomba tamasuka ku lamulo.Tinafa kuli chija chamene chinatipanga ukapolo. Ichi chinankhla telo kuti tikatumikile mu umoyo wasopano mumuzimu,osati mukalata yakale.
ROM 7:7	Tizakamba chani manje? Ninshi lamulo nichimo payeka? Chisankhale telo, koma sembe sininazibe chimo, kuti sichinali kupitila mu lamulo.chifukwa sembe sininazibe kukhumbwila chamwine pokhapo lamulo yakamba,
ROM 7:8	Koma chimo inatenga Mpata kupitila mu lamulo nakuleta chilakolako muli ine. Pakuti kulibe lamulo chimo niyaakufa.
ROM 7:9	Panthawi inangu nenze wamoyo kulibe lamulo,koma pamene lamulo inabwela,chimo inankhala na moyo ndipo ninfa.
ROM 7:10	Lamulo yamene yenzofunika kuleta omoyo inasanduka infa kuli ine
ROM 7:11	Pakuti chimo inankhala na Mpata kupitila mu lamulo nakunama ine.Kupitila mu lamulo inanipaya.
ROM 7:12	Kotelo lamulo niyoyela, ndipo lamulo niyolungama, niyoyela, ndipo niyabwino.
ROM 7:13	Manje ninshi chabwino chinankhala infa kuli ine?Chisankhale telo. Koma chimo kuchitila kuti ikaonekele kuti nichimo, kupitila mu chamene nichabwino, chinabwelesa infa muli ine.Ichi chinachitika kuti kupitila mu lamulo, kuti chimo ikankhale chimo kupitilila malile.
ROM 7:14	Pakuti tiziba kuti lamulo niyauzimu, koma ine ndine waku thupi.Ninagulisiwa ku ukapolo wa chimo.
ROM 7:15	Pakuti chamene nichita,sinimanimnvesesa,chifukwa chamene nifuna kuchita,sinichichita,ndipo chamene nizonda ndiye chamene nichita.
ROM 7:16	Koma ngati nichita chamene sinifuna kuchita,nigwilizana na lamulo kuti lamulo niyabwino.
ROM 7:17	Koma manje sindine wamene achichita ichi, koma chimo yamene inkhala muli ine.
ROM 7:18	Pakuti niziba kuti muli ine, ndiye kuti mu thupi yanga,mulibe chabwino. Chilakolako cha zinthu zabwino chilimo muli ine, koma sinikwanisa kuchichita.
ROM 7:19	Pakuti chabwino chamene niifuna sinichita,koma choipa chamene sinifuna kuchita,ndiye chamene nichita.
ROM 7:20	Manje ngati nichita chamene sinifuna kuchita,ninshi sindine nichichita, koma chimo yamene inkhala muli ine.
ROM 7:21	Nipeza kansi lamulo muli ine kuti nifuna kuchita chabwino, koma choipa ndiye chili muli ine.
ROM 7:22	Pakuti nisangalala na lamulo ya Mulungu na munthu wamkati,
ROM 7:23	Koma niwona chinthu chosiyana muziwalo za thupi yanga. Chimenyana na ichi chinthu chanyawane munzelu zanga. Chinisunga ukapolo na nkhani ya uchimo muziwalo zathupi yanga.
ROM 7:24	Ndine munthu obvutisidwa,ndani azanimasulako ku infa yathupi?
ROM 7:25	Koma tionga Mulungu kupitila mwa Yesu Christu mfumu yathu.Kotelo ine nitumikila lamulo ya Mulungu na nzelu zanga. Koma na thupi yanga nitumikila mphamnvu yauchimo.
ROM 8:0	Mutu 8
ROM 8:1	Kulibe manje kususiwa kwa baja bali mwa Yesu Christu.
ROM 8:2	Pakuti lamulo ya muzimu ya umoyo mwa Yesu Christu yanimasula ku mphamnvu ya chimo na infa.
ROM 8:3	Chifukwa chamene lamulo sinakwanise chifukwa inalibe mphamnvu kupitila muthupi, Mulungu anakwanisa. Anatuma mwana wake  uchimo muchifanizilo cha uchimo wa munthu, kunkhala chopeleka ku chimo, anasusa chimo muthupi.
ROM 8:4	Anachita ichi kuti, zofunika za lamulo zikwanilisike muli ise,ise bamene sitiyenda kulingana na thupi, koma kulingana na muzimu.
ROM 8:5	Baja bamene bankhala kulingana na thupi,bayika nzelu ku zinthu zakuthupi, koma baja bamene bankhala kulingana na muzimu, baika nzelu kuzinthu zaku uzimu.
ROM 8:6	Pakuti kuika nzelu pazathupi ni infa.koma kuika nzelu kuzinthu zaku uzimu niumoyo namtendere.
ROM 8:7	Kuika nzelu pazinthu zakuthupi nimkwiyo kwa Mulungu.chifukwa sichigonjela ku lamulo ya Mulungu,ndipo sichikwanisa kuchita telo.
ROM 8:8	Baja bamene bali muthupi sibangamukondwelese Mulungu.
ROM 8:9	Koma imwe simuli muthupi koma mumuzimu, Ngati nizoona kuti muzimu wa Mulungu unkhala muli imwe.koma ngati mutnu alibe muzimu wa Christu, ninshi siali wake.
ROM 8:10	Koma ngati Yesu ali muli imwe,ninshi thupi niyakufa ku chimo, koma muzimu ali namoyo kuchiyelo.
ROM 8:11	Ngati muzimu wamene anausa Yesu Christu ankhala muli imwe, uja wamene anausa Christu ku infa azapasa futi moyo kumathupi yanu kupitila mu muzimu wamene akhala muli imwe.
ROM 8:12	Manje abale na imwe bankhongole,koma kuthupi kunkhala monga baku thupi.
ROM 8:13	Chifukwa ngati munkhala kulingana na thupi, mulipafupi nakufa, koma ngati mwauzimu,mupaya zochitika za thupi, muzankhala na moyo.
ROM 8:14	Koma onse bamene basogololewa na muzimu nibana ba Mulungu.
ROM 8:15	Pakuti simunalandile muzimu waukapolo kuti munvele mantha. Munalandila muzimu wakutengewa monga bana, muli eve tilila kuti Aba Tate.
ROM 8:16	Muzimu uchitila umboni na muzimu wathu kuti ndise bana ba Mulungu.
